KAZ02.10.25/ Speaking of faults in birth, person, and conduct — that is censure.

children.text: KAZ02.10.26/ guṇa.vacanam eteṣām eva praśaṃsā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.26/ Speaking of their merits — that is praise.

children.text: KAZ02.10.27/ "katham etad" iti pṛcchā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.27/ 'How is this?' — that is inquiry.

children.text: KAZ02.10.28/ "evam" ity ākhyānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.28/ 'Thus [it is]' — that is narration.

children.text: KAZ02.10.29/ "dehi" ity arthanā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.29/ 'Give' — that is entreaty.

children.text: KAZ02.10.30/ "na prayacchāmi" iti pratyākhyānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.30/ 'I will not give' — that is refusal.

children.text: KAZ02.10.31/ "ananurūpaṃ bhavataḥ" ity upālambhaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.31/ 'This is unworthy of you' — that is reproof.

children.text: KAZ02.10.32/ "mā kārṣīḥ" iti pratiṣedhaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.32/ 'Do not do this' — that is prohibition.

children.text: KAZ02.10.33/ "idaṃ kriyatām" iti codanā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.33/ 'Let this be done' — that is command.

children.text: KAZ02.10.34/ "yo^ahaṃ sa bhavān, yan mama dravyaṃ tad bhavataḥ" ity upagrahaḥ sāntvam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.34/ 'What I am, you are; what is my property is yours' — this embracing [assurance] is conciliation.

children.text: KAZ02.10.35/ vyasana.sāhāyyam abhyupapattiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.35/ Offering help in calamity — that is promise of assistance.

children.text: KAZ02.10.36/ sadoṣam āyati.pradarśanam abhibhartsanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.36/ Showing the faults along with future consequences — that is threatening.

children.text: KAZ02.10.37/ anunayas trividho^artha.kṛtāv atikrame puruṣa.ādi.vyasane ca^iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.37/ Appeasing is threefold: in connection with a task, a transgression, and a personal calamity.

children.text:
KAZ02.10.38ab/ prajñāpana.ājñā.paridāna.lekhās tathā parīhāra.nisṛṣṭi.lekhau /[ś]
KAZ02.10.38cd/ prāvṛttikaś ca pratilekha eva sarvatragaś ca^iti hi śāsanāni //[ś]
KAZ02.10.39ab/ anena vijñāpitam evam āha tad dīyatāṃ ced yadi tattvam asti /[ś]
KAZ02.10.39cd/ rājñaḥ samīpe vara.kāram āha prajñāpanā^eṣā vividhā^upadiṣṭā //[ś]
KAZ02.10.40ab/ bhartur ājñā bhaved yatra nigraha.anugrahau prati /[ś]
KAZ02.10.40cd/ viśeṣeṇa tu bhṛtyeṣu tad.ājñā.lekha.lakṣaṇam //[ś]
KAZ02.10.41ab/ yathā.arha.guṇa.samyuktā pūjā yatra^upalakṣyate /[ś]
KAZ02.10.41cd/ apy ādhau paridāne vā bhavatas tāv upagrahau //[ś]
KAZ02.10.42ab/ jāter viśeṣeṣu pareṣu caiva grāmeṣu deśeṣu ca teṣu teṣu /[ś]
KAZ02/10.42cd/ anugraho yo nṛpter nideśāt taj.jñaḥ parīhāra iti vyavasyet //[ś]
KAZ02.10.43ab/ nisṛṣṭisthā^āpanā kārya.karaṇe vacane tathā /[ś]
KAZ02.10.43cd/ eṣa vācika.lekhaḥ syād bhaven naisṛṣṭiko^api vā //[ś]
KAZ02.10.44ab/ vividhāṃ daiva.samyuktāṃ tattvajāṃ caiva mānuṣīm /[ś]
KAZ02.10.44cd/ dvi.vidhāṃ tāṃ vyavasyanti pravṛttiṃ śāsanaṃ prati //[ś]
KAZ02.10.45ab/ dṛṣṭvā lekhaṃ yathā.tattvaṃ tataḥ pratyanubhāṣya ca /[ś]
KAZ02.10.45cd/ pratilekho bhavet kāryo yathā rāja.vacas tathā //[ś]
KAZ02.10.46ab/ yatra^īśvarāṃś ca^adhikṛtāṃś ca rājā rakṣā.upakārau pathika.artham āha /[ś]
KAZ02.10.46cd/ sarvatrago nāma bhavet sa mārge deśe ca sarvatra ca veditavyaḥ //
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.10.38ab/ Notification, order, grant, and exemption documents, and authorization,
KAZ02.10.38cd/ report, reply, and passport — these are [the types of] edicts.
KAZ02.10.39ab/ 'By this person it has been notified; he says thus; let it be given if the claim is true;'
KAZ02.10.39cd/ 'he states the matter of choice before the king' — this is the notification, taught as being of various kinds.
KAZ02.10.40ab/ Where the master's command applies regarding punishment and reward,
KAZ02.10.40cd/ especially concerning servants — that is defined as an order-document.
KAZ02.10.41ab/ Where honor combined with due merits is observed,
KAZ02.10.41cd/ whether in pledge or in grant — these two are acts of favor.
KAZ02.10.42ab/ The king's grace, by royal decree, for particular castes, groups,
KAZ02.10.42cd/ villages, and regions — the knower should determine this as an exemption.
KAZ02.10.43ab/ Authorization is delegated power in the matter of tasks, procedures, and speech;
KAZ02.10.43cd/ this may be a verbal document or one of delegation.
KAZ02.10.44ab/ Reports pertaining to edicts are understood to be twofold:
KAZ02.10.44cd/ one arising from divine events and another from human affairs.
KAZ02.10.45ab/ Having examined the document as it truly is and then responded appropriately,
KAZ02.10.45cd/ a reply should be composed in accordance with the king's word.
KAZ02.10.46ab/ Where the king instructs the governors and superintendents regarding protection and assistance for travelers,
KAZ02.10.46cd/ that is called a passport — to be recognized on roads, in provinces, and everywhere.

children.text: KAZ02.10.47/ upāyāḥ sāma.upapradāna.bheda.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.47/ The means [of diplomacy] are: conciliation (<s>sāma</s>), gifts (<s>upapradāna</s>), dissension (<s>bheda</s>), and force (<s>daṇḍa</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.10.48/ tatra sāma pañcavidhaṃ - guṇa.saṃkīrtanam, sambandha.upākhyānam, paraspara.upakāra.saṃdarśanam, āyati.pradarśanam, ātma.upanidhānam iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.48/ Among these, conciliation is fivefold: enumeration of merits, declaration of kinship, demonstration of mutual benefit, showing future prospects, and identification of oneself [with the other].

children.text: KAZ02.10.49/ tatra^abhijana.śarīra.karma.prakṛti.śruta.dravya.ādīnāṃ guṇa.grahaṇaṃ praśaṃsā stutir guṇa.saṃkīrtanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.49/ Therein, taking account of the merits of one's birth, person, conduct, disposition, learning, wealth, and the like — [whether as] praise, eulogy — is enumeration of merits.

children.text: KAZ02.10.50/ jñāti.yauna.maukha.srauva.kula.hṛdaya.mitra.saṃkīrtanaṃ sambandha.upākhyānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.50/ Mention of kinship ties through blood relations, marriage, face-to-face acquaintance, through hearing, by clan, by close intimacy, or by friendship — that is declaration of kinship.

children.text: KAZ02.10.51/ sva.pakṣa.para.pakṣayor anyonya.upakāra.saṃkīrtanaṃ paraspara.upakāra.saṃdarśanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.51/ Mention of mutual benefits between one's own party and the other — that is demonstration of mutual benefit.

children.text: KAZ02.10.52/ "asminn evaṃ kṛta idam āvayor bhavati" ity āśā.jananam āyati.pradarśanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.52/ 'When this is done in this way, the following will result for both of us' — generating such hope is showing future prospects.

children.text: KAZ02.10.53/ "yo^ahaṃ sa bhavān, yan mama dravyaṃ tad bhavatā sva.kṛtyeṣu prayojyatām" ity ātma.upanidhānam / iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.53/ 'What I am, you are; what is my property, let it be used by you for your own purposes' — that is identification of oneself [with the other].

children.text: KAZ02.10.54/ upapradānam artha.upakāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.54/ Gifts (<s>upapradāna</s>) are assistance with material resources.

children.text: KAZ02.10.55/ śaṅkā.jananaṃ nirbhartsanaṃ ca bhedaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.55/ Creating suspicion and intimidation — that is dissension (<s>bheda</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.10.56/ vadhaḥ parikleśo^artha.haraṇaṃ daṇḍaḥ / iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.56/ Killing, inflicting suffering, and confiscation of property — that is force (<s>daṇḍa</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.10.57/ akāntir vyāghātaḥ punar.uktam apaśabdaḥ samplava iti lekha.doṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.57/ Unattractiveness, contradiction, repetition, grammatical error, and confusion — these are the faults of a document.

children.text: KAZ02.10.58/ tatra kāla.pattrakam acāru.viṣam avirāga.akṣaratvam akāntiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.58/ Therein, [use of] improper writing material, inelegant layout, and careless lettering — that is unattractiveness.

children.text: KAZ02.10.59/ pūrveṇa paścimasya^anupapattir vyāghātaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.59/ Inconsistency of the latter part with the former — that is contradiction.

children.text: KAZ02.10.60/ uktasya^aviśeṣeṇa dvitīyam uccāraṇaṃ punar.uktam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.60/ Stating the same thing a second time without differentiation — that is repetition.

children.text: KAZ02.10.61/ liṅga.vacana.kāla.kārakāṇām anyathā.prayogo^apaśabdaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.61/ Incorrect use of gender, number, tense, and case — that is grammatical error.

children.text: KAZ02.10.62/ avarge varga.karaṇaṃ ca^avarga.kriyā guṇa.viparyāsaḥ samplavaḥ / iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.10.62/ Making a clause where there should be none, not making one where there should be, and reversal of qualifiers — that is confusion.

children.text:
KAZ02.10.63ab/ sarva.śāstrāṇy anukramya prayogam upalabhya ca /[ś]
KAZ02.10.63cd/ kauṭilyena nara.indra.arthe śāsanasya vidhiḥ kṛtaḥ //[ś] E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.10.63ab/ Having surveyed all the treatises and observed [actual] practice,
KAZ02.10.63cd/ <s>Kauṭilya</s> has formulated the rules of edicts for the benefit of kings.

children.text:
(Examination of the precious articles to be received into the treasury)
KAZ02.11.01/ kośa.adhyakṣaḥ kośa.praveśyaṃ ratnaṃ sāraṃ phalguṃ kupyaṃ vā taj.jāta.karaṇa.adhiṣṭhitaḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text:
(Examination of the precious articles to be received into the treasury)
KAZ02.11.01/ The superintendent of the treasury (<s>kośādhyakṣa</s>) should receive into the treasury precious articles — whether gems, essential commodities, minor articles, or raw materials — supervised by experts of each category.

children.text: KAZ02.11.02/ tāmra.parṇikaṃ pāṇḍyaka.vāṭakaṃ pāśikyaṃ kauleyaṃ caurṇeyaṃ māhendraṃ kārdamikaṃ srautasīyaṃ hrādīyaṃ haimavataṃ ca mauktikam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.02/ Pearls (<s>mauktika</s>) [come from]: <s>Tāmraparṇī</s>, <s>Pāṇḍyaka-vāṭaka</s>, <s>Pāśikya</s>, <s>Kauleya</s>, <s>Caurṇeya</s>, <s>Māhendra</s>, <s>Kārdamika</s>, <s>Srautasīya</s>, <s>Hrādīya</s>, and <s>Haimavata</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.03/ śuktiḥ śaṅkhaḥ prakīrṇakaṃ ca yonayaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.03/ Oyster-shell, conch-shell, and miscellaneous — these are the sources.

children.text: KAZ02.11.04/ masūrakaṃ tri.puṭakaṃ kūrmakam ardha.candrakaṃ kañcukitaṃ yamakaṃ kartakaṃ kharakaṃ siktakaṃ kāmaṇḍalukaṃ śyāvaṃ nīlaṃ durviddhaṃ ca^apraśastam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.04/ Lentil-shaped, three-sided, tortoise-shaped, half-moon-shaped, covered, twin, notched, rough, crested, gourd-shaped, dark, blue, and poorly bored — these are undesirable.

children.text: KAZ02.11.05/ sthūlaṃ vṛttaṃ nistalaṃ bhrājiṣṇu śvetaṃ guru snigdhaṃ deśa.viddhaṃ ca praśastam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.05/ Large, round, smooth, lustrous, white, heavy, glossy, and properly bored — these are desirable.

children.text: KAZ02.11.06/ śīrṣakam upaśīrṣakaṃ prakāṇḍakam avaghāṭakaṃ tarala.pratibaddhaṃ ca^iti yaṣṭi.prabhedāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.06/ Head-piece, secondary head-piece, straight bar, clasp, and pendant-strung — these are the varieties of strings.

children.text: KAZ02.11.07/ yaṣṭīnām aṣṭa.sahasram indrac.chandaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.07/ A string of eight thousand [pearls] is the <s>Indra</s>-pattern.

children.text: KAZ02.11.08/ tato^ardhaṃ vijayac.chandaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.08/ Half of that is the <s>Vijaya</s>-pattern.

children.text: KAZ02.11.09/ catuṣṣaṣṭir ardha.hāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.09/ Sixty-four [pearls make] a half-necklace.

children.text: KAZ02.11.10/ catuṣ.pañcāśad raśmi.kalāpaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.10/ Fifty-four, a ray-cluster.

children.text: KAZ02.11.11/ dvātriṃśad gucchaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.11/ Thirty-two, a bunch.

children.text: KAZ02.11.12/ sapta.viṃśatir nakṣatra.mālā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.12/ Twenty-seven, a constellation-garland (<s>nakṣatra-mālā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.13/ caturviṃśatir ardha.gucchaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.13/ Twenty-four, a half-bunch.

children.text: KAZ02.11.14/ viṃśatir māṇavakaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.14/ Twenty, a boy's [necklace] (<s>māṇavaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.15/ tato^ardham ardha.māṇavakaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.15/ Half of that, a half-<s>māṇavaka</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.16/ eta eva maṇi.madhyās tan.māṇavakā bhavanti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.16/ These same, when set with gems in between, become gem-set <s>māṇavakas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.17/ eka.śīrṣakaḥ śuddho hāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.17/ A pure necklace has a single head-piece.

children.text: KAZ02.11.18/ tadvat.śeṣāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.18/ The same applies to the rest.

children.text: KAZ02.11.19/ maṇi.madhyo^ardha.māṇavakaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.19/ A half-<s>māṇavaka</s> with gems in between [is another variety].

children.text: KAZ02.11.20/ tri.phalakaḥ phalaka.hāraḥ, pañca.phalako vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.20/ One with three pendants is a pendant-necklace; or one with five pendants.

children.text: KAZ02.11.21/ sūtram ekāvalī śuddhā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.21/ A simple thread [of pearls] is a pure single-strand (<s>ekāvalī</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.22/ sā^eva maṇi.madhyā yaṣṭiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.22/ The same with gems in between is a string (<s>yaṣṭi</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.23/ hema.maṇi.citrā ratnāvalī //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.23/ One variegated with gold and gems is a jewel-strand (<s>ratnāvalī</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.24/ hema.maṇi.muktā.antaro^apavartakaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.24/ One with alternating gold, gems, and pearls is a twisted strand (<s>apavartaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.25/ suvarṇa.sūtra.antaraṃ sopānakam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.25/ One with gold thread in between is a staircase [pattern] (<s>sopānaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.26/ maṇi.madhyaṃ vā maṇi.sopānakam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.26/ Or one with gems in between is a gem-staircase.

children.text: KAZ02.11.27/ tena śiro.hasta.pāda.kaṭī.kalāpa.jālaka.vikalpā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.11.27/ By these [descriptions], the varieties of ornaments for the head, hands, feet, waist, girdle, and net-work are explained.

children.text: KAZ02.11.28/ maṇiḥ kauṭo.māleyakaḥ pāra.samudrakaś ca //
children.translated_text: Gems are [classified as] <s>kauṭomāleyaka</s> (domestic) and <s>pārasamudraka</s> (overseas).

children.text: KAZ02.11.29/ saugandhikaḥ padma.rāgo^anavadya.rāgaḥ pārijāta.puṣpako bāla.sūryakaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Saugandhika</s> (<s>padmarāga</s>, ruby): of faultless color, resembling the <s>pārijāta</s> flower, [or] like the rising sun.

children.text: KAZ02.11.30/ vaiḍūryam utpala.varṇaḥ śirīṣa.puṣpaka udaka.varṇo vaṃśa.rāgaḥ śuka.pattra.varṇaḥ puṣya.rāgo go.mūtrako go.medakaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiḍūrya</s> (beryl/cat's-eye): of blue-lotus color, <s>śirīṣa</s>-flower color, water-color, bamboo-tinted, parrot-feather color, <s>puṣyarāga</s> (topaz), cow-urine colored, or <s>gomedaka</s> (hessonite).

children.text: KAZ02.11.31/ indra.nīlo nīla.avalīyaḥ kalāya.puṣpako mahā.nīlo jambv.ābho jīmūta.prabho nandakaḥ sravan.madhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Indranīla</s> (sapphire): blue-streaked, <s>kalāya</s>-flower colored, deep blue, <s>jambu</s>-colored, cloud-lustred, <s>nandaka</s>, or with streaks in the middle.

children.text: KAZ02.11.32/ śuddha.sphaṭiko mūlāṭa.varṇaḥ śīta.vṛṣṭiḥ sūrya.kāntaś ca / iti maṇayaḥ //
children.translated_text: Pure crystal (<s>sphaṭika</s>): radish-colored, <s>śītavṛṣṭi</s> (moonstone), and <s>sūryakānta</s> (sunstone). These are the [varieties of] gems.

children.text: KAZ02.11.33/ ṣaḍ.aśraś catur.aśro vṛtto vā tīvra.rāgaḥ saṃsthānavān achaḥ snigdho gurur arciṣmān antar.gata.prabhaḥ prabhā.anulepī ca^iti maṇi.guṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: Six-faceted, four-faceted, or round; of intense color; well-proportioned; transparent; smooth; heavy; radiant; with inner glow; and spreading its luster — these are the qualities of gems.

children.text: KAZ02.11.34/ manda.rāga.prabhaḥ sa-śarkaraḥ puṣpac.chidraḥ khaṇḍo durviddho lekha.ākīrṇa iti doṣāḥ //
children.translated_text: Faint in color and luster; containing grit; with flower-like inclusions or holes; chipped; poorly cut; covered with scratches — these are the defects.

children.text: KAZ02.11.35/ vimalakaḥ sasyako^añjana.mūlakaḥ pittakaḥ sulabhako lohita.akṣo mṛga.aśmako jyotī.rasako māleyako^ahic.chatrakaḥ kūrpaḥ pratikūrpaḥ sugandhi.kūrpaḥ kṣīravakaḥ śśukti.cūrṇakaḥ śilā.pravālakaḥ pulakaḥ śukla.pulaka ity antara.jātayaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Vimalaka</s>, <s>sasyaka</s>, <s>añjanamūlaka</s>, <s>pittaka</s>, <s>sulabhaka</s>, <s>lohitākṣa</s>, <s>mṛgāśmaka</s>, <s>jyotīrasaka</s>, <s>māleyaka</s>, <s>ahicchatraka</s>, <s>kūrpa</s>, <s>pratikūrpa</s>, <s>sugandhikūrpa</s>, <s>kṣīravaka</s>, <s>śuktichūrṇaka</s>, <s>śilāpravālaka</s>, <s>pulaka</s>, and <s>śuklapulaka</s> — these are the intermediate varieties.

children.text: KAZ02.11.36/ śeṣāḥ kāca.maṇayaḥ //
children.translated_text: The rest are glass-gems.

children.text: KAZ02.11.37/ sabhā.rāṣṭrakaṃ tajjamā.rāṣṭrakaṃ kāstīra.rāṣṭrakaṃ śrī.kaṭanakaṃ maṇimantakam indra.vānakaṃ ca vajram //
children.translated_text: Diamond (<s>vajra</s>) [comes from]: <s>Sabhā</s> country, <s>Tajjamā</s> country, <s>Kāstīra</s> country, <s>Śrīkaṭana</s>, <s>Maṇimanta</s>, and <s>Indravānaka</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.38/ khaniḥ srotaḥ prakīrṇakaṃ ca yonayaḥ //
children.translated_text: Mines, riverbeds, and scattered [surface deposits] are the sources.

children.text: KAZ02.11.39/ mārjāra.akṣakaṃ śirīṣa.puṣpakaṃ go.mūtrakaṃ go.medakaṃ śuddha.sphaṭikaṃ mūlāṭī.varṇaṃ maṇi.varṇānām anyatama.varṇam iti vajra.varṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: Cat's-eye colored, <s>śirīṣa</s>-flower colored, cow-urine colored, <s>gomedaka</s> colored, pure crystal colored, radish-colored, or of any gem-color — these are the colors of diamonds.

children.text: KAZ02.11.40/ sthūlaṃ guru prahāra.sahaṃ samakoṭikaṃ bhājana.lekhi tarku.bhrāmi bhrājiṣṇu ca praśastam //
children.translated_text: Thick, heavy, resistant to blows, with even edges, capable of scratching [other materials], spinning on a spindle, and brilliant — [such a diamond] is commended.

children.text: KAZ02.11.41/ naṣṭa.koṇaṃ nirāśri pārśva.apavṛttaṃ ca^apraśastam //
children.translated_text: One with broken corners, without edges, or with sides chipped off is not commended.

children.text: KAZ02.11.42/ pravālakam āla.kandakaṃ vaivarṇikaṃ ca, raktaṃ padma.rāgaṃ ca karaṭa.garbhiṇikā.varjam iti //
children.translated_text: Coral (<s>pravālaka</s>) is [classified as] <s>ālakandaka</s> and <s>vaivarṇika</s>; red and ruby-colored coral, excluding that with elephant-embryo [inclusions].

children.text: KAZ02.11.43/ candanaṃ sātanaṃ raktaṃ bhūmi.gandhi //
children.translated_text: Sandalwood (<s>candana</s>): <s>sātana</s> [variety] is red [and] earth-scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.44/ go.śīrṣakaṃ kāla.tāmraṃ matsya.gandhi //
children.translated_text: <s>Gośīrṣaka</s> [variety] is dark-copper [and] fish-scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.45/ hari.candanaṃ śuka.pattra.varṇam āmra.gandhi, tārṇasaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: Yellow sandalwood (<s>haricandana</s>) is parrot-feather colored and mango-scented; likewise <s>tārṇasa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.46/ grāmerukaṃ raktaṃ rakta.kālaṃ vā basta.mūtra.gandhi //
children.translated_text: <s>Grāmeruka</s> is red or red-dark, [and] goat-urine scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.47/ daivasabheyaṃ raktaṃ padma.gandhi, jāpakaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: <s>Daivasabheya</s> is red [and] lotus-scented; likewise <s>jāpaka</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.48/ joṅgakaṃ raktaṃ rakta.kālaṃ vā snigdham, taurūpaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: <s>Joṅgaka</s> is red or red-dark, [and] oily; likewise <s>taurūpa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.49/ māleyakaṃ pāṇḍu.raktam //
children.translated_text: <s>Māleyaka</s> is pale-red.

children.text: KAZ02.11.50/ kucandanaṃ rūkṣam aguru.kālaṃ raktaṃ rakta.kālaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: Inferior sandalwood (<s>kucandana</s>) is rough, and dark like <s>aguru</s> (aloe wood), or red, or red-dark.

children.text: KAZ02.11.51/ kāla.parvatakaṃ rakta.kālam anavadya.varṇaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Kālaparvataka</s> is red-dark or of faultless color.

children.text: KAZ02.11.52/ kośa.agāra.parvatakaṃ kālaṃ kāla.citraṃ vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Kośāgāraparvataka</s> is dark or dark-variegated.

children.text: KAZ02.11.53/ śīta.udakīyaṃ padma.ābhaṃ kāla.snigdhaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Śītodakīya</s> is lotus-hued or dark and oily.

children.text: KAZ02.11.54/ nāga.parvatakaṃ rūkṣaṃ śaivala.varṇaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Nāgaparvataka</s> is rough or moss-colored.

children.text: KAZ02.11.55/ śākalaṃ kapilam / iti //
children.translated_text: <s>Śākala</s> is tawny.

children.text: KAZ02.11.56/ laghu snigdham aśyānaṃ sarpiḥ.sneha.lepi gandha.sukhaṃ tvag.anusāry anulbaṇam avirāgy uṣṇa.sahaṃ dāha.grāhi sukha.sparśanam iti candana.guṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: Light, smooth, non-viscous, anointing like ghee, pleasant in fragrance, penetrating the skin, not excessive, not discoloring, heat-resistant, absorbing when applied, and pleasant to the touch — these are the qualities of sandalwood.

children.text: KAZ02.11.57/ aguru joṅgakaṃ kālaṃ kāla.citraṃ maṇḍala.citraṃ vā //
children.translated_text: Aloe wood (<s>aguru</s>): <s>joṅgaka</s> [variety] is dark, dark-variegated, or circle-patterned.

children.text: KAZ02.11.58/ śyāmaṃ doṅgakam //
children.translated_text: Dark-blue is <s>doṅgaka</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.59/ pāra.samudrakaṃ citra.rūpam uśīra.gandhi nava.mālikā.gandhi vā / iti //
children.translated_text: Overseas (<s>pārasamudraka</s>) is multi-colored, <s>uśīra</s>-scented or jasmine-scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.60/ guru snigdhaṃ peśala.gandhi nirhāry agni.saham asampluta.dhūmaṃ vimarda.saham ity aguru.guṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: Heavy, smooth, of refined fragrance, extractable, fire-resistant, with non-diffusing smoke, and resistant to grinding — these are the qualities of aloe wood.

children.text: KAZ02.11.61/ taila.parṇikam aśoka.grāmikaṃ māṃsa.varṇaṃ padma.gandhi //
children.translated_text: <s>Tailaparṇika</s>: from <s>Aśoka</s> village, flesh-colored, lotus-scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.62/ joṅgakaṃ rakta.pītakam utpala.gandhi go.mūtra.gandhi vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Joṅgaka</s>: red-yellow, blue-lotus scented or cow-urine scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.63/ grāmerukaṃ snigdhaṃ go.mūtra.gandhi //
children.translated_text: <s>Grāmeruka</s>: oily, cow-urine scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.64/ sauvarṇa.kuḍyakaṃ rakta.pītaṃ mātuluṅga.gandhi //
children.translated_text: <s>Sauvarṇakuḍyaka</s>: red-yellow, citron-scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.65/ pūrṇaka.dvīpakaṃ padma.gandhi nava.nīta.gandhi vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Pūrṇakadvīpaka</s>: lotus-scented or fresh-butter scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.66/ bhadra.śriyaṃ pāralauhityakaṃ jātī.varṇam //
children.translated_text: <s>Bhadraśrī</s> and <s>Pāralauhityaka</s>: jasmine-colored.

children.text: KAZ02.11.67/ āntaravatyam uśīra.varṇam //
children.translated_text: <s>Āntaravatya</s>: <s>uśīra</s>-colored.

children.text: KAZ02.11.68/ ubhayaṃ kuṣṭha.gandhi ca / iti //
children.translated_text: Both [the last two] are also <s>kuṣṭha</s>-scented.

children.text: KAZ02.11.69/ kāleyakaḥ svarṇa.bhūmijaḥ snigdha.pītakaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Kāleyaka</s> (yellow sandalwood extract): from <s>Svarṇabhūmi</s> (the Golden Land), smooth and yellowish.

children.text:
KAZ02.11.70/ auttara.parvatako rakta.pītakaḥ // iti sārāḥ /
KAZ02.11.71/ piṇḍa.kvātha.dhūma.saham avirāgi yoga.anuvidhāyi ca //
children.translated_text:
<s>Auttaraparvataka</s>: red-yellowish. These are the extracts (<s>sāras</s>).
Resistant to being compounded, boiled, or smoked; not discoloring; and adaptable to [medicinal] preparations.

children.text: KAZ02.11.72/ candana.aguruvac ca teṣāṃ guṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: Their qualities are like those of sandalwood and aloe wood.

children.text: KAZ02.11.73/ kāntanāvakaṃ praiyakaṃ ca^uttara.parvatakaṃ carma //
children.translated_text: Hides (<s>carma</s>): <s>Kāntanāvaka</s>, <s>Praiyaka</s>, and those from the northern mountains.

children.text: KAZ02.11.74/ kāntanāvakaṃ mayūra.grīva.ābham //
children.translated_text: <s>Kāntanāvaka</s> resembles the hue of a peacock's neck.

children.text: KAZ02.11.75/ praiyakaṃ nīla.pīta.śveta.lekhā.bindu.citram //
children.translated_text: <s>Praiyaka</s> is variegated with streaks and dots of blue, yellow, and white.

children.text: KAZ02.11.76/ tad.ubhayam aṣṭa.aṅgula.āyāmam //
children.translated_text: Both of these are eight <s>aṅgulas</s> in length.

children.text: KAZ02.11.77/ bisī mahā.bisī ca dvādaśa.grāmīye //
children.translated_text: <s>Bisī</s> and <s>mahābisī</s> are from the twelve-village [region].

children.text: KAZ02.11.78/ avyakta.rūpā duhilitikā citrā vā bisī //
children.translated_text: <s>Bisī</s> is of indistinct pattern or variegated.

children.text: KAZ02.11.79/ paruṣā śveta.prāyā mahābisī //
children.translated_text: <s>Mahābisī</s> is rough and predominantly white.

children.text: KAZ02.11.80/ dvādaśa.aṅgula.āyāmam ubhayam //
children.translated_text: Both are twelve <s>aṅgulas</s> in length.

children.text: KAZ02.11.81/ śyāmikā kālikā kadalī candra.uttarā śākulā ca^ārohajāḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Śyāmikā</s>, <s>kālikā</s>, <s>kadalī</s>, <s>candrōttarā</s>, and <s>śākulā</s> are from <s>Āroha</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.82/ kapilā bindu.citrā vā śyāmikā //
children.translated_text: <s>Śyāmikā</s> is tawny or dot-variegated.

children.text: KAZ02.11.83/ kālikā kapilā kapota.varṇā vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Kālikā</s> is tawny or pigeon-colored.

children.text: KAZ02.11.84/ tad ubhayam aṣṭa.aṅgula.āyāmam //
children.translated_text: Both of these are eight <s>aṅgulas</s> in length.

children.text: KAZ02.11.85/ paruṣā kadalī hasta.āyatā //
children.translated_text: <s>Kadalī</s> is rough and one <s>hasta</s> (cubit) in length.

children.text: KAZ02.11.86/ sā^eva candra.citrā candra.uttarā //
children.translated_text: The same, when moon-patterned, is <s>candrōttarā</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.87/ kadalī.tri.bhāgā śākulā koṭha.maṇḍala.citrā kṛta.karṇikā^ajina.citrā vā / iti //
children.translated_text: <s>Śākulā</s> is one-third of a <s>kadalī</s>, patterned with circular spots, having decorated ear-pieces, or patterned like [deer] skin.

children.text: KAZ02.11.88/ sāmūraṃ cīnasī sāmūlī ca bāhlaveyāḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Sāmūra</s>, <s>cīnasī</s>, and <s>sāmūlī</s> are from <s>Bāhlīka</s> (Bactria).

children.text: KAZ02.11.89/ ṣaṭ.triṃśad.aṅgulam añjana.varṇaṃ sāmūram //
children.translated_text: <s>Sāmūra</s> is thirty-six <s>aṅgulas</s> [in length] and collyrium-colored.

children.text: KAZ02.11.90/ cīnasī rakta.kālī pāṇḍu.kālī vā //
children.translated_text: <s>Cīnasī</s> is red-dark or pale-dark.

children.text: KAZ02.11.91/ sāmūlī go.dhūma.varṇā / iti //
children.translated_text: <s>Sāmūlī</s> is cow-brown colored.

children.text: KAZ02.11.92/ sāṃtinā nala.tūlā vṛtta.pṛcchā caudrāḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Sātinā</s>, <s>nalatūlā</s>, <s>vṛttapucchā</s> are from <s>Caudra</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.93/ sātinā kṛṣṇā //
children.translated_text: <s>Sātinā</s> is black.

children.text: KAZ02.11.94/ nala.tūlā nala.tūla.varṇā //
children.translated_text: <s>Nalatūlā</s> is reed-down colored.

children.text:
KAZ02.11.95/ kapilā vṛtta.pucchā ca // iti carma.jātayaḥ /
KAZ02.11.96/ carmaṇāṃ mṛdu snigdhaṃ bahula.roma ca śreṣṭham //
children.translated_text:
<s>Vṛttapucchā</s> is tawny. These are the varieties of hides.
Among hides, soft, smooth, and thick-furred is the best.

children.text: KAZ02.11.97/ śuddhaṃ śuddha.raktaṃ pakṣa.raktaṃ ca^āvikam, khacitaṃ vāna.citraṃ khaṇḍa.saṃghātyaṃ tantu.vicchinnaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: Sheep's wool (<s>āvika</s>): pure [white], pure-red, or wing-red; checked, forest-patterned, patchwork, or thread-interspersed.

children.text: KAZ02.11.98/ kambalaḥ kaucapakaḥ kulamitikā saumitikā turaga.āstaraṇaṃ varṇakaṃ talicchakaṃ vāra.vāṇaḥ paristomaḥ samanta.bhadrakaṃ ca^āvikam //
children.translated_text: Blankets, <s>kaucapaka</s>, <s>kulamitikā</s>, <s>saumitikā</s>, horse-coverings, colored [fabrics], <s>talichhaka</s>, <s>vāravāṇa</s>, cushion-covers, and <s>samantabhadraka</s> — [these are made from] sheep's wool.

children.text: KAZ02.11.99/ picchilam ārdram iva ca sūkṣmaṃ mṛdu ca śreṣṭham //
children.translated_text: Silky, seemingly moist, fine, and soft is the best.

children.text: KAZ02.11.100/ aṣṭa.proti.saṃghātyā kṛṣṇā bhiṅgisī varṣa.vāraṇam apasāraka iti naipālakam //
children.translated_text: With eight-fold weave, black: <s>bhiṅgisī</s>, rain-cloak, and <s>apasāraka</s> — [these are] from <s>Nepāla</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.101/ sampuṭikā catur.aśrikā lambarā kaṭavānakaṃ prāvarakaḥ sattalikā^iti mṛga.roma //
children.translated_text: <s>Sampuṭikā</s>, <s>caturaśrikā</s>, <s>lambarā</s>, <s>kaṭavānaka</s>, cloak, and <s>sattalikā</s> — [these are made from] deer hair.

children.text: KAZ02.11.102/ vāṅgakaṃ śvetaṃ snigdhaṃ dukūlam //
children.translated_text: <s>Vāṅgaka</s> (from <s>Vaṅga</s>): white and smooth <s>dukūla</s> (fine fabric).

children.text: KAZ02.11.103/ pauṇḍrakaṃ śyāmaṃ maṇi.snigdham //
children.translated_text: <s>Pauṇḍraka</s> (from <s>Puṇḍra</s>): dark and gem-smooth.

children.text: KAZ02.11.104/ sauvarṇa.kuḍyakaṃ sūrya.varṇaṃ maṇi.snigdha.udaka.vānaṃ catur.aśra.vānaṃ vyāmiśra.vānaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: <s>Sauvarṇakuḍyaka</s>: sun-colored, with gem-smooth water-pattern, four-cornered pattern, or mixed pattern.

children.text: KAZ02.11.105/ eteṣām eka.aṃśukam adhyardha.dvi.tri.catur.aṃśukam iti //
children.translated_text: Of these, [there are varieties of] one panel, one-and-a-half panels, two, three, and four panels.

children.text: KAZ02.11.106/ tena kāśikaṃ pauṇḍrakaṃ ca kṣaumaṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: By this, <s>Kāśika</s> and <s>Pauṇḍraka</s> linen (<s>kṣauma</s>) are explained.

children.text: KAZ02.11.107/ māgadhikā pauṇḍrikā sauvarṇa.kuḍyakā ca pattra.ūrṇā //
children.translated_text: <s>Māgadhikā</s>, <s>Pauṇḍrikā</s>, and <s>Sauvarṇakuḍyakā</s> [produce] tree-silk (<s>pattrūrṇā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.11.108/ nāga.vṛkṣo likuco bakulo vaṭaś ca yonayaḥ //
children.translated_text: The <s>nāga</s>-tree, <s>likuca</s>, <s>bakula</s>, and <s>vaṭa</s> (banyan) are the sources.

children.text: KAZ02.11.109/ pītikā nāga.vṛkṣikā //
children.translated_text: Yellowish is that from the <s>nāga</s>-tree.

children.text: KAZ02.11.110/ go.dhūma.varṇā laikucī //
children.translated_text: Cow-brown is that from <s>likuca</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.111/ śvetā bākulī //
children.translated_text: White is that from <s>bakula</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.11.112/ śeṣā nava.nīta.varṇā //
children.translated_text: The rest is fresh-butter colored.

children.text: KAZ02.11.113/ tāsāṃ sauvarṇa.kuḍyakā śreṣṭhā //
children.translated_text: Of these, <s>Sauvarṇakuḍyakā</s> is the best.

children.text: KAZ02.11.114/ tayā kauśeyaṃ cīna.paṭṭāś ca cīna.bhūmijā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, silk (<s>kauśeya</s>) and <s>Cīna</s> silk-fabrics originating from <s>Cīna</s> (China) are explained.

children.text: KAZ02.11.115/ mādhuram āparāntakaṃ kāliṅgaṃ kāśikaṃ vāṅgakaṃ vātsakaṃ māhiṣakaṃ ca kārpāsikaṃ śreṣṭham / iti //
children.translated_text: <s>Mādhura</s>, <s>Āparāntaka</s>, <s>Kāliṅga</s>, <s>Kāśika</s>, <s>Vāṅgaka</s>, <s>Vātsaka</s>, and <s>Māhiṣaka</s> — [these produce] the best cotton (<s>kārpāsika</s>).

children.text:
KAZ02.11.116/ ataḥ pareṣāṃ ratnānāṃ pramāṇaṃ mūlya.lakṣaṇam /
KAZ02.11.117/ jātiṃ rūpaṃ ca jānīyān nidhānaṃ nava.karma ca //
children.translated_text: Of the remaining precious commodities, one should know the standard, the price-characteristics, the variety, the form, and the storage and new-fashioning [methods].

children.text:
KAZ02.11.118/ purāṇa.pratisaṃskāraṃ karma guhyam upaskarān /
KAZ02.11.119/ deśa.kāla.parībhogaṃ hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca pratikriyām //E
children.translated_text: Also the restoration of old [items], secret craftsmanship, accessories, the [variations due to] place, time, and use, and the counteracting of harmful [substances].

children.text:
(ṣtarting or mines and factories)
KAZ02.12.01/ ākara.adhyakṣaḥ śulba.dhātu.śāstra.rasa.pāka.maṇi.rāgajñas tajjña.sakho vā taj.jāta.karma.kara.upakaraṇa.sampannaḥ kiṭṭa.mūṣa.aṅgāra.bhasma.liṅgaṃ vā^ākaraṃ bhūta.pūrvam abhuta.pūrvaṃ vā bhūmi.prastara.rasa.dhātum atyartha.varṇa.gauravam ugra.gandha.rasaṃ parīkṣeta //
children.translated_text:
(Starting of mines and factories)
The superintendent of mines, knowledgeable in metallurgy, mineralogy, and gem-coloring — or accompanied by experts therein — equipped with appropriate workers and implements, should examine a mine — whether previously worked or unworked — by [analyzing] the earth, rocks, fluids, and ores: their excessive color and weight, strong smell and taste, and the signs of slag, crucibles, charcoal, and ash.

children.text: KAZ02.12.02/ parvatānām abhijñāta.uddeśānāṃ bila.guha.upatyaka.ālayana.gūḍha.khāteṣv antaḥ prasyandino jambū.cūta.tāla.phala.pakva.haridrā.bheda.guḍa(gūḍa?).hari.tāla.manaḥ.śilā.kṣaudra.hiṅguluka.puṇḍarīka.śuka.mayūra.pattra.varṇāḥ savarṇa.udaka.oṣadhi.paryantāś cikkaṇā viśadā bhārikāś ca rasāḥ kāñcanikāḥ //
children.translated_text: In mountains with known locations, in holes, caves, slopes, and hidden excavations, fluids that seep internally — of <s>jambū</s>-fruit, mango, palm-fruit, ripened turmeric, <s>bheda</s>, <s>guḍa</s> (jaggery), yellow orpiment, realgar, <s>kṣaudra</s> (honey), vermillion, <s>puṇḍarīka</s> (white lotus), parrot-feather, and peacock-feather colors — with similarly colored water and herbs around them, and being viscous, clear, and heavy — these are gold-bearing fluids.

children.text: KAZ02.12.03/ apsu niṣṭhyūtās tailavad.visarpiṇaḥ ṣaṅka.mala.grāhiṇaś ca tāmra.rūpyayoḥ śatād upari veddhāraḥ //
children.translated_text: When spat into water, [these fluids] spread like oil and adhere to conch-shell impurities; they pierce [through layers of] copper and silver at more than a hundred [parts].

children.text: KAZ02.12.04/ tat.pratirūpakam ugra.gandha.rasaṃ śilā.jatu vidyāt //
children.translated_text: That which resembles these but has a pungent smell and [comes from] rocks should be known as <s>śilājatu</s> (bitumen/mineral pitch).

children.text:
KAZ02.12.05/ pītakās.tāmrakās tāmra.pītakā vā bhūmi.prastara.dhātavo bhinnā nīla.rājīvanto mudga.māṣa.kṛsara.varṇā vā dadhi.bindu.piṇḍa.citrā haridrā.harītakī.padma.pattra.śaivala.yakṛt.plīha.anavadya.varṇā bhinnāś cuñcu.vāluka.ālekhā.bindu.svastikavantaḥ sugulikā arciṣmantas tāpyamānā na bhidyante bahu.phena.dhūmāś ca suvarṇa.dhātavaḥ pratīvāpa.arthās
tāmra.rūpya.vedhanāḥ //
children.translated_text: Yellow, copper-colored, or copper-yellow earth-rock-ores, when split showing blue streaks, or of <s>mudga</s>-bean, <s>māṣa</s>-bean, or <s>kṛsara</s> (rice-sesame) color, variegated with curd-like dots and lumps, of turmeric, <s>harītakī</s>, lotus-leaf, moss, liver, or spleen color — or faultless color — when split showing beak-marks, sand, scratches, dots, and <s>svastika</s> patterns, well-rounded, lustrous, not cracking when heated, and producing abundant foam and smoke — these are gold-bearing ores, [useful] for alloying and for piercing copper and silver.

children.text: KAZ02.12.06/ śaṅkha.karpūra.sphaṭika.nava.nīta.kapota.pārāvata.vimalaka.mayūra.grīvā.varṇāḥ sasyaka.gomedaka.guḍa.matsyaṇḍikā.varṇāḥ kovidāra.padma.pāṭalīka.lāya.kṣauma.atasī.puṣpa.varṇāḥ sa-sīsāḥ sa.añjanā visrā bhinnāḥ śveta.ābhāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kṛṣṇa.ābhāḥ śvetāḥ sarve vā lekhā.bindu.citrā mṛdavo dhmāyamānā na sphuṭanti bahu.phena.dhūmāś ca rūpya.dhātavaḥ //
children.translated_text: Those of conch, camphor, crystal, fresh-butter, pigeon, dove, <s>vimalaka</s>, or peacock-neck color; of <s>sasyaka</s>, <s>gomedaka</s>, jaggery, or <s>matsyaṇḍikā</s> color; of <s>kovidāra</s>, lotus, <s>pāṭalīka</s>, <s>lāya</s>, flax, or linseed-flower color; containing lead; containing antimony; viscous; when split showing white luster; or black with white luster, or white with black luster; all variegated with streaks and dots; soft; not bursting when smelted; and producing abundant foam and smoke — these are silver-bearing ores.

children.text: KAZ02.12.07/ sarva.dhātūnāṃ gaurava.vṛddhau sattva.vṛddhiḥ //
children.translated_text: For all ores, an increase in weight [indicates] an increase in metal content.

children.text: KAZ02.12.08/ teṣām aśuddhā mūḍha.garbhā vā tīkṣṇa.mūtra.kṣara.bhāvitā rāja.vṛkṣa.vaṭa.pīlu.go.pitta.rocanā.mahiṣa.khara.karabha.mūtra.leṇḍa.piṇḍa.baddhās tat.pratīvāpās tad.avalepā vā viśuddhāḥ sravanti //
children.translated_text: Among these [ores], those that are impure or contain hidden impurities — when treated with caustic urine and alkali, bound with [substances from] <s>rājavṛkṣa</s> (Indian beech), banyan, <s>pīlu</s>, ox-bile, <s>rocanā</s> (yellow pigment), and the urine and dung-pellets of buffalo, donkey, and camel, or re-smelted with those substances or coated with them — flow out purified.

children.text: KAZ02.12.09/ yava.māṣa.tila.palāśa.pīlu.kṣārair.go.kṣīra.aja.kṣīrair vā kadalī.vajra.kanda.pratīvapo mārdava.karaḥ //
children.translated_text: A flux of barley, black gram, sesame, <s>palāśa</s>, and <s>pīlu</s> alkalis with cow's milk or goat's milk, [applied to] a base of plantain and <s>vajrakanda</s>, produces softening.

children.text:
KAZ02.12.10ab/ madhu.madhukam ajā.payaḥ sa-tailaṃ ghṛta.guḍa.kiṇva.yutaṃ sa-kandalīkam /
KAZ02.12.10cd/ yad api śata.sahasradhā vibhinnaṃ bhavati mṛdu tribhir eva tan.niṣekaiḥ //
children.translated_text:
Honey, <s>madhuka</s> (licorice), goat's milk with oil, ghee, jaggery, and yeast, together with plantain —
what has been shattered a hundred thousand times becomes soft with just three applications of this.

children.text: KAZ02.12.11/ go.danta.śṛṅga.pratīvāpo mṛdu.stambhanaḥ //
children.translated_text: A flux of cow teeth and horn produces softening and hardening.

children.text: KAZ02.12.12/ bhārikaḥ snigdho mṛduś ca prastara.dhātur bhūmi.bhāgo vā piṅgalo haritaḥ pāṭalo lohito vā tāmra.dhātuḥ //
children.translated_text: Heavy, oily, and soft — this is the nature of stone ore; an earthy deposit that is tawny, green, pink, or red is copper ore.

children.text: KAZ02.12.13/ kāka.mocakaḥ kapota.rocanā.varṇaḥ śveta.rāji.naddho vā visraḥ sīsa.dhātuḥ //
children.translated_text: Having a crow-releasing appearance, pigeon-<s>rocanā</s> colored, or streaked with white lines, and having a fleshy smell — this is lead ore.

children.text: KAZ02.12.14/ ūṣara.karburaḥ pakva.loṣṭha.varṇo vā trapu.dhātuḥ //
children.translated_text: Saline and mottled, or the color of baked clay — this is tin ore.

children.text: KAZ02.12.15/ kharumbaḥ pāṇḍu.rohitaḥ sindu.vāra.puṣpa.varṇo vā tīkṣṇa.dhātuḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Kharumba</s> [type], pale-reddish, or the color of <s>sinduvāra</s> flowers — this is iron (<s>tīkṣṇa</s>) ore.

children.text: KAZ02.12.16/ kāka.aṇḍa.bhuja.pattra.varṇo vā vaikṛntaka.dhātuḥ //
children.translated_text: The color of a crow's egg or of <s>bhujapatra</s> (birch bark) — this is <s>vaikṛntaka</s> (steel) ore.

children.text: KAZ02.12.17/ acchaḥ snigdhaḥ sa-prabho ghoṣavān śītas tīvras tanu.rāgaś ca maṇi.dhātuḥ //
children.translated_text: Transparent, oily, lustrous, resonant, cool, sharp, and lightly tinted — this is gem ore.

children.text: KAZ02.12.18/ dhātu.samutthaṃ taj.jāta.karma.anteṣu prayojayet //
children.translated_text: What is produced from a [particular] ore should be employed in the manufacturing operations appropriate to that type.

children.text: KAZ02.12.19/ kṛta.bhāṇḍa.vyavahāram eka.mukham, atyayaṃ ca^anyatra kartṛ.kretṛ.vikretṛṛṇāṃ sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: He should centralize the trade in finished goods under a single authority, and impose penalties on unauthorized makers, buyers, and sellers.

children.text: KAZ02.12.20/ ākarikam apaharantam aṣṭa.guṇaṃ dāpayed anyatra ratnebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: One who steals mine products should be made to pay eightfold — except for precious stones.

children.text: KAZ02.12.21/ stenam anisṛṣṭa.upajīvinaṃ ca baddhaṃ karma kārayet, daṇḍa.upakāriṇaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: A thief and one who makes a living without authorization should be put to forced labor in chains, as should one who aids [them] by way of punishment.

children.text: KAZ02.12.22/ vyaya.kriyā.bhārikam āakaraṃ bhāgena prakrayeṇa vā dadyāt, lāghavikam ātmanā kārayet //
children.translated_text: A mine that is costly in expenditure and operations he should grant [to a private operator] for a share or a purchase price; one that is light [in cost] he should work himself.

children.text:
KAZ02.12.23/ loha.adhyakṣas tāmra.sīsa.trapu.vaikṛnta.kāra.kūṭa.vṛtta.kaṃsa.tāla.loha.karma.antān kārayet, loha.bhāṇḍa.vyavahāraṃ ca //KAZ02.12.24/ lakṣaṇa.adhyakṣaś catur.bhāga.tāmraṃ rūpya.rūpaṃ tīkṣṇa.trapu.sīsa.añjanānām anyatama.māṣa.bīja.yuktaṃ kārayet - paṇam ardha.paṇaṃ pādam, aṣṭa.bhāgam iti, pāda.ājīvaṃ tāmra.rūpaṃ - māṣakam ardha.māṣakaṃ kākaṇīm
ardha.kākaṇīm iti //
children.translated_text:
The superintendent of metals (<s>lohādhyakṣa</s>) should oversee the manufacturing operations of copper, lead, tin, <s>vaikṛntaka</s> (steel), <s>kārakūṭa</s> (brass), <s>vṛtta</s>, bell-metal, <s>tāla</s> [metal], and iron, as well as the trade in metal goods.
The superintendent of minting (<s>lakṣaṇādhyakṣa</s>) should have coins struck — silver coins with one-quarter copper, combined with one <s>māṣa</s>-measure of any one among iron, tin, lead, and antimony — [in denominations of] a <s>paṇa</s>, half-<s>paṇa</s>, quarter-<s>paṇa</s>, and eighth-<s>paṇa</s>; and as quarter-<s>paṇa</s> livelihood [coins], copper coins — a <s>māṣaka</s>, half-<s>māṣaka</s>, <s>kākaṇī</s>,
and half-<s>kākaṇī</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.12.25/ rūpa.darśakaḥ paṇa.yātrāṃ vyāvahārikīṃ kośa.praveśyāṃ ca sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: The assayer (<s>rūpadarśaka</s>) should establish the currency for trade and for entry into the treasury.

children.text: KAZ02.12.26/ rūpikam aṣṭakaṃ śatam, pañcakaṃ śataṃ vyājīm, pārīkṣikam aṣṭa.bhāgikam, śatam, pañca.viṃśati.paṇam atyayaṃ ca anyatra.kartṛ.kretṛ.vikretṛ.parīkṣitṛbhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: The minting fee is eight per hundred [for silver coins], five per hundred as commission; the assay fee is one-eighth per hundred; twenty-five <s>paṇas</s> as penalty for unauthorized makers, buyers, sellers, and assayers.

children.text: KAZ02.12.27/ khany.adhyakṣaḥ śaṅkha.vajra.maṇi.muktā.pravāla.kṣāra.karma.antān kārayet, paṇana.vyavahāraṃ ca //
children.translated_text: The superintendent of mines (<s>khanyādhyakṣa</s>) should oversee the manufacturing of conch shells, diamonds, gems, pearls, corals, and alkalis, as well as their trade.

children.text: KAZ02.12.28/ lavaṇa.adhyakṣaḥ pāka.muktaṃ lavaṇa.bhāgaṃ prakrayaṃ ca yathā.kālaṃ saṃgṛhṇīyād, vikrayāc ca mūlyaṃ rūpaṃ vyājīṃ ca //
children.translated_text: The superintendent of salt (<s>lavaṇādhyakṣa</s>) should collect in due season the share and purchase price of salt released from manufacture, and from sales, the price, the coinage [fee], and the commission.

children.text: KAZ02.12.29/ āgantu.lavaṇaṃ ṣaḍ.bhāgaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Imported salt should pay a one-sixth share.

children.text: KAZ02.12.30/ datta.bhāga.vibhāgasya vikrayaḥ, pañcakaṃ śataṃ vyājīṃ rūpaṃ rūpikaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: After the share has been paid, [the remainder may be] sold; five per hundred as commission, plus coinage and minting fees.

children.text: KAZ02.12.31/ kretā śulkaṃ rāja.paṇyac.cheda.anurūpaṃ ca vaidharaṇaṃ dadyāt, anyatra kretā ṣaṭ.chatam atyayaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: The buyer should pay the customs duty and a penalty proportionate to the loss of royal monopoly revenue; [if bought] elsewhere, the buyer pays six per hundred as penalty.

children.text: KAZ02.12.32/ vilavaṇam uttamaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyād, aniṣṛṣṭa.upajīvī ca^anyatra vānaprasthebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: One who trades in contraband salt should pay the highest fine, as should one who makes a living without authorization — except for forest hermits.

children.text: KAZ02.12.33/ śrotriyās tapasvino viṣṭayaś ca bhakta.lavaṇaṃ hareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Vedic scholars, ascetics, and forced laborers may take salt for their food.

children.text: KAZ02.12.34/ ato^anyo lavaṇa.kṣāra.vargaḥ śulkaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: All other salt and alkali products should pay customs duty.

children.text:
KAZ02.12.35ab/ evaṃ mūlyaṃ ca bhāgaṃ ca vyājīṃ parigham atyayam /
KAZ02.12.35cd/ śulkaṃ vaidharaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ rūpaṃ rūpikam eva ca //
children.translated_text:
Thus the price, the share, the commission, the surcharge, the penalty,
the customs duty, the confiscation fine, the penalty, the coinage, and the minting fee —

children.text:
KAZ02.12.36ab/ khanibhyo dvādaśa.vidhaṃ dhātuṃ paṇyaṃ ca saṃharet /
KAZ02.12.36cd/ evaṃ sarveṣu paṇyeṣu sthāpayen mukha.saṃgraham //
children.translated_text:
from mines he should collect twelve kinds of ore and merchandise;
thus for all commodities he should establish centralized collection.

children.text:
KAZ02.12.37ab/ ākara.prabhaḥ kośaḥ kośād daṇḍaḥ prajāyate /
KAZ02.12.37cd/ pṛthivī kośa.daṇḍābhyāṃ prāpyate kośa.bhūṣaṇā //E
children.translated_text:
The treasury originates from the mines; from the treasury, military force is born;
the earth is acquired through treasury and military force — the earth adorned with treasure.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of gold in the ṛorkshop)
KAZ02.13.01/ suvarṇa.adhyakṣaḥ suvarṇa.rajata.karma.antānām asambandha.āveśana.catuḥ.śālām eka.dvārām akṣa.śālāṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of gold in the workshop)
The superintendent of gold (<s>suvarṇādhyakṣa</s>) should have constructed, for gold and silver manufacturing operations, a four-hall workshop (<s>akṣaśālā</s>) with unconnected workstations and a single entrance.

children.text: KAZ02.13.02/ viśikhā.madhye sauvarṇikaṃ śilpavantam abhijātaṃ prātyayikaṃ ca sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: In the middle of the market street, he should station a goldsmith who is skilled, of good birth, and trustworthy.

children.text: KAZ02.13.03/ jāmbūnadaṃ śātakumbhaṃ hāṭakaṃ vaiṇavaṃ śṛṅga.śuktijaṃ jāta.rūpaṃ rasa.viddham ākara.udgataṃ ca suvarṇam //
children.translated_text: <s>Jāmbūnada</s>, <s>śātakumbha</s>, <s>hāṭaka</s>, <s>vaiṇava</s>, horn-and-shell born, naturally occurring (<s>jātarūpa</s>), mercury-extracted, and mine-produced — these are [the varieties of] gold.

children.text: KAZ02.13.04/ kiñjalka.varṇaṃ mṛdu snigdham anādi bhrājiṣṇu ca śreṣṭham, rakta.pītakaṃ madhyamam, raktam avaram //
children.translated_text: That which is filament-colored, soft, oily, without impurity, and lustrous is the best; reddish-yellow is middling; red is the lowest.

children.text: KAZ02.13.05/ śreṣṭhānāṃ pāṇḍu śvetaṃ ca^aprāptakam //
children.translated_text: Among the best grades, pale and white [gold] is unripe (<s>aprāptaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.13.06/ tad yena^aprāptakaṃ tac catur.guṇena sīsena śodhayet //
children.translated_text: That which is unripe should be purified with four times [its weight in] lead.

children.text: KAZ02.13.07/ sīsa.anvayena bhidyamānaṃ śuṣka.paṭalair dhmāpayet //
children.translated_text: That which cracks due to lead content should be smelted with dry leaf-plates.

children.text: KAZ02.13.08/ rūkṣatvād bhidyamānaṃ taila.gomaye niṣecayet //
children.translated_text: That which cracks due to dryness should be quenched in oil and cow-dung.

children.text: KAZ02.13.09/ ākara.udgataṃ sīsa.anvayena bhidyamānaṃ pāka.pattrāṇi kṛtvā gaṇḍikāsu kuṭṭayet, kadalī.vajra.kanda.kalke vā niṣecayet //
children.translated_text: Mine-produced [gold] that cracks due to lead content should be made into leaf-plates and hammered on anvils, or quenched in a paste of plantain and <s>vajrakanda</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.13.10/ tuttha.udgataṃ gauḍikaṃ kāmbukaṃ cākravālikaṃ ca rūpyam //
children.translated_text: Produced from <s>tuttha</s> (copper sulfate), <s>gauḍika</s>, <s>kāmbuka</s>, and <s>cākravālika</s> — these are [the varieties of] silver.

children.text: KAZ02.13.11/ śvetaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛdu ca śreṣṭham //
children.translated_text: White, oily, and soft is the best.

children.text: KAZ02.13.12/ viparyaye sphoṭanaṃ ca duṣṭam //
children.translated_text: The opposite, and that which flakes, is defective.

children.text: KAZ02.13.13/ tat.sīsa.catur.bhāgena śodhayet //
children.translated_text: It should be purified with one-quarter [its weight in] lead.

children.text: KAZ02.13.14/ udgata.cūlikam acchaṃ bhrājiṣṇu dadhi.varṇaṃ ca śuddham //
children.translated_text: That which has risen crests, is transparent, lustrous, and curd-colored is pure.

children.text: KAZ02.13.15/ śuddhasya^eko hāridrasya suvarṇo varṇakaḥ //
children.translated_text: For pure [silver], one <s>varṇaka</s> (color-grade) is [the mark of] the turmeric-gold [level].

children.text: KAZ02.13.16/ tataḥ śulba.kākaṇy.uttara.apasāritā ā.catuḥ.sīma.antād iti ṣoḍaśa varṇakāḥ //
children.translated_text: From that, ascending by one copper <s>kākaṇī</s> [increment] up to the fourth boundary — thus there are sixteen color-grades.

children.text: KAZ02.13.17/ suvarṇaṃ pūrvaṃ nikaṣya paścād varṇikāṃ nikaṣayet //
children.translated_text: One should first assay the gold [on the touchstone], then assay the color-standard.

children.text: KAZ02.13.18/ sama.rāga.lekham animna.unnate deśe nikaṣitam, parimṛditaṃ parilīḍhaṃ nakha.antarād vā gairikeṇa.avacūrṇitam upadhiṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: A streak of uniform color on a surface that is neither depressed nor raised is [genuine]; [a streak that has been] rubbed, licked, or dusted with ochite from under the fingernail should be recognized as fraudulent.

children.text: KAZ02.13.19/ jāti.hiṅgulukena puṣpakā.sīsena vā go.mūtra.bhāvitena digdhena^agra.hastena saṃspṛṣṭaṃ suvarṇaṃ śvetī.bhavati //
children.translated_text: Gold touched with a fingertip smeared with native cinnabar (<s>jātihinṅguluka</s>) or <s>puṣpakā</s>-lead treated with cow's urine turns white [revealing fraud].

children.text: KAZ02.13.20/ sa-kesaraḥ snigdho mṛdur bhājiṣṇuś ca nikaṣa.rāgaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ //
children.translated_text: A touchstone streak that has filaments, is oily, soft, and lustrous is the best.

children.text: KAZ02.13.21/ kāliṅgakas tāpī.pāṣāṇo vā mudga.varṇo nikaṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ //
children.translated_text: A <s>Kāliṅga</s> stone or a <s>Tāpī</s> river stone, mung-bean colored, is the best touchstone.

children.text: KAZ02.13.22/ sama.rāgī vikraya.kraya.hitaḥ //
children.translated_text: One that gives a uniform streak is good for both buying and selling.

children.text: KAZ02.13.23/ hastic.chavikaḥ saharitaḥ prati.rāgī vikraya.hitaḥ //
children.translated_text: One with an elephant-skin appearance, greenish, reflecting the streak, is good for selling.

children.text: KAZ02.13.24/ sthiraḥ paruṣo viṣama.varṇaś ca^apratirāgī kraya.hitaḥ //
children.translated_text: One that is hard, rough, and of uneven color, not reflecting the streak, is good for buying.

children.text: KAZ02.13.25/ chedaś cikkaṇaḥ sama.varṇaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛdur bhājiṣṇuś ca śreṣṭhaḥ //
children.translated_text: A cut [of gold] that is smooth, of uniform color, fine, soft, and lustrous is the best.

children.text: KAZ02.13.26/ tāpo bahir.antaś ca samaḥ kiñjalka.varṇaḥ kuraṇḍaka.puṣpa.varṇo vā śreṣṭhaḥ //
children.translated_text: When heated, [gold that shows] uniform [color] both inside and outside, filament-colored or <s>kuraṇḍaka</s> flower-colored, is the best.

children.text: KAZ02.13.27/ śyāvo nīlaś ca^aprāptakaḥ //
children.translated_text: Dark blue and blue-black are unripe.

children.text: KAZ02.13.28/ tulā.pratimānaṃ pautava.adhyakṣe vakṣyāmaḥ //
children.translated_text: The standard of weights and measures we shall discuss under the superintendent of weights.

children.text: KAZ02.13.29/ tena^upadeśena rūpya.suvarṇaṃ dadyād ādadīta ca //
children.translated_text: By this instruction, he should give and receive silver and gold.

children.text: KAZ02.13.30/ akṣa.śālām anāyukto na^upagacchet //
children.translated_text: One not authorized should not enter the workshop.

children.text: KAZ02.13.31/ abhigacchann ucchedyaḥ //
children.translated_text: One who enters [unauthorized] should be cut off [punished].

children.text: KAZ02.13.32/ āyukto vā sarūpya.suvarṇas tena^eva jīyeta //
children.translated_text: Or an authorized person [found] with silver or gold [on his person] should be penalized with that very [amount].

children.text: KAZ02.13.33/ vicita.vastra.hasta.guhyāḥ kāñcana.pṛṣata.tvaṣṭṛ.tapanīya.kāravo dhmāyaka.caraka.pāṃsu.dhāvakāḥ praviśeyur niṣkaseyuś ca //
children.translated_text: Goldsmiths, droplet-workers, cutters, refiners, smelters, polishers, and dust-washers should enter and exit with their clothes, hands, and private parts inspected.

children.text: KAZ02.13.34/ sarvaṃ ca^eṣām upakaraṇam aniṣṭhitāś ca prayogās tatra^eva^avatiṣṭheran //
children.translated_text: And all their tools and unfinished works should remain in that very [workshop].

children.text: KAZ02.13.35/ gṛhītaṃ suvarṇaṃ dhṛtaṃ ca prayogaṃ karaṇa.madhye dadyāt //
children.translated_text: The gold received and the work in progress should be handed over to the recording office.

children.text: KAZ02.13.36/ sāyaṃ prātaś ca lakṣitaṃ kartṛ.kārayitṛ.mudrābhyāṃ nidadhyāt //
children.translated_text: In the evening and morning, [the work] should be marked with the seals of both the maker and the supervisor and stored.

children.text: KAZ02.13.37/ kṣepaṇo guṇaḥ kṣudrakam iti karmāṇi //
children.translated_text: Casting, thread-work, and small articles — these are the [types of] operations.

children.text: KAZ02.13.38/ kṣepaṇaḥ kāca.arpaṇa.ādīni //
children.translated_text: Casting includes the setting of gems and the like.

children.text: KAZ02.13.39/ guṇaḥ sūtra.vāna.ādīni //
children.translated_text: Thread-work includes wire-drawing, weaving, and the like.

children.text: KAZ02.13.40/ ghanaṃ suṣiraṃ pṛṣata.ādi.yuktaṃ kṣudrakam iti //
children.translated_text: Solid, hollow, and fitted with droplets and the like — these are the small articles.

children.text: KAZ02.13.41/ arpayet kāca.karmaṇaḥ pañca.bhāgaṃ kāñcanaṃ daśa.bhāgaṃ kaṭu.mānam //
children.translated_text: For gem-setting work, one-fifth [of the gold] should be allotted for the gold [loss], and one-tenth as the sharp [tool] measure.

children.text: KAZ02.13.42/ tāmra.pāda.yuktaṃ rūpyaṃ rūpya.pāda.yuktaṃ vā suvarṇaṃ saṃskṛtakam, tasmād rakṣet //
children.translated_text: Silver combined with one-quarter copper, or gold combined with one-quarter silver, is an alloy (<s>saṃskṛtaka</s>) — one should guard against this.

children.text: KAZ02.13.43/ pṛṣata.kāca.karmaṇaḥ trayo hi bhāgāḥ paribhāṇḍaṃ dvau vāstukam, catvāro vā vāstukaṃ trayaḥ paribhāṇḍam //
children.translated_text: For droplet and gem-setting work, three parts are the [gem] setting and two the base; or four parts the base and three the setting.

children.text: KAZ02.13.44/ tvaṣṭṛ.karmaṇaḥ śulba.bhāṇḍaṃ sama.suvarṇena samyūhayet //
children.translated_text: For cutting work, the copper vessel should be compensated with an equal [weight of] gold.

children.text: KAZ02.13.45/ rūpya.bhāṇḍaṃ ghanaṃ suṣiraṃ vā suvarṇa.ardhena^avalepayet //
children.translated_text: A silver vessel, whether solid or hollow, should be plated with half [its weight in] gold.

children.text:
KAZ02.13.46/ catur.bhāga.suvarṇaṃ vā vālukā.hiṅgulukasya rasena cūrṇena vā vāsayet /
KAZ02.13.47/ tapanīyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ suvarṇaṃ surāgaṃ sama.sīsa.atikrāntaṃ pāka.pattra.pakvaṃ saindhavikayā^ujjvālitaṃ nīla.pīta.śveta.harita.śuka.pattra.varṇānāṃ prakṛtir bhavati //
children.translated_text:
Or with gold of one-quarter [fineness], it should be colored with mercury or powder of sand-cinnabar.
The finest gold (<s>tapanīya</s>) — highly colored, having passed through equal [measures of] lead, cooked as leaf-plates, and brightened with rock-salt flux — becomes the base material for blue, yellow, white, green, and parrot-feather colors.

children.text: KAZ02.13.48/ tīkṣṇaṃ ca^asya mayūra.grīva.ābhaṃ śveta.bhaṅgaṃ cimicimāyitaṃ pīta.cūrṇitaṃ kākaṇikaḥ suvarṇa.rāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: And its iron [alloy], having a peacock-neck luster, with white fracture, shimmering, and yellow-powdered — this is the <s>kākaṇika</s> [level of] gold coloring.

children.text: KAZ02.13.49/ tāram upaśuddhaṃ vā - asthi.tutthe catuḥ sama.sīse catuḥ śuṣka.tutthe catuḥ kapāle trir gomaye dvir evaṃ sapta.daśa.tuttha.atikrāntaṃ saindhavikayā^ujjvālitam //
children.translated_text: Or pure silver (<s>tāra</s>) [is refined thus]: in <s>tuttha</s> four [times], in equal lead four [times], in dry <s>tuttha</s> four [times], in a crucible three [times], in cow-dung twice — thus passed through seventeen <s>tuttha</s> [treatments] and brightened with rock-salt flux.

children.text:
KAZ02.13.50/ etasmāt kākaṇy.uttaramād vimāṣād iti suvarṇe deyam, paścād rāga.yogaḥ, śveta.tāraṃ bhavati /
KAZ02.13.51/ trayo^aṃśās tapanīyasya dvātriṃśad.bhāga.śveta.tāram ūrcchitāḥ tat śveta.lohitakaṃ bhavati //
children.translated_text:
From this [scale], ascending by one <s>kākaṇī</s> [increment], decreasing by one <s>māṣa</s> — this is to be given as [the standard for] gold; afterward comes the color-treatment; [the result] is white silver (<s>śvetatāra</s>).
Three parts of <s>tapanīya</s> gold combined with thirty-two parts of white silver — this becomes pinkish-white (<s>śvetalohitaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.13.52/ tāmraṃ pītakaṃ karoti //
children.translated_text: Copper produces a yellowish [tinge].

children.text: KAZ02.13.53/ tapanīyam ujjvālya rāga.tri.bhāgaṃ dadyāt, pīta.rāgaṃ bhavati //
children.translated_text: Having refined <s>tapanīya</s> gold, one should add one-third of the coloring agent — it becomes yellow-tinted.

children.text: KAZ02.13.54/ śveta.tāra.bhāgau dvāv ekas tapanīyasya mudga.varṇaṃ karoti //
children.translated_text: Two parts of white silver to one part of <s>tapanīya</s> produces mung-bean color.

children.text: KAZ02.13.55/ kāla.ayasasya^ardha.bhāga.abhyaktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhavati //
children.translated_text: Coated with half a part of dark iron (<s>kālāyasa</s>), it becomes black.

children.text: KAZ02.13.56/ pratilepinā rasena dvi.guṇa.abhyaktaṃ tapanīyaṃ śuka.pattra.varṇaṃ bhavati //
children.translated_text: Coated twice with the mercury of the covering [agent], <s>tapanīya</s> gold becomes parrot-feather colored.

children.text: KAZ02.13.57/ tasya.ārambhe rāga.viśeṣeṣu prativarṇikāṃ gṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: At the commencement of such [work], he should take a counter-sample for each color-variation.

children.text: KAZ02.13.58/ tīkṣṇa.tāmra.saṃskāraṃ ca budhyeta //
children.translated_text: And he should understand the treatment of iron and copper [alloys].

children.text: KAZ02.13.59/ tasmād vajra.maṇi.muktā.pravāla.rūpāṇām apaneyi.mānaṃ ca rūpya.suvarṇa.bhāṇḍa.bandha.pramāṇāni ca //
children.translated_text: Therefore, [he should know] the deductible amounts for diamonds, gems, pearls, and coral fittings, as well as the standards for the settings of silver and gold vessels.

children.text:
KAZ02.13.60ab/ sama.rāgaṃ sama.dvandvam asakta.pṛṣataṃ sthiram /
KAZ02.13.60cd/ supramṛṣṭam asampītaṃ vibhaktaṃ dhāraṇe sukham //
children.translated_text:
Of uniform color, evenly paired, with unseparated drops, firm,
well-polished, unabsorbed, well-proportioned, and comfortable to hold —

children.text:
KAZ02.13.61ab/ abhinītaṃ prabhā.yuktaṃ saṃsthānam adhuraṃ samam /
KAZ02.13.61cd/ mano.netra.abhirāmaṃ ca tapanīya.guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ //E
children.translated_text:
well-refined, lustrous, of [proper] form, free from blemishes, even,
and pleasing to the mind and eye — these are the qualities of refined gold (<s>tapanīya</s>).

children.text:
(Activity of the goldsmith in the market-highṛay)
KAZ02.14.01/ sauvarṇikaḥ paura.jāna.padānāṃ rūpya.suvarṇam āveśanibhiḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text:
(Activity of the goldsmith in the market-highway)
The superintendent of goldsmiths (<s>sauvarṇika</s>) should have the silver and gold work of the townspeople and country-folk carried out by hired artisans (<s>āveśaniḥ</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.14.02/ nirdiṣṭa.kāla.kāryaṃ ca karma kuryuḥ, anirdiṣṭa.kālaṃ kārya.apadeśam //
children.translated_text: They should execute work with a prescribed deadline [on time]; work without a prescribed deadline [should be completed] on the pretext of the task [at hand].

children.text: KAZ02.14.03/ kāryasya.anyathā.karaṇe vetana.nāśaḥ, tad.dvi.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For altering the work [from what was specified], [the artisan] loses his wages; and the fine is twice that [amount].

children.text: KAZ02.14.04/ kāla.atipātane pāda.hīnaṃ vetanaṃ tad.dvi.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For delay beyond the deadline, the wages are reduced by one quarter, and the fine is twice that [amount].

children.text: KAZ02.14.05/ yathā.varṇa.pramāṇaṃ nikṣepaṃ gṛhṇīyus tathā.vidham eva^arpayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: They should accept the deposit [of metal] as specified in color and weight, and return it in the same manner.

children.text: KAZ02.14.06/ kāla.antarād api ca tathā.vidham eva pratigṛhṇīyuḥ, anyatra kṣīṇa.pariśīrṇābhyām //
children.translated_text: Even after a lapse of time, they should return it in the same condition, except in cases of wear and deterioration.

children.text: KAZ02.14.07/ āveśanibhiḥ suvarṇa.pudgala.lakṣaṇa.prayogeṣu tat.taj jānīyāt //
children.translated_text: Through the hired artisans, [the superintendent] should learn the characteristics of gold — its appearance, quality, and applications in each case.

children.text: KAZ02.14.08/ tapta.kala.dhautakayoḥ kākaṇikaḥ suvarṇe kṣayo deyaḥ //
children.translated_text: In the processes of melting and washing, a loss of one <s>kākaṇī</s> per [unit of] gold is to be allowed.

children.text: KAZ02.14.09/ tīkṣṇa.kākaṇī - rūpya.dvi.guṇaḥ - rāga.prakṣepaḥ, tasya ṣaḍ.bhāgaḥ kṣayaḥ //
children.translated_text: The addition of coloring [agent] is: one <s>tīkṣṇa-kākaṇī</s> [of copper], twice [that amount] of silver; the loss from that [process] is one-sixth.

children.text: KAZ02.14.10/ varṇa.hīne māṣa.avare pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, pramāṇa.hīne madhyamaḥ, tulā.pratimāna.upadhāv uttamaḥ, kṛta.bhāṇḍa.upadhau ca //
children.translated_text: For deficiency in color [quality] by less than one <s>māṣa</s> — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine; for deficiency in quantity — the middle [level]; for fraud with weights and measures — the highest [level]; and also for fraud with finished articles.

children.text: KAZ02.14.11/ sauvarṇikena^adṛṣṭam anyatra vā prayogaṃ kārayato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For having work done unseen by the superintendent of goldsmiths or at another [unauthorized] place — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.14.12/ kartur dvi.guṇaḥ sa-apasāraś cet //
children.translated_text: For the maker — double [the fine], if he has the means to abscond.

children.text: KAZ02.14.13/ anapasāraḥ kaṇṭaka.śodhanāya nīyeta //
children.translated_text: One who does not have the means to abscond should be sent to the department for the removal of thorns [i.e., criminal investigation].

children.text: KAZ02.14.14/ kartuś ca dvi.śato daṇḍaḥ paṇac.chedanaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: And for the maker — a fine of two hundred [<s>paṇas</s>], or mutilation of the hand.

children.text: KAZ02.14.15/ tulā.pratimāna.bhāṇḍaṃ pautava.hastāt krīṇīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: They should purchase the weights, measures, and vessels from the superintendent of weights and measures (<s>pautava</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.14.16/ anyathā dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: Otherwise — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.14.17/ ghanaṃ suṣiraṃ samyūhyam avalepyaṃ saṃghātyaṃ vāsitakaṃ ca kāru.karma //
children.translated_text: Solid, hollow, assembled, overlaid, composite, and scented — these are the types of artisan work.

children.text: KAZ02.14.18/ tulā.viṣamam apasāraṇaṃ visrāvaṇaṃ peṭakaḥ piṅkaś ca^iti haraṇa.upāyāḥ //
children.translated_text: Unequal weighing, smuggling out, draining, concealing in a box (<s>peṭaka</s>), and substitution (<s>piṅka</s>) — these are the methods of theft.

children.text: KAZ02.14.19/ samnāminy utkīrṇikā bhinna.mastaka.upakaṇṭhī kuśikyā sakaṭu.kakṣyā parivelyā^ayas.kāntā ca duṣṭa.tulāḥ //
children.translated_text: One that bends, one with a notched [beam], one with a split head, one close to the neck, one with a pouch, one with a belt, one wrapped around, and one with a magnet — these are the defective balances.

children.text: KAZ02.14.20/ rūpyasya dvau bhāgāv ekaḥ śulbasya tripuṭakam //
children.translated_text: Two parts silver and one part copper make the alloy (<s>tripuṭaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.14.21/ tena^akarod gatam apasāryate tat.tripuṭaka.apasāritam //
children.translated_text: With that, what is made [appears genuine but the precious content] is smuggled out — this is alloy-based smuggling.

children.text: KAZ02.14.22/ śulbena śulba.apasāritam, vellakena vellaka.apasāritam, śulba.ardha.sāreṇa hemnā hema.apasāritam //
children.translated_text: With copper, copper-based smuggling; with tin (<s>vellaka</s>), tin-based smuggling; with copper mixed with half-refined gold, gold-based smuggling.

children.text: KAZ02.14.23/ mūka.mūṣā pūti.kiṭṭaḥ karaṭuka.mukhaṃ nālī saṃdaṃśo joṅganī suvarcikā.lavaṇaṃ tad eva suvarṇam ity apasāraṇa.mārgāḥ //
children.translated_text: A silent crucible, foul slag, a spout-shaped mouth, a tube, tongs, a <s>joṅganī</s> [tool], salt of <s>suvarcikā</s>, [or substituting] the same gold [with a base metal] — these are the methods of smuggling out.

children.text: KAZ02.14.24/ pūrva.praṇihitā vā piṇḍa.vālukā mūṣā.bhedād agniṣṭhād uddhriyante //
children.translated_text: Or, pellets of sand previously placed [in the crucible] are extracted from the furnace upon breaking the crucible.

children.text: KAZ02.14.25/ paścād bandhane ācitaka.pattra.parīkṣāyāṃ vā rūpya.rūpeṇa parivartanaṃ visrāvaṇam, piṇḍa.vālukānāṃ loha.piṇḍa.vālukābhir vā //
children.translated_text: In the final binding, during the inspection of layered sheets, substitution with a silver[-looking base metal] is draining; or [substituting] pellets of sand with pellets of base metal.

children.text: KAZ02.14.26/ gāḍhaś ca^abhyuddhāryaś ca peṭakaḥ samyūhya^avalepya.saṃghātyeṣu kriyate //
children.translated_text: A concealed box (<s>peṭaka</s>) — either tight or extractable — is employed in assembled, overlaid, and composite [articles].

children.text: KAZ02.14.27/ sīsa.rūpaṃ suvarṇa.pattreṇa^avaliptam abhyantaram aṣṭakena baddhaṃ gāḍha.peṭakaḥ //
children.translated_text: A form of lead covered with a gold sheet and bound internally with solder (<s>aṣṭaka</s>) is a tight box (<s>gāḍha-peṭaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.14.28/ sa eva paṭala.sampuṭeṣv abhyuddhāryaḥ //
children.translated_text: The same [box], in layered casings, is an extractable [box].

children.text: KAZ02.14.29/ pattram āśliṣṭaṃ yamakapattraṃ vā^avalepyeṣu kriyate //
children.translated_text: A clinging sheet, or a double sheet, is used in overlaid [articles].

children.text: KAZ02.14.30/ śulbaṃ tāraṃ vā garbhaḥ pattrāṇāṃ saṃghātyeṣu kriyate //
children.translated_text: Copper or silver as the core of sheets is used in composite [articles].

children.text: KAZ02.14.31/ śulba.rūpaṃ suvarṇa.pattra.saṃhataṃ pramṛṣṭaṃ supārśvam, tad eva yamaka.pattra.saṃhataṃ pramṛṣṭaṃ tāmra.tāra.rupaṃ ca^uttara.varṇakaḥ //
children.translated_text: A copper form covered and polished with gold sheets, with smooth sides — the same covered and polished with double sheets — and a copper-silver form — this is the superior-coating [fraud].

children.text: KAZ02.14.32/ tad ubhayaṃ tāpani.kaṣābhyāṃ nihśabda.ullekhanābhyāṃ vā vidyāt //
children.translated_text: Both of these should be detected by heating and touchstone, or by noiseless scratching.

children.text: KAZ02.14.33/ abhyuddhāryaṃ badara.āmle lavaṇa.udake vā sādayanti // iti peṭakaḥ //
children.translated_text: The extractable [box] is treated by boiling in jujube-acid or salt-water. — Thus [concludes the section on] the box (<s>peṭaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.14.34/ ghane suṣire vā rūpe suvarṇa.mṛn.mālukā.hiṅguluka.kalpo vā tapto^avatiṣṭhate //
children.translated_text: In solid or hollow coins, a compound of gold-dust, clay, and <s>hiṅguluka</s> (cinnabar), when heated, remains [hidden inside].

children.text: KAZ02.14.35/ dṛḍha.vāstuke vā rūpe vālukā.miśraṃ jatu gāndhāra.paṅko vā tapto^avatiṣṭhate //
children.translated_text: Or in a coin of firm construction, sand mixed with lac or <s>Gāndhāra</s> paste, when heated, remains [hidden].

children.text: KAZ02.14.36/ tayos tāpanam avadhvaṃsanaṃ vā śuddhiḥ //
children.translated_text: Heating or breaking open is the means of purification for both.

children.text: KAZ02.14.37/ sa-paribhāṇḍe vā rūpe lavaṇam ulkayā kaṭu.śarkarayā taptam avatiṣṭhate //
children.translated_text: Or in a coin with accessories, salt heated by a torch or with pungent powder remains [hidden].

children.text: KAZ02.14.38/ tasya kvāthanaṃ śuddhiḥ //
children.translated_text: Boiling is the means of purification for that.

children.text: KAZ02.14.39/ abhra.paṭalam aṣṭakena dvi.guṇa.vāstuke vā rūpe badhyate //
children.translated_text: A sheet of mica is bound with solder in a coin of double construction.

children.text: KAZ02.14.40/ tasya^apihita.kācakasya^udake nimajjata eka.deśaḥ sīdati, paṭala.antareṣu vā sūcyā bhidyate //
children.translated_text: When such [a coin], with its glass-covering concealed, is immersed in water, one side sinks; or it can be pierced with a needle between the layers.

children.text: KAZ02.14.41/ maṇayo rūpyaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā ghana.suṣirāṇāṃ piṅkaḥ //
children.translated_text: Gems, silver, or gold [hidden] inside solid or hollow [articles] is substitution (<s>piṅka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.14.42/ tasya tāpanam avadhvaṃsanaṃ vā śuddhiḥ / iti piṅkaḥ //
children.translated_text: Heating or breaking open is the means of purification for that. — Thus [concludes the section on] substitution (<s>piṅka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.14.43/ tasmād vajra.maṇi.muktā.pravāla.rūpāṇāṃ jāti.rūpa.varṇa.pramāṇa.pudgala.lakṣaṇāny upalabheta //
children.translated_text: Therefore, [the superintendent] should ascertain the species, form, color, weight, and identifying marks of diamonds, gems, pearls, coral, and coins.

children.text: KAZ02.14.44/ kṛta.bhāṇḍa.parīkṣāyāṃ purāṇa.bhāṇḍa.pratisaṃskāre vā catvāro haraṇa.upāyāḥ - parikuṭṭanam avacchedanam ullekhanaṃ parimardanaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: In the inspection of finished articles or in the repair of old articles, there are four methods of theft: scraping, cutting, scratching, and rubbing.

children.text: KAZ02.14.45/ peṭaka.apadeśena pṛṣataṃ guṇaṃ piṭakāṃ vā yat pariśātayanti tat.parikuṭṭanam //
children.translated_text: Scraping is when, under the pretext of [removing] a box-fitting, they scrape off drops, threads, or chips.

children.text: KAZ02.14.46/ yad.dvi.guṇa.vāstukānāṃ vā rūpe sīsa.rūpaṃ prakṣipya^ābhyantaram avacchindanti tad avacchedanam //
children.translated_text: Cutting is when, in coins of double construction, they insert a lead form and cut out the interior.

children.text: KAZ02.14.47/ yad ghanānāṃ tīkṣṇena^ullikhanti tad ullekhanam //
children.translated_text: Scratching is when they scratch solid [articles] with a sharp [instrument].

children.text: KAZ02.14.48/ hari.tāla.manaḥ.śilā.hiṅguluka.cūrṇānām anyatamena kuru.vinda.cūrṇena vā vastraṃ samyūhya yat parimṛdnanti tat parimardanam //
children.translated_text: Rubbing is when they rub [articles] with cloth smeared with powder of any one of orpiment, realgar, or cinnabar, or with powder of <s>kuruvinda</s> (corundum).

children.text: KAZ02.14.49/ tena sauvarṇa.rājatāni bhāṇḍāni kṣīyante, na ca^eṣāṃ kiṃcid avarugṇaṃ bhavati //
children.translated_text: By this means, gold and silver articles are diminished, yet nothing appears damaged in them.

children.text: KAZ02.14.50/ bhagna.khaṇḍa.ghṛṣṭānāṃ samyūhyānāṃ sadṛśena^anumānaṃ kuryāt //02.14.51/ avalepyānāṃ yāvad utpāṭitaṃ tāvad utpāṭya^anumānaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text:
For broken, chipped, or ground articles that are assembled, one should estimate [the loss] by comparison with a similar [article].
For overlaid articles, one should estimate [the loss] by peeling off as much as can be peeled.

children.text: KAZ02.14.52/ virūpāṇāṃ vā tāpanam udaka.peṣaṇaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Or for deformed [articles], one should repeatedly heat and grind them with water.

children.text: KAZ02.14.53/ avakṣepaḥ pratimānam agnir gaṇḍikā bhaṇḍika.adhikaraṇī piñchaḥ sūtraṃ cellaṃ bollanaṃ śira utsaṅgo makṣikā sva.kāya.īkṣā dṛtir udaka.śarāvam agniṣṭham iti kācaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: The depression, the touchstone, fire, the lump, the test-dish and its stand, the peacock-feather, the thread, the screen, the bellows, the tip, the lap, the fly, self-body inspection, the bellows-bag, the water-bowl, and the fire-pit — [the superintendent] should know these as [potential means of] fraud.

children.text: KAZ02.14.54/ rājatānāṃ visraṃ mala.grāhi paruṣaṃ prastīnaṃ vivarṇaṃ vā duṣṭam iti vidyāt //
children.translated_text: For silver [articles], one should know as defective [those that are]: fetid, absorbing impurities, rough, flaking, or discolored.

children.text:
KAZ02.14.55ab/ evaṃ navaṃ ca jīrṇaṃ ca virūpaṃ ca^api bhāṇḍakam /
KAZ02.14.55cd/ parīkṣeta^atyayaṃ ca^eṣāṃ yathā.uddiṣṭaṃ prakalpayet //E
children.translated_text:
Thus, whether new, old, or deformed, every article
should be inspected, and the penalty for [fraud in] these should be imposed as prescribed.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of the magaśin)
KAZ02.15.01/ koṣṭha.agāra.adhyakṣaḥ sītā.rāṣṭra.krayima.parivartaka.prāmityaka.āpamityaka.saṃhanika.anya.jāta.vyaya.pratyāya.upasthānāny upalabhet //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of the storehouse)
The superintendent of the storehouse (<s>koṣṭhāgārādhyakṣa</s>) should take charge of the revenues from crown lands, the countryside, purchases, exchanges, borrowings, repayments, manufactures, miscellaneous, expenditure, income, and balances.

children.text: KAZ02.15.02/ sītā.adhyakṣa.upanītaḥ sasya.varṇakaḥ sītā //
children.translated_text: The harvest share, with its classification of crops, brought in by the superintendent of agriculture (<s>sītādhyakṣa</s>) constitutes the crown-land [revenue] (<s>sītā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.03/ piṇḍa.karaḥ ṣaḍ.bhāgaḥ senā.bhaktaṃ baliḥ kara utsaṅgaḥ pārśvaṃ pārihīṇikam aupāyanikaṃ kauṣṭheyakaṃ ca rāṣṭram //
children.translated_text: The lump tax, the one-sixth share, army provisions, tribute (<s>bali</s>), the tax (<s>kara</s>), the surcharge (<s>utsaṅga</s>), the side-levy (<s>pārśva</s>), the compensatory levy (<s>pārihīṇika</s>), the voluntary gift (<s>aupāyanika</s>), and the storehouse levy (<s>kauṣṭheyaka</s>) — [these constitute] the countryside [revenue] (<s>rāṣṭra</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.04/ dhānya.mūlyaṃ kośa.nirhāraḥ prayoga.pratyādānaṃ ca krayimam //
children.translated_text: Grain [acquired at its] price, disbursement from the treasury, and recovery of advances — [these constitute] purchases (<s>krayima</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.05/ sasya.varṇānām argha.antareṇa vinimayaḥ parivartakaḥ //
children.translated_text: The exchange of crop varieties at differential prices is barter (<s>parivartaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.06/ sasya.yācanam anyataḥ prāmityakam //
children.translated_text: Requesting grain from another [source] is borrowing (<s>prāmityaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.07/ tad eva pratidāna.artham āpamityakam //
children.translated_text: The same for the purpose of repayment is repayment (<s>āpamityaka</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.08/ kuṭṭaka.rocaka.saktu.śukta.piṣṭa.karma taj.jīvaneṣu taila.pīḍana.maudra.cākrikeṣv ikṣūṇāṃ ca kṣāra.karma saṃhanikā //
children.translated_text: Husking, fermentation, flour-making, vinegar-making, and pastry-making; oil-pressing, honey-processing, and confectionery, among those who live by these [trades]; and alkali-processing of sugarcane — [these constitute] manufactures (<s>saṃhanikā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.09/ naṣṭa.prasmṛta.ādir anya.jātaḥ //
children.translated_text: Lost and forgotten [items] and the like constitute miscellaneous [income] (<s>anyajāta</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.10/ vikṣepa.vyādhita.antara.ārambha.śeṣaṃ ca vyaya.pratyāyaḥ //
children.translated_text: The remainder after deducting [amounts for] distribution, spoiled [goods], and secondary operations constitutes the expenditure-income [balance] (<s>vyayapratyāya</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.11/ tulā.māna.antaraṃ hasta.pūraṇam utkaro vyājī paryuṣitaṃ prārjitaṃ ca^upasthānam / iti //
children.translated_text: The difference in weighing and measuring, the handful-fill, the sweepings, the surplus, the stale [remainder], and the cleaned [residue] — [these constitute] the balance (<s>upasthāna</s>). — Thus [ends the enumeration].

children.text: KAZ02.15.12/ dhānya.sneha.kṣāra.lavaṇānāṃ dhānya.kalpaṃ sītā.adhyakṣe vakṣyāmaḥ //
children.translated_text: We shall discuss the classification of grains, oils, alkalis, and salts under the superintendent of agriculture.

children.text: KAZ02.15.13/ sarpis.taila.vasā.majjānaḥ snehāḥ //
children.translated_text: Clarified butter, oil, fat, and marrow — these are the oils (<s>snehas</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.14/ phāṇita.guḍa.matsyaṇḍika.akhaṇḍa.śarkarāḥ kṣāra.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: Treacle (<s>phāṇita</s>), jaggery (<s>guḍa</s>), granulated sugar (<s>matsyaṇḍikā</s>), lump sugar (<s>akhaṇḍa</s>), and crystallized sugar (<s>śarkarā</s>) — these are the alkali group.

children.text: KAZ02.15.15/ saindhava.sāmudra.biḍa.yava.kṣāra.sauvarcala.udbhedajā lavaṇa.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: Rock salt (<s>saindhava</s>), sea salt (<s>sāmudra</s>), black salt (<s>biḍa</s>), barley-alkali salt (<s>yavakṣāra</s>), <s>sauvarcala</s> salt, and earth-born salt (<s>udbhedaja</s>) — these are the salt group.

children.text: KAZ02.15.16/ kṣaudraṃ mārdvīkaṃ ca madhu //
children.translated_text: Bee-honey (<s>kṣaudra</s>) and grape-wine (<s>mārdvīka</s>) — these are honey (<s>madhu</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.15.17/ ikṣu.rasa.guḍa.madhu.phāṇita.jāmbava.panasānām anyatamo meṣa.śṛṅgī.pippalī.kvātha.abhiṣuto māsikaḥ ṣāṇmāsikaḥ sāṃvatsariko vā cidbhiṭor vāruka.ikṣu.kāṇḍa.āmra.phala.āmalaka.avasutaḥ śuddho vā śukta.vargaḥ //
