children.translated_text: Fermented from any one of sugarcane juice, jaggery, honey, treacle, rose-apple, or jackfruit, infused with a decoction of <s>meṣaśṛṅgī</s> and long pepper — [whether] monthly, six-monthly, or yearly — or [made from] <s>cidbhiṭa</s>, prepared from <s>vāruka</s> cane, mango fruit, or <s>āmalaka</s>, or plain — these are the vinegar group.

children.text: KAZ02.15.18/ vṛkṣa.āmla.kara.marda.āmra.vidala.āmalaka.mātuluṅga.kola.badara.sauvīraka.parūṣaka.ādiḥ phala.āmla.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: Tree-acid (<s>vṛkṣāmla</s>), <s>karamarda</s>, mango, split [chickpea acid], <s>āmalaka</s>, citron, jujube, plum, <s>sauvīraka</s>, <s>parūṣaka</s>, and so on — these are the fruit-acid group.

children.text: KAZ02.15.19/ dadhi.dhānya.āmla.ādir drava.āmla.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: Curds, grain-acid, and so on — these are the liquid-acid group.

children.text: KAZ02.15.20/ pippalī.marica.śṛṅgi.berā.ajājī.kirāta.tikta.gaura.sarṣapa.kustumburu.coraka.damanaka.maruvaka.śigru.kāṇḍa.ādiḥ kaṭuka.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: Long pepper, black pepper, <s>śṛṅgībera</s> (ginger), cumin, <s>kirātatikta</s>, white mustard, coriander, <s>coraka</s>, <s>damanaka</s>, marjoram, drumstick, and so on — these are the pungent group.

children.text: KAZ02.15.21/ śuṣka.matsya.māṃsa.kanda.mūla.phala.śāka.ādi ca śāka.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: Dried fish, meat, bulbs, roots, fruits, vegetables, and so on — these are the vegetable group.

children.text: KAZ02.15.22/ tato^ardham āpad.arthaṃ jānapadānāṃ sthāpayed, ardham upayuñjīta //
children.translated_text: Half of [the stores] he should set aside for the emergency needs of the country-folk, and half he should use [for current consumption].

children.text: KAZ02.15.23/ navena ca^anavaṃ śodhayet //
children.translated_text: And he should replace the old [stock] with new.

children.text: KAZ02.15.24/ kṣuṇṇa.ghṛṣṭa.piṣṭa.bhṛṣṭānām ārdra.śuṣka.siddhānāṃ ca dhānyānāṃ vṛddhi.kṣaya.pramāṇāni pratyakṣī.kurvīta //
children.translated_text: He should ascertain the rates of increase and decrease for grains that are pounded, ground, milled, and roasted, both in wet and dry states, and when cooked.

children.text: KAZ02.15.25/ kodrava.vrīhīṇām ardhaṃ sāraḥ, śālīnām ardha.bhāga.ūnaḥ, tri.bhāga.ūno varakāṇām //
children.translated_text: For <s>kodrava</s> and <s>vrīhi</s> (rice), the yield is one-half; for <s>śāli</s> (fine rice), less by a half-portion; for <s>varaka</s>, less by one-third.

children.text: KAZ02.15.26/ priyaṅgūṇām ardhaṃ sāro nava.bhāga.vṛddhiś ca //
children.translated_text: For <s>priyaṅgu</s> (millet), the yield is one-half, with an increase of one-ninth.

children.text: KAZ02.15.27/ udārakas tulyaḥ, yavā go.dhūmāś ca kṣuṇṇāḥ, tilā yavā mudga.māṣāś ca ghṛṣṭāḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Udāraka</s> is equal [in yield]; barley and wheat when pounded, sesame, barley, <s>mudga</s> (green gram), and <s>māṣa</s> (black gram) when ground [yield the same].

children.text: KAZ02.15.28/ pañca.bhāga.vṛddhir.go.dhūmaḥ, saktavaś ca //
children.translated_text: Wheat has an increase of one-fifth [when cooked], as do barley-grits.

children.text: KAZ02.15.29/ pāda.ūnā kalāya.camasī //
children.translated_text: For peas and <s>camasī</s>, [the yield] is less by one-quarter.

children.text: KAZ02.15.30/ mudga.māṣāṇām ardha.pāda.ūnā //
children.translated_text: For <s>mudga</s> and <s>māṣa</s>, less by half a quarter.

children.text: KAZ02.15.31/śaumbyānām ardhaṃ sāraḥ, tri.bhāga.ūno masūrāṇām //
children.translated_text: For legumes (<s>śaumbya</s>), the yield is one-half; for lentils (<s>masūra</s>), less by one-third.

children.text: KAZ02.15.32/ piṣṭam āmaṃ kulmāṣāś ca^adhyardha.guṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: Raw flour and parched grain (<s>kulmāṣa</s>) [yield] one and a half times.

children.text: KAZ02.15.33/ dvi.guṇo yāvakaḥ, pulākaḥ, piṣṭaṃ ca siddham //
children.translated_text: Barley gruel (<s>yāvaka</s>) [yields] double, as does boiled rice-husk (<s>pulāka</s>) and cooked flour.

children.text: KAZ02.15.34/ kodrava.varaka.udāraka.priyaṅgūṇāṃ tri.guṇam annam, catur.guṇaṃ vrīhīṇām, pañca.guṇaṃ śālīnām //
children.translated_text: For <s>kodrava</s>, <s>varaka</s>, <s>udāraka</s>, and <s>priyaṅgu</s> — the cooked rice is threefold; for <s>vrīhi</s> — fourfold; for <s>śāli</s> — fivefold.

children.text: KAZ02.15.35/ timitam apara.annaṃ dvi.guṇam, ardha.adhikaṃ virūḍhānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.35/ Soaked rice yields double; one and a half times more for sprouted [grains].

children.text: KAZ02.15.36/ pañca.bhāga.vṛddhir bhṛṣṭānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.36/ For roasted [grains], the increase is one-fifth.

children.text: KAZ02.15.37/ kalāyo dvi.guṇaḥ, lājā bharujāś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.37/ Peas [yield] double; likewise parched grain and roasted barley.

children.text: KAZ02.15.38/ṣaṭkaṃ tailam atasīnām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.38/ Oil from linseed is one-sixth [of the raw material].

children.text: KAZ02.15.39/ nimba.kuśa.āmraka.pittha.ādīnāṃ pañca.bhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.39/ From neem, <s>kuśa</s> grass, mango, wood-apple, and others — one-fifth.

children.text: KAZ02.15.40/ catur.bhāgikās tila.kusumbha.madhūka.iṅgudī.snehāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.40/ Oils from sesame, safflower, <s>madhūka</s>, and <s>iṅgudī</s> yield one-fourth.

children.text: KAZ02.15.41/ kārpāsa.kṣaumāṇāṃ pañca.pale palaṃ sūtram //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.41/ From five <s>palas</s> of cotton or linen, one <s>pala</s> of thread [is produced].

children.text: KAZ02.15.42/ pañca.droṇe śālīnāṃ dvādaśa.āḍhakaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ kalabha.bhojanam, ekādaśakaṃ vyālānām, daśakam aupavāhyānāṃ navakaṃ sāmnāhyānām, aṣṭakaṃ pattīnām, saptakaṃ mukhyānām, ṣaṭkaṃ devī.kumārāṇām, pañcakaṃ rājñām, akhaṇḍa.pariśuddhānāṃ vā tuaṇḍulānāṃ prasthaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.42/ From five <s>droṇas</s> of unhusked rice: twelve <s>āḍhakas</s> of husked rice for young elephants; eleven for draught elephants; ten for riding elephants; nine for armored elephants; eight for foot-soldiers; seven for chiefs; six for queens and princes; five for the king; or one <s>prastha</s> of unbroken, fully cleaned rice [per person].

children.text: KAZ02.15.43/ taṇḍulānāṃ prasthaḥ catur.bhāgaḥ sūpaḥ sūpa.ṣoḍaśo lavaṇasya^aṃśaḥ catur.bhāgaḥ sarpiṣas tailasya vā^ekam ārya.bhaktaṃ puṃsaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.43/ One <s>prastha</s> of rice, one-fourth [<s>prastha</s>] of lentil soup, one-sixteenth of salt in proportion to the soup, one-fourth of ghee or oil — this constitutes one meal ration for a man of the superior class.

children.text: KAZ02.15.44/ṣaḍ.bhāgaḥ sūpaḥ ardha.sneham avarāṇām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.44/ One-sixth [<s>prastha</s>] of lentil soup and half the fat for those of the lower class.

children.text: KAZ02.15.45/ pāda.ūnaṃ strīṇām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.45/ One-quarter less for women.

children.text: KAZ02.15.46/ ardhaṃ bālānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.46/ Half for children.

children.text: KAZ02.15.47/ māṃsa.pala.viṃśatyā sneha.ardha.kuḍubaḥ paliko lavaṇasya^aṃśaḥ kṣāra.pala.yogo dvi.dharaṇikaḥ kaṭuka.yogo dadhnuś ca^ardha.prasthaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.47/ With twenty <s>palas</s> of meat: half a <s>kuḍuba</s> of fat, one <s>pala</s> of salt, the spice mixture weighing two <s>dharaṇas</s>, the pungent seasoning, and half a <s>prastha</s> of curds.

children.text: KAZ02.15.48/ tena^uttaraṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.48/ By that, the higher [rations] are explained.

children.text: KAZ02.15.49/ śākānām adhyardha.guṇaḥ, śuṣkāṇāṃ dvi.guṇaḥ, sa caiva yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.49/ For fresh vegetables, one and a half times [the quantity]; for dried, double — with the same seasoning.

children.text: KAZ02.15.50/ hasty.aśvayos tad.adhyakṣe vidhā.pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.50/ For elephants and horses, we shall state the measure of rations under their respective superintendents.

children.text: KAZ02.15.51/ balī.vardānāṃ māṣa.droṇaṃ yavānāṃ vā pulākaḥ, śeṣam aśva.vidhānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.51/ For bullocks: one <s>droṇa</s> of black gram or barley husks; the rest follows the ration for horses.

children.text: KAZ02.15.52/ viśeṣo ghāṇa.piṇyāka.tulā, kaṇa.kuṇḍakaṃ daśa.āḍhakaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.52/ The distinction is: one <s>tulā</s> of oil-cake from the press, and ten <s>āḍhakas</s> of bran and husk.

children.text: KAZ02.15.53/ dvi.guṇaṃ mahiṣa.uṣṭrāṇām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.53/ Double for buffaloes and camels.

children.text: KAZ02.15.54/ ardha.droṇaṃ khara.pṛṣata.rohitānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.54/ Half a <s>droṇa</s> for donkeys, spotted deer, and red deer.

children.text: KAZ02.15.55/ āḍhakam eṇa.kuraṅgāṇām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.55/ One <s>āḍhaka</s> for antelope and <s>kuraṅga</s> deer.

children.text: KAZ02.15.56/ ardha.āḍhakam aja.eḍaka.varāhāṇām, dvi.guṇaṃ vā kaṇa.kuṇḍakam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.56/ Half an <s>āḍhaka</s> for goats, sheep, and pigs; or double the [amount of] bran and husk.

children.text: KAZ02.15.57/ prastha.odanaḥ śunām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.57/ One <s>prastha</s> of cooked rice for dogs.

children.text: KAZ02.15.58/ haṃsa.krauñca.mayūrāṇām ardha.prasthaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.58/ Half a <s>prastha</s> for geese, herons, and peacocks.

children.text: KAZ02.15.59/ śeṣāṇām ato mṛga.paśu.pakṣi.vyālānām eka.bhaktād anumānaṃ grāhayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.59/ For the remaining wild animals, domestic animals, birds, and reptiles, the ration should be estimated from a single feeding.

children.text: KAZ02.15.60/ aṅgārāṃs tuṣān loha.karma.anta.bhitti.lepyānāṃ hārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.60/ He should have charcoal, husks, and ashes taken away for use in metalwork and wall-plastering.

children.text: KAZ02.15.61/ kaṇikā dāsa.karma.kara.sūpa.kārāṇām, ato^anyad audanika.apūpikebhyaḥ prayacchet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.61/ Broken grain [goes] to slaves, laborers, and soup-makers; the rest he should distribute to pastry-makers and cake-makers.

children.text: KAZ02.15.62/ tulā.māna.bhāṇḍaṃ rocanī.dṛṣan.musala.ulūkhala.kuṭṭaka.rocaka.yantra.pattraka.śūrpa.cālanika.akaṇḍolī.piṭaka.sammārjanyaś ca^upakaraṇāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.62/ Scales, measures, and vessels; coloring stones, grinding stones, pestles, mortars, pounders, polishing stones, mechanical sifters, winnowing baskets, sieves, baskets, containers, and brooms — these are the equipment.

children.text: KAZ02.15.63/ mārjaka.rakṣaka.dharaka.māyaka.māpaka.dāyaka.dāpaka.śalāka.apratigrāhaka.dāsa.karma.kara.vargaś ca viṣṭiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.15.63/ Cleaners, guards, carriers, assayers, measurers, distributors, collectors, tally-stick receivers, slaves, and laborers — these constitute the labor force.

children.text:
KAZ02.15.64ab/ uccair dhānyasya nikṣepo mūtāḥ kṣārasya saṃhatāḥ /
KAZ02.15.64cd/ mṛt.kāṣṭha.koṣṭhāḥ snehasya pṛthivī lavaṇasya ca //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.15.64ab/ Grain should be stored on high [platforms]; salts packed together in compact heaps;
KAZ02.15.64cd/ fats in earthen or wooden containers; and salt [stored] on the ground.

children.text:
(ḍirector of trade)
KAZ02.16.01/ paṇya.adhyakṣaḥ sthala.jalajānāṃ nānā.vidhānāṃ paṇyānāṃ sthala.patha.vāri.patha.upayātānāṃ sāra.phalgv.argha.antaraṃ priya.apriyatāṃ ca vidyāt, tathā vikṣepa.saṃkṣepa.kraya.vikraya.prayoga.kālān //
children.translated_text:
(Director of trade)
KAZ02.16.01/ The superintendent of commerce should know the difference in quality and price, and the desirability or undesirability, of various kinds of goods — produced on land and in water — that arrive by land routes and waterways; likewise the times for dispersal, consolidation, purchase, sale, and commercial operations.

children.text: KAZ02.16.02/ yac ca paṇyaṃ pracuraṃ syāt tad ekī.kṛtya^argham āropayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.02/ Whatever merchandise is abundant, he should consolidate it and raise the price.

children.text: KAZ02.16.03/ prāpte^arghe vā^argha.antaraṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.03/ Or when the price has been reached, he should create a price differential.

children.text: KAZ02.16.04/ sva.bhūmijānāṃ rāja.paṇyānām eka.mukhaṃ vyavahāraṃ sthāpayet, para.bhūmijānām aneka.mukham //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.04/ For royal goods produced in one's own territory, he should establish a single outlet for trade; for those from foreign territory, multiple outlets.

children.text: KAZ02.16.05/ ubhayaṃ ca prajānām anugraheṇa vikrāpayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.05/ Both he should sell for the benefit of the subjects.

children.text: KAZ02.16.06/ sthūlam api ca lābhaṃ prajānām aupaghātikaṃ vārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.06/ Even a large profit that is harmful to the subjects he should prevent.

children.text: KAZ02.16.07/ ajasra.paṇyānāṃ kāla.uparodhaṃ saṃkula.doṣaṃ vā na^utpādayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.07/ For goods in constant demand, he should not create a restriction of time or a fault of congestion.

children.text: KAZ02.16.08/ bahu.mukhaṃ vā rāja.paṇyaṃ vaidehakāḥ kṛta.arghaṃ vikrīṇīran //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.08/ Or, for royal goods with multiple outlets, traders should sell [them] at a fixed price.

children.text: KAZ02.16.09/ cheda.anurūpaṃ ca vaidharaṇaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.09/ And they should pay a handling fee proportionate to the loss [from handling].

children.text: KAZ02.16.10/ ṣoḍaśa.bhāgo māna.vyājī, viṃśati.bhāgas tulā.mānam, gaṇya.paṇyānām ekādaśa.bhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.10/ The measuring fee is one-sixteenth; the weighing fee one-twentieth; for goods sold by count, one-eleventh.

children.text: KAZ02.16.11/ para.bhūmijaṃ paṇyam anugraheṇa^āvāhayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.11/ Merchandise from foreign lands should be attracted through concessions.

children.text: KAZ02.16.12/ na^avikasa.artha.vāhebhyaś ca parihāram āyati.kṣamaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.12/ And to merchants bringing unsold goods, he should grant exemptions that promote future revenue.

children.text: KAZ02.16.13/ anabhiyogaś ca^artheṣv āgantūnām, anyatra sabhyā.upakāribhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.13/ And there should be no harassment of newcomers in their business, except from those who assist at the tribunal.

children.text: KAZ02.16.14/ paṇya.adhiṣṭhātāraḥ paṇya.mūlyam eka.mukhaṃ kāṣṭha.droṇyām ekac.chidra.apidhānāyāṃ nidadhyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.14/ The overseers of merchandise should deposit the sale price in a single wooden box with one opening and a lid.

children.text: KAZ02.16.15/ ahnaś ca^aṣṭame bhāge paṇya.adhyakṣasya^arpayeyuḥ - "idaṃ vikrītam, idaṃ śeṣam" iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.15/ And at the eighth part of the day, they should report to the superintendent of commerce: "This much was sold; this much remains."

children.text: KAZ02.16.16/ tulā.māna.bhāṇḍaṃ ca^arpayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.16/ And they should return the scales, measures, and vessels.

children.text: KAZ02.16.17/ iti sva.viṣaye vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.17/ Thus is explained [trade] in one's own territory.

children.text: KAZ02.16.18/ para.viṣaye tu - paṇya.pratipaṇyayor arghaṃ mūlyaṃ ca^āgamayya śulka.vartanyā^ātivāhika.gulmatara.deya.bhakta.bhāga.vyaya.śuddham udayaṃ paśyet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.18/ In foreign territory, however — having ascertained the price and cost of goods and counter-goods, he should calculate the net profit after deducting tolls, road fees, escort charges, frontier duties, provisions, share [of the ruler], and expenses.

children.text: KAZ02.16.19/ asaty udaye bhāṇḍa.nirvahaṇena paṇya.pratipaṇya.ānayanena vā lābhaṃ paśyet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.19/ If there is no profit, he should see profit in transporting the goods [elsewhere] or in bringing back counter-goods.

children.text: KAZ02.16.20/ tataḥ sāra.pādena sthala.vyavahāram adhvanā kṣemeṇa prayojayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.20/ Then, with a quarter [reserved] as the best [goods], he should conduct overland trade by a safe route.

children.text: KAZ02.16.21/ aṭavy.anta.pāla.pura.rāṣṭra.mukhyaiś ca pratisaṃsargaṃ gacched anugraha.artham //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.21/ And he should establish relations with chiefs of forest regions, frontier guards, and town and district heads for the purpose of receiving concessions.

children.text: KAZ02.16.22/ āpadi sāram ātmānaṃ vā mokṣayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.22/ In a calamity, he should save the best [goods] or himself.

children.text: KAZ02.16.23/ ātmano vā bhūmiṃ prāptaḥ sarva.deya.viśuddhaṃ vyavahareta //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.23/ Or, having reached his own territory, he should trade free of all dues.

children.text: KAZ02.16.24/ vāri.pathe vā yāna.bhāgaka.pathy.adana.paṇya.pratipaṇya.argha.pramāṇa.yātrā.kāla.bhaya.pratīkāra.paṇya.pattana.cāritrāṇy upalabheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.16.24/ Or by water route, he should ascertain the vessel charges, route, provisions, price and quantity of goods and counter-goods, time of voyage, measures against danger, and the customs of trading ports.

children.text:
KAZ02.16.25ab/ nadī.pathe ca vijñāya vyavahāraṃ caritrataḥ /
KAZ02.16.25cd/ yato lābhas tato gacched alābhaṃ parivarjayet //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.16.25ab/ And having learned the trade customs of the river route,
KAZ02.16.25cd/ he should go where there is profit and avoid where there is no profit.

children.text:
(ḍirector of forest produce)
KAZ02.17.01/ kupya.adhyakṣo dravya.vana.pālaiḥ kupyam ānāyayet //
children.translated_text:
(Director of forest produce)
KAZ02.17.01/ The superintendent of forest produce should have raw materials brought in through the forest guards.

children.text: KAZ02.17.02/ dravya.vana.karma.antāṃś ca prayojayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.02/ And he should employ the workshops for processing forest produce.

children.text: KAZ02.17.03/ dravya.vanac.chidrāṃ ca deyam atyayaṃ ca sthāpayed anyatra^āpadbhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.03/ He should establish what is due from forest produce openings and the penalties [for violations], except in cases of calamity.

children.text: KAZ02.17.04/ kupya.vargaḥ - śāka.tiniśa.dhanvana.arjuna.madhūka.tilaka.sāla.śiṃśapā.arimeda.rāja.adana.śirīṣa.khadira.sarala.tāla.sarja.aśva.karṇa.soma.valka.kuśa.āmra.priyaka.dhava.ādiḥ sāra.dāru.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.04/ The raw material categories: <s>śāka</s>, <s>tiniśa</s>, <s>dhanvana</s>, <s>arjuna</s>, <s>madhūka</s>, <s>tilaka</s>, <s>sāla</s>, <s>śiṃśapā</s>, <s>arimeda</s>, <s>rājādana</s>, <s>śirīṣa</s>, <s>khadira</s>, <s>sarala</s>, <s>tāla</s>, <s>sarja</s>, <s>aśvakarṇa</s>, <s>somavalka</s>, <s>kuśāmra</s>, <s>priyaka</s>, <s>dhava</s>, and others — this is the category of hardwoods.

children.text: KAZ02.17.05/ uṭaja.cimiya.cāpa.veṇu.vaṃśa.sātina.kaṇṭaka.bhāllūka.ādir veṇu.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.05/ <s>Uṭaja</s>, <s>cimiya</s>, bow-bamboo, <s>veṇu</s>, <s>vaṃśa</s>, <s>sātina</s>, thorny bamboo, <s>bhāllūka</s>, and others — this is the category of bamboo.

children.text: KAZ02.17.06/ vetra.śīka.vallī.vāśī.śyāma.latā.nāga.latā.ādir vallī.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.06/ Cane, <s>śīka</s>, creepers, <s>vāśī</s>, <s>śyāmalata</s>, <s>nāgalatā</s>, and others — this is the category of creepers.

children.text: KAZ02.17.07/ mālatī.mūrvā.arka.śaṇa.gavedhukā.atasy.ādir valka.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.07/ <s>Mālatī</s>, <s>mūrvā</s>, <s>arka</s>, hemp, <s>gavedhukā</s>, linseed, and others — this is the category of bark-fibers.

children.text: KAZ02.17.08/ muñja.balbaja.ādi rajju.bhāṇḍam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.08/ <s>Muñja</s>, <s>balbaja</s>, and others [constitute] rope-making materials.

children.text: KAZ02.17.09/ tālī.tāla.bhūrjānāṃ pattram //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.09/ Leaves of <s>tālī</s>, <s>tāla</s> (palm), and <s>bhūrja</s> (birch).

children.text: KAZ02.17.10/ kiṃśuka.kusumbha.kuṅkumānāṃ puṣpam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.10/ Flowers of <s>kiṃśuka</s>, safflower, and saffron.

children.text: KAZ02.17.11/ kanda.mūla.phala.ādir auṣadha.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.11/ Tubers, roots, fruits, and others — this is the category of medicinal plants.

children.text: KAZ02.17.12/ kāla.kūṭa.vatsa.nābha.hālāhala.meṣa.śṛṅga.mustā.kuṣṭha.mahā.viṣa.vellitaka.gaura.ardra.bālaka.mārkaṭa.haimavata.kāliṅgaka.dāradaka.aṅkola.sāraka.uṣṭraka.ādīni viṣāṇi, sarpāḥ kīṭāś ca ta eva kumbha.gatāḥ viṣa.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.12/ <s>Kālakūṭa</s>, <s>vatsanābha</s>, <s>hālāhala</s>, <s>meṣaśṛṅga</s>, <s>mustā</s>, <s>kuṣṭha</s>, <s>mahāviṣa</s>, <s>vellitaka</s>, <s>gaurārdra</s>, <s>bālaka</s>, <s>mārkaṭa</s>, <s>haimavata</s>, <s>kāliṅgaka</s>, <s>dāradaka</s>, <s>aṅkolasāraka</s>, <s>uṣṭraka</s>, and others — these are the poisons; serpents and insects, and those same [poisons] stored in pots, constitute the poison category.

children.text: KAZ02.17.13/ godhā.seraka.dvīpy.ṛkṣa.śiṃśumāra.siṃha.vyāghra.hasti.mahiṣa.camara.sṛmara.khaḍga.go.mṛga.gavayānāṃ carma.asthi.pitta.snāyv.akṣi.danta.śṛṅga.khura.pucchāni, anyeṣāṃ vā^api mṛga.paśu.pakṣi.vyālānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.13/ From monitor lizards, <s>seraka</s>, leopards, bears, crocodiles, lions, tigers, elephants, buffaloes, <s>camara</s> (yak), <s>sṛmara</s>, rhinoceros, cattle, deer, and <s>gavaya</s> (wild ox) — hides, bones, bile, sinews, eyes, teeth, horns, hooves, and tails; and from other wild animals, domestic animals, birds, and reptiles [as well].

children.text: KAZ02.17.14/ kāla.ayasa.tāmra.vṛtta.kaṃsa.sīsa.trapu.vaikṛntaka.āra.kūṭāni lohāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.14/ Iron, steel, copper, <s>vṛtta</s> (brass), bell-metal, lead, tin, <s>vaikṛntaka</s>, and alloys — these are the metals.

children.text: KAZ02.17.15/ vidala.mṛttikāmayaṃ bhāṇḍam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.15/ Vessels made of split [bamboo] and clay.

children.text: KAZ02.17.16/ aṅgāra.tuṣa.bhasmāni, mṛga.paśu.pakṣi.vyāla.vāṭāḥ kāṣṭha.tṛṇa.vāṭāś ca / iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.17.16/ Charcoal, husks, and ashes; enclosures for wild animals, domestic animals, birds, and reptiles; and enclosures for timber and grass. Thus [ends the section].

children.text:
KAZ02.17.17ab/ bahir antaś ca karma.antā vibhaktāḥ sārvabhāṇḍikāḥ /
KAZ02.17.17cd/ ājīva.pura.rakṣā.arthāḥ kāryāḥ kupya.upajīvinā //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.17.17ab/ Workshops both outside and inside [the fort], classified by all kinds of goods,
KAZ02.17.17cd/ should be established by the superintendent of forest produce for the purposes of livelihood and protection of the city.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of the armoury)
KAZ02.18.01/ āyudha.agāra.adhyakṣaḥ sāṃgrāmikaṃ daurgakarmikaṃ para.pura.abhighātikaṃ ca yantram āyudham āvaraṇam upakaraṇaṃ ca taj.jāta.kāru.śilpibhiḥ kṛta.karma.pramāṇa.kāla.vetana.phala.niṣpattibhiḥ kārayet, sva.bhūmiṣu ca sthāpayet //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of the armoury)
KAZ02.18.01/ The superintendent of the armoury should have weapons for battle, for fort operations, and for assaulting enemy fortifications — machines, weapons, armor, and equipment — manufactured by skilled artisans and craftsmen with fixed specifications of work, measurement, time, wages, and output, and should store them in their proper places.

children.text: KAZ02.18.02/ sthāna.parivartanam ātapa.pravāta.pradānaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.02/ He should frequently rotate their storage locations and provide exposure to sun and wind.

children.text: KAZ02.18.03/ ūṣma.upasneha.krimibhir upahanyamānam anyathā sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.03/ What is being damaged by heat, moisture, or worms should be stored differently.

children.text: KAZ02.18.04/ jāti.rūpa.lakṣaṇa.pramāṇa.āgama.mūlya.nikṣepaiś ca^upalabheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.04/ And he should keep track of them by type, form, distinguishing marks, measurement, origin, and price of deposit.

children.text: KAZ02.18.05/ sarvato.bhadra.jāmadagnya.bahu.mukha.viśvāsa.ghāti.saṃghāṭī.yānaka.parjanyaka.bāhu.ūrdhva.bāhv.ardha.bāhūni sthita.yantrāṇi //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.05/ <s>Sarvatobhadra</s> (all-auspicious), <s>jāmadagnya</s>, <s>bahumukha</s> (many-faced), <s>viśvāsaghātī</s> (trust-destroyer), <s>saṃghāṭī</s> (jointed), <s>yānaka</s> (mobile), <s>parjanyaka</s> (rain-like), <s>bāhu</s> (arm), <s>ūrdhvabāhu</s> (raised-arm), <s>ardhabāhu</s> (half-arm) — these are the stationary engines.

children.text: KAZ02.18.06/ pāñcālika.deva.daṇḍa.sūkarikā.musala.yaṣṭi.hasti.vāraka.tāla.vṛnta.mudgara.gadā.spṛktalā.kuddāla.āsphāṭima.utpāṭima.udghāṭima.śataghni.tri.śūla.cakrāṇi cala.yantrāṇi //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.06/ <s>Pāñcālika</s> (puppet-like), <s>devadaṇḍa</s> (divine staff), <s>sūkarikā</s> (boar-like), <s>musala</s> (pestle), <s>yaṣṭi</s> (staff), <s>hastivāraka</s> (elephant-repeller), <s>tālavṛnta</s> (fan-palm), <s>mudgara</s> (mace), <s>gadā</s> (club), <s>spṛktalā</s>, <s>kuddāla</s> (hoe), <s>āsphāṭima</s> (crusher), <s>utpāṭima</s> (uprooter), <s>udghāṭima</s> (opener), <s>śataghnī</s> (hundred-killer), <s>triśūla</s> (trident), <s>cakra</s> (discus) — these are the mobile engines.

children.text: KAZ02.18.07/ śakti.prāsa.kunta.hāṭaka.bhiṇḍi.pāla.śūla.tomara.varāha.karṇa.kaṇaya.karpaṇa.trāsika.ādīni ca hula.mukhāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.07/ <s>Śakti</s> (lance), <s>prāsa</s> (barbed spear), <s>kunta</s> (spear), <s>hāṭaka</s>, <s>bhiṇḍipāla</s> (sling-javelin), <s>śūla</s> (spike), <s>tomara</s> (javelin), <s>varāhakarṇa</s> (boar-ear), <s>kaṇaya</s>, <s>karpaṇa</s> (lance), <s>trāsika</s> (frightener), and others — these are the spike-headed [weapons].

children.text: KAZ02.18.08/ tāla.cāpa.dārava.śārṅgāṇi kārmuka.kodaṇḍa.drūṇā dhanūṃṣi //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.08/ Palm-bows, wooden bows, <s>śārṅga</s> bows, <s>kārmuka</s>, <s>kodaṇḍa</s>, and <s>drūṇa</s> — these are the bows.

children.text: KAZ02.18.09/ mūrvā.arka.śana.gavedhu.veṇu.snāyūni jyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.09/ Bowstrings are made of <s>mūrvā</s>, <s>arka</s>, hemp, <s>gavedhuka</s>, bamboo, and sinew.

children.text: KAZ02.18.10/ veṇu.śara.śalākā.daṇḍa.āsana.nārācāś ca^iṣavaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.10/ Arrows are made of bamboo, reeds, splints, shafts, cane, and <s>nārāca</s> (iron arrows).

children.text: KAZ02.18.11/ teṣāṃ mukhāni chedana.bhedana.tāḍanāny āyasa.asthi.dāravāṇi //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.11/ Their heads — for cutting, piercing, and striking — are made of iron, bone, or wood.

children.text: KAZ02.18.12/ nistriṃśa.maṇḍala.agra.asi.yaṣṭayaḥ khaḍgāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.12/ <s>Nistriṃśa</s> (straight sword), <s>maṇḍalāgra</s> (curved-tip), and <s>asiyaṣṭi</s> (sword-staff) — these are the swords.

children.text: KAZ02.18.13/ khaḍga.mahiṣa.vāraṇa.viṣāṇa.dāru.veṇu.mūlāni tsaravaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.13/ Shields are made from [the hides of] sword[-fish], buffalo, elephant, rhinoceros [horn], wood, and bamboo roots.

children.text: KAZ02.18.14/ paraśu.kuṭhāra.paṭṭasa.khanitra.kuddāla.krakaca.kāṇḍac.chedanāḥ kṣura.kalpāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.14/ Axe, hatchet, <s>paṭṭasa</s> (broad-blade), pick, hoe, saw, and stalk-cutters — these are the razor-edged [weapons].

children.text: KAZ02.18.15/ yantra.goṣpaṇa.muṣṭi.pāṣāṇa.rocanī.dṛṣadaś ca^aśma.āyudhāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.15/ Machine-slings, catapult-stones, fist-stones, boulders, coloring stones, and grinding stones — these are the stone weapons.

children.text: KAZ02.18.16/ loha.jālikā.paṭṭa.kavaca.sūtra.kaṅkaṭa.śiṃśumāraka.khaḍgi.dhenuka.hasti.go.carma.khura.śṛṅga.saṃghātaṃ varmāṇi //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.16/ Coats of mail made of iron chain, plate armor, cord-armor, <s>kaṅkaṭa</s>, crocodile-skin, rhinoceros-hide, <s>dhenuka</s> (cowhide), elephant-hide, cattle-hide, and composite [armor] of hooves and horns — these are the body armors.

children.text: KAZ02.18.17/ śiras.trāṇa.kaṇṭha.trāṇa.kūrpāsa.kañcuka.vāra.vāṇa.paṭṭa.nāga.udarikāḥ peṭī.carma.hasti.karṇa.tāla.mūla.dhamani.kāka.pāṭa.kiṭikā.apratihata.balāha.kāntāś ca^āvaraṇāṇi //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.17/ Helmets, neck-guards, cuirasses, jackets, mail-coats, arrow-shields, breast-plates, and serpent-belly [armor] — and shields made of hide, elephant-ear, palm-trunk, membrane, crow-wing, quilted, impenetrable, cloud-colored, and thorned — these are the protective coverings.

children.text: KAZ02.18.18/ hasti.ratha.vājināṃ yogyā.bhāṇḍam ālaṃkārikaṃ samnāha.kalpanāś ca^upakaraṇāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.18/ Harness equipment for elephants, chariots, and horses, decorative gear, and armor fittings — these are the accessories.

children.text: KAZ02.18.19/ aindrajālikam aupaniṣadikaṃ ca karma //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.18.19/ Magic arts and esoteric practices — these are [also part of] the operations.

children.text:
KAZ02.18.20ab/ karma.antānāṃ ca - icchām ārambha.niṣpattiṃ prayogaṃ vyājam uddayam /
KAZ02.18.20cd/ kṣaya.vyayau ca jānīyāt kupyānām āyudha.īśvaraḥ //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.18.20ab/ Of all manufacturing operations — their desirability, initiation, completion, method, disguise, revenue,
KAZ02.18.20cd/ as well as loss and expenditure — the superintendent of the armory (<s>āyudhādhyakṣa</s>) should know.

children.text:
(ṣtandardisation of ṛeights and measures)
KAZ02.19.01/ pautava.adhyakṣaḥ pautava.karma.antān kārayet //
children.translated_text:
(Standardization of weights and measures)
KAZ02.19.01/ The superintendent of weights and measures (<s>pautavādhyakṣa</s>) should have the weighing operations carried out.

children.text: KAZ02.19.02/ dhānya.māṣā daśa suvarṇa.māṣakaḥ, pañca vā guñjāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.02/ Ten grain-seeds (<s>dhānya-māṣas</s>) make one gold-<s>māṣaka</s>, or five <s>guñjā</s> berries.

children.text: KAZ02.19.03/ te ṣoḍaśa suvarṇaḥ karṣo vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.03/ Sixteen of those make one <s>suvarṇa</s> or one <s>karṣa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.04/ catuṣ.karṣaṃ palam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.04/ Four <s>karṣas</s> make one <s>pala</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.05/ aṣṭa.aśītir gaura.sarṣapā rūpya.māṣakaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.05/ Eighty-eight white mustard seeds make one silver <s>māṣaka</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.06/ te ṣoḍaśa dharaṇam, śaumbyāni vā viṃśatiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.06/ Sixteen of those make one <s>dharaṇa</s>, or twenty <s>śaumbī</s> [seeds].

children.text: KAZ02.19.07/ viṃśati.taṇḍulaṃ vajra.dharaṇam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.07/ Twenty rice-grains make one diamond-<s>dharaṇa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.08/ ardha.māṣakaḥ māṣakaḥ dvau catvāraḥ aṣṭau māṣakāḥ suvarṇo dvau catvāraḥ, aṣṭau suvarṇāḥ daśa viṃśatiḥ triṃśat catvāriṃśat śatam iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.08/ Half a <s>māṣaka</s>, one <s>māṣaka</s>, two, four, eight <s>māṣakas</s>, one <s>suvarṇa</s>, two, four, eight <s>suvarṇas</s>, ten, twenty, thirty, forty, one hundred — thus [are the weight denominations].

children.text: KAZ02.19.09/ tena dharaṇāni vyākhyātāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.09/ By this, the <s>dharaṇa</s> [denominations] are also explained.

children.text: KAZ02.19.10/ pratimānāny ayomayāni māgadha.mekala.śailamayāni yāni vā na^udaka.pradehābhyāṃ vṛddhiṃ gaccheyur uṣṇena vā hrāsam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.10/ The standard weights should be made of iron, or of stone from <s>Magadha</s> or <s>Mekala</s>, or of any [material] that does not increase from water or paste, nor decrease from heat.

children.text: KAZ02.19.11/ ṣaḍaṅgulād ūrdhvam aṣṭa.aṅgula.uttarā daśa tulāḥ kārayet loha.palād ūrdhvam eka.pala.uttarāḥ, yantram ubhayataḥ.śikyaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.11/ Starting from six <s>aṅgulas</s>, he should have ten balances made, each increasing by eight <s>aṅgulas</s>, starting from one <s>pala</s> of iron, each increasing by one <s>pala</s>; or a beam with pans hanging from both ends.

children.text: KAZ02.19.12/ pañca.triṃśat.palalohāṃ dvi.saptaty.aṅgula.āyāmāṃ sama.vṛttāṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.12/ He should have [a balance] made of thirty-five <s>palas</s> of iron, seventy-two <s>aṅgulas</s> long, and perfectly round.

children.text: KAZ02.19.13/ tasyāḥ pañca.palikaṃ maṇḍalaṃ baddhvā sama.karaṇaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.13/ Having attached a five-<s>pala</s> ring [at the fulcrum], he should have it balanced.

children.text: KAZ02.19.14/ tataḥ karṣa.uttaraṃ palaṃ pala.uttaraṃ daśa.palaṃ dvādaśa pañcadaśa viṃśatir iti padāni kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.14/ Then he should make weight-markers increasing by one <s>karṣa</s> [up to] one <s>pala</s>, then by one <s>pala</s> [up to] ten <s>palas</s>, then twelve, fifteen, and twenty.

children.text: KAZ02.19.15/ tata ā.śatād daśa.uttaraṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.15/ Then up to one hundred, increasing by ten.

children.text: KAZ02.19.16/ akṣeṣu nāndī.pinaddhaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.16/ He should have the axle-pins bound with the <s>nāndī</s> [seal].

children.text: KAZ02.19.17/ dvi.guṇa.lohāṃ tulām ataḥ ṣaṇṇavaty.aṅgula.āyāmāṃ parimāṇīṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.17/ A larger balance (<s>parimāṇī</s>) should be made with double the iron, ninety-six <s>aṅgulas</s> long.

children.text: KAZ02.19.18/ tasyāḥ śata.padād ūrdhvaṃ viṃśatiḥ pañcāśat śatam iti padāni kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.18/ For it, he should make weight-markers above the hundred-mark: [at] twenty, fifty, and one hundred.

children.text: KAZ02.19.19/ viṃśati.tauliko bhāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.19/ Twenty <s>tulas</s> make one <s>bhāra</s> (load).

children.text: KAZ02.19.20/ daśa.dhāraṇikaṃ palam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.20/ One <s>pala</s> equals ten <s>dharaṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.21/ tat.pala.śatam āya.mānī //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.21/ One hundred such <s>palas</s> make the revenue balance (<s>āya-mānī</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.19.22/ pañca.pala.avarā vyāvahārikī bhājany antaḥ.pura.bhājanī ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.22/ The commercial balance starts from five <s>palas</s>, as does the household balance and the inner-palace balance.

children.text: KAZ02.19.23/ tāsām ardha.dharaṇa.avaraṃ palam, dvi.pala.avaram uttara.loham, ṣaḍ.aṅgula.avarāś ca^āyāmāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.23/ For these, the minimum <s>pala</s> weight is half a <s>dharaṇa</s>, the minimum surplus-iron is two <s>palas</s>, and the minimum length is six <s>aṅgulas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.24/ pūrvayoḥ pañca.palikaḥ prayāmo māṃsa.loha.lavaṇa.maṇi.varjam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.24/ For the first two [balances], the tolerance is five <s>palas</s>, except for meat, iron, salt, and gems.

children.text: KAZ02.19.25/ kāṣṭha.tulā aṣṭa.hastā padavatī pratimānavatī mayūra.pada.adhiṣṭhitā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.25/ A wooden balance is eight <s>hastas</s> long, with weight-markers, standard weights, and resting on a peacock-foot [stand].

children.text: KAZ02.19.26/ kāṣṭha.pañcaviṃśati.palaṃ taṇḍula.prastha.sādhanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.26/ [It weighs] twenty-five <s>palas</s> of wood and serves as the measure for one <s>prastha</s> of rice.

children.text: KAZ02.19.27/ eṣa pradeśo bahv.alpayoḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.27/ This is the standard for both large and small [quantities].

children.text: KAZ02.19.28/ iti tulā.pratimānaṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.28/ Thus the balances and standard weights have been explained.

children.text: KAZ02.19.29/ atha dhānya.māṣa.dvi.pala.śataṃ droṇam āya.mānam, sapta.aśīti.pala.śatam ardha.palaṃ ca vyāvahārikam, pañca.saptati.pala.śataṃ bhājanīyam, dvi.ṣaṣṭi.pala.śatam ardha.palaṃ ca^antaḥ.pura.bhājanīyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.29/ Now, two hundred <s>palas</s> of grain-<s>māṣa</s> [weight] is the <s>droṇa</s> revenue measure; one hundred and eighty-seven and a half <s>palas</s> is the commercial [measure]; one hundred and seventy-five <s>palas</s> is the household [measure]; one hundred and sixty-two and a half <s>palas</s> is the inner-palace [measure].

children.text: KAZ02.19.30/ teṣām āḍhaka.prastha.kuḍubāś catur.bhāga.avarāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.30/ Their sub-measures — <s>āḍhaka</s>, <s>prastha</s>, and <s>kuḍuba</s> — decrease by one-quarter [successively].

children.text: KAZ02.19.31/ ṣoḍaśa.droṇā khārī //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.31/ Sixteen <s>droṇas</s> make one <s>khārī</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.32/ viṃśati.droṇikaḥ kumbhaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.32/ Twenty <s>droṇas</s> make one <s>kumbha</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.33/ kumbhair daśabhir vahaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.33/ Ten <s>kumbhas</s> make one <s>vaha</s> (cartload).

children.text: KAZ02.19.34/ śuṣka.sāra.dāru.mayaṃ samaṃ catur.bhāga.śikhaṃ mānaṃ kārayet, antaḥ.śikhaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.34/ The measure should be made of dry, hard wood, level, with a rim of one-quarter [height]; or with an internal rim.

children.text: KAZ02.19.35/ rasasya tu surāyāḥ puṣpa.phalayos tuṣa.aṅgārāṇāṃ sudhāyāś ca śikhā.mānaṃ dvi.guṇa.uttarā vṛddhiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.35/ For liquids — liquor, flowers, fruits, husks, charcoal, and lime — the rim measure [applies], with the increase doubling [the standard].

children.text: KAZ02.19.36/ sa-pāda.paṇo droṇa.mūlyam āḍhakasya pāda.ūnaḥ, ṣaṇ.māṣakāḥ prasthasya, māṣakaḥ kuḍubasya //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.36/ The price of a <s>droṇa</s> [measure] is one and a quarter <s>paṇas</s>; for an <s>āḍhaka</s>, a quarter less; six <s>māṣakas</s> for a <s>prastha</s>; one <s>māṣaka</s> for a <s>kuḍuba</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.37/ dvi.guṇaṃ rasa.ādīnāṃ māna.mūlyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.37/ The price of the measure for liquids and the like is double.

children.text: KAZ02.19.38/ viṃśati.paṇāḥ pratimānasya //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.38/ Twenty <s>paṇas</s> for a standard weight.

children.text: KAZ02.19.39/ tulā.mūlyaṃ tri.bhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.39/ The price of a balance is one-third [of that].

children.text: KAZ02.19.40/ catur.māsikaṃ prātivedhanikaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.40/ He should have the verification done every four months.

children.text: KAZ02.19.41/ apratividdhasya^atyayaḥ sa-pādaḥ sapta.viṃśati.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.41/ The penalty for an unverified [measure] is one and a quarter [times] twenty-seven <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.19.42/ prātivedhanikaṃ kākaṇīkam ahar ahaḥ pautava.adhyakṣāya dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.42/ The verification fee of one <s>kākaṇī</s> per day should be paid to the superintendent of weights and measures.

children.text: KAZ02.19.43/ dvātriṃśad.bhāgas tapta.vyājī sarpiṣaḥ, catuḥ.ṣaṣṭi.bhāgas tailasya //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.43/ One thirty-second part is the heating loss for ghee; one sixty-fourth for oil.

children.text: KAZ02.19.44/ pañcāśad bhāgo māna.srāvo dravāṇām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.44/ One-fiftieth is the measure-loss for liquids.

children.text: KAZ02.19.45/ kuḍuba.ardha.catur.aṣṭa.bhāgāni mānāni kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.45/ He should have sub-measures made: <s>kuḍuba</s>, half, quarter, and eighth.

children.text: KAZ02.19.46/ kuḍubāś catur.aśītir vārakaḥ sarpiṣo mataḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.46/ Eighty-four <s>kuḍubas</s> make one <s>vāraka</s> for ghee.

children.text: KAZ02.19.47/ catuḥ.ṣaṣṭis tu tailasya pādaś ca ghaṭikā^anayoḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.19.47/ Sixty-four for oil; and one <s>ghaṭikā</s> is a quarter of these.

children.text:
(ṃeasures of space and time)
KAZ02.20.01/ māna.adhyakṣyo deśa.kāla.mānaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text:
(Measures of space and time)
KAZ02.20.01/ The superintendent of measures (<s>mānādhyakṣa</s>) should know the measurement of space and time.

children.text: KAZ02.20.02/ aṣṭau parama.aṇavo ratha.cakra.vipruṭ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.02/ Eight atoms (<s>paramāṇus</s>) make one speck of dust from a chariot wheel (<s>rathacakra-vipruṭ</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.03/ tā aṣṭau likṣā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.03/ Eight of those make one nit-egg (<s>likṣā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.04/ tā aṣtau yūkā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.04/ Eight of those make one louse (<s>yūkā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.05/ tā aṣṭau yava.madhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.05/ Eight of those make one middle barley-grain (<s>yava-madhya</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.06/ aṣṭau yava.madhyā aṅgulam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.06/ Eight middle barley-grains make one finger-breadth (<s>aṅgula</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.07/ madhyamasya puruṣasya madhyamāyā anugulyā madhya.prakarṣo vā^aṅgulam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.07/ The middle joint or the maximum breadth of the middle finger of a man of medium size — that is one <s>aṅgula</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.08/ catur.aṅgulo dhanur.grahaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.08/ Four <s>aṅgulas</s> make one bow-grip (<s>dhanurgraha</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.09/ aṣṭa.aṅgulā dhanur.muṣṭiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.09/ Eight <s>aṅgulas</s> make one bow-fist (<s>dhanurmuṣṭi</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.10/ dvādaśa.aṅgulā vitastiḥ, chāyā.pauruṣaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.10/ Twelve <s>aṅgulas</s> make one span (<s>vitasti</s>), which is also the shadow-<s>pauruṣa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.11/ catur.daśa.aṅgulaṃ śamaḥ śalaḥ parīrayaḥ padaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.11/ Fourteen <s>aṅgulas</s> make one <s>śama</s>, <s>śala</s>, <s>parīraya</s>, and foot (<s>pada</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.12/ dvi.vitastir aratniḥ prājāpatyo hastaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.12/ Two spans make one cubit (<s>aratni</s>), which is the <s>Prājāpatya</s> hand-measure (<s>hasta</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.13/ sa-dhanur.grahaḥ pautava.vivīta.mānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.13/ With one bow-grip added, it is the measure for weights and enclosed areas.

children.text: KAZ02.20.14/ sa-dhanur.muṣṭiḥ kuṣkuḥ kaṃso vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.14/ With one bow-fist added, it is the <s>kuṣku</s> or <s>kaṃsa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.15/ dvi.catvāriṃśad.aṅgulas takṣṇaḥ krākacanika.kiṣkuḥ skandha.āvāra.durga.rāja.parigraha.mānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.15/ Forty-two <s>aṅgulas</s> is the carpenter's <s>kiṣku</s>, the saw-measure — the measure for military camps, forts, and royal enclosures.

children.text: KAZ02.20.16/ catuṣ.pañcāśad.aṅgulaḥ kūpya.vana.hastaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.16/ Fifty-four <s>aṅgulas</s> is the <s>hasta</s> for mines and forests.

children.text: KAZ02.20.17/ catur.aśīty.aṅgulo vyāmo rajju.mānaṃ khāta.pauruṣaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.17/ Eighty-four <s>aṅgulas</s> is the fathom (<s>vyāma</s>), which is the rope-measure and the depth-<s>pauruṣa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.18/ catur.aratnir daṇḍo dhanur.nālikā pauruṣaṃ ca gārhapatyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.18/ Four cubits make one staff (<s>daṇḍa</s>), bow (<s>dhanus</s>), tube (<s>nālikā</s>), and the household <s>pauruṣa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.19/ aṣṭa.śata.aṅgulaṃ dhanuḥ pathi.prākāra.mānaṃ pauruṣaṃ ca^agni.cityānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.19/ One hundred and eight <s>aṅgulas</s> is the bow — the measure for roads and ramparts, and the <s>pauruṣa</s> for fire-altars.

children.text: KAZ02.20.20/ ṣaṭ.kaṃso daṇḍo brahma.deya.ātithya.mānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.20/ Six <s>kaṃsas</s> make one <s>daṇḍa</s>, which is the measure for <s>brahmadeya</s> (Brahmin grants) and guest-house [plots].

children.text: KAZ02.20.21/ daśa.daṇḍo rajjuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.21/ Ten <s>daṇḍas</s> make one <s>rajju</s> (rope).

children.text: KAZ02.20.22/ dvi.rajjukaḥ parideśaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.22/ Two <s>rajjus</s> make one <s>parideśa</s> (circumference).

children.text: KAZ02.20.23/ tri.rajjukaṃ nivartanam ekataḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.23/ Three <s>rajjus</s> on one side make one <s>nivartana</s> (unit of land area).

children.text: KAZ02.20.24/ dvi.daṇḍa.adhiko bāhuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.24/ A <s>bāhu</s> (arm-length) exceeds [one <s>rajju</s>] by two <s>daṇḍas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.25/ dvi.dhanuḥ.sahasraṃ go.rutam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.25/ Two thousand bows make one <s>goruta</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.26/ catur.go.rutaṃ yojanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.26/ Four <s>gorutas</s> make one <s>yojana</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.27/ iti deśa.mānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.27/ Thus the measurement of space.

children.text: KAZ02.20.28/ kāla.mānam ata ūrdhvam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.28/ The measurement of time is next.

children.text: KAZ02.20.29/ tuṭo lavo nimeṣaḥ kāṣṭhā kallā nālikā muhūrtaḥ pūrva.apara.bhāgau divaso rātriḥ pakṣo māsa ṛtur ayanaṃ saṃvatsaro yugam iti kālāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.29/ <s>Tuṭa</s>, <s>lava</s>, <s>nimeṣa</s> (blink), <s>kāṣṭhā</s>, <s>kalā</s>, <s>nālikā</s>, <s>muhūrta</s>, forenoon and afternoon, day, night, fortnight, month, season, solstice, year, and age (<s>yuga</s>) — these are the [divisions of] time.

children.text: KAZ02.20.30/ dvau tuṭau lavaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.30/ Two <s>tuṭas</s> make one <s>lava</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.31/ dvau lavau nimeṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.31/ Two <s>lavas</s> make one <s>nimeṣa</s> (blink of an eye).

children.text: KAZ02.20.32/ pañca.nimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.32/ Five <s>nimeṣas</s> make one <s>kāṣṭhā</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.33/ triṃśat.kāṣṭhāḥ kalāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.33/ Thirty <s>kāṣṭhās</s> make one <s>kalā</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.34/ catvāriṃśat.kalāḥ nālikā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.34/ Forty <s>kalās</s> make one <s>nālikā</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.35/ suvarṇa.māṣakāś catvāraś catur.aṅgula.āyāmāḥ kumbhac.chidram āḍhakam ambhaso vā nālikā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.35/ Four gold <s>māṣakas</s>, four <s>aṅgulas</s> long [dropped into] a hole in a pot [filled with] one <s>āḍhaka</s> of water — [the time it takes to drain] is one <s>nālikā</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.36/ dvi.nāliko muhūrtaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.36/ Two <s>nālikās</s> make one <s>muhūrta</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.37/ pañca.daśa.muhūrto divaso rātriś ca caitre ca^āśvayuje ca māsi bhavataḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.37/ Fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s> each for day and night — [this applies] in the months of <s>Caitra</s> and <s>Āśvayuja</s> [the equinoxes].

children.text: KAZ02.20.38/ tataḥ paraṃ tribhir muhūrtair anyataraḥ ṣaṇ.māsaṃ vardhate hrasate ca^iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.38/ Thereafter, one of them increases and the other decreases by three <s>muhūrtas</s> over six months.

children.text: KAZ02.20.39/ chāyāyām aṣṭa.pauruṣyām aṣṭādaśa.bhāgaś chedaḥ, ṣaṭ.pauruṣyāṃ catur.daśa.bhāgaḥ, tri.pauruṣyām aṣṭa.bhāgaḥ, dvi.pauruṣyāṃ ṣaḍ.bhāgaḥ, pauruṣyāṃ catur.bhāgaḥ, aṣṭa.aṅgulāyāṃ trayo daśa.bhāgāḥ, catur.aṅgulāyāṃ trayo^aṣṭa.bhāgāḥ, acchāyo madhya.ahna iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.39/ When the shadow is eight <s>pauruṣas</s>, an eighteenth part [of the day has elapsed]; at six <s>pauruṣas</s>, a fourteenth; at three, an eighth; at two, a sixth; at one, a quarter; at eight <s>aṅgulas</s>, three-tenths; at four <s>aṅgulas</s>, three-eighths; when shadowless, it is midday.

children.text: KAZ02.20.40/ parāvṛtte divase śeṣam evaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.40/ After midday turns, the remainder [is calculated] in the same way.

children.text: KAZ02.20.41/ āṣāḍhe māsi naṣṭac.chāyo madhya.ahno bhavati //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.41/ In the month of <s>Āṣāḍha</s>, noon is shadowless.

children.text: KAZ02.20.42/ ataḥ paraṃ śrāvaṇa.ādīnāṃ ṣaṇ.māsānāṃ dvy.aṅgula.uttarā māgha.ādīnāṃ dvy.aṅgula.avarā chāyā iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.42/ Thereafter, the shadow increases by two <s>aṅgulas</s> for the six months beginning with <s>Śrāvaṇa</s>, and decreases by two <s>aṅgulas</s> for those beginning with <s>Māgha</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.20.43/ pañcadaśa.aho.rātrāḥ pakṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.43/ Fifteen day-and-nights make one fortnight (<s>pakṣa</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.44/ soma.āpyāyanaḥ śuklaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.44/ The bright [fortnight] is [the time of] the moon's waxing.

children.text: KAZ02.20.45/ soma.avacchedano bahulaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.45/ The dark [fortnight] is [the time of] the moon's waning.

children.text: KAZ02.20.46/ dvi.pakṣo māsaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.46/ Two fortnights make one month.

children.text: KAZ02.20.47/ triṃśad.aho.rātraḥ karma.māsaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.47/ Thirty day-and-nights make one working month (<s>karma-māsa</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.48/ sa-ardhaḥ sauraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.48/ With a half [day] added, it is a solar [month].

children.text: KAZ02.20.49/ ardha.nyūnaś cāndra.māsaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.49/ With a half [day] less, it is a lunar month.

children.text: KAZ02.20.50/ sapta.viṃśatir nākṣatra.māsaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.50/ Twenty-seven [days] is a sidereal month (<s>nākṣatra-māsa</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.51/ dvātriṃśad bala.māsaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.51/ Thirty-two [days] is a military month (<s>bala-māsa</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.52/ pañcatriṃśad aśva.vāhāyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.52/ Thirty-five [days] for a horse-march.

children.text: KAZ02.20.53/ catvāriṃśadd.hasti.vāhāyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.53/ Forty [days] for an elephant-march.

children.text: KAZ02.20.54/ dvau māsāv ṛtuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.54/ Two months make one season (<s>ṛtu</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.55/ śrāvaṇaḥ prauṣṭhapadaś ca varṣāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.55/ <s>Śrāvaṇa</s> and <s>Prauṣṭhapada</s> [Bhādrapada] — the rainy season (<s>varṣā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.56/ āśvayujaḥ kārttikaś ca śarat //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.56/ <s>Āśvayuja</s> and <s>Kārttika</s> — autumn (<s>śarat</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.57/ mārga.śīrṣaḥ pauṣaś ca hemantaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.57/ <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s> and <s>Pauṣa</s> — early winter (<s>hemanta</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.58/ māghaḥ phālgunaś ca śiśiraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.58/ <s>Māgha</s> and <s>Phālguna</s> — late winter (<s>śiśira</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.59/ caitro vaiśākhaś ca vasantaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.59/ <s>Caitra</s> and <s>Vaiśākha</s> — spring (<s>vasanta</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.60/ jyeṣṭhāmūlīya āṣāḍhaś ca grīṣmaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.60/ <s>Jyeṣṭhāmūlīya</s> and <s>Āṣāḍha</s> — summer (<s>grīṣma</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.61/ śiśira.ādy uttara.ayaṇam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.61/ Beginning with late winter is the northern solstice (<s>uttarāyaṇa</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.62/ varṣa.ādi dakṣiṇa.ayanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.62/ Beginning with the rainy season is the southern solstice (<s>dakṣiṇāyana</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.63/ dvy.ayanaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.63/ Two solstices make one year (<s>saṃvatsara</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.20.64/ pañca.saṃvatsaro yugam / iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.20.64/ Five years make one age (<s>yuga</s>).

children.text:
KAZ02.20.65ab/ divasasya haraty arkaḥ ṣaṣṭi.bhāgam ṛtau tataḥ /
KAZ02.20.65cd/ karoty ekam ahaś.chedaṃ tathā^eva^ekaṃ ca candramāḥ //
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.20.65ab/ The sun takes away one-sixtieth of the day in a season; thereby
KAZ02.20.65cd/ it produces one intercalary day, and the moon likewise one.

children.text:
KAZ02.20.66ab/ evam ardha.tṛtīyānām abdānām adhimāsakam /
KAZ02.20.66cd/ grīṣme janayataḥ pūrvaṃ pañca.abda.ante ca paścimam //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.20.66ab/ Thus in two and a half years, [they produce] one intercalary month;
KAZ02.20.66cd/ the first [intercalary month] arises in summer, and the second at the end of [every] five years.

children.text:
(Collector of costums and tolls)
KAZ02.21.01/ śulka.adhyakṣaḥ śulka.śālāṃ dhvajaṃ ca prān.mukham udan.mukhaṃ vā mahā.dvāra.abhyāśe niveśayet //
children.translated_text:
(Collector of customs and tolls)
KAZ02.21.01/ The superintendent of tolls (<s>śulkādhyakṣa</s>) should establish the customs house and its banner facing east or north, near the main gate.

children.text: KAZ02.21.02/ śulka.ādāyinaś catvāraḥ pañca vā sārtha.upayātān vaṇijo likheyuḥ - ke kutastyāḥ kiyat.paṇyāḥ kva ca^abhijñānaṃ mudrā vā kṛtā iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.21.02/ Four or five customs-collectors should register the merchants arriving with caravans — [recording] who they are, where they are from, the value of their goods, and where the identification seal has been affixed.

children.text: KAZ02.21.03/ amudrāṇām atyayo deya.dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.21.03/ The penalty for those without a seal is double the duty payable.

children.text: KAZ02.21.04/ kūṭa.mudrāṇāṃ śulka.aṣṭa.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.21.04/ For those with a forged seal, the fine is eight times the duty.

children.text: KAZ02.21.05/ bhinna.mudrāṇām atyayo ghaṭikā.sthāne sthānam //
children.translated_text: For those with broken seals, the penalty is confinement at a guard-post.

children.text: KAZ02.21.06/ rāja.mudrā.parivartane nāma.kṛte vā sa-pāda.paṇikaṃ vahanaṃ dāpayet //
children.translated_text: For counterfeiting the royal seal or making it in [another's] name, he should impose a transport fee of one and a quarter <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.21.07/ dhvaja.mūla.upasthitasya pramāṇam arghaṃ ca vaidehikāḥ paṇyasya brūyuḥ "etat.pramāṇena^argheṇa paṇyam idaṃ kaḥ kretā" iti //
children.translated_text: The traders should announce the quantity and price of the merchandise brought before the toll-flag: 'Who will buy this merchandise of such quantity and price?'

children.text: KAZ02.21.08/ tri.ruddha.uṣitam arthibhyo dadyāt //
children.translated_text: After it has stood for three days, he should give it to the bidders.

children.text: KAZ02.21.09/ kretṛ.saṃgharṣe mūlya.vṛddhiḥ sa-śulkā kośaṃ gacchet //
children.translated_text: If there is competition among buyers, the increase in price together with the toll should go to the treasury.

children.text: KAZ02.21.10/ śulka.bhayāt paṇya.pramāṇa mūlyaṃ vā hīnaṃ bruvatas tad atiriktaṃ rājā haret //
children.translated_text: For one who understates the quantity or price of merchandise out of fear of the toll, the king should confiscate the excess.

children.text: KAZ02.21.11/ śulkam aṣṭa.guṇaṃ vā dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Or he should impose eight times the toll [as a fine].

children.text: KAZ02.21.12/ tad eva niviṣṭa.paṇyasya bhāṇḍasya hīna.prativarṇakena^argha.apakarṣaṇe sāra.bhāṇḍasya phalgu.bhāṇḍena praticchādane ca kuryāt //
children.translated_text: The same [penalty applies] for reducing the price of stored merchandise by substituting inferior quality, or for concealing valuable goods with cheap goods.

children.text: KAZ02.21.13/ pratikretṛ.bhayād vā paṇya.mūlyād upari mūlyaṃ vardhayato mūlya.vṛddhiṃ rājā haret, dvi.guṇaṃ vā śulkaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Or, for one who raises the price above the [declared] merchandise price out of fear of a counter-buyer, the king should confiscate the price increase, or impose double the toll.

children.text: KAZ02.21.14/ tad eva^aṣṭa.guṇam adhyakṣasyac. chādayataḥ //
children.translated_text: The same, [multiplied] eightfold, [applies] when the superintendent conceals [the fraud].

children.text: KAZ02.21.15/ tasmād vikrayaḥ paṇyānāṃ dhṛto mito gaṇito vā kāryaḥ, tarkaḥ phalgu.bhāṇḍānām ānugrāhikāṇāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: Therefore, the sale of merchandise should be conducted by weighing, measuring, or counting; estimation [is permitted] for cheap goods and those given as favors.

children.text: KAZ02.21.16/ dhvaja.mūlam atikrāntānāṃ ca^akṛta.śulkānāṃ śulkād aṣṭa.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For those who bypass the toll-flag without paying tolls, the fine is eight times the toll.

children.text: KAZ02.21.17/ pathika.utpathikās tad vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Patrol-agents on highways and byways should detect these.

children.text: KAZ02.21.18/ vaivāhikam anvāyanam aupāyikaṃ yajña.kṛtya.prasava.naimittikaṃ deva^ijyā.caula.upanayana.go.dāna.vrata.dīkṣā.ādiṣu kriyā.viśeṣeṣu bhāṇḍam ucchulkaṃ gacchet //
children.translated_text: Goods for weddings, inheritance-related [ceremonies], gifts, sacrificial rites, childbirth, votive rituals, and special ceremonies such as worship of deities, first tonsure, investiture with the sacred thread, and cow-donation should pass toll-free.

children.text: KAZ02.21.19/ anyathā.vādinaḥ steya.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who makes false claims [regarding these exemptions], the penalty for theft [applies].

children.text: KAZ02.21.20/ kṛta.śulkena^akṛta.śulkaṃ nirvāhayato dvitīyam eka.mudrayā bhittvā paṇya.puṭam apaharato vaidehakasya tac^ca tāvac ca daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For a trader who passes off untaxed [goods] along with taxed goods, or who removes merchandise from a sealed package by breaking a single seal — the fine is [the value of] that [goods] plus an equal amount.

children.text: KAZ02.21.21/ śulka.sthānād gomaya.palālaṃ pramāṇaṃ kṛtvā^apaharata uttamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who removes [goods] from a toll-station by using cow-dung or straw as a standard [to conceal them], the highest <s>sāhasa</s> (violence) penalty [applies].

children.text: KAZ02.21.22/ śastra.varma.kavaca.loha.ratha.ratna.dhānya.paśūnām anyatamam anirvāhyaṃ nirvāhayato yathā^avaghuṣito daṇḍaḥ paṇya.nāśaś^ca //
children.translated_text: For one who smuggles out any item from among weapons, armor, coats of mail, iron, chariots, gems, grain, or cattle — which are prohibited from export — the fine is as publicly proclaimed, plus confiscation of the merchandise.

children.text: KAZ02.21.23/ teṣām anyatamasya^ānayane bahir eva^ucchulko vikrayaḥ //
children.translated_text: For importing any of these, the sale should be toll-free, [conducted] outside [the toll-station] only.

children.text: KAZ02.21.24/ anta.pālaḥ sa-pāda.paṇikāṃ vartanīṃ gṛhṇīyāt paṇya.vahanasya, paṇikām eka.khurasya, paśūnām ardha.paṇikāṃ kṣudra.paśūnāṃ pādikām, aṃsa.bhārasya māṣikām //
children.translated_text: The border-guard should collect a road-toll of one and a quarter <s>paṇas</s> for a merchandise-cart, one <s>paṇa</s> for a single-hoofed [animal], half a <s>paṇa</s> for cattle, a quarter <s>paṇa</s> for small livestock, and one <s>māṣa</s> for a shoulder-load.

children.text: KAZ02.21.25/ naṣṭa.apahṛtaṃ ca pratividadhyāt //
children.translated_text: And he should compensate for [goods that are] lost or stolen.

children.text: KAZ02.21.26/ vaideśyaṃ sārthaṃ kṛta.sāra.phalgu.bhāṇḍa.vicayanam abhijñānaṃ mudrāṃ ca dattvā preṣayed adhyakṣasya //
children.translated_text: He should send a foreign caravan, after having distinguished its valuable and cheap goods and having given it an identification seal, to the superintendent.

children.text: KAZ02.21.27/ vaidehaka.vyañjano vā sārtha.pramāṇaṃ rājñaḥ preṣayet //
children.translated_text: Or an agent disguised as a trader should send the caravan's inventory to the king.

children.text: KAZ02.21.28/ tena pradeśena rājā śulka.adhyakṣasya sārtha.pramāṇam upadiśet sarvajña.khyāpana^artham //
children.translated_text: Using that information, the king should convey the caravan's inventory to the superintendent of tolls, in order to demonstrate [his] omniscience.

children.text: KAZ02.21.29/ tataḥ sārtham adhyakṣo^abhigamya brūyāt "idam amuṣyām uṣya ca sāra.bhāṇḍaṃ phalgu.bhāṇḍaṃ ca, na nihūhitavyam, eṣa rājñaḥ prabhāvaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: Then the superintendent, approaching the caravan, should say: 'These are the valuable goods and cheap goods, having stayed at such-and-such a place. Nothing should be concealed — this is the king's power.'

children.text: KAZ02.21.30/ nihūhataḥ phalgu.bhāṇḍaṃ śulka.aṣṭa.guṇo daṇḍaḥ, sāra.bhāṇḍaṃ sarva.apahāraḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who conceals [goods]: for cheap goods, the fine is eight times the toll; for valuable goods, total confiscation.

children.text:
KAZ02.21.31ab/ rāṣṭra.pīḍā.karaṃ bhāṇḍam ucchindyād aphalaṃ ca yat /
KAZ02.21.31cd/ mahā.upakāram ucchulkaṃ kuryād bījaṃ ca durlabham //E
children.translated_text: He should prohibit merchandise that is harmful to the country or fruitless. He should make toll-free that which is of great benefit, and also seeds that are rare.

children.text:
(ṭariff of duties and tolls)
KAZ02.22.01/ bāhyam ābhyantaraṃ ca^ātithyam //
children.translated_text:
(Tariff of duties and tolls)
Hospitality [tax applies to] both foreign and domestic [traders].

children.text: KAZ02.22.02/ niṣkrāmyaṃ praveśyaṃ ca śulkam //
children.translated_text: Tolls [are levied on goods] going out and coming in.

children.text: KAZ02.22.03/ praveśyānāṃ mūlya.pañca.bhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: For imports, [the toll is] one-fifth of the value.

children.text: KAZ02.22.04/ puṣpa.phala.śāka.mūla.kanda.vāllikya.bīja.śuṣka.matsya.māṃsānāṃ ṣaḍ.bhāgaṃ gṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: For flowers, fruits, vegetables, roots, tubers, creepers, seeds, dried fish, and meats, he should take one-sixth.

children.text: KAZ02.22.05/ śaṅkha.vajra.maṇi.muktā.pravāla.hārāṇāṃ taj.jāta.puruṣaiḥ kārayet kṛta.karma.pramāṇa.kāla.vetana.phala.niṣpattibhiḥ //
children.translated_text: For conches, diamonds, gems, pearls, corals, and garlands, he should have [the work] done by experts of those kinds, [paying them] according to the accomplished work, quantity, time, wages, and output.

children.text: KAZ02.22.06/ kṣauma.dukūla.krimi.tāna.kaṅkaṭa.hari.tāla.manaḥ.śilā.añjana.hiṅguluka.loha.varṇa.dhātūnāṃ candana.aguru.kaṭuka.kiṇva.avarāṇāṃ carma.danta.āstaraṇa.prāvaraṇa.krimi.jātānām āja.eḍakasya ca daśa.bhāgaḥ pañca.daśa.bhāgo vā //
children.translated_text: For linen, <s>dukūla</s>, silk-worm [fabric], <s>kaṅkaṭa</s>, yellow orpiment, realgar, collyrium, vermillion, metals, color-ores, sandalwood, aloe wood, pungent [spices], yeast, and inferior [goods]; hides, ivory, spreads, cloaks, silk-worm products, and goat and sheep [products] — one-tenth or one-fifteenth.

children.text: KAZ02.22.07/ vastra.catuṣpada.dvipada.sūtra.kārpāsa.gandha.bhaiṣajya.kāṣṭha.veṇu.valkala.carma.mṛdbha.aṇḍānāṃ dhānya.sneha.kṣāra.lavaṇa.madya.pakvān nādīnāṃ ca viṃśati.bhāgaḥ pañca.viṃśati.bhāgo vā//
children.translated_text: For cloth, quadrupeds, bipeds, thread, cotton, fragrances, medicines, timber, bamboo, bark, leather, earthen vessels, grain, oils, alkalis, salt, liquor, and cooked food vessels — one-twentieth or one-twenty-fifth.

children.text: KAZO2.22.08/ dvārādeyaṃ śulkaṃ pañca.bhāgaḥ ānugrāhikaṃ vā yathā.deśa.upakāraṃ sthāpaytet//
children.translated_text: The gate-toll is one-fifth, or a concessional [rate] may be established according to the benefit to the region.

children.text: KAZO2.22.09/ jāti.bhūmiṣu ca paṇyānāṃ vikrayaḥ//
children.translated_text: Merchandise should be sold in its region of origin.

children.text: KAZO2.22.10/ khanibhyo dhātu.paṇyādāne ṣaṭ.chatam atyayaḥ//
children.translated_text: For taking mineral merchandise from mines, the penalty is six hundred [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZO2.22.11/ puṣpa.phala.vāṭebhyaḥ puṣpa.phala.ādāne catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For taking flowers and fruits from flower and fruit gardens, the fine is fifty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZO2.22.12 ṣaṇḍebhyaḥ śāka.mūla.kanda.ādāne pāda.ūnaṃ dvi.pañcāśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For taking vegetables, roots, and tubers from plantations, the fine is fifty-one and three-quarter <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.22.13/ kṣetrebhyaḥ sarva.sasya.ādāne tri.pañcāśat.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For taking any crop from fields, [the fine is] fifty-three <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.22.14/ paṇo^adhyardha.paṇaś ca sītā.atyayaḥ //
children.translated_text: One <s>paṇa</s> and one-and-a-half <s>paṇas</s> are the penalties for [offenses concerning] crown lands.

children.text:
KAZ02.22.15ab/ ato nava.purāṇāṃ deśa.jāti.caritrataḥ /
KAZ02.22.15cd/ paṇyānāṃ sthāpayec^śuklam atyayaṃ ca^apakārataḥ //E
children.translated_text: Accordingly, he should establish the toll and the penalty for harm, for both new and old merchandise, based on the region, kind, and custom.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of yarns (and teṣtiles))
KAZ02.23.01/ sūtra.adhyakṣaḥ sūtra.varma.vastra.rajju.vyavahāraṃ taj.jāta.puruṣaiḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of yarns and textiles)
The superintendent of yarns should have the work of spinning yarn, making armor, weaving cloth, and twisting ropes carried out by persons skilled in those crafts.

children.text: KAZ02.23.02/ ūrṇā.valka.kārpāsa.tūla.śaṇa.kṣaumāṇi ca vidhavā.nyaṅgā.kanyā.pravrajitā.daṇḍa.pratikāriṇībhī rūpa.ājīvā.mātṛkābhir vṛddha.rāja.dāsībhir vyuparata.upasthāna.deva.dāsībhiś ca kartayet //
children.translated_text: He should have wool, bark-fiber, cotton, cotton-down, hemp, and flax spun by widows, disabled women, unmarried girls, female renunciants, women working off penalties, women living by their beauty, mothers [of courtesans], aged royal slave-women, and temple slave-women who have retired from service.

children.text: KAZ02.23.03/ ślakṣṇa.sthūla.madhyatāṃ ca sūtrasya viditvā vetanaṃ kalpayet, bahv.alpatāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: Having assessed the fineness, coarseness, or medium [quality] of the yarn, and its quantity — whether large or small — he should determine the wages.

children.text: KAZ02.23.04/ sūtra.pramāṇa jñātvā taila.āmalaka.udvartanair etā anugṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: Having ascertained the yarn's quantity, he should reward these [women] with oil and <s>āmalaka</s> (myrobalan) ointments.

children.text: KAZ02.23.05/ tithiṣu pratimāna.dānaiś ca karma kārayitavyāḥ //
children.translated_text: On festival days, they should be made to work by giving token gifts.

children.text: KAZ02.23.06/ sūtra.hrāse vetana.hrāso dravya.sārāt //
children.translated_text: For a shortfall in yarn, [there should be] a proportionate deduction from wages based on the material value.

children.text: KAZ02.23.07/ kṛta.karma.pramāṇa.kāla.vetana.phala.niṣpattibhiḥ kārubhiś ca karma kārayet, pratisaṃsargaṃ ca gacchet //
children.translated_text: He should also have the work done by artisans according to the accomplished work, quantity, time, wages, and output, and should personally inspect [the work].

children.text: KAZ02.23.08/ kṣauma.dukūla.krimi.tāna.rāṅkava.kārpāsa.sūtra.vāna.karma.antāṃś ca prayuñjāno gandha.mālya.dānair anyaiś ca^aupagrāhikair ārādhayet //
children.translated_text: He should encourage those engaged in the finishing of linen, <s>dukūla</s>, silk-worm [fabric], woolen, cotton yarn, and woven [fabrics] through gifts of fragrances and garlands, and other favors.

children.text: KAZ02.23.09/ vastra.āstaraṇa.prāvaraṇa.vikalpān utthāpayet //
children.translated_text: He should promote innovations in the design of garments, spreads, and cloaks.

children.text: KAZ02.23.10/ kaṅkaṭa.karma.antāṃś ca taj.jāta.kāru.śilpibhiḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: He should have armor-work done by artisans and craftsmen skilled in those [products].

children.text: KAZ02.23.11/ yāś ca^aniṣkāsinyaḥ proṣitā vidhavā nyaṅgāḥ kanyakā vā^ātmānaṃ bibhṛyuḥ tāḥ sva.dāsībhir anusārya sa-upagrahaṃ karma kārayitavyāḥ //
children.translated_text: Women who do not go out — those whose husbands are away, widows, the disabled, or unmarried girls — who support themselves, should be traced through their own slave-women and given work with [appropriate] assistance.

children.text: KAZ02.23.12/ svayam āgacchantīnāṃ vā sūtra.śālāṃ pratyuṣasi bhāṇḍa.vetana.vinimayaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: Or, for those who come of their own accord to the yarn-workshop at dawn, he should arrange the exchange of goods for wages.

children.text: KAZ02.23.13/ sūtra.parīkṣā.artha.mātraḥ pradīpaḥ //
children.translated_text: The lamp [should provide] only enough [light] to examine the yarn.

children.text: KAZ02.23.14/ striyā mukha.saṃdarśane^anya.kārya.sambhāṣāyāṃ vā pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, vetana.kāla.atipātane madhyamaḥ, akṛta.karma.vetana.pradāne ca //
children.translated_text: For gazing at a woman's face or conversing about other matters, the lowest <s>sāhasa</s> penalty [applies]; for delaying the payment of wages, the middle [penalty]; and for paying wages for work not done, [the same].

children.text: KAZ02.23.15/ gṛhītvā vetanaṃ karma.akurvatyā aṅguṣṭha.saṃdaṃśaṃ dāpayet, bhakṣita.apahṛta.avaskanditānāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: For a woman who takes wages but does not work, thumb-pressing [punishment] should be imposed; likewise for those who consume, steal, or abscond [with materials].

children.text: KAZ02.23.16/ vetaneṣu ca karma.karāṇām aparādhato daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: And among the wages of workers, the penalty [should be] according to the offense.

children.text: KAZ02.23.17/ rajju.vartakair varma.kāraiś ca svayaṃ saṃsṛjyeta //
children.translated_text: He should personally supervise the rope-makers and armor-makers.

children.text: KAZ02.23.18/ bhāṇḍāni ca varatra.ādīni vartayet //
children.translated_text: He should have straps and similar accessories produced.

children.text:
KAZ02.23.19ab/ sūtra.valkamayī rajjur varatrā vaitra.vaiṇavīḥ /
KAZ02.23.19cd/ sāmnāhyā bandha.nīyāś ca yāna.yugyasya karayet //E
children.translated_text: Ropes of yarn and bark, straps of cane and bamboo, and harnesses and bindings for vehicles and yokes he should have manufactured.

children.text:
(ḍirector of agriculture)
KAZ02.24.01/ sītā.adhyakṣaḥ kṛṣi.tantra.śulba.vṛkṣa.āyur.vedajñas taj.jña.sakho vā sarva.dhānya.puṣpa.phala.śāka.kanda.mūla.vāllikya.kṣauma.kārpāsa.bījāni yathā.kālaṃ gṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text:
(Director of agriculture)
The superintendent of agriculture (<s>sītādhyakṣa</s>), knowledgeable in the science of farming, metallurgy, arboriculture, and <s>Āyurveda</s> — or accompanied by experts therein — should collect at the proper seasons all seeds of grain, flowers, fruits, vegetables, tubers, roots, creepers, flax, and cotton.

children.text: KAZ02.24.02/ bahu.hala.parikṛṣṭāyāṃ sva.bhūmau dāsa.karma.kara.daṇḍa.pratikartṛbhir vāpayet //
children.translated_text: On [the king's] own land, well-plowed with many plows, he should have [the crops] sown by slaves, laborers, and those working off penalties.

children.text: KAZ02.24.03/ karṣaṇa.yantra.upakaraṇa.balīvardaiś ca^eṣām asaṅgaṃ kārayet, kārubhiś ca karmāra.kuṭṭāka.medaka.rajju.vartaka.sarpa.grāha.ādibhiś ca //
children.translated_text: He should ensure that there is no interruption in their work with plowing implements, tools, and draft oxen, and also with artisans such as blacksmiths, woodcutters, borers, rope-makers, and snake-catchers.

children.text: KAZ02.24.04/ teṣāṃ karma.phala.vinipāte tat.phala.hānaṃ daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For failure in the output of their work, the fine is the loss of that output.

children.text: KAZ02.24.05/ ṣoḍaśa.droṇaṃ jāṅgalānāṃ varṣa.pramāṇam, adhyardham ānūpānāṃ deśa.vāpānām, ardha.trayodaśa^aśmakānām, trayoviṃśatir avantīnām, amitam apara.antānāṃ haimanyānāṃ ca, kulyā.āvāpānāṃ ca kālataḥ //
children.translated_text: The standard rainfall for arid lands is sixteen <s>droṇas</s>; for wetlands, one and a half [times that] for rain-fed sowing; thirteen and a half for the <s>Aśmaka</s> country; twenty-three for <s>Avantī</s>; unlimited for the western coast and <s>Haimanya</s> (Himalayan) regions; and for canal-irrigated [lands], according to the season.

children.text: KAZ02.24.06/ varṣa.tri.bhāgaḥ pūrva.paścima.māsayoḥ, dvau tri.bhāgau madhyamayoḥ - suṣamā.rūpam //
children.translated_text: One-third of the rain [falls] in the first and last months [of the rainy season], two-thirds in the middle months — [this is] the ideal pattern.

children.text: KAZ02.24.07/ tasya^upaladhir bṛhaspateḥ sthāna.gamana.garbha.ādhānebhyaḥ śukra.udaya.astamaya.cārebhyaḥ sūryasya prakṛti.vaikṛtāc ca //
children.translated_text: Its prediction [is derived] from [the positions of] <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter) — its station, movement, and conception; from the rising, setting, and courses of <s>Śukra</s> (Venus); and from the normal and abnormal [behavior] of the Sun.

children.text: KAZ02.24.08/ sūryād bīja.siddhiḥ, bṛhaspateḥ sasyānāṃ stamba.kāritā, śukrād vṛṣṭiḥ / iti //
children.translated_text: From the Sun [comes knowledge of] seed-ripening; from <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the stalk-productivity of crops; from <s>Śukra</s>, rainfall.

children.text:
KAZ02.24.09ab/ trayaḥ sapta.ahikā meghā aśītiḥ kaṇa.śīkarāḥ /
KAZ02.24.09cd/ ṣaṣṭir ātapa.meghānām eṣā vṛṣṭiḥ samā hitā //
children.translated_text: Three [periods of] seven-day rains, eighty [days of] drops and drizzle, sixty [days of] sunshine-with-clouds — this is the proper total rainfall.

children.text:
KAZ02.24.10ab/ vātam ātapa.yogaṃ ca vibhajan yatra varṣati /
KAZ02.24.10cd/ trīn karīṣāṃś ca janayaṃs tatra sasya.āgamo dhruvaḥ //
children.translated_text: Where [rain] falls while alternating wind and sunshine, and producing three <s>karīṣas</s> [of water per unit] — there a good harvest is certain.

children.text: KAZ02.24.11/ tataḥ prabhūta.udakam alpa.udakaṃ vā sasyaṃ vāpayet //
children.translated_text: Accordingly, he should sow crops [requiring] abundant water or little water.

children.text: KAZ02.24.12/ śāli.vrīhi.kodrava.tila.priyaṅgu.udāraka.varakāḥ pūrva.vāpāḥ //
children.translated_text: Rice (<s>śāli</s>), wild rice (<s>vrīhi</s>), <s>kodrava</s>, sesame, <s>priyaṅgu</s>, <s>udāraka</s>, and <s>varaka</s> are early-sown [crops].

children.text: KAZ02.24.13/ mudga.māṣa.śaimbyā madhya.vāpāḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Mudga</s> (green gram), <s>māṣa</s> (black gram), and <s>śaimbya</s> (beans) are mid-season crops.

children.text: KAZ02.24.14/ kusumbha.masūra.kulattha.yava.go.dhūma.kalāya.atasī.sarṣapāḥ paścād.vāpāḥ //
children.translated_text: Safflower, lentils, <s>kulattha</s> (horse-gram), barley, wheat, <s>kalāya</s> (peas), linseed, and mustard are late-sown crops.

children.text: KAZ02.24.15/ yathā.ṛtu.vaśena vā bīja.vāpāḥ //
children.translated_text: Or, seed-sowing [should follow] the dictates of the season.

children.text: KAZO2.24.16/ vāpa.atiriktam ardha.sītikāḥ kuryuḥ, sva.vīrya.upajīvino vā catur.tha.pañca.bhāgikāḥ //
children.translated_text: Those who sow beyond [the king's allotment] should cultivate as half-share tenants, or as those living by their own effort, [paying] one-fourth or one-fifth share.

children.text: KAZU2.24.17/ yathā^iṣṭam anavasita.bhāgaṃ dadyuḥ, anyatra kṛcchrebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: They should give whatever share they wish, except in times of hardship.

children.text: KAZU2.24.18/ sva.setubhyo hasta.prāvartimam udaka.bhāgaṃ pañcamaṃ dadyuḥ, skandha.prāvartimaṃ caturtham, sroto.yantra.prāvartimaṃ ca tṛtīyam, caturthaṃ nadī.saras.taṭāka.kūpa.uddhāṭam //
children.translated_text: From their own reservoirs, they should give one-fifth as the water-share for hand-operated [irrigation], one-fourth for shoulder-operated, one-third for water-channel and mechanical [irrigation], and one-fourth for [water drawn from] rivers, lakes, tanks, and wells.

children.text: KAZU2.24.19/ karma.udaka.pramāṇena kaidāraṃ haimanaṃ graiṣmikaṃ vā sasyaṃ sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: According to the measure of available water for cultivation, he should establish paddy, winter, or summer crops.

children.text: KAZU2.24.20/ śāly.ādi jyeṣṭham, ṣaṇḍo madhyamaḥ, ikṣuḥ pratyavaraḥ //
children.translated_text: Rice and such [crops] are the best; groves are middling; sugarcane is the lowest.

children.text: KAZ02.24.21/ ikṣavo hi bahv.ābādhā vyaya.grāhiṇaś ca //
children.translated_text: For sugarcane is subject to many afflictions and expensive to maintain.

children.text: KAZ02.24.22/ phena.āghāto vallī.phalānām, parīvāha.antāḥ pippalī.mṛdvīka.ikṣūṇām, kūpa.paryantāḥ śāka.mūlānām, haraṇī.paryantā haritakānām, pālyo lavānāṃ gandha.bhaiṣajya.uśīra.hrībera.piṇḍāluka.ādīnām //
children.translated_text: At the foam-banks [of rivers], climbing fruits [should be grown]; at the ends of drainage channels, long pepper, grapes, and sugarcane; around wells, vegetables and roots; alongside water channels, green [leafy] plants; and in nurseries, harvests of perfumes, medicinal plants, <s>uśīra</s>, <s>hrībera</s>, <s>piṇḍāluka</s>, and the like.

children.text: KAZ02.24.23/ yathā.svaṃ bhūmiṣu ca sthālyāś ca^ānūpyāś ca^oṣadhīḥ sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: And he should establish medicinal plants — both those of dry and marshy land — each in their appropriate soils.

children.text: KAZ02.24.24/ tuṣāra.pāyana.muṣṇa.śoṣaṇaṃ ca^ā.sapta.rātrād iti dhānya.bījānām, tri.rātraṃ vā pañca.rātraṃ vā kośī.dhānyānām, madhu.ghṛta.sūkara.vasābhiḥ śakṛd.yuktābhiḥ kāṇḍa.bījānāṃ cheda.lepo, madhu.ghṛtena kandānām, asthi.bījānāṃ śakṛd.ālepaḥ, śākhināṃ garta.dāho go.asthi.śakṛdbhiḥ kāle dauhrdaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: For grain seeds: drying by exposure to frost, sunlight, and heat for up to seven nights; or three nights or five nights for husk-covered grains; for stem-cuttings, a coating on the cut with cow-dung mixed with honey, ghee, and pig fat; for tubers, [a coating with] honey and ghee; for stone-seeds, a smearing with cow-dung; for trees, burning [the planting pit] with cow-bones and cow-dung, and fulfillment of their cravings at the [proper] season.

children.text: KAZ02.24.25/ prarūḍhāṃś ca^aśuṣka.kaṭu.matsyāṃś ca snuhi.kṣīreṇa pāyayet //
children.translated_text: And sprouted [plants], he should water with fresh pungent fish [solution] mixed with <s>snuhī</s> (spurge) milk.

children.text:
KAZ02.24.26ab/ kārpāsa.sāraṃ nirmokaṃ sarpasya ca samāharet /
KAZ02.24.26cd/ na sarpās tatra tiṣṭhanti dhūmo yatra^eṣa tiṣṭhati //
children.translated_text:
Gather the essential cotton fibers and a snake's slough;
where the smoke from these stands, snakes do not remain.

children.text: KAZ02.24.27/ sarva.jījānāṃ tu prathama.vāpe suvarṇa.udaka.samplutāṃ pūrva.muṣṭiṃ vāpayed, amuṃ ca mantraṃ brūyāt - "prajāpataye kāśyapāya devāya ca namaḥ sadā / sītā me ṛdhyatāṃ devī bījeṣu ca dhaneṣu ca //
