children.translated_text: For the very first sowing of all seeds, he should sow the first handful drenched in gold-water, and recite this mantra: 'Homage always to <s>Prajāpati</s>, to the divine <s>Kaśyapa</s>; may the goddess <s>Sītā</s> prosper for me, in seeds and in wealth.'

children.text: KAZ02.24.28/ ṣaṇḍa.vāṭa.go.pālaka.dāsa.karma.karebhyo yathā.puruṣa.parivāpaṃ bhaktaṃ kuryāt, sa-pāda.paṇikaṃ ca māsaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: He should provide food allowances to the workers of groves, gardens, cowherds, slaves, and laborers according to [the number of] men, and give one and a quarter <s>paṇas</s> per month.

children.text: KAZ02.24.29/ karma.anurūpaṃ kārubhyo bhakta.vetanam //
children.translated_text: For artisans, food and wages in proportion to their work.

children.text: KAZ02.24.30/ praśīrṇaṃ ca puṣpa.phalaṃ deva.kārya.arthaṃ vrīhi.yavam āgrayaṇa.arthaṃ śrotriyās tapasvinaś ca^āhareyuḥ, rāśi.mūlam uñcha.vṛttayaḥ //
children.translated_text: Fallen flowers and fruits [may be taken] for religious purposes; rice and barley for the <s>āgrayaṇa</s> (first-fruits) offering by Vedic scholars and ascetics; and gleanings from the heap by those who live by gleaning.

children.text:
KAZ02.24.31ab/ yathā.kālaṃ ca sasya.ādi jātaṃ jātaṃ praveśayet /
KAZ02.24.31cd/ na kṣetre sthāpayet kiṃcit palālam api paṇḍitaḥ //
children.translated_text:
Each and every crop that ripens should be brought in at the proper time;
the wise one should not leave anything in the field, not even straw.

children.text:
KAZ02.24.32ab/ prākārāṇāṃ samucchrayān valabhīr vā tathā.vidhāḥ /
KAZ02.24.32cd/ na saṃhatāni kurvīta na tucchāni śirāṃsi ca //
children.translated_text:
He should not make the walls or roofed galleries overly high,
nor make the grain-tops joined together or hollow.

children.text:
KAZ02.24.33ab/ khalasya prakarān kuryān maṇḍala.ante samāśritān /
KAZ02.24.33cd/ anagnikāḥ sa-udakāś ca khale syuḥ parikarmiṇaḥ //E
children.translated_text:
He should construct the threshing-floor walls at the edge of the circular [area];
the workers at the threshing floor should be without fire and supplied with water.

children.text:
(Controller of spiritual liquors)
KAZ02.25.01/ surā.adhyakṣaḥ surā.kiṇva.vyavahārān durge jana.pade skandha.āvāre vā taj.jāta.surā.kiṇva.vyavahāribhiḥ kārayed, eka.mukham aneka.mukhaṃ vā vikraya.kraya.vaśena vā //
children.translated_text:
(Controller of spirituous liquors)
The superintendent of liquor (<s>surādhyakṣa</s>) should have the manufacture and trade of liquor and ferment carried out in the fort, the countryside, or the military camp — by those engaged in such liquor and ferment trade — either centralized or decentralized, according to the conditions of buying and selling.

children.text: KAZ02.25.02/ ṣaṭ.śatam atyayam anyatra kartṛ.kretṛ.vikretṛṛṇāṃ sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: He should impose a penalty of six hundred [<s>paṇas</s>] on unauthorized makers, buyers, and sellers.

children.text: KAZ02.25.03/ grāmād anirṇayaṇam asampātaṃ ca surāyāḥ, pramāda.bhayāt karmasu ñjirdiṣṭānām, maryāda.atikrama.bhayād āryāṇām, utsāha.bhayāc ca tīṣkṇānām //
children.translated_text: Liquor should not be taken out of a village or brought together [in quantities], out of fear of negligence among those assigned to duties, fear of transgression of social boundaries among the respectable, and fear of [violent] impulse among the fierce.

children.text: KAZ02.25.04/ lakṣitam alpaṃ vā catur.bhāgam ardha.kuḍubaṃ kuḍubam ardha.prasthaṃ prasthaṃ vā^iti jñāta.śaucā nirhareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Those of known good character may carry out — in marked [containers] — a small quantity: a quarter-measure, half-<s>kuḍuba</s>, a <s>kuḍuba</s>, half-<s>prastha</s>, or a <s>prastha</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.25.05/ pāna.agāreṣu vā pibeyur asaṃcāriṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: Or they may drink at licensed drinking houses, without leaving [the premises].

children.text: KAZ02.25.06/ nikṣepa.upanidhi.prayoga.apahṛtānām aniṣṭa.upagatānāṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ jñāna.artham asvāmikaṃ kupyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca^upalabhya niṣkeptāram anyatra vyapadeśena grāhayed, ativyaya.kartāram anāyati.vyayaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: For the purpose of discovering goods stolen from deposits, pledges, or loans, and of goods that have come into unauthorized possession, [the superintendent], upon finding ownerless raw materials or money, should have the depositor arrested elsewhere under a pretext — as well as one who spends excessively and one who spends without future [income].

children.text: KAZ02.25.07/ na ca^anargheṇa kālikāṃ vā surāṃ dadyād, anyatra duṣṭa.surāyāḥ //
children.translated_text: And he should not give stale or [genuine] liquor below its proper price, except for spoiled liquor.

children.text: KAZ02.25.08/ tām anyatra vikrāpayet //
children.translated_text: That [spoiled liquor] he should have sold elsewhere.

children.text: KAZ02.25.09/ dāsa.karma.karebhyo vā vetanaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Or he should give it as wages to slaves and laborers.

children.text: KAZ02.25.10/ vāhana.pratipānaṃ sūkara.poṣaṇaṃ vā dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Or he should give it as feed for draft animals or for rearing pigs.

children.text: KAZ02.25.11/ pāna.agārāṇy.aneka.kakṣyāṇi vibhakta.śayana.āsanavanti pāna.uddeśāni gandha.mālya.udakavanti ṛtu.sukhāni kārayet //
children.translated_text: He should have the drinking houses constructed with multiple enclosures, separate sleeping and seating quarters, drinking areas supplied with perfumes, garlands, and water, and made comfortable for the [respective] season.

children.text: KAZ02.25.12/ tatrasthāḥ prakṛty.autpattikau vyayau gūḍhā vidyuḥ, āgantūṃś ca //
children.translated_text: Secret agents stationed there should ascertain the natural and incidental expenditures of [the patrons], as well as [those of] visitors.

children.text: KAZ02.25.13/ kretṛṛṇāṃ matta.suptānām alaṅkārāt^chādana.hiraṇyāni ca vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: They should ascertain the ornaments, clothes, and money of buyers who fall asleep or become intoxicated.

children.text: KAZ02.25.14/ tan.nāśe vaṇijas tac ca tāvac ca daṇḍaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: If those [items] are lost, the tavern-keepers should pay a fine equal to [the value of] that and the same again.

children.text: KAZ02.25.15/ vaṇijaśs tu saṃvṛteṣu kakṣyā.vibhāgeṣu sva.dāsībhiḥ peśala.rūpābhir āgantūnāṃ vāstavyānāṃ ca^ārya.rūpāṇāṃ matta.suptānāṃ bhāvaṃ vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: The tavern-keepers, in the enclosed divisions [of the establishment], through their own slave-women of attractive appearance, should ascertain the sentiments of visitors and residents who are of respectable appearance when intoxicated or asleep.

children.text: KAZ02.25.16/ medaka.prasanna.āsava.ariṣṭa.maireya.madhūnām //
children.translated_text: [The following are types of liquor:] <s>medaka</s>, <s>prasannā</s>, <s>āsava</s>, <s>ariṣṭa</s>, <s>maireya</s>, and <s>madhu</s> (honey-wine).

children.text: KAZ02.25.17/ udaka.droṇaṃ taṇḍulānām ardha.āḍhakaṃ trayaḥ prasthāḥ kiṇvasya^iti medaka.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: One <s>droṇa</s> of water, half an <s>āḍhaka</s> of rice, and three <s>prasthas</s> of ferment — this is the recipe for <s>medaka</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.25.18/ dvādaśa.āḍhakaṃ piṣṭasya pañca prasthāḥ kiṇvasya kramuka.tvak.phala.yukto vā jāti.sambhāraḥ prasannā.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: Twelve <s>āḍhakas</s> of flour, five <s>prasthas</s> of ferment — with the bark and fruit of areca nut, or a collection of spices — this is the recipe for <s>prasannā</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.25.19/ kapittha.tulā phāṇitaṃ pañca.taulikaṃ prastho madhuna ity āsava.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: One <s>tulā</s> (a measure) of wood-apple, five <s>tulā</s>-measures of treacle, and one <s>prastha</s> of honey — this is the recipe for <s>āsava</s>.

children.text: KAZU2.25.20/ pād.adhiko jyeṣṭhaḥ pāda.hīnaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ //
children.translated_text: Increased by a quarter is the superior [grade]; decreased by a quarter is the inferior.

children.text: KAZU2.25.21/ cikitsaka.pramāṇāḥ pratyekaśo vikārāṇām ariṣṭāḥ //
children.translated_text: The <s>ariṣṭas</s> are medicinal preparations of individual variants, as prescribed by physicians.

children.text: KAZU2.25.22/ meṣa.śṛṅgī.tvak.kvātha.abhiṣuto guḍa.pratīvāpaḥ pippalī.marica.sambhāras tri.phalā.yukto vā maireyaḥ //
children.translated_text: Infused with a decoction of <s>meṣaśṛṅgī</s> bark, with a flux of jaggery, with long pepper and black pepper as spices, combined with the three fruits (<s>triphalā</s>) — this is <s>maireya</s>.

children.text: KAZY2.25.23/ guḍa.yuktānāṃ vā sarveṣāṃ tri.phalā.sambhāraḥ //
children.translated_text: Or for all [liquors] combined with jaggery, the spice mixture is <s>triphalā</s>.

children.text: KAZU2.25.24/ mṛdvīkā.raso madhu //
children.translated_text: Grape juice is <s>madhu</s> (honey-wine).

children.text: KAZu2.25.25/ tasya sva.deśo vyākhyānaṃ kāpi.śāyanaṃ hāra.hūrakam iti //
children.translated_text: Its regional [varieties are known by their] designations: <s>Kāpiśāyana</s>, <s>Hārahūraka</s>, and so forth.

children.text: KAZU2.25.26/ māṣakalanīdroṇamāmaṃ siddhaṃ vā tri.bhāga.adhika.taṇḍulaṃ moraṭa.ādīnāṃ kārṣika.bhāga.yuktaṃ kiṇva.bandhaḥ //
children.translated_text: One <s>droṇa</s> of <s>māṣa</s>-soaked [rice], raw or cooked, with rice increased by one-third, combined with a <s>karṣa</s>-measure of <s>moraṭā</s> and the like — this is the ferment preparation.

children.text: KAZ02.25.27/ pāṭhā.loghra.tejovaty.elā.vāluka.madhuka.madhu.rasā.priyaṅgu.dāru.haridrā.marica.pippalīnāṃ ca pañca.kārṣikaḥ sambhāra.yogo medakasya prasannāyāś ca //
children.translated_text: Five <s>karṣas</s> each of <s>pāṭhā</s>, <s>lodhra</s>, <s>tejovatī</s>, cardamom, <s>vāluka</s>, <s>madhuka</s>, honey-extract, <s>priyaṅgu</s>, turmeric bark, black pepper, and long pepper — this is the spice formula for <s>medaka</s> and <s>prasannā</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.25.28/ madhuka.niryūha.yuktā kaṭa.śarkarā varṇa.prasādanī ca //
children.translated_text: <s>Madhuka</s> decoction combined with cane sugar — this is the color-clarifier.

children.text: KAZ02.25.29/ coca.citraka.vilaṅga.gaja.pippalīnāṃ ca kārṣikaḥ kramuka.madhuka.mustā.lodhrāṇāṃ dvi.kārṣikaś ca^āsava.sambhāraḥ //
children.translated_text: One <s>karṣa</s> each of <s>coca</s>, <s>citraka</s>, <s>vilaṅga</s>, and long pepper; two <s>karṣas</s> each of areca, <s>madhuka</s>, <s>mustā</s>, and <s>lodhra</s> — this is the spice formula for <s>āsava</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.25.30/ daśa.bhāgaś ca^eṣāṃ bīja.bandhaḥ //
children.translated_text: And one-tenth of these [quantities constitutes] the seed-ferment.

children.text: KAZ02.25.31/ prasannā.yogaḥ śveta.surāyāḥ //
children.translated_text: The recipe for <s>prasannā</s> [applies also to] white liquor.

children.text: KAZ02.25.32/ sahakāra.surā rasa.uttarā bīja.uttarā vā mahā.surā sambhārikī vā //
children.translated_text: Mango liquor, rich in juice or rich in seed, is great liquor (<s>mahāsurā</s>), whether spiced or not.

children.text: KAZ02.25.33/ tāsāṃ moraṭā.palāśa.pattūra.meṣa.śṛṅgī.karañja.kṣīra.vṛkṣa.kaṣāya.bhāvitaṃ dagdha.kaṭa.śarkarā.cūrṇaṃ loghra.citraka.vilaṅga.pāṭhā.mustā.kaliṅga.yava.dāru.haridra.indīvara.śata.puṣpa.apāmārga.sapta.parṇa.nimba.āsphota.kalka.ardha.yuktam antar.nakho muṣṭiḥ kumbhīṃ rāja.peyāṃ prasādayati //
children.translated_text: For those [liquors], a fistful [of a powder] — [made from] a decoction of <s>moraṭā</s>, <s>palāśa</s>, <s>pattūra</s>, <s>meṣaśṛṅgī</s>, <s>karañja</s>, and milk-trees, steeped with burnt cane-sugar powder, combined with half [the amount of] a paste of <s>lodhra</s>, <s>citraka</s>, <s>vilaṅga</s>, <s>pāṭhā</s>, <s>mustā</s>, <s>kaliṅga</s>, barley, turmeric bark, blue lotus, <s>śatapuṣpa</s>, <s>apāmārga</s>, <s>saptaparṇa</s>, neem, and <s>āsphota</s> — [packed] within the closed fist, clarifies a pot of royal liquor.

children.text: KAZ02.25.34/ phāṇitaḥ pañca.palikaś ca^atra rasa.vṛddhir deyaḥ //
children.translated_text: And here, five <s>palas</s> of treacle should be added for increasing the flavor.

children.text: KAZ02.25.35/ kuṭumbinaḥ kṛtyeṣu śveta.surām, auṣadha.arthaṃ vāriṣṭam, anyad vā kartuṃ labheran //
children.translated_text: Householders may prepare white liquor for [ritual and festive] occasions, <s>ariṣṭa</s> for medicinal purposes, or any other [type].

children.text: KAZ02.25.36/ utsava.samāja.yātrāsu catur.ahaḥ sauriko deyaḥ //
children.translated_text: During festivals, gatherings, and processions, a four-day [brewing license] should be granted.

children.text: KAZ02.25.37/ teṣv ananujñātānāṃ prahavana.antaṃ daivasikam atyayaṃ gṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: For those who [brew] without permission during those [periods], he should levy a daily fine up to [the amount of] one <s>prahavaṇa</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.25.38/ surā.kiṇva.vicayaṃ striyo bālāś ca kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: Women and children should sort the liquor ferment.

children.text: KAZ02.25.39/ arāja.paṇyāḥ pañcakaṃ śataṃ śulkaṃ dadyuḥ, surakā.medaka.ariṣṭa.madhu.phala.āmla.āmla.śīdhūnāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: Those whose [liquor] is not a royal monopoly should pay five per hundred as customs duty — [applicable to] <s>surakā</s>, <s>medaka</s>, <s>ariṣṭa</s>, <s>madhu</s>, fruit-acid, sour liquor, and <s>śīdhu</s>.

children.text:
KAZ02.25.40ab/ ahnaś ca vikrayaṃ jñātvā vyājīṃ māna.hiraṇyayoḥ /
KAZ02.25.40cd/ tathā vaidharaṇaṃ kuryād ucitaṃ ca^anuvartayet //E
children.translated_text:
Having ascertained the daily sales, the commission on measures and money,
he should accordingly levy the confiscation fee and maintain the established practice.

children.text:
(ṣupervisor of (animal-)slaughter)
KAZ02.26.01/ sūnā.adhyakṣaḥ pradiṣṭa.abhayānām abhaya.vana.vāsināṃ ca mṛga.paśu.pakṣi.matsyānāṃ bandha.vadha.hiṃsāyām uttamaṃ daṇḍaṃ kārayet, kuṭumbinām abhaya.vana.parigraheṣu madhyamam //
children.translated_text:
(Supervisor of [animal] slaughter)
The superintendent of slaughter (<s>sūnādhyakṣa</s>) should impose the highest fine for the capture, killing, or harming of animals, livestock, birds, and fish that have been granted protection or that dwell in sanctuaries; and the middle fine for householders [who encroach upon] the sanctuaries.

children.text: KAZ02.26.02/ apravṛtta.vadhānāṃ matsya.pakṣiṇāṃ bandha.vadha.hiṃsāyāṃ pāda.ūna.sapta.viṃśati.paṇam atyayaṃ kuryāt, mṛga.paśūnāṃ dvi.guṇam //
children.translated_text: For the capture, killing, or harming of fish and birds for which slaughter has not been authorized, he should impose a fine of twenty-six and three-quarter <s>paṇas</s>; for [wild] animals and livestock, double.

children.text: KAZ02.26.03/ pravṛtta.hiṃsānām aparigṛhītānāṃ ṣaḍ.bhāgaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, matsya.pakṣiṇāṃ daśa.bhāgaṃ vā^adhikam, mṛga.paśūnāṃ śulkaṃ vā^adhikam //
children.translated_text: For [creatures] whose slaughter is authorized and that are not in reserved areas, he should take a one-sixth share; for fish and birds, a one-tenth share or more; for [wild] animals and livestock, the customs duty or more.

children.text: KAZ02.26.04/ pakṣi.mṛgāṇāṃ jīvat ṣaḍ.bhāgam abhaya.vaneṣu pramuñcet //
children.translated_text: Of birds and wild animals, one-sixth of those alive he should release into the sanctuaries.

children.text: KAZ02.26.05/ sāmudra.hasty.aśva.puruṣa.vṛṣa.gardabha.ākṛtayo matsyāḥ sārasā na^ādeyās taṭāka.kulyā.udbhavā vā krauñca.utkrośaka.dātyūha.haṃsa.cakravāka.jīvan.jīvaka.bhṛṅga.rāja.cakora.matta.kokila.mayūra.śuka.madana.śārikā vihāra.pakṣiṇo maṅgalyāś ca^anye^api prāṇinaḥ pakṣi.mṛgā hiṃsā.bādhebhyo rakṣyāḥ //
children.translated_text: Fish that have the form of sea-creatures, elephants, horses, humans, bulls, or donkeys, and <s>sārasa</s> cranes [should] not [be] taken, nor those born in reservoirs and canals; <s>krauñca</s> herons, <s>utkrośaka</s> ospreys, <s>dātyūha</s> gallinules, <s>haṃsa</s> geese, <s>cakravāka</s> sheldrakes, <s>jīvañjīvaka</s> pheasants, <s>bhṛṅgarāja</s> shrikes, <s>cakora</s> partridges, <s>mattakokila</s> cuckoos, peacocks, parrots, <s>madana</s> (love-birds), <s>sārikā</s> mynas — these pleasure-birds, auspicious animals, and other creatures among birds and beasts should be protected from slaughter and harassment.

children.text: KAZ02.26.06/ rakṣā.atikrame pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For violation of this protection, the first level of <s>sāhasa</s> (violence) penalty [applies].

children.text: KAZ02.26.07/ mṛga.paśūnām anasthi.māṃsaṃ sadyo.hataṃ vikrīṇīran //
children.translated_text: Boneless meat of [wild] animals and livestock should be sold freshly slaughtered.

children.text: KAZ02.26.08/ asthimataḥ pratipātaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: For meat with bones, a proportionate reduction should be given.

children.text: KAZ02.26.09/ tulā.hīne hīna.aṣṭa.guṇam //
children.translated_text: For short-weighing, [a fine of] eight times the deficiency.

children.text: KAZ02.26.10/ vatso vṛṣo dhenuś ca^eṣām avadhyāḥ //
children.translated_text: Among these, a calf, a bull, and a milch cow are not to be slaughtered.

children.text: KAZ02.26.11/ ghnataḥ pañcāśatko daṇḍaḥ, kliṣṭa.ghātaṃ ghātayataś ca //
children.translated_text: For one who kills [them], a fine of fifty [<s>paṇas</s>]; and for one who causes [another to] kill by torture.

children.text: KAZ02.26.12/ pariśūnam aśiraḥ.pāda.asthi vigandhaṃ svayaṃ.mṛtaṃ ca na vikrīṇīran //
children.translated_text: They should not sell [meat that is] shrunken, headless, footless, boneless, putrid, or naturally dead.

children.text: KAZ02.26.13/ anyathā dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: Otherwise, a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text:
KAZ02.26.14ab/ duṣṭāḥ paśu.mṛga.vyālā matsyaś ca^abhaya.cāriṇaḥ /
KAZ02.26.14cd/ anyatra gupti.sthānebhyo vadha.bandham avāpnuyuḥ //E
children.translated_text:
Dangerous domestic animals, wild beasts, serpents, and fish that roam in sanctuary [areas] —
except in protected zones — should receive capture or death.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of courtesans)
KAZ02.27.01/ gaṇikā.adhyakṣo gaṇikā.anvayām agaṇikā.anvayāṃ vā rūpa.yauvana.śilpa.sampannāṃ sahasreṇa gaṇikāṃ kārayet, kuṭumba.ardhena pratigaṇikām //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of courtesans)
The superintendent of courtesans (<s>gaṇikādhyakṣa</s>) should appoint as a state courtesan (<s>gaṇikā</s>), whether from a courtesan family or not, a woman endowed with beauty, youth, and artistic skill, with a salary of a thousand [<s>paṇas</s>]; and a deputy courtesan (<s>pratigaṇikā</s>) with half that salary.

children.text: KAZ02.27.02/ niṣpatitā.pretayor duhitā bhaginī vā kuṭumbaṃ bhareta, mātā vā pratigaṇikāṃ sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: When [a courtesan] has left or died, her daughter or sister should bear the [household] establishment; or the mother should appoint a deputy courtesan.

children.text: KAZ02.27.03/ tāsām abhāve rājā haret //
children.translated_text: In their absence, the king should take [the establishment].

children.text: KAZ02.27.04/ saubhāgya.alaṃkāra.vṛddhyā sahasreṇa vāraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ madhyamam uttamaṃ vā^āropayet chatra.bhṛṅgāra.vyajana.śibikā.pīṭhikā.ratheṣu ca viśeṣa.artham //
children.translated_text: By increasing the charm and adornment [of a courtesan], he should raise [her fee] by a thousand to the lower, middle, or higher class; and in the special matter of [granting the privilege of] parasol, golden water-vessel, fan, palanquin, seat, and chariot.

children.text: KAZ02.27.05/ saubhāgya.bhaṅge mātṛkāṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Upon the loss of her charm, she should be made a matron (<s>mātṛkā</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.27.06/ niṣkrayaś catur.viṃśati.sāhasro gaṇikāyāḥ, dvādaśa.sāhasro gaṇikā.putrasya //
children.translated_text: The ransom for a courtesan is twenty-four thousand [<s>paṇas</s>]; for a courtesan's son, twelve thousand.

children.text: KAZ02.27.07/ aṣṭa.varṣāt prabhṛti rājñaḥ kuśīlava.karma kuryāt //
children.translated_text: From the age of eight, [a courtesan's child] should perform entertainment services for the king.

children.text: KAZ02.27.08/ gaṇikā.dāsī bhagna.bhogā koṣṭha.agāre mahānase vā karma kuryāt //
children.translated_text: A courtesan's slave-woman who has lost her earning power should work in the storehouse or kitchen.

children.text: KAZ02.27.09/ aviśantī sapāda.paṇam avaruddhā māsa.vetanaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: One who refuses to receive [clients] should, when confined, pay a monthly wage of one and a quarter <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.27.10/ bhogaṃ dāyamāyaṃ vyayam āyatiṃ ca gaṇikāyā nibandhayet, ati.vyaya.karma ca vārayet //
children.translated_text: [The superintendent] should register the courtesan's income, inheritance, expenditure, and future obligations, and should prevent extravagant spending.

children.text: KAZ02.27.11/ mātṛ.hastād anyatra abharaṇa.nyāse sa.pāda.catuṣ.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For depositing ornaments anywhere other than with her mother — a fine of four and a quarter <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.27.12/ svāpateyaṃ vikrayam ādhānaṃ vā nayantyāḥ sa.pāda.pañcāśat.paṇaḥ paṇo^ardha.paṇa.cchedane //
children.translated_text: For a woman who sells or mortgages her own property — a fine of fifty-four and a quarter <s>paṇas</s>, [deducted at] one <s>paṇa</s> and half a <s>paṇa</s> [per installment].

children.text: KAZ02.27.13/ akāmāyāḥ kumāryā vā sāhase uttamo daṇḍaḥ, sa.kāmāyāḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For the rape (<s>sāhasa</s>) of an unwilling [courtesan] or a virgin — the highest <s>sāhasa</s> fine; for a willing one — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ02.27.14/ gaṇikām akāmāṃ rundhato niṣpātayato vā vraṇa.vidāraṇena vā rūpaṃ.upaghnataḥ sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who confines an unwilling courtesan, or drives her out, or disfigures her by inflicting wounds — a fine of one thousand [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ02.27.15/ sthān.viśeṣeṇa vā daṇḍa.vṛddhiḥ ā.niṣkraya.dvi.guṇāt //
children.translated_text: Or an increased fine according to the particular rank [of the courtesan], up to double the redemption price.

children.text: KAZ02.27.16/ prāpta.adhikāraṃ gaṇikāṃ ghatayato niṣkraya.tri.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For killing a courtesan who has attained her position — a fine of three times the redemption price.

children.text: KAZ02.27.17/ mātṛkā.duhitṛkā.rūpa.dāsīnāṃ ghāte uttamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For killing a <s>mātṛkā</s> (chief courtesan), a <s>duhitṛkā</s> (courtesan's daughter), or a <s>rūpadāsī</s> (beauty-slave) — the highest <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ02.27.18/ sarvatra prathame^aparādhe prathamaḥ, dvitīye dvi.guṇaḥ, tṛtīye tri.guṇaḥ, caturthe yathā.kāmī syāt //
children.translated_text: In all cases, for the first offense — the first [level of fine]; for the second — double; for the third — triple; for the fourth — [the king] may impose as he wishes.

children.text: KAZ02.27.19/ rāja.ājñayā puruṣam anabhigacchantī gaṇikā śiphā.sahasraṃ labheeta, pañca.sahasraṃ vā daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: A courtesan who, by the king's command, refuses to receive a man shall receive one thousand lashes with a whip, or a fine of five thousand [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ02.27.20/ bhogaṃ gṛhītvā dviṣatyā bhoga.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who, having received the fee, shows aversion — a fine of double the fee.

children.text: KAZ02.27.21/ vasati.bhoga.apahāre bhogam aṣṭa.guṇaṃ dadyād anyatra vyādhi.puruṣa.doṣebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: For absconding with the lodging fee, she should pay eight times the fee, except in cases of illness or defects of the man.

children.text: KAZ02.27.22/ puruṣaṃ ghnatyāś citā.pratāpe^apsu praveśanaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: For a [courtesan] who kills a man — burning on the funeral pyre or drowning in water.

children.text: KAZ02.27.23/ gaṇikā.bharaṇam arthaṃ bhogaṃ vā^apaharato^aṣṭa.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who steals a courtesan's maintenance, property, or fee — a fine of eight times [the amount].

children.text: KAZ02.27.24/ gaṇikā bhogam āyatiṃ puruṣaṃ ca nivedayet //
children.translated_text: The courtesan should report her income, obligations, and [the identity of] the man.

children.text: KAZ02.27.25/ etena naṭa.nartaka.gāyana.vādaka.vāg.jīvana.kuśīlava.plavaka.saubhika.cāraṇānāṃ strī.vyavahāriṇāṃ striyo gūḍha.ājīvāś ca vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, the rules for women of actors, dancers, singers, musicians, professional speakers, jesters, swimmers, showmen, and wandering bards — those who deal in women — as well as women of secret livelihood are explained.

children.text: KAZ02.27.26/ teṣāṃ tūryam āgantukaṃ pañca.paṇaṃ prekṣā.vetanaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: For visiting performers among them, the viewing fee should be five <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.27.27/ rūpa.ājīvā bhoga.dvaya.guṇaṃ māsaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Those who live by their beauty should pay double the fee as a monthly [levy].

children.text: KAZ02.27.28/ gīta.vādya.pāṭhya.nṛtya.nāṭya.akṣara.citra.vīṇā.veṇu.mṛdaṅga.para.citta.jñāna.gandha.mālya.samyūhana.saṃvādana.saṃvāhana.vaiśika.kalā.jñānāni gaṇikā dāsī raṅga.upajīvinīś ca grāhayato rāja.maṇḍalād ājīvaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: One who teaches courtesans, slave-women, and women who live by the stage the arts of singing, instrumental music, recitation, dancing, acting, writing, painting, <s>vīṇā</s>, flute, <s>mṛdaṅga</s> (drum), mind-reading, perfumery, garland-making, shampooing, conversation, massage, and the knowledge of the courtesan's arts — [such a teacher] should earn a livelihood from the royal household.

children.text: KAZ02.27.29/ gaṇikā.putrān raṅga.upajīvināṃ ca mukhyān niṣpādayeyuḥ, sarva.tāla.avacarāṇāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: They should train the sons of courtesans and the leading men of the stage performers to be proficient, as well as all acrobats.

children.text:
KAZ02.27.30ab/ saṃjñā.bhāṣā.antarajñāś ca striyas teṣām anātmasu /
KAZ02.27.30cd/ cāra.ghāta.pramāda.arthaṃ prayojyā bandhu.vāhanāḥ //E
children.translated_text:
Women of theirs, skilled in interpreting signs and languages, should be employed among uncontrolled [persons]
for the purposes of espionage, assassination, and detecting negligence — [deployed] as conveyances of kinship [trust].

children.text:
(Controller of shipping)
KAZ02.28.01/ nāv.adhyakṣaḥ samudra.samyāna.nadī.mukhatara.pracārān deva.saro.visaro.nadī.tarāṃś ca sthānīya.ādiṣv avekṣeta //
children.translated_text:
(Controller of shipping)
The superintendent of shipping (<s>nāvadhyakṣa</s>) should oversee the traffic on ocean-going vessels, at river-mouths and ferry crossings, and at sacred lakes, reservoirs, and river ferries in the capital and other [settlements].

children.text: KAZ02.28.02/ tad.velā.kūla.grāmāḥ klṛptaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: The villages on the shores and banks of those [waterways] should pay the established [dues].

children.text: KAZ02.28.03/ matsya.bandhakā naukā.bhāṭakaṃ ṣaḍ.bhāgaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Fishermen should pay the boat-hire and one-sixth share.

children.text: KAZ02.28.04/ pattana.anuvṛttaṃ śulka.bhāgaṃ vaṇijo dadyuḥ, yātrā.vetanaṃ rāja.naubhiḥ sampatantaḥ //
children.translated_text: Merchants should pay the toll-share in accordance with the port regulations; and those traveling on royal vessels [should pay] the voyage fare.

children.text: KAZ02.28.05/ śaṅkha.muktā.grāhiṇo nau.bhāṭakaṃ dadyuḥ, sva.naubhir vā tareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Conch and pearl divers should pay the boat-hire, or they may cross in their own boats.

children.text: KAZ02.28.06/ adhyakṣaś ca^eṣāṃ khany.adhyakṣeṇa vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: The superintendent of these is explained under the superintendent of mines.

children.text: KAZ02.28.07/ pattana.adhyakṣa.nibaddhaṃ paṇya.pattana.cāritraṃ nāv.adhyakṣaḥ pālayet //
children.translated_text: The superintendent of shipping should enforce the trade-port regulations as established by the superintendent of ports.

children.text: KAZ02.28.08/ mūḍha.vāta.āhatā nāvaḥ pitā^iva^anugṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: Vessels lost or storm-struck, he should assist as a father [would].

children.text: KAZ02.28.09/ udaka.prāptaṃ paṇyam aśulkam ardha.śulkaṃ vā kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Merchandise damaged by water should be made free of toll or subject to half-toll.

children.text: KAZ02.28.10/ yathā.nirdiṣṭāś ca^etāḥ paṇya.pattana.yātrā.kāleṣu preṣayet //
children.translated_text: And he should dispatch these [vessels] at the prescribed times for trade-port voyages.

children.text: KAZ02.28.11/ samyātīr nāvaḥ kṣetra.anugatāḥ śulkaṃ yācet //
children.translated_text: Vessels that have completed their voyage and are following the [agricultural] fields — he should collect the toll from them.

children.text: KAZ02.28.12/ hiṃsrikā nirghātayet, amitra.viṣaya.atigāḥ paṇya.pattana.cāritra.upaghātikāś ca //
children.translated_text: Harmful [vessels] he should expel, as well as those entering enemy territory or those that damage the trade-port regulations.

children.text: KAZ02.28.13/ śāsaka.niryāmaka.dātra..raśmi.grāhaka.utsecaka.adhiṣṭhitāś ca mahā.nāvo hemanta.grīṣma.tāryāsu mahā.nadīṣu prayojayet, kṣudrikāḥ kṣudrikāsu varṣā.srāviṇīṣu //
children.translated_text: Large vessels, manned by a helmsman, navigator, bailer, rope-handlers, and bailing crew, should be employed on great rivers navigable in winter and summer; small [vessels] on smaller rivers during the rainy season.

children.text: KAZ02.28.14/ bādha.tīrthāś ca^etāḥ kāryā rāja.dviṣṭa.kāriṇāṃ taraṇa.bhayāt //
children.translated_text: And these [ferries] should be stationed at restricted crossings, for fear that those who have committed offenses against the king might cross.

children.text: KAZ02.28.15/ akāle^atīrthe ca tarataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who crosses at the wrong time or at a non-designated crossing — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ02.28.16/ kāle tīrthe ca^aniṣṛṣṭa.tāriṇaḥ pāda.ūna.sapta.viṃśati.paṇas tara.atyayaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who, at the proper time and designated crossing, does not release the ferry — a fine of twenty-six and three-quarter <s>paṇas</s> as the crossing penalty.

children.text: KAZ02.28.17/ kaivartaka.aṣṭa.tṛṇa.bhāra.puṣpa.phala.vāṭa.ṣaṇḍa.go.pālakānām anatyayaḥ, sambhāvya.dūta.anupātināṃ ca senā.bhāṇḍa.prayogāṇāṃ ca sva.taraṇais taratām, bīja.bhakta.dravya.upaskarāṃś ca^ānūpa.grāmāṇāṃ tārayatām //
children.translated_text: There is no penalty for fishermen, those carrying eight bundles of grass, flower and fruit garden workers, grove keepers, and cowherds; nor for those following a respectable envoy, or those with military supplies crossing in their own boats; nor for those who ferry the residents of marshy villages with their seed-grain, provisions, materials, and equipment.

children.text: KAZ02.28.18/ brāhmaṇa.pravrajita.bāla.vṛddha.vyādhita.śāsana.hara.garbhiṇyo nāv.adhyakṣa.mudrābhis tareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, ascetics, children, the aged, the sick, royal messengers, and pregnant women should cross with the superintendent of shipping's seal.

children.text: KAZ02.28.19/ kṛta.praveśāḥ pāraviṣayikāḥ sārtha.pramāṇā vā praviśeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Foreigners who have paid the entry [dues] should enter, or [they may enter] in the measure of a caravan.

children.text: KAZ02.28.20/ parasya bhāryāṃ kanyāṃ vittaṃ vā^apaharantaṃ śavittaṃ vā^apaharantaṃ śaṅkitam āvignam udbhāṇḍī.kṛtaṃ mahā.bhāṇḍena mūrdhni bhāreṇa^avacchādayantaṃ sadyo.gṛhīta.liṅginam aliṅginaṃ vā pravrajitam alakṣya.vyādhitaṃ bhaya.vikāriṇaṃ gūḍha.sāra.bhāṇḍa.śāsana.śastra.agniyogaṃ viṣa.hastaṃ dīrgha.pathikam amudraṃ ca^upagrāhayet //
children.translated_text: One who is abducting another's wife, a maiden, or property, or carrying a corpse; a suspect; one who is agitated; one with concealed goods covered by a large bundle on the head; a recently adopted religious disguise, whether genuine or not; one with a concealed illness; one showing signs of fear; one with hidden valuables, documents, weapons, or fire-devices; one with poison in hand; a long-distance traveler; and one without a seal — [all these] should be detained.

children.text: KAZ02.28.21/ kṣudra.paśur manuṣyaś ca sa.bhāro māṣakaṃ dadyāt, śiro.bhāraḥ kāya.bhāro gava^aśvaṃ ca dvau, uṣṭra.mahiṣaṃ caturaḥ, pañca labhuyānam, ṣaḍ goliṅgam, sapta śakaṭam, panya.bhāraḥ pādam //
children.translated_text: A small animal and a human with a load should pay one <s>māṣaka</s>; a head-load, body-load, cow, or horse — two; a camel or buffalo — four; a small conveyance — five; a large ox-cart — six; a cart — seven; and for merchandise — one quarter of a <s>paṇa</s> per load.

children.text: KAZ02.28.22/ tena bhāṇḍa.bhāro vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, the cargo-load [tariff] is explained.

children.text: KAZ02.28.23/ dvi.guṇo mahā.nadīṣu taraḥ //
children.translated_text: On great rivers, the ferry charge is double.

children.text: KAZ02.28.24/ klṛptam ānūpa.grāmā bhakta.vetanaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: The residents of marshy villages should pay the established provisions and wages.

children.text: KAZ02.28.25/ pratyanteṣu tarāḥ śulkam ātivāhikaṃ vartanīṃ ca gṛhṇīyuḥ, nirgacchataś ca^amudra.dravyasya bhāṇḍaṃ hareyuḥ, atibhāreṇa^avelāyām atirthe tarataś ca //
children.translated_text: At frontier [crossings], the ferrymen should collect the toll, the transit fee, and the road-cess; and they should confiscate the goods of one departing with unsealed merchandise, as well as [the goods of] one crossing with an overload, at the wrong time, or at a non-designated crossing.

children.text: KAZ02.28.26/ puruṣa.upakaraṇa.hīnāyām asaṃskṛtāyāṃ vā nāvi vipannāyāṃ nāv.adhhyakṣo naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā^abhyāvahet //
children.translated_text: When a vessel lacking crew and equipment, or unrepaired, is wrecked, the superintendent of shipping should compensate for what is lost or destroyed.

children.text:
KAZ02.28.27ab/ sapta.aha.vṛttām āṣāḍhīṃ kārttikīṃ ca^antarā taraḥ /
KAZ02.28.27cd/ kārmikaḥ pratyayaṃ dadyān nityaṃ ca^āhnikam āvahet //E
(ṣuperintendent of cattle)
KAZ02.29.01/ go.adhyakṣo vetana.upagrāhikaṃ kara.pratikaraṃ bhagna.utsṛṣṭakaṃ bhāga.anupraviṣṭakaṃ vraja.paryagraṃ naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ kṣīra.ghṛta.saṃjātaṃ ca^upalabheta //
children.translated_text:
During the seven-day period between [the full moons of] <s>Āṣāḍha</s> and <s>Kārttika</s>,
the boatman should pay his dues and should always bring the daily [revenue].
(Superintendent of cattle)
The superintendent of cattle (<s>godhyakṣa</s>) should take charge of [the records of] hired and requisitioned [cattle], taxes and counter-services, broken and abandoned [cattle], share-contributions, the survey of herds, lost and destroyed [cattle], and the production of milk and clarified butter.

children.text: KAZ02.29.02/ go.pālaka.piṇḍāraka.dohaka.manthaka.lubdhakāḥ śataṃ śataṃ dhenūnāṃ hiraṇya.bhṛtāḥ pālayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Cowherds, cattle-watchers, milkers, churners, and hunters — hired for pay — should tend groups of one hundred cows each.

children.text: KAZ02.29.03/ kṣīra.ghṛta.bhṛtā hi vatsān upahanyuḥ / iti vetana.upagrāhikam //
children.translated_text: For those paid in milk and ghee would harm the calves. — Thus [ends the section on] hired and requisitioned [labor].

children.text: KAZ02.29.04/ jaradgu.dhenu.garbhiṇī.paṣṭhauhī.vatsatarīṇāṃ sama.vibhāgaṃ rūpa.śatam ekaḥ pālayet //
children.translated_text: One [herdsman] should tend a uniformly distributed group of one hundred: old cows, milch cows, pregnant cows, heifers, and young cows.

children.text: KAZ02.29.05/ ghṛtasya^aṣṭau vārakān paṇikaṃ puccham aṅka.carma ca vārṣikaṃ dadyāt / iti kara.pratikaraḥ //
children.translated_text: He should annually deliver eight <s>vārakas</s> of clarified butter, one <s>paṇika</s> of tail-hair, and one hide with brand-mark. — Thus [ends the section on] taxes and counter-services.

children.text: KAZ02.29.06/ vyādhitā.nyaṅgā.ananya.dohī.durdohā.putraghnīnāṃ ca sama.vibhāgaṃ rūpa.śataṃ pālayantas taj.jātikaṃ bhāgaṃ dadyuḥ / iti bhagna.utṣṛṣṭakam //
children.translated_text: Those tending a uniformly distributed group of one hundred — [consisting of] diseased, deformed, single-milkers, difficult-to-milk, and calf-killers — should deliver a share proportionate to the type [of animal]. — Thus [ends the section on] broken and abandoned [cattle].

children.text: KAZ02.29.07/ para.cakra.aṭavī.bhayād anupraviṣṭānāṃ paśūnāṃ pālana.dharmeṇa daśa.bhagaṃ dadyuḥ / iti bhāga.anupraviṣṭakam //
children.translated_text: For animals that have entered [the royal herds] out of fear of enemy forces or forest [dangers], [the herdsmen] should deliver a one-tenth share according to the rules of tending. — Thus [ends the section on] share-contributions.

children.text: KAZ02.29.08/ vatsā vatsatarā damyā vahino vṛṣā ukṣāṇaś ca puṃgavāḥ, yuga.vāhana.śakaṭa.vahā vṛṣabhāḥ sūnā.mahiṣāḥ pṛṣṭa.skandha.vāhinaś ca mahiṣāḥ, vatsikā vatsatarī paṣṭahuhī garbhiṇī dhenuś ca^aprajātā vandhyāś ca gāvo mahiṣyaś ca, māsa.dvi.māsa.jātās tāsām upajā vatsā vatsikāś ca //
children.translated_text: Calves, young bulls, animals in training, draft animals, bulls, and oxen are the males; yoke-bearers, cart-pullers, and draft-bullocks are the working bulls; slaughter-buffaloes and back-and-shoulder-burden buffaloes are the [male] buffaloes; heifer calves, young heifers, maiden heifers, pregnant cows, milch cows, barren cows, and sterile cows are the [female] cattle and she-buffaloes; and those born one or two months [ago] — their offspring — are the male and female calves.

children.text: KAZ02.29.09/ māsa.dvi.māsa.jātān aṅkayet //
children.translated_text: He should brand [calves] at one or two months of age.

children.text: KAZ02.29.10/ māsa.dvi.māsa.paryuṣitam aṅkayet //
children.translated_text: He should brand [livestock] after one or two months [of registration].

children.text: KAZ02.29.11/ aṅkaṃ cihnaṃ varṇaṃ śṛṅga.antaraṃ ca lakṣaṇam evam upajā nibandhayet / iti vraja.paryagram //
children.translated_text: The brand, the distinctive mark, the color, and the horn-distance — these identifying marks, along with the offspring, he should register. — Thus [ends the section on] the survey of herds.

children.text: KAZ02.29.12/ cora.hṛtam anya.yūtha.praviṣṭam avalīnaṃ vā naṣṭam //
children.translated_text: Stolen by thieves, entered into another herd, or hidden — [this constitutes] lost [cattle].

children.text: KAZ02.29.13/ paṅka.viṣama.vyādhi.jarā.toya.āhāra.avasannaṃ vṛkṣa.taṭa.kāṣṭha.śilā.abhihatam īśāna.vyāla.sarpa.grāha.dāva.agni.vipannaṃ vinaṣṭam //
children.translated_text: Sunk in mud, fallen on rough terrain, [dead from] disease, old age, or lack of water and food, struck by tree, bank, timber, or rock, [or] destroyed by storm, wild animals, snakes, crocodiles, or forest fire — [this constitutes] destroyed [cattle].

children.text: KAZ02.29.14/ pramādād abhyāvaheyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Through negligence, [the herdsmen] should compensate [for losses].

children.text: KAZ02.29.15/ evaṃ rūpa.agraṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: Thus, [the superintendent] should know the best of each type.

children.text: KAZ02.29.16/ svayaṃ hantā ghātayitā hartā hārayitā ca vadhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: One who himself kills, causes to be killed, steals, or causes to be stolen [royal cattle] — [is punishable by] death.

children.text: KAZ02.29.17/ para.paśūnāṃ rāja.aṅkena parivartayitā rūpasya pūrvaṃ sāhasa.daṇḍaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: One who re-brands another's cattle with the royal brand should pay the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine for the [misbranded] animal.

children.text: KAZ02.29.18/ sva.deśīyānāṃ cora.hṛtaṃ pratyānīya paṇitaṃ rūpaṃ haret //
children.translated_text: For [cattle] of one's own territory stolen by thieves — having recovered them, [the superintendent] should collect the assessed price of the animal.

children.text: KAZ02.29.19/ para.deśīyānāṃ mokṣayitā^ardhaṃ haret //
children.translated_text: For [cattle] of foreign territory, one who secures their release should collect half.

children.text: KAZ02.29.20/ bāla.vṛddha.vyādhitānāṃ go.pālakāḥ pratikuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: Cowherds should look after the young, old, and sick [cattle].

children.text: KAZ02.29.21/ lubdhaka.śva.gaṇibhir apāstas tena^avyāla.parābādha.bhayam ṛtu.vibhaktam araṇyaṃ cārayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Having cleared [the grazing area] of [threats from] thieves and packs of wolves by means of hunters, dogs, and traps, they should graze [the cattle] in a forest free from danger of wild animals, divided by season.

children.text: KAZ02.29.22/ sarpa.vyāla.trāsana.arthaṃ go.cara.anupāta.jñāna.arthaṃ ca trasnūnāṃ ghaṇṭā.tūryaṃ ca badhnīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: They should tie bells and drums on timid [animals] to frighten away snakes and wild beasts, and to track the movements of the cattle.

children.text: KAZ02.29.23/ sama.vyūḍha.tīrtham akardama.grāham udakam avatārayeyuḥ pālayeyuś ca //
children.translated_text: They should lead [the cattle] down to water at a crossing that is level, firm, free of mud, and without crocodiles, and should guard them.

children.text: KAZ02.29.24/ stena.vyāla.sarpa.grāha.gṛhītaṃ vyādhi.jarā.avasannaṃ ca^āvedayeyuḥ, anyathā rūpa.mūlyaṃ bhajeran //
children.translated_text: They should report [cattle] seized by thieves, wild animals, snakes, or crocodiles, or sunk by disease or old age; otherwise, they should bear the price of the animal.

children.text: KAZ02.29.25/ kāraṇa.mṛtasya^aṅka.carma go.mahiṣasya, karṇa.lakṣaṇam aja.avikānām, puccham aṅka.carma ca^aśva.khara.uṣṭrāṇām, bāla.carma.basti.pitta.snāyu.danta.khura.śṛṅga.asthīni ca^āhareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: For an animal that has died of natural causes — the brand-marked hide of a cow or buffalo; the ear-mark of goats and sheep; the tail, brand-marked hide of horses, donkeys, and camels; and the hair, hide, bladder, bile, sinews, teeth, hooves, horns, and bones — [all these] they should bring in.

children.text: KAZ02.29.26/ māṃsam ārdraṃ śuṣkaṃ vā vikrīṇīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Meat, whether fresh or dried, they should sell.

children.text: KAZ02.29.27/ udaśvit.śva.varāhebhyo dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: They should give [scraps] to hyenas, dogs, and boars.

children.text: KAZ02.29.28/ kūrcikāṃ senā.bhakta.artham āhareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: They should collect condensed milk (<s>kūrcikā</s>) for the army's provisions.

children.text: KAZ02.29.29/ kilāṭo ghāṇa.piṇyāka.kleda.arthaḥ //
children.translated_text: Curd-residue (<s>kilāṭa</s>) is for moistening oil-cakes and [other] dry [feed].

children.text: KAZ02.29.30/ paśu.vikretā pādikaṃ rūpaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: A seller of cattle should pay one-quarter of the price.

children.text: KAZ02.29.31/ varṣā.śaradd.hemantān ubhayataḥ.kālaṃ duhyuḥ, śiśira.vasanta.grīṣmān eka.kālam //
children.translated_text: In the rainy season, autumn, and winter, [cows] should be milked twice daily; in the cool season, spring, and summer — once daily.

children.text: KAZ02.29.32/ dvitīya.kāla.dogdhur aṅguṣṭhac.chedo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who milks at the second [unauthorized] time — the punishment is the cutting off of a thumb.

children.text: KAZ02.29.33/ dohana.kālam atikrāmatas tat.phala.hānaṃ daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.33/ For one who misses the milking time, the fine is [equal to] the loss of its yield.

children.text: KAZ02.29.34/ etena nasya.damya.yuga.piṅgana.vartana.kālā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.34/ By this are explained the times for administering nasal medicine, breaking-in, yoking, branding, and turning [cattle].

children.text: KAZ02.29.35/ kṣīra.droṇe gavāṃ ghṛta.prasthaḥ, pañca.bhāga.adhiko mahiṣīṇām, dvi.bhāga.adhiko^aja.avīnām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.35/ From one <s>droṇa</s> of cow's milk, one <s>prastha</s> of ghee [is obtained]; from buffaloes, one-fifth more; from goats and sheep, two parts more.

children.text: KAZ02.29.36/ mantho vā sarveṣāṃ pramāṇam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.36/ Or buttermilk is the standard measure for all.

children.text: KAZ02.29.37/ bhūmi.tṛṇa.udaka.viśeṣādd hi kṣīra.ghṛta.vṛddhir bhavati //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.37/ For the increase of milk and ghee depends on the quality of land, grass, and water.

children.text: KAZ02.29.38/ yūtha.vṛṣaṃ vṛṣeṇa^avapātayataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, ghātayata uttamaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.38/ For one who causes a herd bull to fall by [setting] another bull [against it] — the first level of <s>sāhasa</s> fine; for one who causes it to be killed — the highest.

children.text: KAZ02.29.39/ varṇa.avarodhena daśatī rakṣā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.39/ Protection is by confining [cattle] according to their color-markings.

children.text: KAZ02.29.40/ upaniveśa.dig.vibhāgo go.pracārād bala^anvayato vā gavāṃ rakṣā.sāmarthyāc ca//
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.40/ The division of settlements by directions [should be determined] according to the range of the cattle, or according to the strength of the herd, and according to the capacity for protection of the cattle.

children.text: KAZ02.29.41/ ajāvīnāṃ ṣaṇ.māsikī.mūrṇāṃ grāhayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.41/ From goats and sheep, he should have the wool collected every six months.

children.text: KAZ02.29.42/ tena^aśva.khara.uṣṭra.varāha.vrajā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.42/ By this are explained the herds of horses, donkeys, camels, and pigs.

children.text:
KAZ02.29.43/ balīvardānāṃ nasya.aśva.bhadra.gati.vāhināṃ yava.sasya.ardha.bhāras tṛṇasya dvi.guṇam, tulā ghāṇa.piṇyākasya, daśa.āḍhakaṃ kaṇa.kuṇḍakasya, pañca.palikaṃ mukha.lavanAm, taila.kuḍubo nasyaṃ prasthaḥ pānaṃ, māṃsa.tulā, dadhnaś ca^āḍhakam, yava.droṇaṃ māṣāṇāṃ vā pulākaḥ, kṣīra.droṇam ardha.āḍhakaṃ vā surāyāḥ sneha.prasthaḥ kṣāra.daśa.palaṃ śṛṅgibera.palaṃ
ca pratipānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.43/ For bullocks — those trained for nasal [control], of fine gait, and bearing loads: half a <s>bhāra</s> of barley or grain fodder, double that of grass; one <s>tulā</s> of oil-cake from the press; ten <s>āḍhakas</s> of bran and husk; five <s>palas</s> of rock salt; one <s>kuḍuba</s> of oil for nasal treatment; one <s>prastha</s> as a drink; one <s>tulā</s> of meat; one <s>āḍhaka</s> of curds; one <s>droṇa</s> of barley or pulse-husks; one <s>droṇa</s> of milk or half an <s>āḍhaka</s> of liquor; one <s>prastha</s> of oil; ten <s>palas</s> of alkali; one <s>pala</s> of ginger — as restorative drink.

children.text: KAZ02.29.44/ pāda.ūnam aśvatara.go.kharāṇām, dvi.guṇaṃ mahiṣa.uṣṭrāṇām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.44/ One-quarter less for mules, cattle, and donkeys; double for buffaloes and camels.

children.text: KAZ02.29.45/ karma.kara.balīvardānāṃ pāyana.arthānāṃ ca dhenūnāṃ karma.kālataḥ phalataś ca vidhā.dānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.45/ For working bullocks and milch cows, the ration is given according to their work-time and yield.

children.text: KAZ02.29.46/ sarveṣāṃ tṛṇa.udaka.prākāmyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.46/ For all, grass and water [should be available] at pleasure.

children.text: KAZ02.29.47/ iti go.maṇḍalaṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.29.47/ Thus the management of cattle is explained.

children.text:
KAZ02.29.48ab/ pañca.ṛṣabhaṃ khara.aśvānām aja.avīnāṃ daśa.ṛṣabham /
KAZ02.29.48cd/ śatyaṃ go.mahiṣa.uṣṭrāṇāṃ yūthaṃ kuryāc catur.vṛṣam //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.29.48ab/ A herd of donkeys and horses should have five stallions; of goats and sheep, ten rams;
KAZ02.29.48cd/ a herd of cattle, buffaloes, and camels should have four bulls.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of horses)
KAZ02.30.01/ aśva.adhyakṣaḥ paṇya.āgārikaṃ kraya.upāgatam āhava.labdham ājātaṃ sāhāyya.āgatakaṃ paṇa.sthitaṃ yāvat.kālikaṃ vā^aśva.paryagraṃ kula.vayo.varṇa.cihna.varga.āgamair lekhayet //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of horses)
KAZ02.30.01/ The superintendent of horses should register the total stock of horses — purchased from the market, acquired through procurement, obtained in battle, born [in the stables], received from allies, held in pledge, or [given] for a limited period — recording their breed, age, color, marks, classification, and origin.

children.text: KAZ02.30.02/ apraśasta.nyaṅga.vyādhitāṃś ca^āvedayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.02/ And he should report those with inauspicious marks, defects, or diseases.

children.text: KAZ02.30.03/ kośa.koṣṭha.agārābhyāṃ ca gṛhītvā māsa.lābham aśva.vāhaś cintayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.03/ Having received [supplies] from the treasury and the storehouse, the horse-keeper should calculate the monthly profit.

children.text: KAZ02.30.04/ aśva.vibhavena^āyatām aśvāyām advi.guṇa.vistārāṃ catur.dvāra.upāvartana.madhyāṃ sa-pragrīvāṃ pradvāra.āsana.phalaka.yuktānāṃ vānara.mayūra.pṛṣata.nakula.cakora.śuka.sārika.ākīrṇāṃ śālāṃ niveśayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.04/ In proportion to the number of horses, he should set up a stable not exceeding double the width of the horse-yard, with a turning space in the middle [among] four doors, with a manger-bar, [and stalls] fitted with a door, a seat, and a board in front, filled with monkeys, peacocks, spotted deer, mongooses, <s>cakora</s> [partridges], parrots, and mynas.

children.text: KAZ02.30.05/ aśvāyām acatur.aśra.ślakṣṇa.phalaka.āstāraṃ sa-khādana.koṣṭhakaṃ sa-mūtra.purīṣa.utsargam eka.ekaśaḥ prān.mukham udan.mukhaṃ vā sthānaṃ niveśayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.05/ In the horse-yard, he should set up individual stalls — each non-square with a smooth boarded floor, equipped with a feeding trough, and with a drain for urine and dung — facing east or north.

children.text: KAZ02.30.06/ śālā.vaśena vā dig.vibhāgaṃ kalpayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.06/ Or he may arrange the directional division according to the [space of the] stable.

children.text: KAZ02.30.07/ vaḍavā.vṛṣa.kiśorāṇām eka.anteṣu //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.07/ Mares, stallions, and foals should be at separate ends.

children.text: KAZ02.30.08/ vaḍavāyāḥ prajatāyās tri.rātraṃ ghṛta.prasthaḥ pānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.08/ For a mare that has just foaled, one <s>prastha</s> of ghee as a drink for three days.

children.text: KAZ02.30.09/ ata ūrdhvaṃ saktu.prasthaḥ sneha.bhaiṣajya.pratipānaṃ daśa.rātram //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.09/ After that, one <s>prastha</s> of barley flour with oil and medicinal restoratives for ten days.

children.text: KAZ02.30.10/ tataḥ pulāko yavasam ārtavaś ca^āhāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.10/ Then husked grain, green barley, and seasonal feed.

children.text: KAZ02.30.11/ daśa.rātrād ūrdhvaṃ kiśorasya ghṛta.catur.bhāgaḥ saktu.kuḍubaḥ kṣīra.prasthaś ca^āhāra ā.ṣaṇ.māsāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.11/ After ten days from birth, the foal's diet is: one-quarter [<s>prastha</s>] of ghee, one <s>kuḍuba</s> of barley flour, and one <s>prastha</s> of milk — until six months.

children.text: KAZ02.30.12/ tataḥ paraṃ māsa.uttaram ardha.vṛddhir yava.prastha ā.tri.varṣāt, droṇa ā.catur.varṣāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.12/ Thereafter, increasing by half-[measure] each month, one <s>prastha</s> of barley until three years; one <s>droṇa</s> until four years.

children.text: KAZ02.30.13/ ata ūrdhvaṃ catur.varṣaḥ pañca.varṣo vā karmaṇyaḥ pūrṇa.pramāṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.13/ After that, at four or five years, the horse is fit for work with full rations.

children.text: KAZ02.30.14/ dvātriṃśad.aṅgulaṃ mukham uttama.aśvasya, pañca.mukhāny āyāmo, viṃśaty.aṅgulā jaṅghā, catur.jaṅgha utsedhaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.14/ The face of a superior horse measures thirty-two finger-breadths; its length is five face-lengths; the leg is twenty finger-breadths; and the height is four leg-lengths.

children.text: KAZ02.30.15/ try.aṅgula.avaraṃ madhyama.avarayoḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.15/ Three finger-breadths less for the middling and the inferior.

children.text: KAZ02.30.16/ śata.aṅgulaḥ pariṇāhaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.16/ The girth is one hundred finger-breadths.

children.text: KAZ02.30.17/ pañca.bhāga.avaro madhyama.avarayoḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.17/ One-fifth less for the middling and the inferior.

children.text: KAZ02.30.18/ uttama.aśvasya dvi.droṇaṃ śāli.vrīhi.yava.priyaṅgūṇām ardha.śuṣkam ardha.siddhaṃ vā mudga.māṣāṇāṃ vā pulākaḥ sneha.prasthaś ca, pañca.palaṃ lavaṇasya, māṃsaṃ pañcāśat.palikaṃ rasasya^āḍhakaṃ dvi.guṇaṃ vā dadhnaḥ piṇḍa.kledana.artham, kṣāra.pañca.palikaḥ surāyāḥ prasthaḥ payaso vā dvi.guṇaḥ pratipānam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.18/ For a superior horse: two <s>droṇas</s> of rice, <s>vrīhi</s>, barley, or millet — half dried, half cooked — or husked pulse of <s>mudga</s> or <s>māṣa</s>; one <s>prastha</s> of oil; five <s>palas</s> of salt; fifty <s>palas</s> of meat; one <s>āḍhaka</s> of broth or double that of curds for softening the grain-ball; five <s>palas</s> of alkali; one <s>prastha</s> of liquor or double that of milk as a restorative drink.

children.text: KAZ02.30.19/ dīrgha.patha.bhāra.klāntānāṃ ca khādana.arthaṃ sneha.prastho^anuvāsanaṃ kuḍubo nasya.karmaṇaḥ, yavasasya^ardha.bhāras tṛṇasya dvi.guṇaḥ ṣaḍ.aratni.parikṣepaḥ puñjīla.graho vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.19/ And for those exhausted by long journeys and heavy loads, for the purpose of feeding: one <s>prastha</s> of oil as an enema; one <s>kuḍuba</s> for nasal treatment; half a <s>bhāra</s> of green barley; double that of grass; [space measuring] six cubits in circumference, or a bundle-grasp.

children.text: KAZ02.30.20/ pāda.avaram etan madhyama.avarayoḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.20/ One-quarter less for the middling and the inferior.

children.text: KAZ02.30.21/ uttama.samo rathyo vṛṣaś ca madhyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.21/ A chariot horse and a stallion receive the same as the middling [grade].

children.text: KAZ02.30.22/ madhyama.samaś ca^avaraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.22/ And the inferior [receives the] same as the middling.

children.text: KAZ02.30.23/ pāda.hīnaṃ vaḍavānāṃ pāraśamānāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.23/ One-quarter less for mares and Perso-Scythian horses.

children.text: KAZ02.30.24/ ato^ardhaṃ kiśorāṇāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.24/ Half of that for foals.

children.text: KAZ02.30.25/ iti vidhā.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.25/ Thus the ration system.

children.text: KAZ02.30.26/ vidhā.pācaka.sūtra.grāhaka.cikitsakāḥ pratisvāda.bhājaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.26/ The ration-cook, the string-holder [groom], and the veterinarian are the tasters [who test the food first].

children.text: KAZ02.30.27/ yuddha.vyādhi.jarā.karma.kṣīṇāḥ piṇḍa.gocarikāḥ syuḥ //02.30.28/ asamara.prayogyāḥ paura.jānapadānām arthena vṛṣā vaḍavāsv āyojyāḥ //
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.30.27/ Those worn out by battle, disease, old age, or labor should be put to pasture on grain-balls.
KAZ02.30.28/ Those unfit for war should be assigned as stallions for the mares of townspeople and countryfolk, [who should pay] a fee.

children.text: KAZ02.30.29/ prayogyānām uttamāḥ kāmboja.saindhava.āraṭṭa.vanāyujāḥ, madhyamā bāhlīka.pāpeyaka.sauvīraka.taitalāḥ, śeṣāḥ pratyavarāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.29/ Among those fit for service, the best are from <s>Kamboja</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Āraṭṭa</s>, and forest-bred stock; the middling are from <s>Bāhlīka</s>, <s>Pāpeyaka</s>, <s>Sauvīraka</s>, and <s>Taitala</s>; the rest are inferior.

children.text: KAZ02.30.30/ teṣāṃ tīṣkṇa.bhadra.manda.vaśena sāmnāhyam aupavāhyakaṃ vā karma prayojayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.30/ According to their sharp, fine, or gentle temperament, he should assign them to armored [combat] or to riding duty.

children.text: KAZ02.30.31/ catur.aśraṃ karma.aśvasya sāmnāhyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.31/ The drill for a war-horse is fourfold.

children.text: KAZ02.30.32/ valgano nīcair gato laṅghano ghoraṇo nāroṣṭraś ca^aupavāhyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.32/ <s>Valgana</s> (canter), <s>nīcairgata</s> (low gait), <s>laṅghana</s> (leap), and <s>dhoraṇa</s> (trot), and <s>nāroṣṭra</s> (camel-gait) — these are the riding gaits.

children.text: KAZ02.30.33/ tatra.aupaveṇuko vardhamānako yamaka ālīḍha.plutaḥ pṛthug.astrika.cālī ca valganaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.33/ Among these, <s>aupaveṇuka</s>, <s>vardhamānaka</s>, <s>yamaka</s>, <s>ālīḍhapluta</s>, <s>pṛthugastrikacālī</s> — these are the [varieties of] canter.

children.text: KAZ02.30.34/ sa eva śiraḥ.karṇa.viśuddho nīcair gataḥ, ṣoḍaśa.mārgo vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.34/ The same [canter] refined in head and ear [movement] is the low gait; or the sixteen-step course.

children.text: KAZ02.30.35/ prakīrṇakaḥ prakīrṇa.uttaro niṣaṇṇaḥ pārśva.anuvṛtta ūrmi.mārgaḥ śarabha.krīḍitaḥ śarabha.plutas tri.tālo bāhya.anuvṛttaḥ pañca.pāṇiḥ siṃha.āyataḥ svādhūtaḥ kliṣṭaḥ śliṅgito bṛṃhitaḥ puṣpa.abhikīrṇaś ca^iti nīcair gata.mārgaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.35/ <s>Prakīrṇaka</s>, <s>prakīrṇottara</s>, <s>niṣaṇṇa</s>, <s>pārśvānuvṛtta</s>, <s>ūrmimārga</s>, <s>śarabhakrīḍita</s>, <s>śarabhapluta</s>, <s>tritāla</s>, <s>bāhyānuvṛtta</s>, <s>pañcapāṇi</s>, <s>siṃhāyata</s>, <s>svādhūta</s>, <s>kliṣṭa</s>, <s>śliṅgita</s>, <s>bṛṃhita</s>, <s>puṣpābhikīrṇa</s> — these are the varieties of the low gait.

children.text: KAZ02.30.36/ kapi.pluto bheka.plut^eṇa.pluta^eka.pāda.plutaḥ kokila.saṃcāry.urasyo baka.cārī ca laṅghanaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.36/ <s>Kapipluta</s> (monkey-leap), <s>bhekapluta</s> (frog-leap), <s>eṇapluta</s> (antelope-leap), <s>ekapādapluta</s> (one-foot leap), <s>kokilasañcārī</s> (cuckoo-walk), <s>urasya</s> (chest-forward), and <s>bakacārī</s> (crane-walk) — these are the [varieties of] leaping.

children.text: KAZ02.30.37/ kāṅko vāri.kāṅko māyūro^ardha.māyūro nākulo^rdha.nākulo vārāho^ardha.vārāhaś ca^iti dhoraṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.37/ <s>Kāṅka</s>, <s>vārikāṅka</s>, <s>māyūra</s>, <s>ardhamāyūra</s>, <s>nākula</s>, <s>ardhanākula</s>, <s>vārāha</s>, <s>ardhavārāha</s> — these are the [varieties of] trot.

children.text: KAZ02.30.38/ saṃjñā.pratikāro nāra.uṣṭra^iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.38/ Response to signals is the <s>nāroṣṭra</s> (camel-gait).

children.text: KAZ02.30.39/ ṣaṇṇava dvādaśa^iti yojanāny dhvā rathyānām, pañca yojanāny ardha.aṣṭamāni daśa^iti pṛṣṭha.vāhinām aśvānām adhvā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.39/ The daily range of chariot horses is six, nine, or twelve <s>yojanas</s>; for riding horses, five, seven and a half, or ten <s>yojanas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.30.40/ vikramo bhadra.aśvāso bhāra.vāhya iti mārgāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.40/ Charge, fine pace, and load-bearing — these are the [types of] march.

children.text: KAZ02.30.41/ vikramo valgitam upakaṇṭham upajavo javaś ca dhārāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.41/ Charge [consists of]: gallop, close approach, quick advance, and [full] speed — these are the running gaits.

children.text: KAZ02.30.42/ teṣāṃ bandhana.upakaraṇaṃ yogya.ācāryāḥ pratidiśeyuḥ, sāṃgrāmikaṃ ratha.aśva.alaṃkāraṃ ca sūtāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.42/ The training masters should prescribe the harness and equipment for them; the charioteers [should prescribe] the battle-equipment and ornament for chariot-horses.

children.text: KAZ02.30.43/ aśvānāṃ cikitsakāḥ śarīra.hrāsa.vṛddhi.pratīkāram ṛtu.vibhaktaṃ ca^āhāram //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.43/ The veterinarians [should prescribe] remedies for decrease and increase of the body, and the diet arranged by season.

children.text: KAZ02.30.44/ sūtra.grāhaka.aśva.bandhaka.yāvasika.vidhā.pācaka.sthāna.pāla.keśa.kāra.jāṅgulīvidaś ca sva.karmabhir aśvān ārādhayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.44/ The string-holders, horse-binders, fodder-providers, ration-cooks, stable-keepers, mane-dressers, and snake-venom experts should tend the horses through their respective duties.

children.text: KAZ02.30.45/ karma.atikrame ca^eṣāṃ divasa.vetanac.chedanaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.45/ And for their negligence of duty, he should deduct [a day's] wages.

children.text: KAZ02.30.46/ nīrājana.uparuddhaṃ vāhayataś cikitsaka.uparuddhaṃ vā dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.46/ For one who exercises [a horse] that has been stopped [by the ritual purification ceremony], or one stopped by the veterinarian — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.30.47/ kriyā.bhaiṣajya.saṅgena vyādhi.vṛddhau pratīkāra.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.47/ When a disease worsens through delay in treatment — the fine is double the cost of the remedy.

children.text: KAZ02.30.48/ tad.aparādhena vailomye pattra.mūlyaṃ daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.48/ When, due to his negligence, [a horse] develops an adverse condition — the fine is the cost of the record.

children.text: KAZ02.30.49/ tena go.maṇḍalaṃ khara.uṣṭra.mahiṣam aja.avikaṃ ca vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.30.49/ By this are explained the [management of] cattle herds, donkey, camel, and buffalo herds, and goat and sheep herds.

children.text:
KAZ02.30.50ab/ dvir ahnaḥ snānam aśvānāṃ gandha.mālyaṃ ca dāpayet /
KAZ02.30.50cd/ kṛṣṇa.saṃdhiṣu bhūta.ijyāḥ śukleṣu svasti.vācanam //
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.30.50ab/ He should have the horses bathed twice daily and given fragrant garlands;
KAZ02.30.50cd/ on dark conjunctions, offerings to spirits; on bright ones, benedictions.

children.text:
KAZ02.30.51ab/ nīrājanām āśvayuje kārayen navame^ahani /
KAZ02.30.51cd/ yātrā.ādāv avasāne vā vyādhau vā śāntike rataḥ //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.30.51ab/ The <s>nīrājana</s> (lustration) ceremony should be performed in the month of <s>Āśvayuja</s>, on the ninth day,
KAZ02.30.51cd/ or at the beginning or end of a military campaign, or during illness, devoted to the pacification rite.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of elephants)
KAZ02.31.01/ hasty.adhyakṣo hasti.vana.rakṣāṃ damya.karma.kṣāntānāṃ hasti.hastinī.kalabhānāṃ śālā.sthāna.śayyā.karma.vidhā.yavasa.pramāṇaṃ karmasv āyogaṃ bandhana.upakaraṇaṃ sāṃgrāmikam alaṃkāraṃ cikitsaka.anīkastha.aupasthāyika.vargaṃ ca^anutiṣṭhet //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of elephants)
KAZ02.31.01/ The superintendent of elephants should oversee the protection of elephant forests, the stabling, quarters, bedding, work, rations, fodder, and measure of rations for tamed, working, and gentle elephants, bull elephants, cow elephants, and calves, their employment in duties, harness and equipment, battle accoutrements, ornaments, and the corps of veterinarians, elephant-warriors, and attendants.

children.text: KAZ02.31.02/ hasty.āyāma.dvi.guṇa.utsedha.viṣkambha.āyāmāṃ hastinī.sthāna.adhikāṃ sapragrīvāṃ kumārī.saṃgrahāṃ prān.mukhīm udan.mukhīṃ vā śālāṃ niveśayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.02/ He should set up a stable — east-facing or north-facing, with a manger-bar and a holding-pen for cow elephants — whose width and height are double the elephant's length, and whose length [exceeds that of] the cow elephant's quarters.

children.text: KAZ02.31.03/ hasty.āyāma.catur.aśra.ślakṣṇa.ālāna.stambha.phalaka.āstarakaṃ sa-mūtra.purīṣa.utsargaṃ sthānaṃ niveśayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.03/ He should set up individual stalls — square [in proportion to] the elephant's length, with smooth tethering-posts and boarded floors, equipped with drains for urine and dung.

children.text: KAZ02.31.04/ sthāna.samāṃ śayyām ardha.apāśrayāṃ durge sāmnāhya.aupavāhyānāṃ bahir damya.vyālānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.04/ The bedding should be level with the stall, with half-reclining support; inside the fort for armored and riding elephants; outside for those being trained and for wild ones.

children.text: KAZ02.31.05/ prathama.saptama aṣṭama.bhāgāv ahnaḥ snāna.kālau, tad.anantaraṃ vidhāyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.05/ The first and the seventh-to-eighth parts of the day are the bathing times; immediately after, the feeding times.

children.text: KAZ02.31.06/ pūrva.ahne vyāyāma.kālaḥ, paśca.ahnaḥ pratipāna.kālaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.06/ The forenoon is the exercise time; the afternoon is the time for restorative drinks.

children.text: KAZ02.31.07/ rātri.bhāgau dvau svapna.kālā, tri.bhāgaḥ saṃveśana.utthānikaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.07/ Two parts of the night are for sleeping; three parts for lying down and rising.

children.text: KAZ02.31.08/ grīṣme grahaṇa.kālaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.08/ Summer is the season for capturing [wild elephants].

children.text: KAZ02.31.09/ viṃśati.varṣo grāhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.09/ One of twenty years should be captured.

children.text: KAZ02.31.10/ vikko moḍho makkaṇo vyāthito garbhiṇī dhenukā hastinī ca^agrāhyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.10/ A deformed one, a stupid one, an unruly one, a distressed one, a pregnant one, a nursing cow, and a cow elephant [in general] should not be captured.

children.text: KAZ02.31.11/ sapta.aratni utsedho nava.āyāmo daśa pariṇāhaḥ pramāṇataś catvāriṃśad.varṣo bhavaty uttamaḥ, triṃśad.varṣo madhyamaḥ, pañca.viṃśati.varṣo^avaraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.11/ Seven cubits in height, nine in length, ten in girth — by standard measure, a forty-year-old is superior; a thirty-year-old, middling; a twenty-five-year-old, inferior.

children.text: KAZ02.31.12/ tayoḥ pāda.avaro vidhā.vidhiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.12/ The ration system for the [middling and inferior] two is one-quarter less [respectively].

children.text:
KAZ02.31.13/ aratnau taṇula.droṇaḥ, ardha.āḍhakaṃ tailasya, sarpiṣas trayaḥ prasthāḥ, daśa.palaṃ lavaṇasya, māṃsaṃ pañcāśat.palikam, rasasya^āḍhakaṃ dvi.guṇaṃ vā dadhnaḥ piṇḍa.kledana.artham, kṣāra.daśa.palikaṃ madyasya^āḍhakaṃ dvi.guṇaṃ vā payasaḥ pratipānam, gātra.avasekas taila.prasthaḥ, śiraso^aṣṭa.bhāgaḥ prādīpikaś ca, yavasasya dvau bhārau sa-pādau,
śaṣpasya śuṣkasya^ardha.tṛtīyo bhāraḥ, kaḍaṅkarasya^aniyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.13/ Per cubit [of height]: one <s>droṇa</s> of husked rice; half an <s>āḍhaka</s> of oil; three <s>prasthas</s> of ghee; ten <s>palas</s> of salt; fifty <s>palas</s> of meat; one <s>āḍhaka</s> of broth or double that of curds for softening the grain-ball; ten <s>palas</s> of alkali; one <s>āḍhaka</s> of liquor or double that of milk as a restorative drink; one <s>prastha</s> of oil for rubbing the body; one-eighth [<s>prastha</s>] for the head and as lamp-oil; two and a quarter <s>bhāras</s> of green barley; two and a half <s>bhāras</s> of dried grass; and an unlimited [supply] of rough fodder.

children.text: KAZ02.31.14/ sapta.aratninā tulya.bhojano^aṣṭa.aratnir atyarālaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.14/ One of seven cubits [in height], with feeding equal [to that height], and eight cubits [long] is excessively curved.

children.text: KAZ02.31.15/ yathā.hastam avaśeṣaḥ ṣaḍ.aratniḥ pañca.aratniś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.15/ The rest, proportionate to the hand [measurement], are six-cubit and five-cubit [elephants].

children.text: KAZ02.31.16/ kṣīra.yāvasiko vikkaḥ krīḍā.arthaṃ grāhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.16/ A milk-and-grain-fed young elephant (<s>vikka</s>) should be acquired for sport.

children.text: KAZ02.31.17/ saṃjāta.lohitā praticchannā samlipta.pakṣā sama.kakṣyā vyatikīrṇa.māṃsā sama.talpa.talā jāta.droṇikā^iti śobhāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.31.17/ Blood fully developed, concealed [veins], well-covered flanks, even girths, well-distributed flesh, level sole-beds, and fully formed temporal depressions (<s>droṇikā</s>) — these are the marks of beauty.

children.text:
KAZ02.31.18ab/ śobhā.vaśena vyāyāmaṃ bhadrma mandaṃ ca kārayet /
KAZ02.31.18cd/ mṛgaṃ saṃkīrṇa.liṅgaṃ ca karmasv ṛtu.vaśena vā //
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.31.18ab/ According to the marks of beauty, he should train: the <s>bhadra</s> for exercise, the <s>manda</s> [for gentleness],
KAZ02.31.18cd/ the <s>mṛga</s> and the mixed-type for tasks, or according to the season.

children.text:
(Activity of elephants)
KAZ02.32.01/ karma.skandhāś catvāro damyaḥ sāmnāhya aupavāhyo vyālaś ca //
children.translated_text:
(Activity of elephants)
KAZ02.32.01/ There are four categories of elephant training: the trainable (<s>damya</s>), the battle-elephant (<s>sāmnāhya</s>), the riding-elephant (<s>aupavāhya</s>), and the vicious (<s>vyāla</s>).

children.text: KAZ02.32.02/ tatra damyaḥ pañca.vidhaḥ skandha.gataḥ stambha.gato vāri.gato^avapāta.gato yūtha.gataś ca^iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.02/ Among these, the trainable is fivefold: mounted training, post-tied training, water training, pit training, and herd training.

children.text: KAZ02.32.03/ tasya^upavicāro vikka.karma //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.03/ Its supplementary training is young-elephant work.

children.text: KAZ02.32.04/ sāmnāhyaḥ sapta.kriyā.patha upasthānaṃ saṃvartanaṃ samyānaṃ vadha.āvadho hasti.yuddhaṃ nāga.rāyaṇaṃ sāṃgrāmikaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.04/ The battle-elephant has seven courses of training: attendance, wheeling, proper pacing, striking and counter-striking, elephant combat, war-elephant maneuvers, and battlefield operations.

children.text: KAZ02.32.05/ tasya^upavicāraḥ kakṣyā.karma graiveya.karma yūtha.karma ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.05/ Its supplementary training includes girth work, neck-chain work, and herd work.

children.text: KAZ02.32.06/ aupavāhyo^aṣṭa.vidha ācaraṇaḥ kuñjara.aupavāhyo dhoraṇa ādhāna.gatiko yaṣṭy.upavāhyas totra.upavāhyaḥ śuddha.upavāhyo mārgayukaś ca^iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.06/ The riding-elephant is of eight kinds: the parade elephant, the state riding-elephant, the lead elephant, the marching elephant, the staff-guided, the goad-guided, the free-riding, and the road-trained.

children.text: KAZ02.32.07/ tasya^upavicāraḥ śārada.karma hīna.karma nāra.uṣṭra.karma ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.07/ Its supplementary training includes autumn work, light work, and camel-work.

children.text: KAZ02.32.08/ vyāla^eka.kriyā.pathaḥ śaṅkito^avaruddho viṣamaḥ prabhinnaḥ prabhinna.viniścayo mada.hetu.viniścayaś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.08/ The vicious has a single course: the suspicious, the confined, the uneven, the rutting, the determination of rutting, and the determination of the cause of rut.

children.text: KAZ02.32.09/ tasya-upavicāra āyamya^eka.rakṣā.karma //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.09/ Its supplementary training is restrained single-keeper work.

children.text: KAZ02.32.10/ kriyā.vipanno vyālaḥ śuddhaḥ su.vrato viṣamaḥ sarva.doṣa.praduṣṭaś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.10/ A vicious elephant that has failed its training [is classified as]: pure [vicious], well-behaved, uneven, and corrupted with all faults.

children.text: KAZ02.32.11/ teṣāṃ bandhana.upakaraṇam anīka.stha.pramāṇam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.11/ Their binding equipment is proportionate to the size of the war-formation elephant.

children.text: KAZ02.32.12/ ālāna.graiveya.kakṣyā.pāra.ayaṇa.parikṣepa.uttara.ādikaṃ bandhanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.12/ Tethering post, neck-chain, girth, crossing-chain, enclosure, and over-gear — these constitute the binding equipment.

children.text: KAZ02.32.13/ aṅkuśa.veṇu.yantra.ādikam upakaraṇam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.13/ Goad, bamboo, mechanical devices, and the like — these are the implements.

children.text: KAZ02.32.14/ vaijayantī.kṣura.pramāla.āstaraṇa.kuthā.ādikaṃ bhūṣaṇam //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.14/ Victory banner, razor [ornament], garland, housings, blankets, and the like — these are the decorations.

children.text: KAZ02.32.15/ varma.tomara.śara.āvāpa.yantra.ādikaḥ sāṃgrāmika.alaṃkāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.15/ Armor, lance, arrow-case, mechanical devices, and the like — these are the battle adornments.

children.text: KAZ02.32.16/ cikitsaka.anīkastha.ārohaka.ādhoraṇa.hastipa.kaupacārika.vidhā.pācaka.yāvasika.pādapāśika.kuṭīr.rakṣaka.aupaśayaika.ādir aupasthāyika.vargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.16/ Veterinarian, formation-keeper, rider, under-rider, elephant-keeper, assistant, feed-preparer, grain-feeder, foot-rope attendant, stable-keeper, shelter-keeper, and the like — these form the attendant group.

children.text: KAZ02.32.17/ cikitsaka.kuṭī.rakṣa.vidhā.pācakāḥ prastha.odanaṃ sneha.prasṛtiṃ kṣāra.lavaṇayoś ca dvi.palikaṃ hareyuḥ, daśa.palaṃ māṃsasya, anyatra cikitsakebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.17/ The veterinarian, stable-keeper, feed-preparer, and grain-feeder should receive one <s>prastha</s> of cooked rice, one <s>prasṛti</s> of oil, and two <s>palas</s> of salt and alkali each, and ten <s>palas</s> of meat — apart from the veterinarians [who receive more].

children.text: KAZ02.32.18/ pathi.vyādhi.karma.mada.jarā.abhitaptānāṃ cikitsakāḥ pratikuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.18/ The veterinarians should treat those afflicted by travel, disease, overwork, rut, and old age.

children.text: KAZ02.32.19/ sthānasya^aśuddhir yavasasya^agrahaṇaṃ sthale śāyanam abhāge ghātaḥ para.ārohaṇam akāle yānam abhūmāv atīrthe^avatāraṇaṃ taru.ṣaṇḍa ity atyaya.sthānāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.19/ Uncleanliness of the stable, failure to provide fodder, sleeping on hard ground, striking [the elephant] at a wrong spot, unauthorized mounting, driving at an improper time, taking to unsuitable terrain or to an unsafe ford, and [leading into] a thicket of trees — these are the offenses.

children.text: KAZ02.32.20/ tam eṣāṃ bhakta.vetanād ādadīta //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.32.20/ The [penalty for the] offense should be deducted from their rations and wages.

children.text:
KAZ02.32.21ab/ tisro nīrājanāḥ kāryāś cāturmāsya.ṛtu.saṃdhiṣu /
KAZ02.32.21cd/ bhūtānāṃ kṛṣṇa.saṃdhī^ijyāḥ senānyaḥ śukla.saṃdhuṣu //
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.32.21ab/ Three lustration ceremonies should be performed at the junctures of the four-month seasons;
KAZ02.32.21cd/ worship of beings [should be performed] at the dark junctures, and [worship] of army chiefs at the bright junctures.

children.text:
KAZ02.32.22ab/ danta.mūla.parīṇāha.dvi.guṇaṃ projjhya kalpayet /
KAZ02.32.22cd/ abde dvy.ardhe nadī.jānāṃ pañca.abde parvata.okasām //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.32.22ab/ Adding twice the circumference at the base of the tusk, one should estimate [the age]:
KAZ02.32.22cd/ in two and a half years for river-born [elephants], and in five years for mountain-dwelling ones.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of chariots)
(ṣuperintendent of foot-soldiers)
(Activity of the commandant of the army)
KAZ02.33.01/ aśva.adhyakṣeṇa ratha.adhyakṣo vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of chariots; Superintendent of foot-soldiers; Activity of the commandant of the army)
KAZ02.33.01/ The superintendent of chariots is explained by [analogy with] the superintendent of horses.

children.text: KAZ02.33.02/ sa ratha.karma.antān kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.02/ He should have the chariot manufacturing operations carried out.

children.text: KAZ02.33.03/ daśa.puruṣo dvādaśa.antaro rathaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.03/ A chariot [seats] ten men and [has] twelve-[aṅgula] wheel-spacing.

children.text: KAZ02.33.04/ tasmād eka.antara.avarā ā.ṣaḍ.antarād iti sapta rathāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.04/ From that, [there are types] with one less interval each, down to six intervals — thus seven [types of] chariots.

children.text: KAZ02.33.05/ deva.ratha.puṣya.ratha.sāṃgrāmika.pāriyāṇika.para.pura.abhiyānika.vainayikāṃś ca rathān kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.05/ He should have constructed: the divine chariot, the festival chariot, the war chariot, the transport chariot, the city-assault chariot, and the training chariot.

children.text: KAZ02.33.06/ iṣv.astra.praharaṇa.āvaraṇa.upakaraṇa.kalpanāḥ sārathi.rathika.rathyānāṃ ca karmasv āyogaṃ vidyāt, ā.karmabhyaś ca bhakta.vetanaṃ bhṛtānām abhṛtānāṃ ca yogyā.rakṣā.anuṣṭhānam artha.māna.karma ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.06/ He should know the deployment of arrows, weapons, missiles, and protective and auxiliary equipment, and the engagement of charioteers, warriors, and chariot-horses in their tasks; and from their duties, the rations and wages of the hired, and the training, guard-duty, and reward-and-honor work for the unhired.

children.text: KAZ02.33.07/ etena patty.adhyakṣo vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.07/ By this, the superintendent of foot-soldiers is also explained.

children.text: KAZ02.33.08/ sa maula.bhṛta.śreṇi.mitra.amitra.aṭavī.balānāṃ sāra.phalgutāṃ vidyāt, nimna.sthala.prakāśa.kūṭa.khanaka.ākāśa.divā.rātri.yuddha.vyāyāmaṃ ca, āyogam ayogaṃ ca karmasu //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.08/ He should know the strength and weakness of the hereditary troops, mercenaries, guild-levies, allied troops, enemy [captured] troops, and forest tribal forces; training in warfare on low ground, high ground, open ground, rough terrain, in trenches, in the air, by day, and by night; and their fitness and unfitness for various tasks.

children.text: KAZ02.33.09/ ted eva senā.patiḥ sarva.yuddha.praharaṇa.vidyā.vinīto hasty.aśva.ratha.caryā.saṃghuṣṭaś catur.aṅgasya balasya^anuṣṭhāna.adhiṣṭhānaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.09/ The commander-in-chief (<s>senāpati</s>) — the same [officer], trained in all weapons and battle skills, experienced in elephant, horse, and chariot maneuvers — should know the deployment and command of the fourfold army.

children.text: KAZ02.33.10/ sva.bhūmiṃ yuddha.kālaṃ pratyanīkam abhinna.bhedanaṃ bhinna.saṃdhānaṃ saṃhata.bhedanaṃ bhinna.vadhaṃ durga.vadhaṃ yātrā.kālaṃ ca paśyet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.33.10/ He should consider: favorable terrain, the time for battle, the opposing force, breaking the unbroken, rallying the broken, splitting the united, destroying the split, siege warfare, and the time for military campaigns.

children.text:
KAZ02.33.11ab/ tūrya.dhvaja.patākābhir vyūha.saṃjñāḥ prakalpayet /
KAZ02.33.11cd/ sthāne yāne praharaṇe sainyānāṃ vinaye rataḥ //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.33.11ab/ With drums, banners, and flags he should devise formation signals,
KAZ02.33.11cd/ devoted to the discipline of armies in stationing, marching, and attacking.

children.text:
(ṣuperintendent of passports)
(ṣuperintendent of pasture lands)
KAZ02.34.01/ mudrā.adhyakṣo mudrāṃ māṣakeṇa dadyāt //
children.translated_text:
(Superintendent of passports; Superintendent of pasture lands)
KAZ02.34.01/ The superintendent of seals (<s>mudrādhyakṣa</s>) should issue a passport-seal for one <s>māṣaka</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.34.02/ sa-mudro jana.padaṃ praveṣṭuṃ niṣkramituṃ vā labheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.02/ One with a seal may enter or leave the countryside.

children.text: KAZ02.34.03/ dvādaśa.paṇam amudro jānapado dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.03/ A countryman without a seal should pay twelve <s>paṇas</s>.
