children.text: KAZ02.34.04/ kūṭa.mudrāyāṃ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ tiro.jana.padasya^uttamaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.04/ For a forged seal, the first <s>sāhasa</s> penalty [applies]; for one [passing through] across the countryside, the highest [penalty].

children.text: KAZ02.34.05/ vivīta.adhyakṣo mudrāṃ paśyet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.05/ The superintendent of pasture lands (<s>vivītādhyakṣa</s>) should inspect the seal.

children.text: KAZ02.34.06/ grāma.antareṣu ca vivītaṃ sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.06/ He should establish pasture stations in the spaces between villages.

children.text: KAZ02.34.07/ cora.vyāla.bhayān.nimna.araṇyāni śodhayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.07/ He should clear the forests of dangers from thieves and wild animals.

children.text: KAZ02.34.08/ anudake kūpa.setu.bandha.utsān sthāpayet, puṣpa.phala.vāṭāṃś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.08/ In waterless areas he should establish wells, embankments, and springs, as well as flower and fruit gardens.

children.text: KAZ02.34.09/ lubdhaka.śva.gaṇinaḥ parivrajeyur araṇyāni //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.09/ Hunters with their dogs should patrol the forests.

children.text: KAZ02.34.10/ taskara.amitra.abhyāgame śaṅkha.dundubhi.śabdam agrāhyāḥ kuryuḥ śaila.vṛkṣa.adhirūḍhā vā śīghra.vāhanā vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.10/ In the event of an attack by thieves or enemies, those stationed on rocks or trees, or those with swift mounts, should raise an alarm with conch and drum — [being themselves] beyond capture.

children.text: KAZ02.34.11/ amitra.aṭavī.saṃcāraṃ ca rājño gṛha.kapotair mudrā.yuktair hārayet, dhūma.agni.paramparayā vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.34.11/ Intelligence of enemy and forest-tribe movements should be conveyed to the king through domesticated pigeons bearing sealed messages, or through a relay of smoke and fire signals.

children.text:
KAZ02.34.12ab/ dravya.hasti.vana.ājīvaṃ vartanīṃ cora.rakṣaṇam /
KAZ02.34.12cd/ sārtha.ativāhyaṃ go.rakṣyaṃ vyavahāraṃ ca kārayet //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.34.12ab/ He should manage: income from mines and elephant forests, toll roads, protection from thieves,
KAZ02.34.12cd/ caravan escort, cattle grazing, and trade operations.

children.text:
(Activity of the adiministrator)
(ṣecret agents in the disguise of householders, traders, and ascetics)
KAZ02.35.01/ samāhartā caturdhā jana.apdaṃ vibhajya jyeṣṭha.madhyama.kaniṣṭha.vibhāgena grāma.agraṃ parihārakam āyudhīyaṃ dhānya.paśu.hiraṇya.kupya.viṣṭi.pratikaram idam etāvad iti nibandhayet //
children.translated_text:
(Activity of the administrator; Secret agents in the disguise of householders, traders, and ascetics)
KAZ02.35.01/ The collector (<s>samāhartṛ</s>), having divided the countryside into four [administrative divisions] classified as superior, middling, and inferior, should register for each village: the head-tax, exemptions, military levies, and payments in grain, cattle, gold, raw materials, and forced labor — specifying 'this much and this many.'

children.text: KAZ02.35.02/ tat.pradiṣṭaḥ pañca.grāmīṃ daśa.grāmīṃ vā gopaś cintayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.02/ Under his direction, the village-officer (<s>gopa</s>) should oversee a group of five or ten villages.

children.text: KAZ02.35.03/ sīma.avarodhena grāma.agram, kṛṣṭa.akṛṣṭa.sthala.kedāra.ārāma.ṣaṇḍa.vāṭa.vana.vāstu.caitya.deva.gṛha.setu.bandha.śmaśāna.sattra.prapā.puṇya.sthāna.vivīta.pathi.saṅkhyānena kṣetra.agram, tena sīmnāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ ca karada.akarada.saṅkhyānena //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.03/ He should [record] the village census by boundary demarcation; the field census by enumerating cultivated and uncultivated lands, high and low fields, gardens, groves, orchards, forests, building plots, sacred sites, temples, embankments, cremation grounds, rest-houses, watering places, holy sites, pastures, and roads; and by these [counts], the number of revenue-paying and revenue-exempt fields and boundaries.

children.text: KAZ02.35.04/ teṣu ca^etāvac^cātur.vārṇyam, etāvantaḥ karṣaka.go.rakṣaka.vaidehaka.kāru.karma.kara.dāsāś ca, etāvac ca dvi.pada.catuṣ.padam, idaṃ ca^eṣu hiraṇyalviṣṭi.śulka.daṇḍaṃ samuttiṣṭhati^iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.04/ And within these: how many of the four <s>varṇas</s>, how many farmers, cowherds, traders, artisans, laborers, and slaves, how many bipeds and quadrupeds, and how much revenue arises from gold, forced labor, tolls, and fines.

children.text: KAZ02.35.05/ kulānāṃ ca strī.puruṣāṇāṃ bāla.vṛddha.karma.caritra.ājīva.vyaya.parimāṇaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.05/ He should know, for each household, the number of women and men, their ages (young and old), their occupations, character, livelihood, and expenditure.

children.text: KAZ02.35.06/ evaṃ ca jana.pada.catur.bhāgaṃ sthānikaś cintayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.06/ In this manner, the <s>sthānika</s> (district officer) should oversee one-quarter of the countryside.

children.text: KAZ02.35.07/ gopa.sthānika.sthāneṣu pradeṣṭāraḥ kārya.karaṇaṃ bali.pragrahaṃ ca kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.07/ At the posts of the <s>gopa</s> and <s>sthānika</s>, the <s>pradeṣṭṛs</s> (inspectors) should carry out administrative work and collection of revenue.

children.text: KAZ02.35.08/ samāhartṛ.pradiṣṭāś ca gṛha.patika.vyañjanā yeṣu grāmeṣu praṇihitās teṣāṃ grāmāṇāṃ kṣetra.gṛha.kula.agraṃ vidyuḥ, māna.saṃjātābhyāṃ kṣetrāṇi bhoga.parihārābhyāṃ gṛhāṇi varṇa.karmabhyāṃ kulāni ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.08/ And those deployed by the collector in the guise of householders should know the census of fields, houses, and families of the villages to which they are assigned — fields by measurement and yield, houses by use and exemption, and families by <s>varṇa</s> and occupation.

children.text: KAZ02.35.09/ teṣāṃ jaṅgha.agram āya.vyayau ca vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.09/ They should know their livestock census, and the income and expenditure [of each].

children.text: KAZ02.35.10/ prasthita.āgatānāṃ ca pravāsa.āvāsa.kāraṇam, anarthyānāṃ ca strī.puruṣāṇāṃ cāra.pracāraṃ ca vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.10/ They should know the reasons for the departures and arrivals of travelers and residents, and the movements and activities of idle men and women.

children.text: KAZ02.35.11/ evaṃ vaidehaka.vyañjanāḥ sva.bhūmijānāṃ rāja.paṇyānāṃ khani.setu.vana.karma.anta.kṣetrajānāṃ pramāṇam arghaṃ ca vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.11/ Similarly, those in the guise of traders should know the quantity and price of locally produced goods — royal commodities, mine products, dam products, forest products, workshop products, and field products.

children.text: KAZ02.35.12/ para.bhūmi.jātānāṃ vāri.sthala.patha.upayātānāṃ sāra.phalgu.puṇyānāṃ karmasu ca śulka.vartany.ātivāhika.gulma.tara.deya.bhāga.bhakta.paṇya.agāra.pramāṇaṃ vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.12/ For goods from foreign lands, arriving by water or land routes, they should know the quantities [payable as] customs duty, road tolls, escort fees, checkpoint taxes, ferry charges, share-payments, rations, and warehouse fees — distinguishing valuable from inferior and tax-free goods.

children.text: KAZ02.35.13/ evaṃ samāhartṛ.pradiṣṭās tāpasa.vyañjanāḥ karṣaka.go.rakṣaka.vaidehakānām adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca śauca.āśaucaṃ vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.13/ Similarly, those deployed by the collector in the guise of ascetics should know the integrity and corruption of farmers, cowherds, traders, and superintendents.

children.text: KAZ02.35.14/ purāṇa cora.vyañjanāś ca^antevāsinaś caitya.catuṣpatha.śūnya.pada.uda.pāna.nadī.nipāna.tīrtha.āyatana.āśrama.araṇya.śaila.vana.gahaneṣu stena.amitra.pravīra.puruṣāṇāṃ ca praveśana.sthāna.gamana.prayojanāny upalabheran //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.35.14/ And those in the guise of former thieves, as disciples [of the ascetics], should detect the entries, places, movements, and purposes of thieves, enemies, and dangerous men at sacred sites, crossroads, deserted places, wells, rivers, watering stations, pilgrimage sites, hermitages, forests, mountains, and dense thickets.

children.text:
KAZ02.35.15ab/ samāhartā jana.padaṃ cintayed evam utthitaḥ /
KAZ02.35.15cd/ cintayeyuś ca saṃsthās tāḥ saṃsthāś ca^anyāḥ sva.yonayaḥ //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ02.35.15ab/ Thus should the vigilant collector survey the countryside;
KAZ02.35.15cd/ and those establishments should survey [it], and also the other establishments [should survey] their own domains.

children.text:
(ṛules for the city-superintendent)
KAZ02.36.01/ samāhartṛvan nāgariko nagaraṃ cintayet //
children.translated_text:
(Rules for the city superintendent)
KAZ02.36.01/ The city superintendent (<s>nāgarika</s>) should survey the city in the same manner as the collector [surveys] the countryside.

children.text: KAZ02.36.02/ daśa.kulīṃ gopo viṃśati.kulīṃ catvāriṃśat.kulīṃ vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.02/ The <s>gopa</s> [should oversee] a group of ten families, twenty families, or forty families.

children.text: KAZ02.36.03/ sa tasyāṃ strī.puruṣāṇāṃ jāti.gotra.nāma.karmabhiḥ jaṅgha.agram āya.vyayau ca vidyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.03/ He should know: the livestock census and the income and expenditure of the men and women in his ward, [classified] by caste, lineage, name, and occupation.

children.text: KAZ02.36.04/ evaṃ durga.catur.bhāgaṃ sthānikaś cintayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.04/ Similarly, the <s>sthānika</s> should oversee one-quarter of the fort [city].

children.text: KAZ02.36.05/ dharma.āvasathinaḥ pāṣaṇḍi.pathikān āvedya vāsayeyuḥ, sva.pratyayāś ca tapasvinaḥ śrotriyāṃś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.05/ Those in charge of charitable rest-houses should register and accommodate sectarian wanderers and travelers upon notification, and on their own authority, ascetics and Vedic scholars.

children.text: KAZ02.36.06/ kāru.śilpinaḥ sva.karma.sthāneṣu sva.janaṃ vāsayeyuḥ, vaidehakāś ca^anyonyaṃ sva.karma.sthāneṣu //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.06/ Artisans and craftsmen should lodge their own people at their own workplaces, and traders similarly among themselves at their workplaces.

children.text: KAZ02.36.07/ paṇyānām adeśa.kāla.vikretāram asvakaraṇaṃ ca nivedayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.07/ They should report anyone selling goods at the wrong place or time, or without proper authorization.

children.text: KAZ02.36.08/ śauṇḍika.pākva.māṃsika.audanika.rūpa.ājīvāḥ parijñātam āvāsayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.08/ Distillers, vendors of cooked meat, rice-cake sellers, and those living by their appearance [prostitutes] should lodge only known persons.

children.text: KAZ02.36.09/ ativyaya.kartāram atyāhita.karmāṇaṃ ca nivedayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ02.36.09/ They should report anyone engaged in excessive expenditure or dangerous activities.

children.text: KAZ02.36.10/ cikitsakaḥ pracchanna.vraṇa.pratīkāra.kārayitāram apathya.kāriṇaṃ ca gṛha.svāmī ca nivedya gopa.sthānikayor mucyeta, anyathā tulya.doṣaḥ syāt //
children.translated_text: A physician should report to the village headman and the district officer one who conceals a wound and seeks secret treatment, and one who follows an improper regimen; the householder [should do] likewise. By reporting, he is absolved; otherwise, he incurs equal guilt.

children.text: KAZ02.36.11/ prasthita.āgatau ca nivedayet, anyathā rātri.doṣaṃ bhajeta //
children.translated_text: He should also report [the arrival and] departure of travelers; otherwise, he is liable for nighttime offenses.

children.text: KAZ02.36.12/ kṣema.rātriṣu tri.paṇaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: On safe nights, he should pay three <s>paṇas</s> [as a fine for failure].

children.text: KAZ02.36.13/ pathika.utpathikāś ca bahir.antaś ca nagarasya deva.gṛha.puṇya.sthāna.vana.śmaśāneṣu sa-vraṇam aniṣṭa.upakaraṇam udbhāṇḍī.kṛtam āvignam atisvapnam adhva.klāntam apūrvaṃ vā gṛhṇīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Patrol-agents on highways and byways, both outside and inside the city, should arrest [anyone found] in temples, sacred sites, groves, and cremation grounds who is wounded, carrying suspicious equipment, carrying [goods in] bundles, agitated, excessively sleepy, road-weary, or unfamiliar.

children.text: KAZ02.36.14/ evam abhyantare śūnya.niveśa.āveśana.śauṇḍika.audanika.pākva.māṃsika.dyūta.pāṣaṇḍa.āvāseṣu vicayaṃ kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: Likewise, inside [the city], they should conduct searches in vacant residences, lodging houses, taverns, food shops, cooked-meat shops, gambling houses, and heretical monasteries.

children.text: KAZ02.36.15/ agni.pratīkāraṃ ca grīṣme //
children.translated_text: And [they should enforce] fire precautions in summer.

children.text: KAZ02.36.16/ madhyamayor ahnaś catur.bhāgayor aṣṭa.bhāgo^agni.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: The fire-fine is one-eighth [of the standard fine] during the two middle quarters of the day.

children.text: KAZ02.36.17/ bahir.adhiśrayaṇaṃ vā kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: Or [people] should cook outside.

children.text: KAZ02.36.18/ pādaḥ pañca.ghaṭīnāṃ kumbha.droṇi.nihśreṇī.paraśu.śūrpa.aṅkuśa.kaca.grahaṇī.dṛtīnāṃ ca^akaraṇe //
children.translated_text: One-quarter [of the fine] for [each of] five <s>ghaṭīs</s> [of delinquency], and for failure to maintain water-pots, troughs, ladders, axes, winnowing baskets, hooks, tongs, and leather bags.

children.text: KAZ02.36.19/ tṛṇa.kaṭac.channāny apanayet //
children.translated_text: He should have thatch-and-mat coverings removed.

children.text: KAZ02.36.20/ agni.jīvina ekasthān vāsayet //
children.translated_text: Those who live by fire should be settled in one place.

children.text: KAZ02.36.21/ sva.gṛha.pradvāreṣu gṛha.svāmino vaseyuḥ asampātino rātrau //
children.translated_text: Householders should sit in the doorways of their own houses at night, without gathering [in groups].

children.text: KAZ02.36.22/ rathyāsu kuṭa.vrajāḥ sahasraṃ tiṣṭheyuḥ, catuṣpatha.dvāra.rāja.parigraheṣu ca //
children.translated_text: On the streets, a thousand men in armed patrols should stand, and at crossroads, gates, and royal precincts.

children.text: KAZ02.36.23/ pradīptam anabhidhāvato gṛha.svāmino dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, ṣaṭ.paṇo^avakrayiṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For a householder who does not rush to [extinguish] a fire, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for a tenant, six <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.36.24/ pramādād dīpteṣu catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For [fires] ignited through negligence, the fine is fifty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.36.25/ pradīpiko^agninā vadhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: An arsonist shall be put to death by fire.

children.text: KAZ02.36.26/ pāṃsu.nyāse rathyāyām aṣṭa.bhāgo daṇḍaḥ, paṅka.udaka.samnirodhe pādaḥ //
children.translated_text: For dumping dirt on a street, the fine is one-eighth [of the standard]; for obstructing [the flow of] mud or water, one-quarter.

children.text: KAZ02.36.27/ rāja.mārge dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: On a royal road, [the fine is] double.

children.text: KAZ02.36.28/ paṇya.sthāna.udaka.sthāna.deva.gṛha.rāja.parigraheṣu paṇa.uttarā viṣṭā.daṇḍāḥ, mūtreṣv ardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: In marketplaces, water-stations, temples, and royal precincts, the fines begin at one <s>paṇa</s> upward for [dumping] refuse; for urination, half the fine.

children.text: KAZ02.36.29/ bhaiṣajya.vyādhi.bhaya.nimittam adaṇḍyāḥ //
children.translated_text: For [acts committed due to] medicine, illness, or fear, there is no fine.

children.text: KAZ02.36.30/ mārjāra.śva.nakula.sarpa.pretānāṃ nagarasya.antar.utsarge tri.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, khara.uṣṭra.aśvatara.aśva.pretānāṃ ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ, manuṣya.pretānāṃ pañcāśat.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For abandoning the carcasses of cats, dogs, mongooses, and snakes within the city, the fine is three <s>paṇas</s>; for donkeys, camels, mules, and horses, six <s>paṇas</s>; for human corpses, fifty <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.36.31/ mārga.viparyāse śava.dvārād anyataś ca śava.nirṇayane pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For reversing the [funeral] route or carrying out a corpse through [a gate] other than the corpse-gate, the lowest <s>sāhasa</s> penalty [applies].

children.text: KAZ02.36.32/ dvāḥ.sthānāṃ dviśatam //
children.translated_text: For the gate-keepers, [the fine is] two hundred [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ02.36.33/ śmaśānād anyatra nyāse dahane ca dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For depositing or cremating [a body] in a place other than the cremation ground, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ02.36.34/ viṣaṇṇa.alikam ubhayator ātraṃ yāma.tūryam //
children.translated_text: The night-watch drum [sounds] mournfully and briskly at both ends of the watches.

children.text: KAZ02.36.35/ tūrya.śabde rājño gṛha.abhyāśe sa.pāda.paṇaṃ.akṣaṇa.tāḍanaṃ prathama.paścima.yāmikam, madhyama.yāmikaṃ dvi.guṇam, antaś.catur.guṇam //
children.translated_text: At the sound of the drum, near the king's residence, the fine for striking at an untimely hour is one and a quarter <s>paṇas</s> during the first and last watches; double during the middle watch; and four times [that] inside [the palace].

children.text: KAZ02.36.36/ śaṅkanīye deśe liṅge pūrva.apadāne ca gṛhītam anuyuñjīta //
children.translated_text: One arrested in a suspicious place, with suspicious marks, or with a prior record should be questioned.

children.text: KAZ02.36.37/ rāja.parigraha.upagamane nagara.rakṣā.ārohaṇe ca madhyamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For approaching a royal precinct or climbing the city defenses, the middle <s>sāhasa</s> penalty [applies].

children.text: KAZ02.36.38/ sūtikā.cikitsaka.preta.pradīpa.yāna.nāgarika.tūrya.prekṣā.agni.nimittaṃ mudrābhiś ca^agrāhyāḥ //
children.translated_text: Those [moving about] on account of childbirth, medicine, a death, a lamp, a vehicle, the city-superintendent, a musical performance, an entertainment, or a fire, and those with [official] passes, should not be arrested.

children.text: KAZ02.36.39/ cāra.rātriṣu pracchanna.viparīta.veṣāḥ pravrajitā daṇḍa.śastra.hastāś ca manuṣyā doṣato daṇḍyāḥ //
children.translated_text: On nights of [special] patrol, persons in disguise or reversed attire, ascetics, and men carrying weapons or staffs should be punished according to their offense.

children.text: KAZ02.36.40/ rakṣiṇām avāryaṃ vārayatāṃ vāryaṃ ca^āvārayatāṃ kṣaṇa.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For guards who obstruct those who should not be stopped, or who fail to stop those who should be stopped, the fine is double the hourly rate.

children.text: KAZ02.36.41/ striyaṃ dāsīm adhimehayatāṃ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, adāsīṃ madhyamaḥ, kṛta.avarodhām uttamaḥ, kula.striyaṃ vadhaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who violates a slave-woman, the lowest <s>sāhasa</s> penalty; for a non-slave woman, the middle; for a woman of the [royal] harem, the highest; for a woman of a noble family, death.

children.text: KAZ02.36.42/ cetana.acetanikaṃ rātri.doṣam aśaṃsato nāgarikasya doṣa.anurūpo daṇḍaḥ, pramāda.sthāne ca //
children.translated_text: For a city-superintendent who fails to report an offense — whether involving sentient or non-sentient beings, or a nighttime offense — the fine is proportionate to the offense, as well as for [negligence in] a vulnerable area.

children.text: KAZ02.36.43/ nityam udaka.sthāna.mārga.bhramac.channa.patha.vapra.prākāra.rakṣā.avekṣaṇaṃ naṣṭa.prasmṛta.apasṛtānāṃ ca rakṣaṇam //
children.translated_text: There should be constant vigilance over water-stations, roads, hidden passages, ramparts, and fortification walls, and protection of the lost, the confused, and the displaced.

children.text: KAZ02.36.44/ bandhana.agāre ca bāla.vṛddha.vyādhita.anāthānāṃ jāta.nakṣatra.paurṇamāsīṣu visargaḥ //
children.translated_text: In the prison, the young, the aged, the sick, and the destitute should be released on birth-star [anniversaries] and full-moon days.

children.text: KAZ02.36.45/ paṇya.śīlāḥ samaya.anubaddhā vā doṣa.niṣkrayaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Those engaged in trade or bound by [guild] agreements should pay a redemption fine for their offense.

children.text:
KAZ02.36.46ab/ divase pañca.rātre vā bandhanasthān viśodhayet /
KAZ02.36.46cd/ karmaṇā kāya.daṇḍena hiraṇya.anugraheṇa vā //
children.translated_text: Within a day or five nights, he should clear out prisoners through labor, corporal punishment, or monetary compensation.

children.text:
KAZ02.36.47ab/ apūrva.deśa.adhigame yuva.rāja.abhiṣecane /
KAZ02.36.47cd/ putra.janmani vā mokṣo bandhanasya vidhīyate //E
children.translated_text: Upon the acquisition of new territory, the coronation of a crown prince, or the birth of a son, the release of prisoners is ordained.

children.text:
(ḍetermination of (valid and invalid) transactions)
(Filing of law-suits)
KAZ03.1.01/ dharmasthās trayas trayo^amātyā jana.pada.saṃdhi.saṃgrahaṇa.droṇa.mukha.sthānīyeṣu vyāvahārikān arthān kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Determination of valid and invalid transactions)
(Filing of law-suits)
Three judges (<s>dharmasthāḥ</s>), who are ministers, should adjudicate legal disputes in the rural districts, border-stations, collection points, district seats, and provincial capitals.

children.text: KAZ03.1.02/ tirohita.antar.agāra.nakta.araṇya.upadhy.upahvara.kṛtāṃś ca vyavahārān pratiṣedhayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: They should invalidate transactions conducted in secret, inside inner chambers, at night, in the forest, through fraud, or in a secluded place.

children.text: KAZ03.1.03/ kartuḥ kārayituḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For the doer and the instigator, the lowest <s>sāhasa</s> penalty [applies].

children.text: KAZ03.1.04/ śrotṛṛṇām eka.ekaṃ pratyardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: For the witnesses, half the penalty for each one.

children.text: KAZ03.1.05/ śraddheyānāṃ tu dravya.vyapanayaḥ //
children.translated_text: But for trustworthy [witnesses], [only] confiscation of the [transaction's] proceeds.

children.text: KAZ03.1.06/ parokṣeṇa^adhika.ṛṇa.grahaṇam avaktavya.karā vā tirohitāḥ sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Transactions conducted in secret may be valid if [they involve] taking a loan beyond [one's share] in the absence [of co-heirs], or [are made by] those who are not to be compelled to speak [publicly].

children.text: KAZ03.1.07/ dāya.nikṣepa.upanidhi.vivāha.yuktāḥ strīṇām aniṣkāsinīnāṃ vyādhitānāṃ ca^amūḍha.saṃjñānām antar.agāra.kṛtāḥ sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Transactions conducted inside inner chambers may be valid when they relate to inheritance, deposits, sealed deposits, and marriage, for women who do not go out, and for the sick who are of sound mind.

children.text: KAZ03.1.08/ sāhasa.anupraveśa.kalaha.vivāha.rāja.niyoga.yuktāḥ pūrva.rātra.vyavahāriṇāṃ ca rātri.kṛtāḥ sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Transactions conducted at night may be valid when they relate to violence, forced entry, a quarrel, a marriage, a royal commission, and for those whose [regular] business is conducted in the first watch.

children.text: KAZ03.1.09/ sārtha.vraja.āśrama.vyādha.cāraṇa.madhyeṣv araṇya.carāṇām araṇya.kṛtāḥ sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Transactions conducted in the forest may be valid for forest-dwellers, when [made] among caravans, cattle-camps, hermitages, hunters, and wanderers.

children.text: KAZ03.1.10/ gūḍha.ājīviṣu ca^upadhi.kṛtāḥ sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: And transactions conducted through fraud may be valid [when dealing] with those who earn their living by secret means.

children.text: KAZ03.1.11/ mithaḥ.samavāye ca^upahvara.kṛtāḥ sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: And transactions conducted in a secluded place may be valid when [there is] mutual agreement at the meeting.

children.text: KAZ03.1.12/ ato^anyathā na sidhyeyuḥ, apāśrayavadbhiś ca kṛtāḥ, pitṛmatā putreṇa, pitrā putravatā, niṣkulena bhrātrā, kaniṣṭhena^avibhakta.aṃśena, patimatyā putravatyā ca striyā, dāsa.āhitakābhyām, aprāpta.atīta.vyavahārābhyām, abhiśasta.pravrajita.nyaṅga.vyasanibhiś ca, anyatra niṣṛṣṭa.vyavahārebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: Otherwise, transactions made by these [persons] are not valid — nor [those made] by persons under another's authority: a son whose father is alive, a father who has a [competent] son, a brother without family [standing], a younger [brother] with undivided share, a married woman with a son, a slave and a bonded servant, persons below or past the age of legal competence, and those accused, banished, disabled, or addicted to vices — except those specifically authorized to transact.

children.text: KAZ03.1.13/ tatra^api kruddhena^ārtena mattena.unmattena^avagṛhītena vā kṛtā vyavahārā na sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Even among those [authorized], transactions made by one who is angry, distressed, intoxicated, insane, or coerced are not valid.

children.text: KAZ03.1.14/ kartṛ.kārayitṛ.śrotṛṛṇāṃ pṛthag yathā.uktā daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: For the doer, instigator, and witnesses, the penalties are separately as stated.

children.text: KAZ03.1.15/ sve sve tu varge deśe kāle ca sva.karaṇa.kṛtāḥ sampūrṇa.ācārāḥ śuddha.deśā dṛṣṭa.rūpa.lakṣaṇa.pramāṇa.guṇāḥ sarva.vyavahārāḥ sidhyeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: All transactions conducted in their proper group, place, and time, executed with their proper instruments, complete in procedure, of verified locality, and whose form, marks, quantity, and qualities have been witnessed — these are valid.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.16/ paścimaṃ ca^eṣāṃ karaṇam ādeśa.ādhivarjaṃ śraddheyam // iti vyavahāra.sthāpanā /
KAZ03.1.17/ saṃvatsaram ṛtuṃ māsaṃ pakṣaṃ divasaṃ karaṇam adhikaraṇam ṛṇaṃ vedaka.āvedakayoḥ kṛta.samartha.avasthayor deśa.grāma.jāti.gotra.nāma.karmāṇi ca^abhilikhya vādi.prativādi.praśnān artha.ānupūrvyā niveśayet //
children.translated_text:
The latest document among these is to be trusted, except for mandates and mortgages. This is the establishment of [valid] transactions.
He should record the year, season, month, fortnight, day, the document, the court, the debt, and the informant and the informed, along with whether the matter is concluded, pending, or settled, and the place, village, caste, lineage, name, and occupation — and then present the questions of the plaintiff and defendant in the order of the case.

children.text: KAZ03.1.18/ niviṣṭāṃś ca^avekṣeta //
children.translated_text: And he should examine those [questions] once filed.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.19/ nibaddhaṃ vādam utsṛjya^anyaṃ vādaṃ saṃkrāmati, pūrva.uktaṃ paścimena^arthena na^abhisaṃdhatte, para.vākyam anabhigrāhyam abhigrāhya^avatiṣṭhate, pratijñāya deśaṃ nirdiśa^ity ukte na nirdiśati, hīna.deśam adeśaṃ vā nirdiśati, nirdiṣṭād deśād anyaṃ deśam upasthāpayati, upasthite deśe^artha.vacanaṃ na^evam ity apavyayate, sākṣibhir avadhṛtaṃ na^icchati,
asambhāṣye deśe sākṣibhir mithaḥ sambhāṣate, iti parā.ukta.hetavaḥ //
children.translated_text: One who abandons his recorded plea and shifts to another plea; who does not reconcile his earlier statement with the later one; who accepts and stands by the opponent's statement which should not be accepted; who, having promised to produce evidence and being told 'specify the evidence,' does not specify; who specifies deficient evidence or no evidence; who introduces evidence different from the evidence specified; who, when the evidence is presented, denies the substance of the statement saying 'it is not so'; who does not accept [the testimony] established by witnesses; who converses privately with the witnesses at a place where such conversation is not permitted — these are the grounds for [declaring one] refuted by the other party.

children.text: KAZ03.1.20/ parā.ukta.daṇḍaḥ pañca.bandhaḥ //
children.translated_text: The fine for being refuted by the other party is one-fifth of the [amount at] stake.

children.text: KAZ03.1.21/ svayaṃ.vādi.daṇḍo daśa.bandhaḥ //
children.translated_text: The fine for a self-initiated [frivolous] lawsuit is one-tenth of the stake.

children.text: KAZ03.1.22/ puruṣa.bhṛtir aṣṭa.aṃśaḥ //
children.translated_text: The agent's fee is one-eighth [of the amount].

children.text: KAZ03.1.23/ pathi.bhaktam argha.viśeṣataḥ //
children.translated_text: Travel-expenses [are determined] according to the difference in prices.

children.text: KAZ03.1.24/ tad ubhayaṃ niyamyo dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Both [the fee and travel-expenses] should be paid by the losing party.

children.text: KAZ03.1.25/ abhiyukto na pratyabhiyuñjīta, anyatra kalaha.sāhasa.sārtha.samavāyebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: A defendant should not counter-sue, except in cases of quarrel, violence, caravan disputes, and assembly disputes.

children.text: KAZ03.1.26/ na ca^abhiyukte^abhiyoge^asti //
children.translated_text: Nor is there [any right to] counter-suit while the [original] suit is pending.

children.text: KAZ03.1.27/ abhiyoktā cet pratyuktas tad.ahar eva na pratibrūyāt parā.uktaḥ syāt //
children.translated_text: If a plaintiff is counter-sued and does not respond on that very day, he is declared refuted.

children.text: KAZ03.1.28/ kṛta.kārya.viniścayo hy abhiyoktā na^abhiyuktaḥ //
children.translated_text: For the plaintiff's case is already determined, [while] the defendant's is not.

children.text: KAZ03.1.29/ tasya^apratibruvatas tri.rātraṃ sapta.rātram iti //
children.translated_text: For the [defendant] who does not respond, [the periods are] three nights [or] seven nights.

children.text: KAZ03.1.30/ ata ūrdhvaṃ tri.paṇa.avara.ardhyaṃ dvādaśa.paṇa.paraṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Beyond that, he should impose a fine beginning at a minimum of three <s>paṇas</s>, with a half [increment], up to a maximum of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.1.31/ tri.pakṣād ūrdhvam apratibruvataḥ parā.ukta.daṇḍaṃ kṛtvā yāny asya dravyāṇi syus tato^abhiyoktāraṃ pratipādayed, anyatra vṛtty.upakaraṇebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: Beyond a month and a half, for one who does not respond, having imposed the refutation-fine, whatever property he possesses — from that the plaintiff should be compensated, except for [the defendant's] means of livelihood.

children.text: KAZ03.1.32/ tad eva niṣpatato^abhiyuktasya kuryāt //
children.translated_text: The same should be done for a defendant who absconds.

children.text: KAZ03.1.33/ abhiyoktur niṣpāta.sama.kālaḥ parā.ukta.bhāvaḥ //
children.translated_text: The plaintiff's absconding at the same time [results in] his being declared refuted.

children.text: KAZ03.1.34/ pretasya vyasanino vā sākṣi.vacanam asāram //
children.translated_text: The testimony of a deceased or calamity-stricken witness is without substance.

children.text: KAZ03.1.35/ abhiyoktā daṇḍaṃ dattvā karma kārayet //
children.translated_text: The plaintiff, having paid the fine, should have the work [of enforcement] carried out.

children.text: KAZ03.1.36/ ādhiṃ vā sa kāmaṃ praveśayet //
children.translated_text: Or he may voluntarily pledge a security.

children.text: KAZ03.1.37/ rakṣoghna.rakṣitaṃ vā karmaṇā pratipādayed, anyatra brāhmaṇāt //
children.translated_text: Or [the debt] should be recovered through labor with the protection of guards — except from a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.38ab/ catur.varṇa.āśramasya^ayaṃ lokasya^ācāra.rakṣaṇāt /
KAZ03.1.38cd/ naśyatāṃ sarva.dharmāṇāṃ rājā dharma.pravartakaḥ //
children.translated_text: This king is the promoter of <s>dharma</s> for the world of the four <s>varṇas</s> and <s>āśramas</s>, by protecting their conduct; for when all <s>dharmas</s> are perishing [he restores them].

children.text:
KAZ03.1.39ab/ dharmaś ca vyavahāraś ca caritraṃ rāja.śāsanam /
KAZ03.1.39cd/ vivāda.arthaś catuṣpādaḥ paścimaḥ pūrva.bādhakaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> (sacred law), legal procedure (<s>vyavahāra</s>), custom (<s>caritra</s>), and royal edict (<s>rājaśāsana</s>) — a legal dispute has these four foundations, each later one overriding the earlier.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.40ab/ tatra satye sthito dharmo vyavahāras tu sākṣiṣu /
KAZ03.1.40cd/ caritraṃ saṃgrahe puṃsāṃ rājñām ājñā tu śāsanam //
children.translated_text: Of these, <s>dharma</s> is grounded in truth; legal procedure in witnesses; custom in the accepted practice of the people; and edict is the command of kings.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.41ab/ rājñaḥ sva.dharmaḥ svargāya prajā dharmeṇa rakṣituḥ /
KAZ03.1.41cd/ arakṣitur vā kṣeptur vā mithyā.daṇḍam ato^anyathā //
children.translated_text: It is the king's own <s>dharma</s>, leading to heaven, to protect the people through [just] law; otherwise, for one who fails to protect, or who despises [his duty], or who inflicts unjust punishment, it is [the opposite].

children.text:
KAZ03.1.42ab/ daṇḍo hi kevalo lokaṃ paraṃ ca^imaṃ ca rakṣati /
KAZ03.1.42cd/ rājñā putre ca śatrau ca yathā.doṣaṃ samaṃ dhṛtaḥ //
children.translated_text: For punishment (<s>daṇḍa</s>) alone, when wielded impartially by the king — whether toward his own son or toward his enemy, according to the offense — protects both this world and the next.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.43ab/ anuśāsadd hi dharmeṇa vyavahāreṇa saṃsthayā /
KAZ03.1.43cd/ nyāyena ca caturthena catur.antāṃ vā mahīṃ jayet //
children.translated_text: For by governing through <s>dharma</s>, legal procedure, established practice, and equity as the fourth, he may conquer the earth to its four ends.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.44ab/ saṃsthā yā dharma.śāstreṇa śāstraṃ vā vyāvahārikam /
KAZ03.1.44cd/ yasminn arthe virudhyeta dharmeṇa^arthaṃ vinirṇayet //
children.translated_text: When the established practice conflicts with the <s>dharma</s>-treatise, or the treatise with legal procedure, the matter should be decided by <s>dharma</s>.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.45ab/ śāstraṃ vipratipadyeta dharme nyāyena kenacit /
KAZ03.1.45cd/ nyāyas tatra pramāṇaṃ syāt tatra pāṭho hi naśyati //
children.translated_text: When the treatise conflicts with <s>dharma</s> on some point of equity, equity should be the authority there, for the text [alone] fails in such cases.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.46ab/ dṛṣṭa.doṣaḥ svayaṃ.vādaḥ sva.pakṣa.para.pakṣayoḥ /
KAZ03.1.46cd/ anuyoga.ārjavaṃ hetuḥ śapathaś ca^artha.sādhakaḥ //
children.translated_text:
A self-initiated statement that is found to be flawed — [whether affecting] one's own side or the opposing side —
straightforwardness of cross-examination, [logical] reasoning, and oath — these are the means of establishing [the truth of] a case.

children.text:
KAZ03.1.47ab/ pūrva.uttara.artha.vyāghāte sākṣi.vaktavya.kāraṇe /
KAZ03.1.47cd/ cāra.hastāc ca niṣpāte pradeṣṭavyaḥ parājayaḥ //E
children.translated_text:
When there is a contradiction between earlier and later [statements of] the case, when the testimony of witnesses becomes necessary,
and when a decision is reached through the hand of a secret agent — defeat should be pronounced.

children.text:
(Concerning marriage)
((i) ḷaw of marriage^ (ī) ṛules concerning woman's property^ (īi) Concerning supersession (of a wife) by a second marriage)
KAZ03.2.01/ vivāha.pūrvo vyavahāraḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Concerning marriage)
((i) Law of marriage, (ii) Rules concerning woman's property, (iii) Concerning supersession of a wife by a second marriage)
The [first] legal transaction [concerning persons] is that preceded by marriage.

children.text: KAZ03.2.02/ kanyā.dānaṃ kanyām alaṃkṛtya brāhmo vivāhaḥ //
children.translated_text: The gift of a maiden adorned [to the groom] is the <s>Brāhma</s> form of marriage.

children.text: KAZ03.2.03/ saha.dharma.caryā prājāpatyaḥ //
children.translated_text: The joining together for the practice of <s>dharma</s> is the <s>Prājāpatya</s> form.

children.text: KAZ03.2.04/ go.mithuna.ādānād ārṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: The receiving of a pair of cattle [from the groom constitutes] the <s>Ārṣa</s> form.

children.text: KAZ03.2.05/ antar.vedyām ṛtvije dānād daivaḥ //
children.translated_text: The gift [of the maiden] to the officiating priest within the sacrificial enclosure is the <s>Daiva</s> form.

children.text: KAZ03.2.06/ mithaḥ.samavāyād gāndharvaḥ //
children.translated_text: The voluntary union of the couple is the <s>Gāndharva</s> form.

children.text: KAZ03.2.07/ śulka.ādānād āsuraḥ //
children.translated_text: The receiving of a bride-price (<s>śulka</s>) constitutes the <s>Āsura</s> form.

children.text: KAZ03.2.08/ prasahya.ādānād rākṣasaḥ //
children.translated_text: The taking [of the maiden] by force is the <s>Rākṣasa</s> form.

children.text: KAZ03.2.09/ supta.matta.ādānāt paiśācaḥ //
children.translated_text: The taking [of the maiden while she is] asleep or intoxicated is the <s>Paiśāca</s> form.

children.text: KAZ03.2.10/ pitṛ.pramāṇāś catvāraḥ pūrve dharmyāḥ, mātā.pitṛ.pramāṇāḥ śeṣāḥ //
children.translated_text: The first four are righteous [forms] dependent on the father's authority; the remaining [four] depend on both mother and father.

children.text: KAZ03.2.11/ tau hi śulka.harau duhituḥ, anyatara.abhāve^anyataro vā //
children.translated_text: For they [the parents] are the recipients of the bride-price for the daughter; in the absence of either, the other [alone receives it].

children.text: KAZ03.2.12/ dvitīyaṃ śulkaṃ strī hareta //
children.translated_text: A second bride-price the woman herself should receive.

children.text:
KAZ03.2.13/ sarveṣāṃ prīty.āropaṇam apratiṣiddham // iti vivāha.dharmaḥ /
KAZ03.2.14/ vṛttir ābandhyaṃ vā strī.dhanam //
children.translated_text:
In all [forms of marriage], the enhancement of affection is not prohibited. — Thus [ends the section on] the law of marriage.
A woman's property (<s>strīdhana</s>) consists of her maintenance allowance or her jewelry and ornaments (<s>ābandhya</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.2.15/ para.dvi.sāhasrā sthāpyā vṛttiḥ, ābandhya.aniyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: The maintenance allowance to be set aside may go up to two thousand; there is no limit on the ornaments.

children.text: KAZ03.2.16/ tad ātma.putra.snuṣā.bharmaṇi pravāsa.apratividhāne ca bhāryāyā bhoktum adoṣaḥ, pratirodhaka.vyādhi.durbhikṣa.bhaya.pratīkāre dharma.kārye ca patyuḥ, sambhūya vā dampatyor mithunaṃ prajātayoḥ //
children.translated_text: It is not blameworthy for the wife to use that [property] for the nourishment of herself, her son, or daughter-in-law, and in making provisions during [the husband's] absence; [likewise] the husband [may use it] for counteracting a blockade, disease, famine, or danger, and for a religious purpose; or the couple together, when they have offspring.

children.text: KAZ03.2.17/ tri.varṣa.upabhuktaṃ ca dharmiṣṭheṣu vivāheṣu na^anuyuñjīta //
children.translated_text: And [property] enjoyed for three years in righteous forms of marriage should not be reclaimed.

children.text: KAZ03.2.18/ gāndharva.āsura.upabhuktaṃ sa-vṛddhikam ubhayaṃ dāpyeta, rākṣasa.paiśāca.upabhuktaṃ steyaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: That enjoyed in <s>Gāndharva</s> and <s>Āsura</s> marriages — both [the maintenance and ornaments] should be repaid with interest; that enjoyed in <s>Rākṣasa</s> and <s>Paiśāca</s> marriages — [the husband] should pay [as for] theft.

children.text: KAZ03.2.19/ mṛte bhartari dharma.kāmā tadānīm eva sthāpya^ābharaṇaṃ śulka.śeṣaṃ ca labheta //
children.translated_text: When the husband dies, a woman who desires to remain devoted (<s>dharmakāmā</s>) should immediately receive the ornaments to be set aside and the remainder of the bride-price.

children.text: KAZ03.2.20/ labdhvā vā vindamānā sa-vṛddhikam ubhayaṃ dāpyeta //
children.translated_text: Or, having received [those] and [then] remarrying, she should be made to repay both with interest.

children.text: KAZ03.2.21/ kuṭumba.kāmā tu śvaśura.pati.dattaṃ niveśa.kāle labheta //
children.translated_text: But one who desires [to maintain] the household should receive what was given by the father-in-law and husband at the time of [her] re-establishment.

children.text: KAZ03.2.22/ niveśa.kālaṃ hi dīrgha.pravāse vyākhyāsyāmaḥ //
children.translated_text: We shall explain the time of re-establishment in [the section on] long absence.

children.text: KAZ03.2.23/ śvaśura.prātilomyena vā niviṣṭā śvaśura.pati.dattaṃ jīyeta //
children.translated_text: Or if she re-establishes herself in a manner hostile to the father-in-law's [family], she should forfeit what was given by the father-in-law and husband.

children.text: KAZ03.2.24/ jñāti.hastād.abhimṛṣṭāyā jñātayo yathā.gṛhītaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: If she has been touched [sexually] from the hand of a kinsman, the kinsmen should pay according to what was taken.

children.text: KAZ03.2.25/ nyāya.upagatāyāḥ pratipattā strī.dhanaṃ gopayet //
children.translated_text: The one who takes her [in marriage] when she has come by lawful means should protect her woman's property.

children.text: KAZ03.2.26/ pati.dāyaṃ vindamānā jīyeta //
children.translated_text: If she remarries while receiving the husband's inheritance, she should forfeit [it].

children.text: KAZ03.2.27/ dharma.kāmā bhuñjīta //
children.translated_text: A woman devoted to <s>dharma</s> may enjoy [her property].

children.text: KAZ03.2.28/ putravatī vindamānā strī.dhanaṃ jīyeta //
children.translated_text: A woman with sons who remarries should forfeit her woman's property.

children.text: KAZ03.2.29/ tat tu strī.dhanaṃ putrā hareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: But that woman's property the sons should inherit.

children.text: KAZ03.2.30/ putra.bharaṇa.arthaṃ vā vindamānā putra.arthaṃ sphātī.kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Or if she remarries for the purpose of maintaining her sons, she should increase [the property] for the sake of the sons.

children.text: KAZ03.2.31/ bahu.puruṣa.prajānāṃ putrāṇāṃ yathā.pitṛ.dattaṃ strī.dhanam avasthāpayet //
children.translated_text: For sons of multiple fathers, the woman's property should be apportioned according to what was given by each respective father.

children.text: KAZ03.2.32/ kāma.karaṇīyam api strī.dhanaṃ vindamānā putra.saṃsthaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Even woman's property that she may dispose of freely, when she remarries, she should place in trust for the sons.

children.text: KAZ03.2.33/ aputrā pati.śayanaṃ pālayantī guru.samīpe strī.dhanam āyuḥ.kṣayād bhuñjīta //
children.translated_text: A childless woman, guarding the bed of her [deceased] husband, in the presence of the elders, may enjoy her woman's property until the end of her life.

children.text: KAZ03.2.34/ āpad.arthaṃ hi strī.dhanam //
children.translated_text: For woman's property is meant for times of distress.

children.text: KAZ03.2.35/ ūrdhvaṃ dāyādaṃ gacchet //
children.translated_text: After [her death], it should go to the heirs.

children.text: KAZ03.2.36/ jīvati bhartari mṛtāyāḥ putrā duhitaraś ca strī.dhanaṃ vibhajeran, aputrāyā duhitaraḥ, tad.abhāve bhartā //
children.translated_text: When a [married woman] dies while the husband is alive, the sons and daughters should divide her woman's property; if childless, the daughters; in their absence, the husband.

children.text:
KAZ03.2.37/ śulkam anvādheyam anyad vā bandhubhir dattaṃ bāndhavā hareyuḥ // iti strī.dhana.kalpaḥ /
KAZ03.2.38/ varṣāṇy aṣṭāv aprajāyamānām aputrāṃ vandhyāṃ ca^ākāṅkṣeta, daśa nindum, dvādaśa kanyā.prasavinīm //
children.translated_text:
The bride-price, the supplementary gift (<s>anvādheya</s>), and anything else given by kinsmen — the kinsmen should take. — Thus [ends the section on] the rules of woman's property.
He should wait eight years for [a wife] who does not conceive, who bears no sons, or is barren; ten [years] for one who bears stillborn [children]; twelve for one who bears only daughters.

children.text: KAZ03.2.39/ tataḥ putra.arthī dvitīyāṃ vindeta //
children.translated_text: After that, desiring a son, he may take a second wife.

children.text: KAZ03.2.40/ tasya^atikrame śulkaṃ strī.dhanam ardhaṃ ca^ādhivedanikaṃ dadyāt, catur.viṃśati.paṇa.paraṃ ca daṇḍam //
children.translated_text: If he transgresses [these time limits], he should give [her] the bride-price, the woman's property, and half as compensation for supersession (<s>ādhivedanika</s>), as well as a fine of up to twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.2.41/ śulkaṃ strī.dhanam aśulka.strī.dhanāyās tat.pramāṇam ādhivedanikam anurūpāṃ ca vṛttiṃ dattvā bahvīr api vindeta //
children.translated_text: Having given the bride-price and woman's property — or for one without bride-price and woman's property, the equivalent amount — as supersession compensation, along with a suitable maintenance, he may take even many [wives].

children.text: KAZ03.2.42/ putra.arthā hi striyaḥ //
children.translated_text: For women are [meant] for the purpose of sons.

children.text: KAZ03.2.43/ tīrtha.samavāye ca^āsāṃ yathā.vivāhaṃ pūrva.ūḍhāṃ jīvat.putrāṃ vā pūrvaṃ gacchet //
children.translated_text: And at a convergence of auspicious occasions for these [wives], he should go first to the one married first or the one with a living son.

children.text: KAZ03.2.44/ tīrtha.gūhana.āgamane ṣaṇ.ṇavatir daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For concealment of or falsely claiming an auspicious occasion — a fine of ninety-six [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ03.2.45/ putravatīṃ dharma.kāmāṃ vandhyāṃ ninduṃ nīrajaskāṃ vā na^akāmām upeyāt //
children.translated_text: He should not approach against her will a woman with sons, one devoted to <s>dharma</s>, a barren woman, one who bears stillborn children, or one past menstruation.

children.text: KAZ03.2.46/ na ca^akāmaḥ puruṣaḥ kuṣṭhinīm unmattāṃ vā gacchet //
children.translated_text: Nor should a man be forced to go to a leprous or insane [wife].

children.text: KAZ03.2.47/ strī tu putra.artham evaṃ.bhūtaṃ vā^upagacchet //
children.translated_text: But a woman may approach even such a [husband] for the purpose of sons.

children.text:
KAZ03.2.48ab/ nīcatvaṃ para.deśaṃ vā prasthito rāja.kilbiṣī /
KAZ03.2.48cd/ prāṇa.abhihantā patitas tyājyaḥ klībo^api vā patiḥ //E
children.translated_text:
One who has fallen into low caste, gone to foreign lands, committed an offense against the king,
threatens life, has become an outcaste, or is impotent — such a husband should be abandoned.

children.text:
((iv) ṃarital duty^ (v) ṃaintenance^ (vi) Cruelty^ (vī) ḍisaffection^ (vīi) ṃisconduct^ (ix) Prohibition of favours and dealings)
KAZ03.3.01/ dvādaśa.varṣā strī prāpta.vyavahārā bhavati, ṣoḍaśa.varṣaḥ pumān //
children.translated_text:
((iv) Marital duty, (v) Maintenance, (vi) Cruelty, (vii) Disaffection, (viii) Misconduct, (ix) Prohibition of favors and dealings)
A woman becomes [legally] competent at twelve years; a man at sixteen.

children.text:
KAZ03.3.02/ ata ūrdhvam aśuśrūṣāyāṃ dvādaśa.paṇaḥ striyā daṇḍaḥ, puṃso dvi.guṇaḥ // iti śuśrūṣā /
KAZ03.3.03/ bharmaṇyāyām anirdiṣṭa.kālāyāṃ grāsa.ācchādanaṃ vā^adhikaṃ yathā.puruṣa.parivāpaṃ saviśeṣaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text:
Beyond that, for disobedience, the fine for a woman is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for a man, double. — Thus [ends the section on] obedience.
For a wife who is to be maintained, for whom no time-limit has been fixed, he should give food and clothing, or more — a per-person allowance with special provisions.

children.text: KAZ03.3.04/ nirdiṣṭa.kālāyāṃ tad eva saṃkhyāya bandhaṃ ca dadyāt //
children.translated_text: For one with a fixed time-limit, he should give that [same amount] calculated, along with a bond.

children.text: KAZ03.3.05/ śulka.strī.dhana.ādhivedanikānām anādāne ca //
children.translated_text: And [the same applies] for non-payment of bride-price, woman's property, and supersession compensation.

children.text:
KAZ03.3.06/ śvaśura.kula.praviṣṭāyāṃ vibhaktāyāṃ vā na^abhiyojyaḥ patiḥ // iti bharma /
KAZ03.3.07/ "naṣṭe" "vinaṣṭe" "nyaṅge" "apitṛke" "amātṛke" ity anirdeśena vinaya.grāhaṇam //
children.translated_text:
When she has entered the father-in-law's household, or when [the property] has been divided, the husband is not liable [for maintenance]. — Thus [ends the section on] maintenance.
Disciplinary beating [is restricted to exclamations] such as 'lost,' 'ruined,' 'crippled,' 'fatherless,' 'motherless' — without specification.

children.text: KAZ03.3.08/ veṇu.dala.rajju.hastānām anyatamena vā pṛṣṭhe trir āghātaḥ //
children.translated_text: Three strikes on the back with any one of bamboo, a split [bamboo], a rope, or the hand.

children.text: KAZ03.3.09/ tasya^atikrame vāg.daṇḍa.pāruṣya.daṇḍābhyām ardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: For exceeding that — half the penalties [prescribed] for verbal assault and physical assault.

children.text: KAZ03.3.10/ tad eva striyā bhartari prasiddha.doṣāyāḥ //
children.translated_text: The same [penalties apply] for a woman toward her husband when his fault is well-known.

children.text:
KAZ03.3.11/ īrṣyayā bāhya.vihāreṣu dvāreṣv atyayo yathā.nirdiṣṭaḥ // iti pāruṣyam /
KAZ03.3.12/ bhartāraṃ dviṣatī strī sapta.ārtavāny amaṇḍayamānā tadānīm eva sthāpya^ābharaṇaṃ nidhāya bhartāram anyayā saha śayānam anuśayīta //
children.translated_text:
Out of jealousy, at external excursions and at doorways, the penalty is as prescribed. — Thus [ends the section on] cruelty.
A wife who despises her husband — for seven menstrual periods not adorning herself — should immediately set aside her ornaments, deposit them, and lie beside the husband when he sleeps with another woman.

children.text: KAZ03.3.13/ bhikṣuky.anvādhi.jñāti.kulānām anyatame vā bhartā dviṣan striyam ekām anuśayīta //
children.translated_text: A husband who despises [his wife] should keep one [wife] beside him — at one of: a nunnery, a surety, or a kinsman's house.

children.text: KAZ03.3.14/ dṛṣṭa.liṅge maithuna.apahāre savarṇa.apasarpa.upagame vā mithyā.vādī dvādaśa.paṇaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: When there is visible evidence of sexual withdrawal or when a spy of the same caste has gained access, one who makes a false statement should pay twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.3.15/ amokṣyā bhartur akāmasya dviṣatī bhāryā, bhāryāyāś ca bhartā //
children.translated_text: A wife who is despised is not to be released if the husband is unwilling; nor [is] a husband [to be released] from [his despised] wife.

children.text: KAZ03.3.16/ parasparaṃ.dveṣān mokṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: Release [is possible only] when the aversion is mutual.

children.text: KAZ03.3.17/ strī.viprakārād vā puruṣaś cen mokṣam icched yathā.gṛhītam asyai dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Or, if due to the woman's offensiveness the man desires release, he should give her what was received.

children.text: KAZ03.3.18/ puruṣa.viprakārād vā strī cen mokṣam icchen na^asyai yathā.gṛhītaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Or, if due to the man's offensiveness the woman desires release, he need not give her what was received.

children.text:
KAZ03.3.19/ amokṣo dharma.vivāhānām // iti dveṣaḥ /
KAZ03.3.20/ pratiṣiddhā strī darpa.madya.krīḍāyāṃ tri.paṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text:
There is no release for marriages in the righteous forms. — Thus [ends the section on] disaffection.
A woman who has been prohibited [from certain conduct], if [she engages in] arrogant or drunken entertainment, should pay a fine of three <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.3.21/ divā strī.prekṣā.vihāra.gamane ṣaṭ.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, puruṣa.prekṣā.vihāra.gamane dvādaśa.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For going by day to entertainments or outings for women — a fine of six <s>paṇas</s>; for going to entertainments or outings for men — twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.3.22/ rātrau dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: At night, double.

children.text: KAZ03.3.23/ supta.matta.pravrajane bhartur adāne ca dvārasya dvādaśa.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For leaving the house while [the husband] is asleep or intoxicated, or for the gate when the husband has not given [permission] — twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.3.24/ rātrau niṣkasane dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For going out at night, double.

children.text: KAZ03.3.25/ strī.puṃsayor maithuna.arthena^aṅga.viceṣṭāyāṃ raho^aślīla.sambhāṣāyāṃ vā catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ striyā daṇḍaḥ, puṃso dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For a man and woman making amorous gestures for the purpose of sexual intercourse, or engaging in private obscene conversation — a fine of twenty-four <s>paṇas</s> for the woman, double for the man.

children.text: KAZ03.3.26/ keśa.nīvi.danta.nakha.ālambaneṣu pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, puṃso dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For seizing the hair, the girdle knot, the teeth, or the nails — the first level of <s>sāhasa</s> fine; for the man, double.

children.text: KAZ03.3.27/ śaṅkita.sthāne sambhāṣāyāṃ ca paṇa.sthāne śiphā.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For conversation in a suspicious place and at a market — punishment by whipping.

children.text: KAZ03.3.28/ strīṇāṃ grāma.madhye caṇḍālaḥ pakṣa.antare pañca.śiphā dadyāt //
children.translated_text: In the middle of the village, a <s>Caṇḍāla</s> should administer five lashes to women at alternate fortnights.

children.text:
KAZ03.3.29/ paṇikaṃ vā prahāraṃ mokṣayet // ity atīcāraḥ /
KAZ03.3.30/ pratiṣiddhayoḥ strī.puṃsayor anyonya.upakāre kṣudraka.dravyāṇāṃ dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, sthūlaka.dravyāṇāṃ catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ, hiraṇya.suvarṇayoś catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇaḥ striyā daṇḍaḥ, puṃsor dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text:
Or one should commute [the lashing] into a monetary fine per stroke. — Thus [ends the section on] misconduct.
For a prohibited man and woman who render mutual services — for small articles, a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for large articles, twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; for silver and gold, fifty-four <s>paṇas</s> as the fine for the woman, double for the man.

children.text:
KAZ03.3.31/ ta eva^agamyayor ardha.daṇḍāḥ, tathā pratiṣiddha.puruṣa.vyavahāreṣu ca // iti pratiṣedhaḥ /
KAZ03.3.32ab/ rāja.dviṣṭa.aticārābhyām ātma.apakramaṇena ca /
KAZ03.3.32cd/ strī.dhana.ānīta.śulkānām asvāmyaṃ jāyate striyāḥ //E
children.translated_text:
The same [fines], halved, for those who are unmarriageable; likewise in dealings with prohibited men. — Thus [ends the section on] prohibitions.
Through [the offenses of] hostility to the king, misconduct, self-departure,
the woman loses ownership of the woman's property, bride-price, and ornaments.

children.text:
(ḷeaving home^ ṅoing away (with a man)^ ṣhort absence from home^ ḷong absence from home)
KAZ03.4.01/ pati.kulān niṣpatitāyāḥ striyāḥ ṣaṭ.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra viprakārāt //
children.translated_text:
(Leaving home; Going away [with a man]; Short absence from home; Long absence from home)
For a woman who leaves her husband's house — a fine of six <s>paṇas</s>, except when due to mistreatment.

children.text: KAZ03.4.02/ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ dvādaśa.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: When she has been prohibited, twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.4.03/ prativeśa.gṛha.atigatāyāḥ ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who goes to a neighbor's house — six <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.4.04/ prātiveśika.bhikṣuka.vaidehakānām avakāśa.bhikṣā.paṇya.dāne dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For neighbors, mendicant women, and female peddlers who provide space, alms, or goods [to such a woman] — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.4.05/ pratiṣiddhānāṃ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For those who have been prohibited — the first level of <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.4.06/ para.gṛha.atigatāyāś catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who goes to a stranger's house — twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.4.07/ para.bhāryā.avakāśa.dāne śatyo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra^āpadbhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: For giving shelter to another man's wife — a fine of one hundred, except in cases of distress.

children.text: KAZ03.4.08/ vāraṇa.ajñānayor nirdoṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: No offense for one who prevents [her leaving] or is unaware [of her identity].

children.text: KAZ03.4.09/ "pati.viprakārāt pati.jñāti.sukha.avastha.grāmika.anvādhi.bhikṣukī.jñāti.kulānām anyatamam apuruṣaṃ gantum adoṣaḥ" iti ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: "Due to the husband's mistreatment, it is not blameworthy [for a wife] to go, without a man, to any one of: [the house of] a person known to the husband, a kinsman, a comfortable place, the village headman, a surety, a nunnery, or a kinsman's house" — say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.4.10/ sa-puruṣaṃ vā jñāti.kulam //
children.translated_text: "Or to a kinsman's house even with a man."

children.text: KAZ03.4.11/ kuto hi sādhvī.janasyac^chalam //
children.translated_text: "For how can there be a pretext [for suspicion] among virtuous women?"

children.text: KAZ03.4.12/ sukham etad avaboddhum, iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: "This is easy to ascertain" — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.4.13/ preta.vyādhi.vyasana.garbha.nimittam apratiṣiddham eva jñāti.kula.gamanam //
children.translated_text: Going to a kinsman's house is not prohibited when the reason is death, disease, calamity, or pregnancy.

children.text: KAZ03.4.14/ tan.nimittaṃ vārayato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who prevents [her going] for those reasons — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text:
KAZ03.4.15/ tatra^api gūhamānā strī.dhanaṃ jīyeta, jñātayo vā chādayantaḥ śulka.śeṣam // iti niṣpatanam /
KAZ03.4.16/ pati.kulān niṣpatya grāma.antara.gamane dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ sthāpyā.ābharaṇa.lopaś ca //
children.translated_text:
Therein, a woman who conceals [her property] should forfeit her woman's property; or kinsmen who conceal [her] — [should forfeit] the remainder of the bride-price. — Thus [ends the section on] leaving home.
For one who, having left the husband's house, goes to another village — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>, loss of the ornaments to be set aside.

children.text: KAZ03.4.17/ gamyena vā puṃsā saha prasthāne catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ sarva.dharma.lopaś ca, anyatra bharma.dāna.tīrtha.gamanābhyām //
children.translated_text: For one who departs with an eligible man — twenty-four <s>paṇas</s> and loss of all [marital] entitlements, except in cases of [going to provide] maintenance, gifts, or to [visit] a sacred place.

children.text: KAZ03.4.18/ puṃsaḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ tulya.śreyasoḥ, pāpīyaso madhyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: For the man — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine [for intercourse] with a woman of equal status; the middle [level] for one of lower status.

children.text: KAZ03.4.19/ bandhur.adaṇḍyaḥ //
children.translated_text: A kinsman is not punishable.

children.text: KAZ03.4.20/ pratiṣedhe^ardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: In cases of prohibition — half the [respective] fines.

children.text: KAZ03.4.21/ pathi vyantare gūḍha.deśa.abhigamane maithuna.arthena śaṅkita.pratiṣiddhāyāṃ vā pathy.anusaraṇe saṃgrahaṇaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: Following [a woman] on a road or in a secluded place with the intention of intercourse, or following a woman who is suspected and has been forbidden [to meet him] — this should be known as solicitation (<s>saṃgrahaṇa</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.4.22/ tāla.avacara.cāraṇa.matsya.bandhaka.lubdhaka.go.pālaka.śauṇḍikānām anyeṣāṃ ca prasṛṣṭa.strīkāṇāṃ pathy.anusaraṇam adoṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: Following on the road is no offense for acrobats, wandering bards, fishermen, hunters, cowherds, tavern-keepers, and others whose women are freely accessible.

children.text:
KAZ03.4.23/ pratiṣiddhe vā nayataḥ puṃsaḥ striyo vā gacchantyās ta eva^ardha.daṇḍāḥ // iti pathy.anusaraṇam /
KAZ03.4.24/ hrasva.pravāsināṃ śūdra.vaiśya.kṣatriya.brāhmaṇānāṃ bhāryāḥ saṃvatsara.uttaraṃ kālam ākāṅkṣeran aprajātāḥ, saṃvatsara.adhikaṃ prajātāḥ //
children.translated_text:
But when [a man] takes [a woman] despite prohibition, or when a woman goes [to a man] despite prohibition — the same half-fines [apply]. — Thus [ends the section on] following on the road.
The wives of <s>Śūdras</s>, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, and <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who have gone on a short journey should wait, if without children, for one year beyond [the expected return], and if with children, beyond one year more.

children.text: KAZ03.4.25/ prativihitā dvi.guṇaṃ kālam //
children.translated_text: If [the husband] has made provisions — double that period.

children.text: KAZ03.4.26/ aprativihitāḥ sukha.avasthā bibhṛyuḥ, paraṃ catvāri varṣāṇy aṣṭau vā jñātayaḥ //
children.translated_text: If [the husband] has made no provisions, those in comfortable circumstances should maintain [themselves]; beyond that, [the wife should wait] four years, or [her] kinsmen [should maintain her for] eight years.

children.text: KAZ03.4.27/ tato yathā.dattam ādāya pramuñceyuḥ //
children.translated_text: After that, taking what was given [at marriage], they may release [her from the bond].

children.text: KAZ03.4.28/ brāhmaṇam adhīyānaṃ daśa.varṣāṇy aprajātā, dvādaśa prajātā, rāja.puruṣam āyuḥ.kṣayād ākāṅkṣeta //
children.translated_text: A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who is studying — a childless [wife] should wait ten years, one with children twelve years; a wife of a royal servant should wait until the end of his life.

children.text: KAZ03.4.29/ savarṇataś ca prajātā na^apavādaṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: And a woman who has borne children by a man of equal class should not be subject to reproach.

children.text: KAZ03.4.30/ kuṭumba.ṛddhi.lope vā sukha.avasthair vimuktā yathā.iṣṭaṃ vindeta, jīvita.artham āpad.gatā vā //
children.translated_text: Or, if the family fortune is being ruined, she may be released by those in comfortable circumstances and may marry whomever she wishes, or if she has fallen into distress for [the sake of] livelihood.

children.text: KAZ03.4.31/ dharma.vivāhāt kumārī parigrahītāram anākhyāya proṣitam aśrūyamāṇaṃ sapta tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta, saṃvatsaraṃ śrūyamāṇam //
children.translated_text: A maiden wedded through a <s>dharma</s> marriage should, if her betrothed departs without informing [her] and is not heard of, wait seven cycles of [seasonal] festivals; if he is heard of, one year.

children.text: KAZ03.4.32/ ākhyāya proṣitam aśrūyamāṇaṃ pañca tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta, daśa śrūyamāṇam //
children.translated_text: If he departed after informing [her] and is not heard of, she should wait five cycles; if heard of, ten.

children.text: KAZ03.4.33/ eka.deśa.datta.śulkaṃ trīṇi tīrthāny aśrūyamāṇam, śrūyamāṇaṃ sapta tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta //
children.translated_text: If the bride-price has been partially paid and he is not heard of — three cycles; if heard of — seven cycles.

children.text: KAZ03.4.34/ datta.śulkaṃ pañca tīrthāny aśrūyamāṇam, daśa śrūyamāṇam //
children.translated_text: If the bride-price has been fully paid and he is not heard of — five cycles; if heard of — ten.

children.text: KAZ03.4.35/ tataḥ paraṃ dharmasthair visṛṣṭā yathā.iṣṭaṃ vindeta //
children.translated_text: After that, released by the judges (<s>dharmastha</s>), she may marry whomever she wishes.

children.text: KAZ03.4.36/ tīrtha.uparodho hi dharma.vadha iti kauṭilyaḥ // iti hrasva.pravāsaḥ //
children.translated_text: For obstruction of [the woman's right to remarry at] the proper time is destruction of <s>dharma</s> — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>. — Thus [ends the section on] short absence.

children.text: KAZ03.4.37/ dīrgha.pravāsinaḥ pravrajitasya pretasya vā bhāryā sapta tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta, saṃvatsaraṃ prajātā //
children.translated_text: The wife of one who has gone on a long journey, or has become an ascetic, or has died, should wait seven cycles of festivals; one with children — one year.

children.text: KAZ03.4.38/ tataḥ pati.sodaryaṃ gacchet //
children.translated_text: After that, she should go to her husband's brother.

children.text: KAZ03.4.39/ bahuṣu pratyāsannaṃ dhārmikaṃ bharma.samarthaṃ kaniṣṭham abhāryaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: Among many [brothers]: the nearest one, the most virtuous, one capable of supporting her, the youngest, or one who is unmarried.

children.text: KAZ03.4.40/ tad.abhāve^apy asodaryaṃ sapiṇḍaṃ kulyaṃ vā^āsannam //
children.translated_text: In their absence, even a non-brother — a <s>sapiṇḍa</s> (close agnate), a <s>kulya</s> (clan member), or the nearest [kinsman].

children.text: KAZ03.4.41/ eteṣām eṣa eva kramaḥ //
children.translated_text: For these, this same order [applies].

children.text:
KAZ03.4.42ab/ etān utkramya dāyādān vedane jāra.karmaṇi /
KAZ03.4.42cd/ jāra.strī.dātṛ.vettāraḥ samprāptāḥ saṃgraha.atyayam //E
children.translated_text:
Those who, bypassing these heirs, engage in the act of an adulterer —
the adulterer, the woman, and the giver and the witness — all incur the penalty for solicitation.

children.text:
(Partition of inheritance)
(Order of inheritance)
KAZ03.5.01/ anīśvarāḥ pitṛmantaḥ sthita.pitṛ.mātṛkāḥ putrāḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Partition of inheritance)
(Order of inheritance)
Sons under paternal authority are those whose father is alive and whose mother and father are both living.

children.text: KAZ03.5.02/ teṣām ūrdhvaṃ pitṛto dāya.vibhāgaḥ pitṛ.dravyāṇām //
children.translated_text: For them, the partition of the father's property [takes place] after the father [dies].

children.text: KAZ03.5.03/ svayaṃ.ārjitam avibhājyam, anyatra pitṛ.dravyād utthitebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: Self-acquired property is not subject to partition, except [property] that has arisen from the father's property.

children.text: KAZ03.5.04/ pitṛ.dravyād avibhakta.upagatānāṃ putrāḥ pautrā vā ā.caturthād ity aṃśa.bhājaḥ //
children.translated_text: Sons and grandsons of those who have come into possession of the father's property without partition — up to the fourth [generation] — are entitled to shares.

children.text: KAZ03.5.05/ tāvad avicchinnaḥ piṇḍo bhavati //
children.translated_text: For that long, the funeral offering (<s>piṇḍa</s>) continues unbroken.

children.text: KAZ03.5.06/ vicchinna.piṇḍāḥ sarve samaṃ vibhajeran //
children.translated_text: Those whose funeral-offering connection is broken should all divide equally.

children.text: KAZ03.5.07/ apitṛ.dravyā vibhakta.pitṛ.dravyā vā saha jīvantaḥ punar vibhajeran //
children.translated_text: Those who have no paternal property, or whose paternal property has already been divided, but who live together, may divide again.

children.text: KAZ03.5.08/ yataś ca^uttiṣṭheta sa dvy.aṃśaṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: And whatever [property] arises [from the common fund], the one from whom it arises should receive a double share.

children.text: KAZ03.5.09/ dravyam aputrasya sodaryā bhrātaraḥ saha.jīvino vā hareyuḥ kanyāś ca //
children.translated_text: The property of one who has no son — his uterine brothers or those living together should take it, along with [unmarried] daughters.

children.text: KAZ03.5.10/ rikthaṃ putravataḥ putrā duhitaro vā dharmiṣṭheṣu vivāheṣu jātāḥ //
children.translated_text: The estate of one who has sons — his sons or daughters born in righteous marriages [inherit].

children.text: KAZ03.5.11/ tad.abhāve pitā dharamāṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: In their absence — the father, if still alive.

children.text: KAZ03.5.12/ pitr.abhāve bhrātaro bhrātṛ.putrāś ca //
children.translated_text: In the absence of the father — the brothers or the brothers' sons.

children.text: KAZ03.5.13/ apitṛkā bahavo^api ca bhrātaro bhrātṛ.putrāś ca pitur ekam aṃśaṃ hareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Many brothers and brothers' sons, even if fatherless, should take only one share [equal to that] of the father.

children.text: KAZ03.5.14/ sodaryāṇām aneka.pitṛkāṇāṃ pitṛto dāya.vibhāgaḥ //03.5.15/ pitṛ.bhrātṛ.putrāṇāṃ pūrve vidyamāne na^aparam avalambante, jyeṣṭhe ca kaniṣṭham artha.grāhiṇam //
children.translated_text:
For uterine brothers who have different fathers, the partition of inheritance is from each father [separately].
Among paternal uncles' sons, the prior [generation] being present, the latter does not inherit; and the eldest [takes precedence], with the youngest receiving a property-share.

children.text: KAZ03.5.16/ jīvad.vibhāge pitā na^ekaṃ viśeṣayet //
children.translated_text: In a partition during [the father's] lifetime, the father should not favor one [son over others].

children.text: KAZ03.5.17/ na ca^ekam akāraṇān nirvibhajeta //
children.translated_text: Nor should he disinherit any one [son] without cause.

children.text: KAZ03.5.18/ pitur asaty arthe jyeṣṭhāḥ kaniṣṭhān anugṛhṇīyuḥ, anyatra mithyā.vṛttebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: When the father has no property, the elder brothers should support the younger ones, except those of wrongful conduct.

children.text: KAZ03.5.19/ prāpta.vyavahārāṇāṃ vibhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: Partition [is made] for those who have attained legal majority.

children.text: KAZ03.5.20/ aprāpta.vyavahārāṇāṃ deya.viśuddhaṃ mātṛ.bandhuṣu grāma.vṛddheṣu vā sthāpayeyuḥ ā.vyavahāra.prāpaṇāt, proṣitasya vā //
children.translated_text: For those who have not attained legal majority, [the guardians] should deposit their share, cleared of debts, with maternal kinsmen or village elders, until they attain majority, or [until the return] of an absent [heir].

children.text: KAZ03.5.21/ samniviṣṭa.samam asamniviṣṭebhyo naiveśanikaṃ dadyuḥ, kanyābhyaś ca prādānikam //
children.translated_text: They should give to those not yet settled [in life] a marriage gift equal to [what was given to] those already settled, and to [unmarried] daughters a betrothal gift.

children.text: KAZ03.5.22/ ṛṇa.rikthayoḥ samo vibhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: The partition of debts and inheritance is equal.

children.text: KAZ03.5.23/ "uda.pātrāṇy api niṣkiṃcanā vibhajeran" ity ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: "Even if destitute, they should divide even the water-pots" — say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.5.24/ chalam etad iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: "This is a subterfuge" — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.5.25/ sato^arthasya vibhāgo na^asataḥ //
children.translated_text: Partition is of what exists, not of what does not exist.

children.text: KAZ03.5.26/ etāvān arthaḥ sāmānyas tasya^etāvān praty.aṃśa ity anubhāṣya bruvan sākṣiṣu vibhāgaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: Having declared before witnesses — "This much is the common property, this much is each one's share" — he should carry out the partition.

children.text: KAZ03.5.27/ durvibhaktam anyonya.apahṛtam antarhitam avijñāta.utpannaṃ vā punar vibhajeran //
children.translated_text: What was poorly divided, mutually appropriated, concealed, or [whose origin] was unknown, should be divided again.

children.text: KAZ03.5.28/ adāyādakaṃ rājā haret strī.vṛtti.preta.kārya.varjam, anyatra śrotriya.dravyāt //
children.translated_text: Property without an heir the king should take, except [what is needed for] the maintenance of the wife and the funeral rites, and except the property of a learned <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.5.29/ tat traivedyebhyaḥ prayacchet //
children.translated_text: That [Brāhmaṇa's property] he should give to those learned in the three Vedas.

children.text: KAZ03.5.30/ patitaḥ patitāj jātaḥ klībaś ca^anaṃśāḥ, jaḍa.unmatta.andha.kuṣṭhinaś ca //
children.translated_text: An outcast, one born from an outcast, a eunuch — these have no share; as well as the mentally deficient, the insane, the blind, and lepers.

children.text: KAZ03.5.31/ sati bhārya.arthe teṣām apatyam atad.vidhaṃ bhāgaṃ haret //
children.translated_text: If there is property for [their] wives, their offspring — if not of the same [defective] kind — should take the share.

children.text: KAZ03.5.32/ grāsa.ācchādanam itare patita.varjāḥ //
children.translated_text: The others [i.e., the defective ones], except the outcast, [should receive] food and clothing.

children.text:
KAZ03.5.33ab/ teṣāṃ ca kṛta.dārāṇāṃ lupte prajanane sati /
KAZ03.5.33cd/ sṛjeyur bāndhavāḥ putrāṃs teṣām aṃśān prakalpayet //E
children.translated_text:
And for those among them who have been married, when their procreative capacity has been lost,
the kinsmen should beget sons through [their wives]; for those [sons], shares should be allotted.

children.text:
(ḍivision into shares)
KAZ03.6.01/ eka.strī.putrāṇāṃ jyeṣṭha.aṃśaḥ - brāhmaṇānām ajāḥ, kṣatriyāṇām aśvāḥ, vaiśyānāṃ gāvaḥ, śūdrāṇām avayaḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Division into shares)
For sons of one wife, the eldest son's [preferential] share is: for <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> — goats; for <s>Kṣatriyas</s> — horses; for <s>Vaiśyas</s> — cows; for <s>Śūdras</s> — sheep.

children.text: KAZ03.6.02/ kāṇa.laṅgās teṣāṃ madhyama.aṃśaḥ, bhinna.varṇāḥ kaniṣṭha.aṃśaḥ //
children.translated_text: One-eyed and lame [animals] of those are the middling son's share; those of mixed color are the youngest son's share.

children.text: KAZ03.6.03/ catuṣpada.abhāve ratna.varjānāṃ daśānāṃ bhāgaṃ dravyāṇām ekaṃ jyeṣṭho haret //
children.translated_text: In the absence of quadrupeds, the eldest should take one-tenth of the goods, excluding gems.

children.text: KAZ03.6.04/ pratimukta.svadhā.pāśo hi bhavati //
children.translated_text: For [the eldest], released from the bond of funeral offerings, [bears the responsibility].

children.text: KAZ03.6.05/ ity auśanaso vibhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: This is the division according to <s>Uśanas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.6.06/ pituḥ parivāpād yānam ābharaṇaṃ ca jyeṣṭha.aṃśaḥ, śayana.āsanaṃ bhukta.kāṃsyaṃ ca madhyama.aṃśaḥ, kṛṣṇaṃ dhānya.āyasaṃ gṛha.parivāpo go.śakaṭaṃ ca kaniṣṭha.aṃśaḥ //
children.translated_text: From the father's personal belongings: the vehicle and ornaments are the eldest son's share; the bed, seat, and used bronze [vessels] are the middling son's share; black [goods], grain, iron [implements], household belongings, cattle, and cart are the youngest son's share.

children.text: KAZ03.6.07/ śeṣa.dravyāṇām eka.dravyasya vā samo vibhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: Of the remaining goods, or of a single [type of] goods, the division is equal.

children.text: KAZ03.6.08/ adāyādā bhaginyaḥ, mātuḥ parivāpād bhukta.kāṃsya.ābharaṇa.bhāginyaḥ //
children.translated_text: Sisters are not heirs; [but they receive] from the mother's personal belongings a share of the used bronze [vessels] and ornaments.

children.text: KAZ03.6.09/ mānuṣa.hīno jyeṣṭhas tṛtīyam aṃśaṃ jyeṣṭha.aṃśāl labheta, caturtham anyāya.vṛttiḥ, nivṛtta.dharma.kāryo vā //
children.translated_text: The eldest, if lacking in human qualities, should receive one-third of the eldest share; one-fourth if of unrighteous conduct, or if he has abandoned the performance of religious duties.

children.text: KAZ03.6.10/ kāma.ācāraḥ sarvaṃ jīyeta //
children.translated_text: One who follows his own whims should lose everything.

children.text: KAZ03.6.11/ tena madhyama.kaniṣṭhau vyākhyātau //
children.translated_text: By this, the middling and youngest [sons] are explained.

children.text: KAZ03.6.12/ tayor mānuṣa.upeto jyeṣṭha.aṃśād ardhaṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: Of these, the one endowed with human qualities should receive half the eldest share.

children.text: KAZ03.6.13/ nānā.strī.putrāṇāṃ tu saṃskṛta.asaṃskṛtayoḥ kanyā.kṛta.kṣatayor abhāve ca ekasyāḥ putrayor yamayor vā pūrva.janmanā jyeṣṭha.bhāvaḥ //
children.translated_text: But for sons of different wives: [eldership is determined by] — as between one whose [mother's marriage] sacrament has been performed and one whose has not, and as between one whose [mother] is a maiden and one whose is a repurchased [bride] — seniority is by prior birth, or [by birth from] a twin; and in the absence [of these distinctions, by birth] from [the mother of higher status].

children.text: KAZ03.6.14/ sūta.māgadha.vrātya.ratha.kārāṇām aiśvaryato vibhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: For <s>sūtas</s> (charioteers), <s>māgadhas</s> (bards), <s>vrātyas</s> (degraded twice-born), and <s>rathakāras</s> (chariot-makers) — partition is by authority [i.e., according to power].

children.text: KAZ03.6.15/ śeṣās tam upajīveyuḥ //
children.translated_text: The rest should live dependent on him [who holds authority].

children.text: KAZ03.6.16/ anīśvarāḥ sama.vibhāgāḥ //
children.translated_text: Those without authority [divide] equally.

children.text: KAZ03.6.17/ cāturvarṇya.putrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇī.putraś caturo^aṃśān haret, kṣatriyā.putra.strīn aṃśān, vaiśyā.putro dvāv aṃśau, ekaṃ śūdrā.putraḥ //
children.translated_text: For sons of a man of all four classes: the <s>Brāhmaṇī</s>'s son takes four shares; the <s>Kṣatriyā</s>'s son — three shares; the <s>Vaiśyā</s>'s son — two shares; the <s>Śūdrā</s>'s son — one.

children.text: KAZ03.6.18/ tena tri.varṇa.dvi.varṇa.putra.vibhāgaḥ kṣatriya.vaiśyayor vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, the division of sons of three classes and two classes [wives] for <s>Kṣatriyas</s> and <s>Vaiśyas</s> is explained.

children.text: KAZ03.6.19/ brāhmaṇasya^anantarā.putras tulya.aṃśaḥ //
children.translated_text: For a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, the son of the wife of the next [lower] class receives an equal share.

children.text: KAZ03.6.20/ kṣatriya.vaiśyayor ardha.aṃśaḥ tulya.aṃśo vā mānuṣa.upetaḥ //
children.translated_text: For a <s>Kṣatriya</s> or <s>Vaiśya</s>, [the son of the next lower class wife receives] half a share, or an equal share if endowed with human qualities.

children.text: KAZ03.6.21/ tulya.atulyayor eka.putraḥ sarvaṃ haret, bandhūṃś ca bibhṛyāt //
children.translated_text: Among equal and unequal [wives], a single son takes everything and should support the kinsmen.

children.text: KAZ03.6.22/ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu pāraśavas tṛtīyam aṃśaṃ labheta, dvāv aṃśau sapiṇḍaḥ kulyo vā^āsannaḥ, svadhā.dāna.hetoḥ //
children.translated_text: But for <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, a <s>pāraśava</s> (son by a <s>Śūdrā</s>) takes one-third of the share; the <s>sapiṇḍa</s> or nearest <s>kulya</s> [takes] two shares, for the purpose of offering funeral oblations.

children.text: KAZ03.6.23/ tad.abhāve pitur ācāryo^antevāsī vā //
children.translated_text: In their absence, the father's teacher or pupil.

children.text:
KAZ03.6.24ab/ kṣetre vā janayed asya niyuktaḥ kṣetrajaṃ sutam /
KAZ03.6.24cd/ mātṛ.bandhuḥ sagotro vā tasmai tat pradiśed dhanam //E
children.translated_text:
Or, one appointed [to beget a son] should beget a son begotten on the [deceased's] wife;
a maternal kinsman or one of the same <s>gotra</s> — to him that property should be assigned.

children.text:
(Classification of sons)
KAZ03.7.01/ "para.parigrahe bījam utsṛṣṭaṃ kṣetriṇaḥ" ity ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Classification of sons)
"Seed sown in another's field [belongs to] the owner of the field" — say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.7.02/ "mātā bhastrā, yasya retas tasya^apatyam" ity apare //
children.translated_text: "The mother is [merely] a leather bag; the offspring belongs to the one whose semen [it is]" — say others.

children.text: KAZ03.7.03/ vidyamānam ubhayam iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: Both [principles] are valid — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.04/ svayaṃ.jātaḥ kṛta.kriyāyām aurasaḥ //
children.translated_text: One born by oneself on a wife whose rites have been performed is a legitimate son (<s>aurasa</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.7.05/ tena tulyaḥ putrikā.putraḥ //
children.translated_text: Equal to him is the son of an appointed daughter (<s>putrikāputra</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.7.06/ sagotreṇa^anya.gotreṇa vā niyuktena kṣetra.jātaḥ kṣetrajaḥ putraḥ //
children.translated_text: One begotten on [the wife] by an appointed man of the same or different <s>gotra</s>, born in the [husband's] field, is a <s>kṣetraja</s> (field-born) son.
