children.text: KAZ03.7.07/ janayitur asaty anyasmin putre sa eva dvi.pitṛko dvi.gotro vā dvayor api svadhā.riktha.bhāg bhavati //
children.translated_text: If the begetter has no other son, that [kṣetraja] is called a son of two fathers or of two <s>gotras</s>, and inherits the funeral offerings and estate of both.

children.text: KAZ03.7.08/ tat.sadharmā bandhūnāṃ gṛhe gūḍha.jātas tu gūḍhajaḥ //
children.translated_text: Of similar nature: one secretly born in the house of kinsmen is a <s>gūḍhaja</s> (secretly born) son.

children.text: KAZ03.7.09/ bandhunā^utsṛṣṭo^apaviddhaḥ saṃskartuḥ putraḥ //
children.translated_text: One abandoned by a kinsman and then adopted is an <s>apaviddha</s> (cast-off) son — he is the son of the one who performs the sacraments.

children.text: KAZ03.7.10/ kanyā.garbhaḥ kānīnaḥ //
children.translated_text: One born [while the mother is still] a maiden is a <s>kānīna</s> (maiden-born) son.

children.text: KAZ03.7.11/ sagarbha.ūḍhāyāḥ saha.ūḍhaḥ //
children.translated_text: One born of [a woman] who was married while already pregnant is a <s>sahūḍha</s> (brought-along) son.

children.text: KAZ03.7.12/ punar.bhūtāyāḥ paunarbhavaḥ //
children.translated_text: One born of a remarried woman is a <s>paunarbhava</s> (son of a remarried woman).

children.text: KAZ03.7.13/ svayaṃ.jātaḥ pitur bandhūnāṃ ca dāyādaḥ //
children.translated_text: A self-born [legitimate] son inherits from both the father and the father's kinsmen.

children.text: KAZ03.7.14/ para.jātaḥ saṃskartur eva na bandhūnām //
children.translated_text: A son born of another [man's seed] inherits only from the one who performed the sacraments, not from [that man's] kinsmen.

children.text: KAZ03.7.15/ tat.sadharmā mātā.pitṛbhyām adbhir mukto dattaḥ //
children.translated_text: Of similar nature: one given away by both mother and father with water [libation] is a <s>datta</s> (given) son.

children.text: KAZ03.7.16/ svayaṃ bandhubhir vā putra.bhāva.upagata upagataḥ //
children.translated_text: One who has himself, or through kinsmen, entered into the status of a son is an <s>upagata</s> (self-offered) son.

children.text: KAZ03.7.17/ putratve^adhikṛtaḥ kṛtakaḥ //
children.translated_text: One appointed to sonship is a <s>kṛtaka</s> (made) son.

children.text:
KAZ03.7.18/ parikrītaḥ krītaḥ // iti /
KAZ03.7.19/ aurase tu^utpanne savarṇās tṛtīya.aṃśa.harāḥ, asavarṇā grāsa.ācchādana.bhāginaḥ //
children.translated_text:
One purchased is a <s>krīta</s> (bought) son. — Thus [ends the enumeration].
But when a legitimate son (<s>aurasa</s>) is born, those of the same class [among the secondary sons] take one-third share; those of a different class [receive only] food and clothing.

children.text: KAZ03.7.20/ brāhmaṇa.kṣatriyayor anantarā.putrāḥ savarṇāḥ, eka.antarā asavarṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: For a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> and a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, sons of the next [lower] class wife are of equal class; those once removed are of different class.

children.text: KAZ03.7.21/ brāhmaṇasya vaiśyāyām ambaṣṭhaḥ, śūdrāyāṃ niṣādaḥ pāraśavo vā //
children.translated_text: For a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>: [the son] by a <s>Vaiśyā</s> woman is an <s>ambaṣṭha</s>; by a <s>Śūdrā</s> woman, a <s>niṣāda</s> or <s>pāraśava</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.22/ kṣatriyasya śūdrāyām ugraḥ //
children.translated_text: For a <s>Kṣatriya</s>: [the son] by a <s>Śūdrā</s> woman is an <s>ugra</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.23/ śūdra eva vaiśyasya //
children.translated_text: For a <s>Vaiśya</s>: [the son by a <s>Śūdrā</s> woman] is simply a <s>Śūdra</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.24/ savarṇāsu ca^eṣām acarita.vratebhyo jātā vrātyāḥ //
children.translated_text: And those born to women of equal class from men who have not performed the [proper] rites are <s>vrātyas</s> (degraded twice-born).

children.text: KAZ03.7.25/ ity anulomāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.25/ These are the offspring in the natural order (<s>anuloma</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.7.26/ śūdrād āyogava.kṣatta.caṇḍālāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.26/ From a <s>Śūdra</s> [father]: <s>Āyogava</s>, <s>Kṣattṛ</s>, and <s>Caṇḍāla</s> [are born of women of the three higher classes].

children.text: KAZ03.7.27/ vaiśyān māgadha.vaidehakau //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.27/ From a <s>Vaiśya</s> [father]: <s>Māgadha</s> and <s>Vaideha</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.28/ kṣatriyāt sūtaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.28/ From a <s>Kṣatriya</s> [father]: <s>Sūta</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.29/ paurāṇikas tv anyaḥ sūto māgadhaś ca, brahma.kṣatrād viśeṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.29/ According to the <s>Purāṇas</s>, however, <s>Sūta</s> and <s>Māgadha</s> are different, [being born] from a <s>Brahma-Kṣatra</s> [union]; that is the distinction.

children.text: KAZ03.7.30/ ta ete pratilomāḥ svadharma.atikramād rājñaḥ sambhavanti //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.30/ These are the offspring in the inverse order (<s>pratiloma</s>); they arise from the king's failure to enforce proper duty (<s>svadharma</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.7.31/ ugrān naiṣādyāṃ kukkuṭaḥ, viparyaye pulkasaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.31/ From an <s>Ugra</s> [father] and a <s>Naiṣāda</s> [mother]: <s>Kukkuṭa</s>; in the reverse, <s>Pulkasa</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.32/ vaidehikāyām ambaṣṭhād vaiṇaḥ, viparyaye kuśīlavaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.32/ From an <s>Ambaṣṭha</s> [father] and a <s>Vaidehikā</s> [mother]: <s>Vaiṇa</s>; in the reverse, <s>Kuśīlava</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.33/ kṣattāyām ugrāt^śva.pākaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.33/ From an <s>Ugra</s> [father] and a <s>Kṣattā</s> [mother]: <s>Śvapāka</s> (dog-cooker).

children.text: KAZ03.7.34/ ity ete^anye ca^antarālāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.34/ These and others are the intermediate (<s>antarāla</s>) castes.

children.text: KAZ03.7.35/ karmaṇā vaiśyo ratha.kāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.35/ A <s>Vaiśya</s> becomes a chariot-maker (<s>Rathakāra</s>) by occupation.

children.text: KAZ03.7.36/ teṣāṃ sva.yonau vivāhaḥ, pūrva.apara.gāmitvaṃ vṛtta.anuvṛttaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.36/ Marriage for them is within their own caste; the order of precedence is from higher to lower, and conduct follows established custom.

children.text: KAZ03.7.37/ śūdra.sadharmāṇo vā, anyatra caṇḍālebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.37/ Or they follow the same rules as <s>Śūdras</s>, except for <s>Caṇḍālas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.7.38/ kevalam evaṃ vartamānaḥ svargam āpnoti rājā, narakam anyathā //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.38/ A king who conducts himself solely in this manner attains heaven; otherwise, hell.

children.text: KAZ03.7.39/ sarveṣām antarālānāṃ samo vibhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.7.39/ The share is equal for all intermediate castes.

children.text:
KAZ03.7.40ab/ deśasya jātyāḥ saṃghasya dharmo grāmasya vā^api yaḥ /
KAZ03.7.40cd/ ucitas tasya tena^eva dāya.dharmaṃ prakalpayet //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.7.40ab/ The established custom of a region, a caste, a guild, or a village —
KAZ03.7.40cd/ according to that very custom, one should determine the law of inheritance.

children.text:
(Immovable property)
(ḍwelling-places)
KAZ03.8.01/ sāmanta.pratyayā vāstu.vivādāḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Immovable property)
(Dwelling-places)
KAZ03.8.01/ Disputes concerning immovable property are [decided] on the testimony of neighbors.

children.text: KAZ03.8.02/ gṛhaṃ kṣetram ārāmaḥ setu.bandhas taṭākam ādhāro vā vāstuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.02/ Immovable property (<s>vāstu</s>) is: a house, a field, a garden, an embankment, a reservoir, or a water-channel.

children.text: KAZ03.8.03/ karṇa.kīla.āyasa.sambandho^anugṛhaṃ setuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.03/ A party-wall is [recognized by] the connection of beams, pegs, and iron [fittings] with the adjacent house.

children.text: KAZ03.8.04/ yathā.setu.bhogaṃ veśma kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.04/ He should have a dwelling constructed according to the enjoyment [rights indicated by] the party-wall.

children.text: KAZ03.8.05/ abhūtaṃ vā para.kuḍyād apakramya dvāv aratnī tripadīṃ vā deśa.bandhaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.05/ Or, on previously unbuilt [land], withdrawing two cubits or three feet from the neighbor's wall, he should make a boundary marker.

children.text: KAZ03.8.06/ avaskaraṃ bhramam uda.pānaṃ vā na gṛha.ucitād anyatra, anyatra sūtikā.kūpād ā.nirdaśa.ahād iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.06/ A refuse-pit, a latrine, or a well should not be [dug] anywhere other than the customary place for the house — except a lying-in well [for a mother], for up to ten days [after childbirth].

children.text: KAZ03.8.07/ tasya^atikrame pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.07/ For transgressing this, the first level <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.8.08/ tena^indhanāvaghātana.kṛtaṃ kalyāṇa.kṛtyeṣv ācāma.udaka.mārgāś ca vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.08/ By this are also explained the [rules for] firewood-sheds, pounding-mortars, auspicious ceremonies, and channels for rinsing water.

children.text: KAZ03.8.09/ tripadī.pratikrāntam adhyardham aratniṃ vā gāḍha.prasṛtam udaka.mārgaṃ prasravaṇa.prapātaṃ vā kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.09/ Extending three feet, or one and a half cubits, [from the wall], he should construct a deeply channeled water-drain or a run-off cascade.

children.text: KAZ03.8.10/ tasya^atikrame catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.10/ For transgressing this, the fine is fifty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.8.11/ ekapadī.pratikrāntam aratniṃ vā cakri.catuṣpada.sthānam agniṣṭham udan.jara.sthānaṃ rocanīṃ kuṭṭanīṃ vā kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.11/ Extending one foot, or one cubit, [from the wall], he should construct a place for carts and four-footed animals, a fire-pit, a drain-outlet, or a dyeing or washing [facility].

children.text: KAZ03.8.12/ tasya^atikrame catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.12/ For transgressing this, the fine is twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.8.13/ sarva.vāstukayoḥ prākṣiptakayor vā śālayoḥ kiṣkur antarikā tripadī vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.13/ Between any two dwellings, whether pre-existing or newly constructed, the interval should be one <s>kiṣku</s> (cubit) or three feet.

children.text: KAZ03.8.14/ tayoś catur.aṅgulaṃ nīpra.antaram<nīvra.antaram?> samārūḍhakaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.14/ Between them, the eaves-gap should be four finger-breadths, or [the eaves may be] overlapping.

children.text: KAZ03.8.15/ kiṣku.mātram āṇi.dvāram antarikāyāṃ khaṇḍa.phulla.artham asampātaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.15/ In the interval, a doorway of one cubit [wide] with a pin-lock should be made for the purpose of repairs, without [the structures'] [rain-]water converging.

children.text: KAZ03.8.16/ prakāśa.artham alpam ūrdhvaṃ vāta.ayanaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.16/ For light, a small upward ventilation opening should be made.

children.text: KAZ03.8.17/ tad.avasite veśmanic^chādayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.17/ At its boundary, he should cover the dwelling [with roofing].

children.text: KAZ03.8.18/ sambhūya vā gṛha.svāmino yathā.iṣṭaṃ kārayeyuḥ, aniṣṭaṃ vārayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.18/ Or the house-owners, jointly, may construct as they wish and prevent what is unwanted.

children.text: KAZ03.8.19/ vāna.laṭyāś ca^ūrdhvam āvārya.bhāgaṃ kaṭa.pracchannam avamarśa.bhittiṃ vā kārayed varṣa.ābādha.bhayāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.19/ And above the ground-floor ledge, he should make a mat-covered overflow section or a rain-protection wall, for fear of rain damage.

children.text: KAZ03.8.20/ tasya^atikrame pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, pratiloma.dvāra.vāta.ayana.bādhāyāṃ ca, anyatra rāja.mārga.rathyābhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.20/ For transgressing this, the first level <s>sāhasa</s> fine; also for obstruction through reverse-facing doors and ventilation openings — except [those opening onto] the royal highway or a main road.

children.text: KAZ03.8.21/ khāta.sopāna.praṇālī.niśreṇy.avaskara.bhāgair bahir.bādhāyāṃ bhoga.nigrahe ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.21/ [The same fine applies] for external obstruction through excavated steps, drain-pipes, ladders, or refuse-sections, and for restricting enjoyment [of the property].

children.text: KAZ03.8.22/ para.kuḍyam udakena^upaghnato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, mūtra.purīṣa.upaghāte dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.22/ For damaging a neighbor's wall with water — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for damage with urine or excrement — double.

children.text: KAZ03.8.23/ praṇālī.mokṣo varṣati, anyathā dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.23/ Drain-pipes may be opened during rain; otherwise, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.8.24/ pratiṣiddhasya ca vasataḥ, nirasyataś ca^avakrayiṇam anyatra pāruṣya.steya.sāhasa.saṃgrahaṇa.mithyā.bhogebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.24/ [The same fine] for one who resides [in a property] after being prohibited, and for one who evicts a tenant — except in cases of violence, theft, violent offense, sheltering [criminals], or fraudulent use.

children.text: KAZ03.8.25/ svayaṃ.abhiprasthito varṣa.avakraya.śeṣaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.25/ One who departs voluntarily should pay the remainder of the year's rent.

children.text: KAZ03.8.26/ sāmānye veśmani sāhāyyam aprayacchataḥ, sāmānyam uparundhato bhogaṃ ca gṛhe dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.26/ For one who does not render assistance regarding a shared dwelling, or who obstructs shared [use], or [obstructs] the enjoyment of the house — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.8.27/ vināśayatas tad.dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.8.27/ For destroying [it] — double that.

children.text:
KAZ03.8.28ab/ koṣṭhaka.aṅgaṇa.varcānām agni.kuṭṭana.śālayoḥ /
KAZ03.8.28cd/ vivṛtānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo bhoga iṣyate //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.8.28ab/ Of storerooms, courtyards, latrines, the fire-hall, the pounding-shed,
KAZ03.8.28cd/ and all open [areas] — shared enjoyment is prescribed.

children.text:
(ṣale of immovable property^ Fixing of boundaries^ Encroachment and ḍamage)
KAZ03.9.01/ jñāti.sāmanta.dhanikāḥ krameṇa bhūmi.parigrahān kretum abhyābhaveyuḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Sale of immovable property; Fixing of boundaries; Encroachment and damage)
KAZ03.9.01/ Kinsmen, neighbors, and creditors should have priority, in that order, to purchase immovable properties.

children.text: KAZ03.9.02/ tato^anye bāhyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.02/ After them, outsiders.

children.text: KAZ03.9.03/ sāmanta.catvāriṃśat.kulyeṣu gṛha.pratimukhe veśma śrāvayeyuḥ, sāmanta.grāma.vṛddheṣu kṣetram ārāmaṃ setu.bandhaṃ taṭākam ādhāraṃ vā maryādāsu yathā.setu.bhogaṃ "anena^argheṇa kaḥ kretā" iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.03/ In the presence of forty neighbors, they should announce at the front of the house a dwelling [for sale]; and among the neighbors and village elders, [announce] a field, garden, embankment, reservoir, or water-channel at the boundaries, according to the enjoyment-rights of the party-wall: "At this price, who will buy?"

children.text: KAZ03.9.04/ trir āghuṣitam avyāhataṃ kretā kretuṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.04/ After being proclaimed three times without objection, the buyer may purchase.

children.text: KAZ03.9.05/ spardhayā vā mūlya.vardhane mūlya.vṛddhiḥ sa-śulkā kośaṃ gacchet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.05/ Or if the price is raised through competition, the price increase together with the transaction tax goes to the treasury.

children.text: KAZ03.9.06/ vikraya.pratikroṣṭā śulkaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.06/ One who protests the sale should pay the transaction tax.

children.text: KAZ03.9.07/ asvāmi.pratikrośe catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.07/ For protest by a non-owner, the fine is twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.9.08/ sapta.rātrād ūrdhvam anabhisarataḥ pratikruṣṭo vikrīṇīta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.08/ After seven days, if the protester does not come forward, the seller may sell.

children.text:
KAZ03.9.09/ pratikruṣṭa.atikrame vāstuni dviśato daṇḍaḥ, anyatra catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ // iti vāstu.vikrayaḥ /
KAZ03.9.10/ sīma.vivādaṃ grāmayor ubhayoḥ sāmantā pañca.grāmī daśa.grāmī vā setubhiḥ sthāvaraiḥ kṛtrimair vā kuryāt //
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.9.09/ For violating a protest regarding immovable property, the fine is two hundred [<s>paṇas</s>]; in other cases, twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>. Thus the sale of immovable property.
KAZ03.9.10/ Boundary disputes between two villages should be settled by the neighbors, a group of five or ten villages, using permanent or artificial boundary-marks.

children.text: KAZ03.9.11/ karṣaka.go.pālaka.vṛddhāḥ pūrva.bhuktikā vā bāhyāḥ setūnām abhijñā bahava eko vā nirdiśya sīma.setūn viparīta.veṣāḥ sīmānaṃ nayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.11/ Elderly farmers, herdsmen, or former occupants, or outsiders knowledgeable about the boundary-marks — many, or even one — should point out the boundary-marks and, wearing reversed garments, lead [the parties] to the boundary.

children.text:
KAZ03.9.12/ uddiṣṭānāṃ setūnām adarśane sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ /
KAZ03.9.13/ tad eva nīte sīma.apahāriṇāṃ setuc.chidāṃ ca kuryāt //
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.9.12/ For failing to find the indicated boundary-marks, the fine is one thousand [<s>paṇas</s>].
KAZ03.9.13/ The same [fine] should be imposed on boundary-thieves and boundary-mark destroyers when [the party] is led to the [wrong] boundary.

children.text:
KAZ03.9.14/ pranaṣṭa.setu.bhogaṃ vā sīmānaṃ rājā yathā.upakāraṃ vibhajet // iti sīma.vivādaḥ /
KAZ03.9.15/ kṣetra.vivādaṃ sāmanta.grāma.vṛddhāḥ kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.9.14/ Or, when the boundary-marks and enjoyment-rights are lost, the king should divide the boundary according to [mutual] benefit. Thus boundary disputes.
KAZ03.9.15/ Field disputes should be settled by the neighbors and village elders.

children.text: KAZ03.9.16/ teṣāṃ dvaidhī.bhāve yato bahavaḥ śucayo^anumatā vā tato niyaccheyuḥ madhyaṃ vā gṛhṇīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.16/ When there is a disagreement among them, [the decision] should be according to the majority of trustworthy or [mutually] accepted [witnesses]; or they should take the middle [course].

children.text: KAZ03.9.17/ tad.ubhaya.parā.uktaṃ vāstu rājā haret, pranaṣṭa.svāmikaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.17/ Property disclaimed by both parties the king should confiscate; likewise property whose owner is lost.

children.text: KAZ03.9.18/ yathā.upakāraṃ vā vibhajet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.18/ Or he should divide it according to [mutual] benefit.

children.text: KAZ03.9.19/ prasahya.ādāne vāstuni steya.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.19/ For seizing immovable property by force — the penalty for theft.

children.text:
KAZ03.9.20/ kāraṇa.ādāne prayāsam ājīvaṃ ca parisaṃkhyāya bandhaṃ dadyāt // iti kṣetra.vivādaḥ /
KAZ03.9.21/ maryādā.apaharaṇe pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.9.20/ For seizure with [some legitimate] cause — after calculating the labor and livelihood [lost], he should impose a bond. Thus field disputes.
KAZ03.9.21/ For removing a boundary-mark — the first level <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.9.22/ maryādā.bhede catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.22/ For breaking a boundary — twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text:
KAZ03.9.23/ tena tapo.vana.vivīta.mahā.patha.śmaśāna.deva.kula.yajana.puṇya.sthāna.vivādā vyākhyātāḥ // iti maryādā.sthāpanam /
KAZ03.9.24/ sarva eva vivādāḥ sāmanta.pratyayāḥ //
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.9.23/ By this are explained disputes concerning ascetic groves, commons, highways, cremation grounds, temples, sacrificial grounds, and holy places. Thus the establishment of boundaries.
KAZ03.9.24/ All disputes indeed are [decided] on the testimony of neighbors.

children.text: KAZ03.9.25/ vivīta.sthala.kedāra.ṣaṇḍa.khala.veśma.vāhana.koṣṭhānāṃ pūrvaṃ.pūrvam ābādhaṃ saheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.25/ Among commons, dry land, irrigated fields, groves, threshing floors, dwellings, enclosures, and storehouses — each earlier one should tolerate the encroachment of each later one.

children.text: KAZ03.9.26/ brahma.soma.araṇya.deva.yajana.puṇya.sthāna.varjāḥ sthala.pradeśāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.26/ Dry land areas are [to be kept] free of <s>Brahma</s>-groves, <s>Soma</s>-groves, sacred forests, deity-temples, sacrificial grounds, and holy places.

children.text: KAZ03.9.27/ ādhāra.parivāha.kedāra.upabhogaiḥ para.kṣetra.kṛṣṭa.bīja.hiṃsāyāṃ yathā.upaghātaṃ mūlyaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.27/ For damage to another's field, sown seeds, or cultivation through irrigation channels, overflow channels, or field-embankments — they should pay the price according to the damage.

children.text: KAZ03.9.28/ kedāra.ārāma.setu.bandhānāṃ paraspara.hiṃsāyāṃ hiṃsā.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.28/ For mutual damage among irrigated fields, gardens, and embankments — the fine is double the damage.

children.text: KAZ03.9.29/ paścān.niviṣṭam adhara.taṭākaṃ na^upari.taṭākasya kedāram udakena^āplāvayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.29/ A lower reservoir built later should not flood the irrigated land of an upper reservoir.

children.text: KAZ03.9.30/ upari.niviṣṭaṃ na^adhara.taṭākasya pūra.āsrāvaṃ vārayed, anyatra tri.varṣa.uparata.karmaṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.30/ An upper [reservoir] should not block the flood-discharge of a lower reservoir — except one whose operations have been suspended for three years.

children.text: KAZ03.9.31/ tasya^atikrame pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, taṭāka.vāmanaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.31/ For transgressing this, the first level <s>sāhasa</s> fine, and the diminishment of the reservoir [to its proper level].

children.text: KAZ03.9.32/ pañca.varṣa.uparata.karmaṇaḥ setu.bandhasya svāmyaṃ lupyeta, anyatra^āpadbhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.32/ An embankment whose operations have been suspended for five years loses its ownership — except in cases of calamity.

children.text: KAZ03.9.33/ taṭāka.setu.bandhānāṃ nava.pravartane pāñcavarṣikaḥ parihāraḥ, bhagna.utsṛṣṭānāṃ cāturvarṣikaḥ, samupārūḍhānāṃ traivarṣikaḥ, sthalasya dvaivarṣikaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.33/ For new construction of reservoirs and embankments, a five-year tax exemption; for broken and abandoned ones, four years; for those taken over [and restored], three years; for dry land, two years.

children.text: KAZ03.9.34/ sva.ātma.ādhāne vikraye ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.34/ [The same exemption applies] when built with one's own resources and for sale.

children.text: KAZ03.9.35/ khāta.prāvṛttim anadī.nibandha.āyatana.taṭāka.kedāra.ārāma.ṣaṇḍa.vāpānāṃ sasya.varṇa.bhāga.uttarikam anyebhyo vā yathā.upakāraṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.35/ For excavated [reservoirs], seasonal, non-river-dammed [channels], shrines, reservoirs, irrigated fields, gardens, groves, and seed-beds — those [who benefit from them] should give a share of grain proportionate to [the benefit] and above, or give to others according to [mutual] benefit.

children.text: KAZ03.9.36/ prakraya.avakraya.adhibhāga.bhoganiṣṛṣṭa.upabhoktāraś ca^eṣāṃ pratikuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.36/ Purchasers, tenants, additional share-holders, and those granted enjoyment — these should reciprocate [the benefit].

children.text: KAZ03.9.37/ arpatīkāre hīna.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.9.37/ For failure to reciprocate — the fine is double the deficiency.

children.text:
KAZ03.9.38ab/ setubhyo muñcatas toyam avāre ṣaṭ.paṇo damaḥ /
KAZ03.9.38cd/ vāre vā toyam anyeṣāṃ pramādena^uparundhataḥ //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.9.38ab/ For one who releases water from embankments out of turn, the fine is six <s>paṇas</s>;
KAZ03.9.38cd/ the same for one who, through negligence, blocks another's water during their turn.

children.text:
(ḍamage to pastures, fields and roads)
KAZ03.10.01/ karma.udaka.mārgam ucitaṃ rundhataḥ kurvato^anucitaṃ vā pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, setu.kūpa.puṇya.sthāna.caitya.deva.āyatanāni ca para.bhūmau niveśayataḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Damage to pastures, fields, and roads)
KAZ03.10.01/ For one who blocks a customary work- or water-channel, or creates an irregular one — the first level <s>sāhasa</s> fine; likewise for one who establishes an embankment, well, holy place, shrine, or temple on another's land.

children.text: KAZ03.10.02/ pūrva.anuvṛttaṃ dharma.setum ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā nayato nāyayato vā madhyamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, śrotṛṛṇām uttamaḥ, anyatra bhagna.utsṛṣṭāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.02/ For one who alienates or causes to be alienated — through sale or donation — a previously established religious endowment (<s>dharmasetu</s>) or a charitable foundation — the middle <s>sāhasa</s> fine; for the witnesses, the highest — except when [the endowment is] broken and abandoned.

children.text: KAZ03.10.03/ svāmy abhāve grāmāḥ puṇya.śīlā vā pratikuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.03/ In the absence of an owner, the villagers or the virtuous should maintain [it].

children.text: KAZ03.10.04/ pathi.pramāṇaṃ durga.niveśe vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.04/ The road-widths are explained in [the section on] fort construction.

children.text: KAZ03.10.05/ kṣudra.paśu.manuṣya.pathaṃ rundhato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, mahā.paśu.pathaṃ catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ, hasti.kṣetra.pathaṃ catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇaḥ, setu.vana.pathaṃ ṣaṭ.śataḥ, śmaśāna.grāma.pathaṃ dviśataḥ, droṇa.mukha.pathaṃ pañca.śataḥ, sthānīya.rāṣṭra.vivīta.pathaṃ sāhasraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.05/ For blocking a path for small animals and humans — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for a large-animal path — twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; for an elephant or field path — fifty-four <s>paṇas</s>; for an embankment or forest path — six hundred; for a cremation-ground or village path — two hundred; for a <s>droṇamukha</s> (market-town) path — five hundred; for a provincial, district, or commons path — one thousand.

children.text: KAZ03.10.06/ atikarṣaṇe ca^eṣāṃ daṇḍa.caturthā daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.06/ For excessive plowing [encroaching on these] — fines of one-fourth [of the above].

children.text: KAZ03.10.07/ karṣaṇe pūrva.uktāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.07/ For [mere] plowing [encroachment] — the previously stated [fines apply].

children.text: KAZ03.10.08/ kṣetrikasya^akṣipataḥ kṣetram upavāsasya vā tyajato bīja.kāle dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra doṣa.upanipāta.aviṣahyebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.08/ For a farmer who does not cultivate his field or abandons fallow land at sowing time — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>, except when prevented by unavoidable calamities.

children.text: KAZ03.10.09/ karadāḥ karadeṣv ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā kuryuḥ, brahma.deyikā brahma.deyikeṣu //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.09/ Tax-paying [landholders] should make donations and sales to [other] tax-payers; <s>brahmadeya</s> (Brahmanical-grant) holders to [other] <s>brahmadeya</s> holders.

children.text: KAZ03.10.10/ anyathā pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.10/ Otherwise, the first level <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.10.11/ karadasya vā^akarada.grāmaṃ praviśataḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.11/ [The same] for a tax-payer who enters a tax-exempt village.

children.text: KAZ03.10.12/ karadaṃ tu praviśataḥ sarva.dravyeṣu prākāmyaṃ syāt, anyatra^agārāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.12/ But for one who enters a tax-paying [village], there should be freedom regarding all property — except the dwelling.

children.text: KAZ03.10.13/ tad apy asmai dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.13/ Even that should be given to him.

children.text: KAZ03.10.14/ anādeyam akṛṣato^anyaḥ pañca.varṣāṇy upabhujya prayāsa.niṣkrayeṇa dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.14/ [Land] that cannot be confiscated, if left uncultivated by another for five years [who has been using it], should be returned upon payment of the labor costs.

children.text: KAZ03.10.15/ akaradāḥ paratra vasanto bhogam upajīveyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.15/ Those who pay no taxes, while living elsewhere, should subsist on the [common] usufruct.

children.text: KAZ03.10.16/ grāma.arthena grāmikaṃ vrajantam upavāsāḥ paryāyeṇa^anugaccheyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.16/ Villagers should accompany the village headman in turns when he goes on village business.

children.text: KAZ03.10.17/ ananugacchantaḥ paṇa.ardha.paṇikaṃ yojanaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.17/ Those who do not accompany should pay half a <s>paṇa</s> per <s>yojana</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.10.18/ grāmikasya grāmād astena.pāradārikaṃ nirasyataś catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, grāmasya^uttamaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.18/ The fine for a village headman who expels from the village one who is neither a thief nor an adulterer is twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; for the village [collectively expelling such a person], the highest [penalty].

children.text: KAZ03.10.19/ nirastasya praveśo hy abhigamena vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.19/ The re-entry of one expelled is explained under the rules of approach.

children.text: KAZ03.10.20/ stambhaiḥ samantato grāmād dhanuḥ.śata.apakṛṣṭam upasālaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.20/ He should have an outer enclosure built with posts all around the village, withdrawn one hundred bow-lengths [from it].

children.text: KAZ03.10.21/ paśu.pracāra.arthaṃ vivītam ālavanena^upajīveyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.21/ They should maintain the pasture ground for the movement of cattle, subsisting on the profits from it.

children.text: KAZ03.10.22/ vivītaṃ bhakṣayitvā^apasṛtānām uṣṭra.mahiṣāṇāṃ pādikaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇīyuḥ, gava.aśva.kharāṇāṃ ca^ardha.pādikam, kṣudra.paśūnāṃ ṣoḍaśa.bhāgikam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.22/ For camels and buffaloes that have strayed after grazing on the pasture, they should collect a quarter-<s>rūpa</s> [fee]; for cattle, horses, and donkeys, half of that; for small animals, one-sixteenth.

children.text: KAZ03.10.23/ bhakṣayitvā niṣaṇṇānām eta eva dvi.guṇā daṇḍāḥ, parivasatāṃ catur.guṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.23/ For those that sit down after grazing, the same fines are doubled; for those that stay [overnight], quadrupled.

children.text: KAZ03.10.24/ grāma.deva.vṛṣā vā^anirdaśa.ahā vā dhenur ukṣāṇo go.vṛṣāś ca^adaṇḍyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.24/ Village bulls, cows within ten days [of calving], draught bulls, and breeding bulls are exempt from fines.

children.text: KAZ03.10.25/ sasya.bhakṣaṇe sasya.upaghātaṃ niṣpattitaḥ parisaṃkhyāya dvi.guṇaṃ dāpayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.25/ In case of crop-grazing, [the owner of the cattle] should be made to pay double the estimated crop damage calculated from the expected yield.

children.text: KAZ03.10.26/ svāminaś ca^anivedya cārayato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇdaḥ, pramuñcataś catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.26/ And for one who grazes [cattle on another's field] without informing the owner, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for one who lets [them] loose, twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.10.27/ pālinām ardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.27/ For the herdsmen, half the fine.

children.text: KAZ03.10.28/ tad eva ṣaṇḍa.bhakṣaṇe kuryāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.28/ The same [rules] apply to grazing in orchards.

children.text: KAZ03.10.29/ vāṭa.bhede dvi.guṇaḥ veśma.khala.valaya.gatānāṃ ca dhānyānāṃ bhakṣaṇe //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.29/ In case of breaking through a fence, the fine is double; and the same for eating grain stored in houses, threshing floors, or enclosures.

children.text: KAZ03.10.30/ hiṃsā.pratīkāraṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.30/ Restitution should be made for any injury [to crops or property].

children.text: KAZ03.10.31/ abhaya.vana.mṛgāḥ parigṛhītā vā bhakṣayantaḥ svāmino nivedya yathā^avadhyās tathā pratiṣeddhavyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.31/ Animals from a protected forest or captive animals that eat [crops] should be warded off — after notifying the owner — so as not to be harmed.

children.text: KAZ03.10.32/ paśavo raśmi.pratodābhyāṃ vārayitavyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.32/ Cattle should be restrained with rope and goad.

children.text: KAZ03.10.33/ teṣām anyathā hiṃsāyāṃ daṇḍa.pāruṣya.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.33/ For injuring them otherwise, the penalties for assault (<s>daṇḍa-pāruṣya</s>) [apply].

children.text:
KAZ03.10.34/ prārthayamānā dṛṣṭa.aparādhā vā sarva.upāyair niyantavyāḥ // iti kṣetra.patha.hiṃsā /
KAZ03.10.35/ karṣakasya grāmam abhyupetya^akurvato grāma eva^atyayaṃ haret //
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.10.34/ Those that attack or have been caught offending should be restrained by all means. Thus [ends the section on] damage to fields and roads.
KAZ03.10.35/ A farmer who, having agreed to cultivate a village's [land], fails to do so — the village should collect the fine from him.

children.text: KAZ03.10.36/ karma.akaraṇe karma.vetana.dvi.guṇam, hiraṇya.adāne pratyaṃśa.dvi.guṇam, bhakṣya.peya.adāne ca prahavaṇeṣu dvi.guṇam aṃśaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.36/ For failure to perform [agreed] work, [he should pay] double the work-wages; for failure to pay money, double the share; for failure to provide food and drink, double the share at festivals.

children.text: KAZ03.10.37/ prekṣāyām anaṃśadaḥ, sa-sva.jano na prekṣeta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.37/ One who gives no share at a spectacle should not watch it together with his household.

children.text: KAZ03.10.38/ pracchanna.śravaṇa.īkṣaṇe ca sarva.hite ca karmaṇi nigraheṇa dvi.guṇam aṃśaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.38/ And in cases of eavesdropping and spying, and in any work for the common good, [the offender] should pay double the share by way of punishment.

children.text: KAZ03.10.39/ sarva.hitam ekasya bruvataḥ kuryur ājñām //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.39/ When one person declares something to be for the benefit of all, they should obey his command.

children.text: KAZ03.10.40/ akaraṇe dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.40/ For non-compliance, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.10.41/ taṃ cet sambhūya vā hanyuḥ pṛthag eṣām aparādha.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.41/ If they [collectively] should kill him, the fine for each is double their individual offense.

children.text: KAZ03.10.42/ upahantṛṣu viśiṣṭaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.42/ For the instigators, [the penalty] is higher.

children.text: KAZ03.10.43/ brāhmaṇaś ca^eṣāṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ niyamyeta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.43/ And a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> among them should be appointed to leadership.

children.text: KAZ03.10.44/ prahavaṇeṣu ca^eṣāṃ brāhmaṇā na^akāmāḥ kuryuḥ, aṃśaṃ ca labheran //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.44/ And at festivals, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> should not be compelled against their will, but they should receive a share.

children.text: KAZ03.10.45/ tena deśa.jāti.kula.saṃghānāṃ samayasya^anapākarma vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.10.45/ By this, the non-violation of customary agreements of regional, caste, clan, and corporate groups is explained.

children.text:
KAZ03.10.46ab/ rājā deśa.hitān setūn kurvatāṃ pathi saṃkramān /
KAZ03.10.46cd/ grāma.śobhāś ca rakṣāś ca teṣāṃ priya.hitaṃ caret //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.10.46ab/ The king should act for the welfare and benefit of those who construct embankments useful to the region and bridges on roads,
KAZ03.10.46cd/ as well as village beautifications and defenses.

children.text:
(ṇon-payment of debts)
KAZ03.11.01/ sapāda.paṇā dharmyā māsa.vṛddhiḥ paṇa.śatasya, pañca.paṇā vyāvahārikī, daśa.paṇā kāntāragāṇām, viṃśati.paṇā sāmudrāṇām //
children.translated_text:
(Non-payment of debts)
KAZ03.11.01/ The righteous rate of interest is one and a quarter <s>paṇas</s> per month per hundred <s>paṇas</s>; the commercial rate is five <s>paṇas</s>; for those traveling through wildernesses, ten <s>paṇas</s>; for sea-voyagers, twenty <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.11.02/ tataḥ paraṃ kartuḥ kārayituś ca pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, śrotṛṛṇām eka.ekaṃ pratyardha.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.02/ Beyond that, the first <s>sāhasa</s> penalty [applies] for both the creditor and the one who causes it; for the witnesses, half the penalty for each.

children.text: KAZ03.11.03/ rājany ayoga.kṣema.āvahe tu dhanika.dhāraṇikayoś caritram avekṣeta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.03/ But when the king fails to provide security and livelihood, he should examine the conduct of both creditor and debtor.

children.text: KAZ03.11.04/ dhānya.vṛddhiḥ sasya.niṣpattāv upārdhā, paraṃ mūlya.kṛtā vardheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.04/ Interest on grain [is payable] at harvest: up to half [the principal]; beyond that, it increases at the price-rate.

children.text: KAZ03.11.05/ prakṣepa.vṛddhir udayād ardhaṃ samnidhāna.sannā vārṣikī deyā //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.05/ Compound interest, [payable] from revenue at half [the principal], is to be paid annually, due upon deposit.

children.text: KAZ03.11.06/ cira.pravāsaḥ stambha.praviṣṭo vā mūlya.dvi.guṇaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.06/ One who has been away long or has entered the [enemy's] fortress should pay double the principal.

children.text: KAZ03.11.07/ akṛtvā vṛddhiṃ sādhayato vardhayato vā, mūlyaṃ vā vṛddhim āropya śrāvayato bandha.catur.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.07/ For one who realizes interest without a [valid] agreement, or compounds [interest], or who inflates the principal and then sues for the interest — the fine is four times the bond-amount.

children.text: KAZ03.11.08/ tuccha.śrāvaṇāyām abhūta.catur.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.08/ For a fraudulent claim, [the fine is] four times the fabricated [amount].

children.text: KAZ03.11.09/ tasya tri.bhāgam ādātā dadyāt, śeṣaṃ pradātā //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.09/ Of that, the claimant should pay one-third, the defendant the remainder.

children.text: KAZ03.11.10/ dīrgha.sattra.vyādhi.guru.kula.uparuddhaṃ bālam asāraṃ vā na^ṛṇam anuvardheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.10/ A debt owed by one detained by a prolonged ritual, illness, or a patron's household, or by a minor or insolvent person, should not accrue interest.

children.text: KAZ03.11.11/ mucyamānam ṛṇam apratigṛhṇato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.11/ The fine for one who refuses to accept a debt being repaid is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.11.12/ kāraṇa.apadeśena nivṛtta.vṛddhikam anyatra tiṣṭhet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.12/ On the pretext of a [valid] reason, the [debt with] stopped interest may be placed elsewhere.

children.text: KAZ03.11.13/ daśa.varṣa.upekṣitam ṛṇam apratigrāhyam, anyatra bāla.vṛddha.vyādhita.vyasani.proṣita.deśa.tyāga.rājya.vibhramebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.13/ A debt ignored for ten years cannot be recovered, except from minors, the aged, the sick, the afflicted, those away abroad, those who have left the country, and those [displaced by] political upheaval.

children.text: KAZ03.11.14/ pretasya putrāḥ kusīdaṃ dadyuḥ, dāyādā vā riktha.harāḥ, saha.grāhiṇaḥ, pratibhuvo vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.14/ The sons of a deceased [debtor] should pay the principal with interest, or the heirs who take the inheritance, or the co-signers, or the guarantors.

children.text: KAZ03.11.15/ na prātibhāvyam anyat //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.15/ A guarantee [extends to] no other [obligation beyond the guaranteed one].

children.text: KAZ03.11.16/ asāraṃ bāla.prātibhāvyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.16/ A guarantee given by a minor is invalid.

children.text: KAZ03.11.17/ asaṃkhyāta.deśa.kālaṃ tu putrāḥ pautrā dāyādā vā rikthaṃ haramāṇā dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.17/ But [a guarantee] without a specified place and time — the sons, grandsons, or heirs who take the inheritance should pay it.

children.text: KAZ03.11.18/ jīvita.vivāha.bhūmi.prātibhāvyam asaṃkhyāta.deśa.kālaṃ tu putrāḥ pautrā vā vaheyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.18/ A guarantee for life, marriage, or land, without a specified place and time — the sons or grandsons should bear it.

children.text: KAZ03.11.19/ nānā^ṛṇa.samavāye tu na^ekaṃ dvau yugapad abhivadeyātām, anyatra pratiṣṭhamānāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.19/ When [a debtor has] multiple debts at the same time, two creditors should not sue simultaneously, except one whose claim is being settled.

children.text: KAZ03.11.20/ tatra^api gṛhīta.ānupūrvyā rāja.śrotriya.dravyaṃ vā pūrvaṃ pratipādayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.20/ Among them too, by the order in which [the debts] were contracted, or the king's and the Vedic scholar's property should be recovered first.

children.text: KAZ03.11.21/ dampatyoḥ pitā.putrayoḥ bhrātṛṛṇāṃ ca^avibhaktānāṃ paraspara..kṛtam ṛṇam asādhyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.21/ A debt contracted by one [spouse] of a married couple, by one of father and son, or by one of undivided brothers, against the other, is unrecoverable.

children.text: KAZ03.11.22/ agrāhyāḥ karma.kāleṣu karṣakā rāja.puruṣāś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.22/ Farmers during work-seasons and royal servants are exempt from seizure [for debts].

children.text: KAZ03.11.23/ strī ca^apratiśrāviṇī pati.kṛtam ṛṇam, anyatra go.pālaka.ardha.sītikebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.23/ And a wife who has not stood surety is not liable for a debt contracted by her husband, except in the case of cowherds and share-croppers.

children.text: KAZ03.11.24/ patis tu grāhyaḥ strī.kṛtam ṛṇam, aprati.vidhāya proṣita iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.24/ But a husband is liable for a debt contracted by his wife, if he has gone abroad without making [adequate] provision.

children.text: KAZ03.11.25/ sampratipattāv uttamaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.25/ For agreement [on the debt], the highest [standard of proof applies].

children.text: KAZ03.11.26/ asmapratipattau tu sākṣiṇaḥ pramāṇaṃ prātyayikāḥ śucayo^anumatā vā trayo^avara.ardhyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.26/ In the absence of agreement, witnesses are the authority — [they should be] trustworthy, pure, approved, or three in number from the lower half [of society].

children.text: KAZ03.11.27/ pakṣa.anumatau vā dvau, ṛṇaṃ prati na tv eva^ekaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.27/ Or two approved by [both] parties; but for debts, never just one.

children.text: KAZ03.11.28/ pratiṣiddhāḥ syāla.sahāya.anvarthi.dhanika.dhāraṇika.vairi.nyaṅga.dhṛta.daṇḍāḥ, pūrve ca^avyavahāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.28/ Those disqualified [as witnesses] are: brothers-in-law, associates, interested parties, the creditor and debtor [themselves], enemies, the maimed, and those previously punished — and those previously [declared] incompetent in legal proceedings.

children.text: KAZ03.11.29/ rāja.śrotriya.grāma.bhṛtaka.kuṣṭhi.vraṇinaḥ patita.caṇḍāla.kutsita.karmāṇo^andha.badhira.mūka.ahaṃ.vādinaḥ strī.rāja.puruṣāś ca, anyatra sva.vargebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.29/ [Also disqualified are:] royal servants, Vedic scholars, village employees, lepers, those with wounds, outcasts, <s>Caṇḍālas</s>, those of despised occupations, the blind, deaf, mute, and self-serving persons, as well as women and royal officials — except when [testifying] within their own groups.

children.text: KAZ03.11.30/ pāruṣya.steya.saṃgrahaṇeṣu tu vairi.syāla.sahāya.varjāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.30/ But in cases of assault, theft, and abduction, [all are valid witnesses] except enemies, brothers-in-law, and associates.

children.text: KAZ03.11.31/ rahasya.vyavahāreṣv ekā strī puruṣa upaśrotā upadraṣṭā vā sākṣī syād rāja.tāpasa.varjam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.31/ In private transactions, a single woman or man, or a listener or observer, may serve as witness — except for royal [matters] and ascetics.

children.text: KAZ03.11.32/ svāmino bhṛtyānām ṛtvig.ācāryāḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ mātā.pitarau putrāṇāṃ ca^anigraheṇa sākṣyaṃ kuryuḥ, tesām itare vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.32/ Masters for their servants, sacrificial priests and teachers for their students, and parents for their children may give testimony without [risk of] punishment; and others [may testify] for them.

children.text: KAZ03.11.33/ paraspara.abhiyoge ca^eṣām uttamāḥ parā.uktā daśa.bandhaṃ dadyuḥ, avarāḥ pañca.bandham // iti sākṣy.adhikāraḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.33/ And when they accuse one another, the higher-ranking among them should pay a fine of ten times the bond, the lower-ranking five times. Thus [ends] the section on witnesses.

children.text: KAZ03.11.34/ brāhmaṇa.uda.kumbha.agni.sakāśe sākṣiṇaḥ parigṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.34/ He should administer the oath to witnesses in the presence of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, a water-pot, and fire.

children.text: KAZ03.11.35/ tatra brāhmaṇaṃ brūyāt "satyaṃ brūhi" iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.35/ To a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> he should say: 'Speak the truth.'

children.text: KAZ03.11.36/ rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā "mā tava^iṣṭā.pūrta.phalam, kapāla.hastaḥ śatru.kulaṃ bhikṣā.arthī gaccheḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.36/ To a <s>Kṣatriya</s> or <s>Vaiśya</s>: 'May the fruits of your sacrifices and meritorious deeds [be lost]; may you go begging to the house of your enemy with a skull in hand.'

children.text: KAZ03.11.37/ śūdraṃ "janma.maraṇa.antare yad vaḥ puṇya.phalaṃ tad rājānaṃ gacched, rājñaś ca kilbiṣaṃ yuṣmān anyathā.vāde, daṇḍaś ca^anubaddhaḥ, paścād api jñāyeta yathā.dṛṣṭa.śrutam, eka.mantrāḥ satyam upaharata" iti //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.37/ To a <s>Śūdra</s>: 'Whatever merit you earn between birth and death — may it go to the king, and may the king's sin be upon you if you speak falsely; punishment will follow; even afterward it shall be known. Report truthfully what you have seen and heard, being of one counsel.'

children.text: KAZ03.11.38/ anupaharatāṃ sapta.rātrād ūrdhvaṃ dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, tri.pakṣād ūrdhvam abhiyogaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.38/ For those who fail to appear [as witnesses], the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s> after seven nights; after three fortnights, they should give [additional] testimony.

children.text: KAZ03.11.39/ sākṣi.bhede yato bahavaḥ śucayo^anumatā vā tato niyaccheyuḥ, madhyaṃ vā gṛhṇīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.39/ In case of disagreement among witnesses, [the court] should decide in favor of the majority, or the trustworthy, or the approved — or take a middle position.

children.text: KAZ03.11.40/ tad vā dravyaṃ rājā haret //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.40/ Or the king may confiscate the disputed property.

children.text: KAZ03.11.41/ sākṣiṇaś ced abhiyogād ūnaṃ brūyur atiriktasya^abhiyoktā bandhaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.41/ If witnesses state less than the claim, the claimant should pay a fine on the excess.

children.text: KAZ03.11.42/ atiriktaṃ vā brūyus tad.atiriktaṃ rājā haret //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.42/ Or if they state more, the king should confiscate the excess.

children.text: KAZ03.11.43/ bāliśyād abhiyoktur vā duhśrutaṃ durlikhitaṃ preta.abhiniveśaṃ vā samīkṣya sākṣi.pratyayam eva syāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.43/ Due to foolishness of the claimant, or a mishearing, a miswriting, or influence of the deceased — upon examining [the evidence], one should rely on the testimony of witnesses.

children.text: KAZ03.11.44/ "sākṣi.bāliṣyeṣv eva pṛthag.anuyoge deśa.kāla.kāryāṇāṃ pūrva.madhyama.uttamā daṇḍāḥ" ity auśanasāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.44/ 'In cases of witness foolishness, and separate interrogation regarding place, time, and circumstances — the first, middling, and highest penalties [apply]' — say the followers of <s>Uśanas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.11.45/ "kūṭa.sākṣiṇo yam artham abhūtaṃ kuryur bhūtaṃ vā nāśayeyus tad daśa.guṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyuḥ" iti mānavāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.45/ 'False witnesses should pay a fine ten times the amount they fabricate or cause to be lost' — say the followers of <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.11.46/ "bāliśyād vā visaṃvādayatāṃ citro ghātaḥ" iti bārhaspatyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.46/ 'Or for those who deceive through foolishness, various corporal punishments' — say the followers of <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.11.47/ na^iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.47/ Not so, says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.11.48/ dhruvaṃ hi sākṣibhiḥ śrotavyam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.48/ For witnesses must certainly be heard.

children.text: KAZ03.11.49/ aśṛṇvatāṃ catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, tato^ardham abruvāṇānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.11.49/ The fine for those who refuse to hear is twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; half of that for those who refuse to speak.

children.text:
KAZ03.11.50ab/ deśa.kāla.avidūrasthān sākṣiṇaḥ pratipādayet /
KAZ03.11.50cd/ dūrasthān aprasārān vā svāmi.vākyena sādhayet //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.11.50ab/ He should produce witnesses who are not far removed in place and time;
KAZ03.11.50cd/ for those far away or unable to travel, [the claim should be] established by the owner's statement.

children.text:
(ḍeposits)
KAZ03.12.01/ upanidhir ṛṇena vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Deposits)
KAZ03.12.01/ A deposit (<s>upanidhi</s>) is explained by [the rules of] debt.

children.text: KAZ03.12.02/ para.cakra.āṭavikābhyāṃ durga.rāṣṭra.vilope vā, pratirodhakair vā grāma.sārtha.vraja.vilope, cakra.yukta.nāśe vā, grāma.madhya.agny.udaka.ābādhe jvālā.vega.uparuddhe vā, nāvi nimagnāyāṃ muṣitāyāṃ vā svayam uparūḍho na^upanidhim abhyāvahet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.02/ In case of plunder of the fort or countryside by an enemy army or forest tribes, or plunder of a village, caravan, or cattle camp by marauders, or destruction of vehicles, or flooding by fire or water in the midst of a village, or being trapped by the force of flames — one who has himself climbed to safety need not restore the deposit.

children.text: KAZ03.12.03/ upanidhi.bhoktā deśa.kāla.anurūpaṃ bhoga.vetanaṃ dadyāt, dvādaśa.paṇaṃ ca daṇḍam //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.03/ One who uses a deposit should pay rent proportionate to the place and time, and a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.12.04/ upabhoga.nimittaṃ naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā^abhyāvahet, catur.viṃśati.paṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ, anyathā vā niṣpatane //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.04/ [A deposit] lost or destroyed through use must be restored, with a fine of twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; or [the same fine] if it [naturally] deteriorates otherwise.

children.text: KAZ03.12.05/ pretaṃ vyasana.gataṃ vā na^upanidhim abhyāvahet //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.05/ One need not restore a deposit to a deceased person or one overtaken by calamity.

children.text: KAZ03.12.06/ ādhāna.vikraya.apavyayaneṣu ca^asya catur.guṇa.pañca.bandho daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.06/ For pledging, selling, or squandering [a deposit], the fine is four times the value plus one-fifth.

children.text: KAZ03.12.07/ parivartane niṣpātane vā mūlya.samaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.07/ For substitution or [causing] deterioration, [the fine is] equal to the value.

children.text: KAZ03.12.08/ tena^ādhi.praṇāśa.upabhoga.vikraya.ādhāna.apahārā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.08/ By this, the rules for pledges — their destruction, use, sale, re-pledging, and theft — are explained.

children.text: KAZ03.12.09/ na^ādhiḥ sa-upakāraḥ sīdet, na ca^asya mūlyaṃ vardheta, anyatra nisargāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.09/ A pledge that yields benefit [to the creditor] should not deteriorate, nor should its value increase — except by natural [appreciation].

children.text: KAZ03.12.10/ nirupakāraḥ sīdet, mūlyaṃ ca^asya vardheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.10/ A pledge that yields no benefit may deteriorate, and its value may increase [as a charge against the debtor].

children.text: KAZ03.12.11/ upasthitasya^ādhim aprayacchato dvādaśaṇpaṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.12.11/ The fine for not returning a pledge to one who presents himself [to redeem it] is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.12.12/ prayojaka.asamnidhāne vā grāma.vṛddheṣu sthāpayitvā niṣkrayam ādhiṃ pratipadyeta //
children.translated_text: Or, in the absence of the pledger, he should deposit [the pledge] with the village elders and accept the redemption price for the pledge.

children.text: KAZ03.12.13/ nivṛtta.vṛddhiko vā^ādhis tat.kāla.kṛta.mūlyas tatra^eva^avatiṣṭheta, anāśa.vināśa.karaṇa.adhiṣṭhito vā //
children.translated_text: Or a pledge whose interest has ceased should remain in that place at the value assessed at that time, provided it is maintained without destruction or deterioration.

children.text: KAZ03.12.14/ dhāraṇika.asamnidhāne vā vināśa.bhayād udgata.arghaṃ dharmastha.anujñāto vikrīṇīta, ādhi.pāla.pratyayo vā //
children.translated_text: Or, in the absence of the holder, fearing destruction, he should sell [the pledge] at the current market price with the authorization of the judges, or on the guarantee of the pledge-keeper.

children.text: KAZ03.12.15/ sthāvaras tu prayāsa.bhogyaḥ phala.bhogyo vā prakṣepa.vṛddhi.mūlya.śuddham ājīvam amūlya.kṣayeṇa^upanayet //
children.translated_text: But an immovable pledge, whether enjoyable through effort or enjoyable for its produce, should yield income net of investment, interest, and the principal value, without diminishing the capital value.

children.text: KAZ03.12.16/ anisṛṣṭa.upabhoktā mūlya.śuddham ājīvaṃ bandhaṃ ca dadyāt //
children.translated_text: One who uses [the pledge] without authorization should pay the net income and the interest.

children.text: KAZ03.12.17/ śeṣam upanidhinā vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: The remainder is explained under [the rules for] sealed deposits (<s>upanidhi</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.12.18/ etena^ādeśo^anvādhiś ca vyākhyātau //
children.translated_text: By this, mandates (<s>ādeśa</s>) and subsidiary pledges (<s>anvādhi</s>) are also explained.

children.text: KAZ03.12.19/ sārthena^anvādhi.hasto vā pradiṣṭāṃ bhūmim aprāptaś corair bhagna.utsṛṣṭo vā na^anvādhim abhyāvahet //
children.translated_text: One who holds a subsidiary pledge while traveling with a caravan, who has not reached the designated place, or who has been robbed or abandoned by thieves, should not be made to restore the subsidiary pledge.

children.text: KAZ03.12.20/ antare vā mṛtasya dāyādo^api na^abhyāvahet //
children.translated_text: Nor should even the heir of one who dies en route be made to restore it.

children.text: KAZ03.12.21/ śeṣam upanidhinā vyakahyātam //
children.translated_text: The remainder is explained under [the rules for] sealed deposits.

children.text: KAZ03.12.22/ yācitakam avakrītakaṃ vā yathā.vidhaṃ gṛhṇīyus tathā.vidham eva^arpayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: A borrowed item or one taken on approval should be returned in the same condition as when received.

children.text: KAZ03.12.23/ bhreṣa.upanipātābhyāṃ deśa.kāla.uparodhi dattaṃ naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā na^abhyāvaheyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Items given [that were] damaged by accident or calamity, and [which were] obstructed by place or time, [if] lost or destroyed, should not be made to be restored.

children.text: KAZ03.12.24/ śeṣam upanidhinā vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: The remainder is explained under [the rules for] sealed deposits.

children.text: KAZ03.12.25/ vaiyāvṛtya.vikrayas tu - vaiyāvṛtya.karā yathā.deśa.kālaṃ vikrīṇānāḥ paṇyaṃ yathā.jātaṃ mūlyam udayaṃ ca dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: As for commission sales — commission agents selling [goods] according to the [conditions of] place and time should pay the actual price and the profit of the merchandise.

children.text: KAZ03.12.26/ deśa.kāla.atipātane vā parihīṇaṃ sampradāna.kālikena^argheṇa mūlyam udayaṃ ca dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Or, if [the goods are] diminished by missing the [right] place and time, they should pay the price and profit at the rate prevailing at the time of consignment.

children.text: KAZ03.12.27/ yathā.sambhāṣitaṃ vā vikrīṇānā na^udayam adhigaccheyuḥ, mūlyam eva dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Or, selling at the agreed-upon [price], they should not [be entitled to] the profit, but should pay only the price.

children.text: KAZ03.12.28/ argha.patane vā parihīṇaṃ yathā.parihīṇaṃ mūlyam ūnaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Or, if [the goods are] diminished due to a fall in prices, they should pay the diminished price to the extent of the diminution.

children.text: KAZ03.12.29/ sāṃvyavahārikeṣu vā prātyayikeṣv arāja.vācyeṣu bhreṣa.upanipātābhyāṃ naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā mūlyam api na dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Or, for [goods entrusted to] commercial agents who are trusted and not under royal compulsion, [if] lost or destroyed by accident or calamity, they should not pay even the price.

children.text: KAZ03.12.30/ deśa.kāla.antaritānāṃ tu paṇyānāṃ kṣaya.vyaya.viśuddhaṃ mūlyam udayaṃ ca dadyuḥ, paṇya.samavāyānāṃ ca pratyaṃśam //
children.translated_text: But for merchandise that has been delayed by place or time, they should pay the price and profit net of depreciation and expenses, and [for] pooled merchandise, [they should pay] each partner's share.

children.text: KAZ03.12.31/ śeṣam upanidhinā vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: The remainder is explained under [the rules for] sealed deposits.

children.text: KAZ03.12.32/ etena vaiyāvṛtya.vikrayo vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, commission sales are explained.

children.text: KAZ03.12.33/ nikṣepaś ca^upanidhinā //
children.translated_text: Deposits are also [explained] under sealed deposits.

children.text: KAZ03.12.34/ tam anyena nikṣpitam anyasya^arpayato hīyeta //
children.translated_text: One who delivers a deposit made by one person to another should lose [his claim].

children.text: KAZ03.12.35/ nikṣepa.apahāre pūrva.apadānaṃ nikṣeptāraś ca pramāṇam //
children.translated_text: In the misappropriation of a deposit, the prior record and the depositors are the evidence.

children.text: KAZ03.12.36/ aśucayo hi kāravaḥ //
children.translated_text: For merchants are dishonest.

children.text: KAZ03.12.37/ na^eṣāṃ karaṇa.pūrvo nikṣepa.dharmaḥ //
children.translated_text: The law of deposits does not [apply] to them without documentary [evidence].

children.text: KAZ03.12.38/ karaṇa.hīnaṃ nikṣepam apavyayamānaṃ gūḍha.bhitti.nyastān sākṣiṇo nikṣeptā rahasi praṇipātena prajñāpayet, vana.ante vā madya.prahavaṇa.viśvāsena //
children.translated_text: When one denies a deposit that lacks documentation, the depositor should secretly alert witnesses hidden in a wall, through supplication in private, or at the edge of a forest through [building] trust at a drinking gathering.

children.text: KAZ03.12.39/ rahasi vṛddho vyādhito vā vaidehakaḥ kaścit kṛta.lakṣaṇaṃ dravyam asya haste nikṣipya^apagacchet //
children.translated_text: In private, an aged or sick trader should deposit a marked item in [the suspect's] hand and depart.

children.text: KAZ03.12.40/ tasya pratideśena putro bhrātā vā^abhigamya nikṣepaṃ yāceta //
children.translated_text: By his direction, a son or brother should approach and request the deposit.

children.text: KAZ03.12.41/ dāne śuciḥ, anyathā nikṣepaṃ steya.daṇḍaṃ ca dadyāt //
children.translated_text: If he gives [it back], he is honest; otherwise, he should pay the deposit and the theft-penalty.

children.text: KAZ03.12.42/ pravrajyā.abhimukho vā śraddheyaḥ kaścit kṛta.lakṣaṇaṃ dravyam asya haste nikṣipya pratiṣṭheta //
children.translated_text: Or a trustworthy person about to go on a journey should deposit a marked item in [the suspect's] hand and set forth.

children.text: KAZ03.12.43/ tataḥ kāla.antara.āgato yāceta //
children.translated_text: Then, after an interval of time, he should come and request [it].

children.text: KAZ03.12.44/ dāne śuciḥ, anyathā nikṣepaṃ steya.daṇḍaṃ ca dadyāt //
children.translated_text: If he gives [it back], he is honest; otherwise, he should pay the deposit and the theft-penalty.

children.text: KAZ03.12.45/ kṛta.lakṣaṇena vā dravyeṇa pratyānayed enam //
children.translated_text: Or he should expose him through the marked item.

children.text: KAZ03.12.46/ bāliśa.jātīyo vā rātrau rāja.dāyikā.kṣaṇa.bhītaḥ sāram asya haste nikṣipya^apagacchet //
children.translated_text: Or a naive-seeming person, fearful of the king's officers at night, should deposit his valuables in [the suspect's] hand and depart.

children.text: KAZ03.12.47/ sa enaṃ bandhana.agāra.gato yāceta //
children.translated_text: Then, [the agent] from the prison should come and request [the deposit].

children.text: KAZ03.12.48/ dāne śuciḥ, anyathā nikṣepaṃ steya.daṇḍaṃ ca dadyāt //
children.translated_text: If he gives [it back], he is honest; otherwise, he should pay the deposit and the theft-penalty.

children.text: KAZ03.12.49/ abhijñānena ca^asya gṛhe janam ubhayaṃ yāceta //
children.translated_text: And by [producing] the identifying mark, he should request [the goods] from both [the suspect and his] household.

children.text: KAZ03.12.50/ anyatarta.ādāne yathā.uktaṃ purastāt //
children.translated_text: For taking [goods] from elsewhere, [the procedure is] as stated before.

children.text: KAZ03.12.51/ dravya.bhogānām āgamaṃ ca^asya^anuyuñjīta, tasya ca^arthasya vyavahāra.upaliṅganam, abhiyoktuś ca^artha.sāmarthyam //
children.translated_text: He should also investigate the source of [the suspect's] enjoyment of goods, the circumstances of that [particular] property, and the means of the plaintiff.

children.text: KAZ03.12.52/ etena mithaḥ.samavāyo vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, [disputes arising from] mutual agreements are explained.

children.text:
KAZ03.12.53ab/ tasmāt sākṣimad acchannaṃ kuryāt samyag.vibhāṣitam /
KAZ03.12.53cd/ sve pare vā jane kāryaṃ deśa.kāla.agra.varṇataḥ //E
children.translated_text: Therefore, one should conduct [transactions] with witnesses, openly, and with clear terms, whether with one's own people or with others, specifying place, time, precedence, and category.

children.text:
(ḷaw concerning slaves and labourers)
KAZ03.13.01/ udara.dāsa.varjam ārya.prāṇam aprāpta.vyavahāraṃ śūdraṃ vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayataḥ sva.janasya dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, vaiśyaṃ dvi.guṇaḥ, kṣatriyaṃ tri.guṇaḥ, brāhmaṇaṃ catur.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Law concerning slaves and laborers)
For a kinsman who sells or pledges a free-born (<s>ārya</s>) <s>Śūdra</s> who is below the age of legal competence — excluding a belly-slave (one born into slavery) — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for a <s>Vaiśya</s>, double; for a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, triple; for a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, quadruple.

children.text: KAZ03.13.02/ para.janasya pūrva.madhyama.uttama.vadhā daṇḍāḥ, kretṛ.śrotṛṛṇāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: For a stranger [doing the same], the lowest, middle, and highest violence (<s>sāhasa</s>) penalties [respectively]; likewise for the buyer and the witnesses.

children.text: KAZ03.13.03/ mlecchānām adoṣaḥ prajāṃ vikretum ādhātuṃ vā //
children.translated_text: For <s>Mlecchas</s> (barbarians), there is no offense in selling or pledging their offspring.

children.text: KAZ03.13.04/ na tv eva^āryasya dāsa.bhāvaḥ //
children.translated_text: But under no circumstance may a free-born person (<s>ārya</s>) be reduced to slavery.

children.text: KAZ03.13.05/ athavā^āryam ādhāya kula.bandhana āryāṇām āpadi, niṣkrayaṃ ca^adhigamya bālaṃ sāhāyya.dātāraṃ vā pūrvaṃ niṣkrīṇīran //
children.translated_text: However, if a free-born person is pledged by kinsmen of free-born persons in times of distress, they should first redeem a child or one who has given assistance, upon obtaining the redemption price.

children.text: KAZ03.13.06/ sakṛd.ātma.ādhātā niṣpatitaḥ sīdet, dvir anyena^āhitakaḥ, sakṛd ubhau para.viṣaya.abhimukhau //
children.translated_text: One who pledges himself once is [to be treated as] absconded if he flees; one pledged by another twice [is absconded]; both [are absconded] after a single [attempt] if they head for enemy territory.

children.text: KAZ03.13.07/ vitta.apahāriṇo vā dāsasya^ārya.bhāvam apaharato^ardha.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: Or for one who takes away the property of a slave or who removes [a slave's] free-born status, [the fine is] half the [standard] penalty.

children.text: KAZ03.13.08/ niṣpatita.preta.vyasaninām ādhātā mūlyaṃ bhajeta //
children.translated_text: For those who have absconded, died, or met with calamity, the pledger should bear the price.

children.text: KAZ03.13.09/ preta.viṇ.mūtra.ucchiṣṭa.grāhaṇam āhitasya nagna.snāpanaṃ daṇḍa.preṣaṇam atikramaṇaṃ ca strīṇāṃ mūlya.nāśa.karaṃ, dhātrī.paricārika.ardha.sītika.upacārikāṇāṃ ca mokṣa.karam //
children.translated_text: Making [the pledged person] handle corpses, excrement, urine, or leavings, bathing a pledged woman naked, sending [her] on errands [requiring] punishment, and violating women — these nullify the price [paid for the pledge]; and for wet-nurses, female attendants, half-share workers, and female servants, they effect release.

children.text: KAZ03.13.10/ siddham upacārakasya^abhiprajātasya^apakramaṇam //
children.translated_text: It is established that a servant (<s>upacāraka</s>) who has produced offspring [for the master] may leave.

children.text: KAZ03.13.11/ dhātrīm āhitikāṃ vā^akāmāṃ sva.vaśāṃ gacchataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, para.vaśāṃ madhyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who takes a wet-nurse or a pledged woman under his own control against her will, the lowest <s>sāhasa</s> penalty; for [giving her] to another's control, the middle.

children.text: KAZ03.13.12/ kanyām āhitikāṃ vā svayam anyena vā duṣayato mūlya.nāśaḥ śulkaṃ tad.dvu.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who deflowers an unmarried girl, whether pledged or not, himself or through another — the nullification of the price, the bride-price, and a fine of double that [amount].

children.text: KAZ03.13.13/ ātma.vikrayiṇaḥ prajām āryāṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: The offspring of one who has sold himself should be known as free-born.

children.text: KAZ03.13.14/ ātma.adhigataṃ svāmi.karma.aviruddhaṃ labheta, pitryaṃ ca dāyam //
children.translated_text: He should obtain what he has earned himself, [provided it is] not contrary to the master's work, and also his paternal inheritance.

children.text: KAZ03.13.15/ mūlyena ca^āryatvaṃ gacchet //
children.translated_text: And by [paying] the price, he should attain free-born status.

children.text: KAZ03.13.16/ tena^udara.dāsa.āhitakau vyākhyātau //
children.translated_text: By this, the belly-slave and the bonded servant are explained.

children.text: KAZ03.13.17/ prakṣepa.anurūpaś ca^asya niṣkrayaḥ //
children.translated_text: And his redemption price should be proportionate to the [original] investment.

children.text: KAZ03.13.18/ daṇḍa.praṇītaḥ karmaṇā daṇḍam upanayet //
children.translated_text: One sentenced to [slavery as] punishment should work off the penalty through labor.

children.text: KAZ03.13.19/ ārya.prāṇo dhvaja.āhṛtaḥ karma.kāla.anurūpeṇa mūlya.ardhena vā vimucyeta //
children.translated_text: A free-born person captured in war should be released for half the price proportionate to the work and time, or [simply for half the price].

children.text: KAZ03.13.20/ gṛhe.jāta.dāya.āgata.labdha.krītānām anyatamaṃ dāsam ūna.aṣṭa.varṣaṃ vibandhum akāmaṃ nīce karmaṇi videśe dāsīṃ vā sagarbhām aprativihita.garbha.bharmaṇyāṃ vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, kretṛ.śrotṛṛṇāṃ ca //
children.translated_text: For one who sells or pledges any slave — whether house-born, inherited, obtained, or purchased — who is under eight years of age, or a kinsman against his will, or [assigns him] to degrading work or to a foreign land, or a pregnant slave-woman without provision for her pregnancy — the lowest <s>sāhasa</s> penalty [applies]; likewise for the buyer and the witnesses.

children.text: KAZ03.13.21/ dāsam anurūpeṇa niṣkrayeṇa^āryam akurvato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, saṃrodhaś ca^ā.karaṇāt //
children.translated_text: For one who does not free a slave at the appropriate redemption price, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>, and confinement until [the redemption is] done.

children.text: KAZ03.13.22/ dāsa.dravyasya jñātayo dāyādāḥ, teṣām abhāve svāmī //
children.translated_text: The relatives are heirs to a slave's property; in their absence, the master [inherits].

children.text: KAZ03.13.23/ svāminaḥ svasyāṃ dāsyāṃ jātaṃ samātṛkam adāsaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: An offspring born to the master from his own slave-woman should be known as a non-slave, together with its mother.

children.text: KAZ03.13.24/ gṛhyā cet kuṭumba.artha.cintanī mātā bhrātā bhaginī ca^asyā adāsāḥ syuḥ //
children.translated_text: If [the slave-woman] is a household [member] managing family affairs, her mother, brother, and sister should also be non-slaves.

children.text:
KAZ03.13.25/ dāsaṃ dāsīṃ vā niṣkrīya punar vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra svayaṃ.vādibhyaḥ // iti dāsa.kalpaḥ /
KAZ03.13.26/ karma.karasya karma.sambandham āsannā vidyuḥ //
children.translated_text:
For one who, after redeeming a slave or slave-woman, sells or pledges [them] again, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s> — except for those who voluntarily [re-enter servitude]. This is the law of slaves.
Those near [to the laborer] should know the terms of a laborer's work-engagement.

children.text: KAZ03.13.27/ yathā.sambhāṣitaṃ vetanaṃ labheta, karma.kāla.anurūpam asambhāṣita.vetanaḥ //
children.translated_text: He should receive wages as agreed upon; one without agreed wages [should receive] according to the work and time.

children.text: KAZ03.13.28/ karṣakaḥ sasyānāṃ go.pālakaḥ sarpiṣāṃ vaidehakaḥ paṇyānām ātmanā vyavahṛtānāṃ daśa.bhāgam asambhāṣita.vetano labheta //
children.translated_text: A farmer [should receive] one-tenth of the harvest, a cowherd one-tenth of the ghee, a trader one-tenth of the merchandise he has personally traded — as wages when none were agreed upon.

children.text: KAZ03.13.29/ sambhāṣita.vetanas tu yathā.sambhāṣitam //
children.translated_text: But one with agreed wages [receives] as agreed.

children.text: KAZ03.13.30/ kāru.śilpi.kuśīlava.cikitsaka.vāg.jīvana.paricāraka.ādir āśā.kārika.vargas tu yathā^anyas tad.vidhaḥ kuryād yathā vā kuśalāḥ kalpayeyus tathā vetanaṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: Artisans, craftsmen, entertainers, physicians, professional reciters, attendants, and others — the group that works on [payment based on] results — should receive wages as another of the same kind would [charge], or as experts would assess.

children.text: KAZ03.13.31/ sākṣi.pratyayam eva syāt //
children.translated_text: It should rest on the testimony of witnesses alone.

children.text: KAZ03.13.32/ sākṣiṇām abhāve yataḥ karma tato^anuyuñjīta //
children.translated_text: In the absence of witnesses, inquiry should be made at the place of work.

children.text: KAZ03.13.33/ vetana.ādāne daśa.bandho daṇḍaḥ, ṣaṭ.paṇo vā //
children.translated_text: For [failure to pay] wages [already] taken, the fine is one-tenth of the [amount at] stake, or six <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.13.34/ apavyayamāne dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, pañca.bandho vā //
children.translated_text: For one who denies [the wage agreement], the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>, or one-fifth of the stake.

children.text: KAZ03.13.35/ nadī.vega.jvālā.stena.vyāla.uparuddhaḥ sarva.sva.putra.dāra.ātma.dānena^ārtas trātāram āhūya niṣtīrṇaḥ kuśala.pradiṣṭaṃ vetanaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: One overtaken by a river's current, flames, thieves, or wild animals — who, in distress offering his entire property, sons, wife, or even himself, called upon a rescuer and was saved — should pay wages as assessed by experts.

children.text: KAZ03.13.36/ tena sarvatra^ārta.dāna.anuśayā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, [the rules regarding] regret over gifts made in distress are explained for all [situations].

children.text:
KAZ03.13.37ab/ labheta puṃścalī bhogaṃ saṃgamasya^upaliṅganāt /
KAZ03.13.37cd/ atiyācnā tu jīyeta daurmatya.avinayena vā //E
children.translated_text: A courtesan may claim her fee based on evidence of the encounter; but for excessive demands, she forfeits [her claim] due to ill-temper or improper conduct.

children.text:
(ḍuties of servants)
(Undertaking in partnership)
KAZ03.14.01/ gṛhītvā vetanaṃ karma^akurvato bhṛtakasya dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, saṃrodhaś ca^ā.karaṇāt //
children.translated_text:
(Duties of servants)
(Undertaking in partnership)
For a hired worker who takes wages but does not do the work, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>, and confinement until [the work is] done.

children.text: KAZ03.14.02/ aśaktaḥ kutsite karmaṇi vyādhau vyasane vā^anuśayaṃ labheta, pareṇa vā kārayitum //
children.translated_text: If unable [to work], he may receive a refund for [work that is] defective, or [he may hire] another to do [the work] on his behalf, in case of illness or calamity.

children.text: KAZ03.14.03/ tasya.vyaya.karmaṇā labheta bhartā vā kārayitum //
children.translated_text: At the cost of that [substitute's] labor, the employer may [also] have [the work] done.

children.text: KAZ03.14.04/ "na^anyas tvayā kārayitavyo, mayā vā na^anyasya kartavyam" ity avarodhe bhartur akārayato bhṛtakasya^akurvato vā dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: In a mutual exclusivity agreement — 'No other should be employed by you, nor should I work for another' — for an employer who does not assign work or a worker who does not perform, the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.14.05/ karma.niṣṭhāpane bhartur anyatra gṛhīta.vetano na^asakāmaḥ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: Until the completion of the work, one who has received wages from the employer should not refuse to work, unless unwilling [from the start].

children.text: KAZ03.14.06/ "upasthitam akārayataḥ kṛtam eva vidyād" ity ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: 'If [the employer] has [the worker] present but does not assign work, [the work] should be considered done' — say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.14.07/ na^iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: Not so, says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.14.08/ kṛtasya vetanaṃ na^akṛtasya^asti //
children.translated_text: Wages are for work done, not for work not done.

children.text: KAZ03.14.09/ sa ced alpam api kārayitvā na kārayet kṛtam eva^asya vidyāt //
children.translated_text: But if [the employer] has [the worker] do even a little and then does not [assign further] work, [the work] should be considered done.

children.text: KAZ03.14.10/ deśa.kāla.atipātanena karmaṇām anyathā.karaṇe vā na^asakāmaḥ kṛtam anumanyeta //
children.translated_text: One should not accept work as done without [his] consent when [the employer] has missed the [proper] place and time, or has had the work done differently [than agreed].

children.text: KAZ03.14.11/ sambhāṣitād adhika.kriyāyāṃ prayāsaṃ na moghaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: For work exceeding what was agreed upon, the [extra] effort should not be rendered fruitless.

children.text: KAZ03.14.12/ tena saṃgha.bhṛtā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, workers hired by a guild are explained.

children.text: KAZ03.14.13/ teṣām ādhiḥ sapta.rātram āsīta //
children.translated_text: Their waiting period for [payment] should be seven nights.

children.text: KAZ03.14.14/ tato^anyam upasthāpayet, karma.niṣpākaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: After that, he should appoint another [worker], and [ensure] completion of the work.

children.text: KAZ03.14.15/ na ca^anivedya bhartuḥ saṃghaḥ kaṃcit parihared upanayed vā //
children.translated_text: And the guild should not, without informing the employer, remove or add anyone [to the work-team].

children.text: KAZ03.14.16/ tasya^atikrame catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For transgressing that — a fine of twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.14.17/ saṃghena parihṛtasya^ardha.daṇḍaḥ // iti bhṛtaka.adhikāraḥ //
children.translated_text: For one abandoned by the group — half the penalty. — Thus [ends the section on] the rules concerning hired laborers.

children.text: KAZ03.14.18/ saṃgha.bhṛtāḥ sambhūya.samutthātāro vā yathā.sambhāṣitaṃ vetanaṃ samaṃ vā vibhajeran //
children.translated_text: Those hired by a guild, or those who have come together as joint venturers, should divide the wages as agreed upon, or equally.

children.text: KAZ03.14.19/ karṣaṇa.vaidehakā vā sasya.paṇya.ārambha.paryavasāna.antare sannasya yathā.kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ pratyaṃśaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Or agriculturalists and traders should give, at any point between the commencement and completion of a crop or merchandise venture, a proportionate share to one who has withdrawn, according to the work done.

children.text: KAZ03.14.20/ puruṣa.upasthāne samagram aṃśaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: When [the withdrawing person provides] a substitute, they should give [him] the full share.

children.text: KAZ03.14.21/ saṃsiddhe tu^uddhṛta.paṇye sannasya tadānīm eva pratyaṃśaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: But when [the venture] has been accomplished and the merchandise taken out, they should give the one who withdrew a proportionate share immediately.

children.text: KAZ03.14.22/ sāmānyā hi pathi.siddhiś ca^asiddhiś ca //
children.translated_text: For success and failure on the road are common [to all].

children.text: KAZ03.14.23/ prakrānte tu karmaṇi svasthasya^apakrāmato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: But for one who is healthy and withdraws from an undertaking already in progress — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.14.24/ na ca prākāmyam apakramaṇe //
children.translated_text: And there should be no arbitrary withdrawal.

children.text: KAZ03.14.25/ coraṃ tv abhaya.pūrvaṃ karmaṇaḥ pratyaṃśena grāhayed, dadyāt pratyaṃśam abhayaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: But a thief [in the group], having first been given assurance of safety, should be made to pay a proportionate share of [the stolen goods]; he should give [back] the share and [receive] the assurance of safety.

children.text: KAZ03.14.26/ punaḥ.steye pravāsanam, anyatra.gamane ca //
children.translated_text: For repeated theft — banishment; likewise for going elsewhere [to join a rival group].

children.text: KAZ03.14.27/ mahā.aparādhe tu dūṣyavad ācaret //
children.translated_text: For a major offense, he should be treated as an enemy.

children.text: KAZ03.14.28/ yājakāḥ svā.pracāra.dravya.varjaṃ yathā.sambhāṣitaṃ vetanaṃ samaṃ vā vibhajeran //
children.translated_text: Sacrificial priests should divide the wages as agreed upon or equally, excluding the items specific to each [priest's] own role.
