children.text: KAZ03.14.29/ agniṣṭoma.ādiṣu ca kratuṣu dīkṣaṇād ūrdhvaṃ tṛtīyam aṃśaṃ, madhyama.upasada ūrdhvam ardham aṃśaṃ, sutye prātaḥ.savanād ūrdhvaṃ pāda.ūnam aṃśam //
children.translated_text: And in <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> and other sacrifices — after the consecration (<s>dīkṣaṇa</s>), one-third of the share; after the middle preparatory rite (<s>upasad</s>), half the share; at the pressing day (<s>sutya</s>), after the morning pressing (<s>prātaḥsavana</s>), three-quarters of the share.

children.text: KAZ03.14.30/ mādhyandināt savanād ūrdhvaṃ samagram aṃśaṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: After the midday pressing (<s>mādhyandinasavana</s>), he should receive the full share.

children.text: KAZ03.14.31/ nītā hi dakṣiṇā bhavanti //
children.translated_text: For the sacrificial fees become conclusive [only at the end].

children.text: KAZ03.14.32/ bṛhaspati.sava.varjaṃ pratisavanaṃ hi dakṣiṇā dīyante //
children.translated_text: For — except in the <s>Bṛhaspatisava</s> — the fees are given at each pressing.

children.text: KAZ03.14.33/ tena^ahar.gaṇa.dakṣiṇā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, the fees for multi-day [sacrifices] are explained.

children.text: KAZ03.14.34/ sanānām ā.daśa.aho.rātrāt^śeṣa.bhṛtāḥ karma kuryuḥ, anye vā sva.pratyayāḥ //
children.translated_text: For <s>sattra</s> sacrifices lasting up to ten day-and-night periods, [those who join] for the remainder should perform the work as hired; or others [may act as substitutes] on their own behalf.

children.text: KAZ03.14.35/ karmaṇy asamāpte tu yajamānaḥ sīded, ṛtvijaḥ karma samāpayya dakṣiṇāṃ hareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: But if the sacrificer should die before the sacrifice is completed, the priests should complete the ritual and take the fees.

children.text: KAZ03.14.36/ asamāpte tu karmaṇi yājyaṃ yājakaṃ vā tyajataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who abandons either the patron or the priest while the ritual is incomplete — the first level of <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text:
KAZ03.14.37ab/ anāhita.agniḥ śata.guru.yajvā ca sahasraguḥ /
KAZ03.14.37cd/ surāpo vṛṣalī.bhartā brahmahā guru.talpagaḥ //
children.translated_text:
One who has not established the sacred fires [may officiate for] a patron whose [fee is] a hundred [cattle]; and one who has performed sacrifices, [for one whose fee is] a thousand cattle;
a drinker of liquor, a husband of a <s>Śūdra</s> woman, a slayer of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, or a violator of the teacher's bed —

children.text:
KAZ03.14.38ab/ asat.pratigrahe yuktaḥ stenaḥ kutsita.yājakaḥ /
KAZ03.14.38cd/ adoṣas tyaktum anyonyaṃ karma.saṃkara.niścayāt //E
children.translated_text:
one who accepts improper gifts, a thief, and a despicable officiating priest —
it is no offense for them to abandon each other, being certain of the contamination of the ritual.

children.text:
(ṛescission of sale and purchase)
KAZ03.15.01/ vikrīya paṇyam aprayacchato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra doṣa.upanipāta.aviṣahyebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Rescission of sale and purchase)
For one who, having sold a commodity, does not deliver it — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>, except in cases of defect, calamity, or force majeure.

children.text: KAZ03.15.02/ paṇya.doṣo doṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: A defect in the commodity is a 'defect.'

children.text: KAZ03.15.03/ rāja.cora.agny.udaka.bādha upanipātaḥ //
children.translated_text: Obstruction by the king, thieves, fire, or flood is a 'calamity.'

children.text: KAZ03.15.04/ bahu.guṇa.hīnam ārta.kṛtaṃ vā^aviṣahyam //
children.translated_text: 'Force majeure' is when [the price has become] many times less [than agreed], or when [the transaction was] made under duress.

children.text: KAZ03.15.05/ vaidehakānām eka.rātram anuśayaḥ, karṣakāṇāṃ tri.rātraṃ, go.rakṣakāṇāṃ pañca.rātram //
children.translated_text: For traders, the period of rescission is one night; for farmers, three nights; for cattle-keepers, five nights.

children.text: KAZ03.15.06/ vyāmiśrāṇām uttamānāṃ ca varṇānāṃ vṛtti.vikraye sapta.rātram //
children.translated_text: For the sale of livelihood [goods] of mixed and upper castes — seven nights.

children.text: KAZ03.15.07/ ātipātikānāṃ paṇyānāṃ "anyatra.avikreyam" ity avarodhena^anuśayo deyaḥ //
children.translated_text: For perishable commodities, the right of rescission should be granted by [the seller's stipulation] 'not saleable elsewhere.'

children.text: KAZ03.15.08/ tasya^atikrame catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, paṇya.daśa.bhāgo vā //03.15.09/ krītvā paṇyam apratigṛhṇato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra doṣa.upanipāta.aviṣahyebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text:
For transgressing that — a fine of twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>, or one-tenth of the commodity's [value].
For one who, having bought a commodity, does not accept it — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>, except in cases of defect, calamity, or force majeure.

children.text: KAZ03.15.10/ samānaś ca^anuśayo vikretur anuśayena //
children.translated_text: The right of rescission of the buyer is the same as that of the seller.

children.text: KAZ03.15.11/ vivāhānāṃ tu trayāṇāṃ pūrveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ pāṇi.grahaṇāt siddham upāvartanaṃ, śūdrāṇāṃ ca prakarmaṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For marriages of the first three [righteous forms] among the [upper] castes, rescission is valid up to the clasping of hands; for <s>Śūdras</s>, up to the preliminary rites.

children.text: KAZ03.15.12/ vṛtta.pāṇi.grahaṇayor api doṣam aupaśāyikaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddham upāvartanam //
children.translated_text: Even after the clasping of hands and the [initial] union, if a hereditary defect is discovered, rescission is valid.

children.text: KAZ03.15.13/ na tv eva^abhiprajātayoḥ //
children.translated_text: But not after they have produced offspring.

children.text: KAZ03.15.14/ kanyā.doṣam aupaśāyikam anākhyāya prayacchataḥ kanyāṃ ṣaṇ.ṇavatir daṇḍaḥ, śulka.strī.dhana.pratidānaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: For one who gives a maiden without declaring a hereditary defect — a fine of ninety-six [<s>paṇas</s>], and the return of bride-price and woman's property.

children.text: KAZ03.15.15/ varayitur vā vara.doṣam anākhyāya vindato dvi.guṇaḥ, śulka.strī.dhana.nāśaś ca //
children.translated_text: Or for a suitor who takes [a bride] without declaring the groom's defect — double [the fine], and the loss of bride-price and woman's property.

children.text: KAZ03.15.16/ dvipada.catuṣpadānāṃ tu kuṇṭha.vyādhita.aśucīnām utsāha.svāsthya.śucīnām ākhyāne dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For declaring bipeds and quadrupeds [that are] dull, diseased, or impure as vigorous, healthy, or pure — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.15.17/ ā.tri.pakṣād iti catuṣpadānām upāvartanam, ā.saṃvatsarād iti manuṣyāṇām //
children.translated_text: The period of rescission for quadrupeds is up to a month and a half; for humans, up to a year.

children.text: KAZ03.15.18/ tāvatā hi kālena śakyaṃ śauca.āśauce jñātum //
children.translated_text: For within that period it is possible to determine purity and impurity.

children.text:
KAZ03.15.19ab/ dātā pratigrahītā ca syātāṃ na^upahatau yathā /
KAZ03.15.19cd/ dāne kraye vā^anuśayaṃ tathā kuryuḥ sabhāsadaḥ //E
children.translated_text:
The members of the court should arrange the rescission in such a way
that neither the giver nor the receiver is harmed, whether in a gift or a sale.

children.text:
(ṇon-conveyance of gifts)
(ṣale without ownership)
(ṛelation of ownership)
KAZ03.16.01/ dattasya^apradānam ṛṇa.ādānena vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text:
(Non-conveyance of gifts)
(Sale without ownership)
(Relation of ownership)
Non-delivery of what has been given is explained by [the rules for] debt-recovery.

children.text: KAZ03.16.02/ dattam avyavahāryam ekatra^anuśaye varteta //
children.translated_text: What has been given is irrevocable; [rescission] would apply only when there is [mutual] rescission.

children.text: KAZ03.16.03/ sarva.svaṃ putra.dāram ātmānaṃ vā pradāya^anuśayinaḥ prayacchet //
children.translated_text: One who, having given away all one's property, one's son and wife, or oneself, and then regrets — should [still] give.

children.text: KAZ03.16.04/ dharma.dānam asādhuṣu karmasu ca^aupaghātikeṣu vā, artha.dānam anupakāriṣv apakāriṣu vā, kāma.dānam anarheṣu ca //
children.translated_text: A gift of <s>dharma</s> [given] to unworthy persons or in activities that cause harm; a gift of wealth to those who render no service or to those who cause harm; a gift of love to the undeserving —

children.text: KAZ03.16.05/ yathā ca dātā pratigrahītā ca na^upahatau syātāṃ tathā^anuśayaṃ kuśalāḥ kalpayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: the wise should arrange the rescission so that neither the giver nor the receiver is harmed.

children.text: KAZ03.16.06/ daṇḍa.bhayād ākrośa.bhayād anartha.bhayād vā bhaya.dānaṃ pratigṛhṇataḥ steya.daṇḍaḥ, prayacchataś ca //
children.translated_text: For one who receives a gift [made] out of fear — fear of punishment, fear of reproach, or fear of calamity — the penalty for theft [applies], and likewise for the giver.

children.text: KAZ03.16.07/ roṣa.dānaṃ para.hiṃsāyāṃ, rājñām upari darpa.dānaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: A gift [made] in anger is [applicable to cases involving] injury to another; and a gift [made] out of arrogance toward kings.

children.text: KAZ03.16.08/ tatra^uttamo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For that — the highest fine.

children.text:
KAZ03.16.09/ prātibhāvyaṃ daṇḍa.śulka.śeṣam ākṣikaṃ saurikaṃ ca na^akāmaḥ putro dāyādo vā riktha.haro dadyāt // iti dattasya^anapākarma /
KAZ03.16.10/ asvāmi.vikrayas tu - naṣṭa.apahṛtam āsādya svāmī dharmasthena grāhayet //
children.translated_text:
A son, heir, or inheritor should not unwillingly pay: a suretyship, the balance of a fine or toll, a gambling debt, or a drinking debt. — Thus [ends the section on] the irrevocability of gifts.
As for sale without ownership — the owner, having found lost or stolen [property], should have it seized through the judicial officer.

children.text: KAZ03.16.11/ deśa.kāla.atipattau vā svayaṃ gṛhītvā^upaharet //
children.translated_text: Or if the time and place have passed [for that], having himself taken possession, he should present [it to the court].

children.text: KAZ03.16.12/ dharmasthaś ca svāminam anuyuñjīta "kutas te labdham" iti //
children.translated_text: And the judicial officer should question the possessor: 'Where did you obtain this?'

children.text: KAZ03.16.13/ sa ced ācāra.kramaṃ darśayeta, na vikretāraṃ, tasya dravyasya^atisargeṇa mucyeta //
children.translated_text: If he shows a regular chain of acquisition but not the seller, he should be released by surrendering the article.

children.text: KAZ03.16.14/ vikretā ced dṛśyeta, mūlyaṃ steya.daṇḍaṃ ca dadyāt //
children.translated_text: If the seller is found, he should pay the price and the penalty for theft.

children.text: KAZ03.16.15/ sa ced apasāram adhigacched apasared ā.apasāra.kṣayāt //
children.translated_text: If he [the possessor] can trace [the chain of sellers], he should trace it until the chain is exhausted.

children.text: KAZ03.16.16/ kṣaye mūlyaṃ steya.daṇḍaṃ ca dadyāt //
children.translated_text: When the chain is exhausted, he should pay the price and the penalty for theft.

children.text: KAZ03.16.17/ nāṣṭikaś ca sva.karaṇaṃ kṛtvā naṣṭa.pratyāhṛtaṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: And one who has lost [property], having established his own title, should receive what has been lost and recovered.

children.text: KAZ03.16.18/ sva.karaṇa.abhāve pañca.bandho daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: In the absence of proof of title — a fine of five-fold [the value].

children.text: KAZ03.16.19/ tac ca dravyaṃ rāja.dharmyaṃ syāt //
children.translated_text: And that article should become the property of the king.

children.text: KAZ03.16.20/ naṣṭa.apahṛtam anivedya^utkarṣataḥ svāminaḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For an owner who removes lost or stolen [property] without reporting [to the authorities] — the first level of <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.16.21/ śulka.sthāne naṣṭa.apahṛta.utpannaṃ tiṣṭhet //
children.translated_text: Lost or stolen [property that has been] found should remain at the toll station.

children.text: KAZ03.16.22/ tri.pakṣād ūrdhvam anabhisāraṃ rājā haret, svāmī vā sva.karaṇena //
children.translated_text: After a month and a half, if unclaimed, the king should take it; or the owner [may reclaim it] with proof of title.

children.text: KAZ03.16.23/ pañca.paṇikaṃ dvipada.rūpasya niṣkrayaṃ dadyāt, catuṣpaṇikam eka.khurasya, dvipaṇikaṃ gomahiṣasya, pādikaṃ kṣudra.paśūnām //
children.translated_text: He should pay a ransom of five <s>paṇas</s> for a biped, four for a single-hooved animal, two for a cow or buffalo, and a quarter [<s>paṇa</s>] for small animals.

children.text: KAZ03.16.24/ ratna.sāra.phalgu.kupyānāṃ pañcakaṃ śataṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: For precious stones, valuable goods, inferior goods, and raw materials — five per hundred.

children.text: KAZ03.16.25/ para.cakra.aṭavī.hṛtaṃ tu pratyānīya rājā yathā.svaṃ prayacchet //
children.translated_text: But [property] carried off by a foreign army or forest tribes — the king, having recovered it, should restore it to its rightful owner.

children.text: KAZ03.16.26/ cora.hṛtam avidyamānaṃ sva.dravyebhyaḥ prayacchet, pratyānetum aśakto vā //
children.translated_text: Stolen [property] that cannot be found — he should compensate from his own resources, or if unable to recover [it].

children.text: KAZ03.16.27/ svayaṃ.grāheṇa^āhṛtaṃ pratyānīya tan.niṣkrayaṃ vā prayacchet //
children.translated_text: What is brought [back] by self-help — having recovered it, he should give [the rescuer] its ransom price.

children.text:
KAZ03.16.28/ para.viṣayād vā vikrameṇa^ānītaṃ yathā.pradiṣṭaṃ rājñā bhuñjīta, anyatra^ārya.prāṇebhyo deva.brāhmaṇa.tapasvi.dravyebhyaś ca // ity asvāmi.vikrayaḥ /
KAZ03.16.29/ sva.svāmi.sambandhas tu - bhoga.anuvṛttir ucchinna.deśānāṃ yathā.svaṃ dravyāṇām //
children.translated_text:
Or what is brought from foreign territory by force — the king should enjoy it as prescribed, except for the persons of respectable people and the property of gods, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, and ascetics. — Thus [ends the section on] sale without ownership.
As for the relation of ownership — continued enjoyment [establishes ownership] of property in regions where [previous claims have been] extinguished.

children.text: KAZ03.16.30/ yat svaṃ dravyam anyair bhujyamānaṃ daśa varṣāṇy upekṣeta, hīyeta^asya, anyatra bāla.vṛddha.vyādhita.vyasani.proṣita.deśa.tyāga.rājya.vibhramebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: If one neglects for ten years one's own property being enjoyed by others, one loses [the claim to] it — except for minors, the aged, the sick, the distressed, those abroad, those who have left the country, and those [affected by] political upheaval.

children.text: KAZ03.16.31/ viṃśati.varṣa.upekṣitam anavasitaṃ vāstu na^anuyuñjīta //
children.translated_text: An unsettled homestead neglected for twenty years should not be reclaimed.

children.text: KAZ03.16.32/ jñātayaḥ śrotriyāḥ pāṣaṇḍā vā rājñām asaṃnidhau para.vāstuṣu vivasanto na bhogena hareyuḥ, upanidhim ādhiṃ nidhiṃ nikṣepaṃ striyaṃ sīmānaṃ rāja.śrotriya.dravyāṇi ca //
children.translated_text: Kinsmen, Vedic scholars, or ascetics, dwelling in another's homestead in the absence of the king, should not acquire [it] through enjoyment — [nor] a deposit, a pledge, a treasure, an article in safekeeping, a woman, a boundary, the property of the king, or of Vedic scholars.

children.text: KAZ03.16.33/ āśramiṇaḥ pāṣaṇḍā vā mahaty avakāśe parasparam abādhamānā vaseyuḥ //
children.translated_text: Ascetics of various orders or sects should dwell in ample space without mutual harassment.

children.text: KAZ03.16.34/ alpāṃ bādhāṃ saheran //
children.translated_text: They should endure a small inconvenience.

children.text: KAZ03.16.35/ pūrva.āgato vā vāsa.paryāyaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: Or the one who arrived first should give way in turn.

children.text: KAZ03.16.36/ apradātā nirasyeta //
children.translated_text: One who does not give way should be expelled.

children.text: KAZ03.16.37/ vānaprastha.yati.brahma.cāriṇām ācārya.śiṣya.dharma.bhrātṛ.samāna.tīrthyā riktha.bhājaḥ krameṇa //
children.translated_text: For forest hermits, renunciants, and celibate students — the teacher, pupil, <s>dharma</s>-brother, and fellow-student are the heirs, in order.

children.text: KAZ03.16.38/ vivāda.padeṣu ca^eṣāṃ yāvantaḥ paṇā daṇḍās tāvatī rātrīḥ kṣapaṇa.abhiṣeka.agni.kārya.mahā.kaccha.vardhanāni rājñaś careyuḥ //
children.translated_text: And in their disputes, for as many <s>paṇas</s> as the fine [would be], they should perform for the king that many nights of fasting, ritual bathing, fire-offerings, and great penance.

children.text: KAZ03.16.39/ ahiraṇya.suvarṇāḥ pāṣaḍhāḥ sādhavaḥ //
children.translated_text: Ascetics who are without silver and gold are 'virtuous' (<s>sādhus</s>).

children.text: KAZ03.16.40/ te yathā.svam upavāsa.vratair ārādhayeyuḥ, anyatra pāruṣya.steya.sāhasa.saṃgrahaṇebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: They should propitiate [their faults] with fasting and vows according to their own [order], except for [offenses of] assault, theft, violence, and hoarding.

children.text: KAZ03.16.41/ teṣu yathā.uktā daṇḍāḥ kāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: For those [offenses], the prescribed penalties should be imposed on them.

children.text:
KAZ03.16.42ab/ pravrajyāsu vṛthā.ācārān rājā daṇḍena vārayet /
KAZ03.16.42cd/ dharmo hy adharma.upahataḥ śāstāraṃ hanty upekṣitaḥ //E
children.translated_text:
The king should restrain with punishment those of false conduct among the renunciant orders;
for <s>dharma</s>, when injured by <s>adharma</s>, destroys the ruler who neglects [it].

children.text:
(Forcible seiśure)
KAZ03.17.01/ sāhasam anvayavat prasabha.karma //
children.translated_text:
(Forcible seizure)
Forcible seizure (<s>sāhasa</s>) is a violent act accompanied by [an identifiable] perpetrator.

children.text: KAZ03.17.02/ niranvaye steyam, apavyayane ca //
children.translated_text: When without [an identifiable] perpetrator — it is theft; and likewise in cases of dissipation.

children.text: KAZ03.17.03/ "ratna.sāra.phalgu.kupyānāṃ sāhase mūlya.samo daṇḍaḥ" iti mānavāḥ //
children.translated_text: "For forcible seizure of precious stones, valuable goods, inferior goods, and raw materials — the penalty equals the value" — say the followers of <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.17.04/ "mūlya.dvi.guṇaḥ" ity auśanasāḥ //
children.translated_text: "Double the value" — say the followers of <s>Uśanas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.17.05/ yathā.aparādha iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: "According to the offense" — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.17.06/ "puṣpa.phala.śāka.mūla.kanda.pakva.anna.carma.veṇu.mṛd.bhāṇḍa.ādīnāṃ kṣudraka.dravyāṇāṃ dvādśa.paṇa.avaraś caturviṃśati.paṇa.paro daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For small articles such as flowers, fruits, vegetables, roots, tubers, cooked food, leather, bamboo, clay pots, and the like — the fine ranges from a minimum of twelve <s>paṇas</s> to a maximum of twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.17.07/ kāla.āyasa.kāṣṭha.rajju.dravya.kṣudra.paśu.paṭa.ādīnāṃ sthūlaka.dravyāṇāṃ caturviṃśati.paṇa.avaro^aṣṭa.catvāriṃśat.paṇa.paro daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For medium articles such as iron, wood, ropes, commodities, small animals, cloth, and the like — the fine ranges from a minimum of twenty-four <s>paṇas</s> to a maximum of forty-eight <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.17.08/ tāmra.vṛtta.kaṃsa.kāca.danta.bhāṇḍa.ādīnāṃ sthūlaka.dravyāṇām aṣṭa.catvāriṃśat.paṇa.avaraḥ ṣaṇ.ṇavati.paraḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For larger articles such as copper, <s>vṛtta</s> [metal], bell-metal, glass, and ivory vessels and the like — the first level of <s>sāhasa</s> fine, ranging from a minimum of forty-eight <s>paṇas</s> to a maximum of ninety-six.

children.text: KAZ03.17.09/ mahā.paśu.manuṣya.kṣetra.gṛha.hiraṇya.suvarṇa.sūkṣma.vastra.ādīnāṃ sthūlaka.dravyāṇāṃ dviśata.avaraḥ pañca.śata.paro madhyamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For large articles such as large livestock, humans, fields, houses, silver, gold, and fine cloth — the middle level of <s>sāhasa</s> fine, ranging from a minimum of two hundred to a maximum of five hundred.

children.text: KAZ03.17.10/ striyaṃ puruṣaṃ vā^abhiṣahya badhnato bandhayato bandhaṃ vā mokṣayataḥ pañca.śata.avaraḥ sahasra.para uttamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ // ity ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who forcibly binds, causes to be bound, or releases from bondage a woman or man — the highest <s>sāhasa</s> fine, ranging from five hundred as the minimum to one thousand as the maximum. — Thus say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.17.11/ "yaḥ sāhasaṃ "pratipattā" iti kārayati sa dvi.guṇaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: "One who commits violence [saying] 'I will make amends' should pay double.

children.text: KAZ03.17.12/ "yāvadd hiraṇyam upayokṣyate tāvad dāsyāmi" iti sa catur.guṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: One [who says] 'I will pay as much gold as will be needed' should pay a fine of four times [the amount].

children.text: KAZ03.17.13/ yaḥ "etāvadd hiraṇyaṃ dāsyāmi" iti pramāṇam uddiśya kārayati sa yathā.uktaṃ hiraṇyaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca dadyāt" iti bārhaspatyāḥ //
children.translated_text: One who, specifying an amount, says 'I will pay this much gold' and commits [the act] — he should pay the stated gold and [also] a fine" — say the followers of <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.17.14/ sa cet kopaṃ madaṃ mohaṃ vā^apadiśed yathā.uktavad daṇḍam enaṃ kuryād iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: If he pleads anger, intoxication, or confusion [as an excuse], the fine should be imposed on him as stated — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text:
KAZ03.17.15ab/ daṇḍa.karmasu sarveṣu rūpam aṣṭa.paṇaṃ śatam /
KAZ03.17.15cd/ śatāt pareṣu vyājīṃ ca vidyāt pañca.paṇaṃ śatam //
children.translated_text:
In all penalty proceedings, the standard fee is one hundred and eight <s>paṇas</s>;
and in [cases involving] more than one hundred, the surcharge (<s>vyājī</s>) is known to be five hundred <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text:
KAZ03.17.16ab/ prajānāṃ doṣa.bāhulyād rājñāṃ vā bhāva.doṣataḥ /
KAZ03.17.16cd/ rūpa.vyājyāv adharmiṣṭhe dharmyā tu prakṛtiḥ smṛtā //E
children.translated_text:
Due to the abundance of offenses among the subjects or due to the faults of kings' temperament,
the fees and surcharges are unrighteous; but the natural [standard] is considered righteous.

children.text:
(Verbal injury)
KAZ03.18.01/ vāk.pāruṣyam upavādaḥ kutsanam abhibhartsanam iti //
children.translated_text:
(Verbal injury)
Verbal assault (<s>vākpāruṣya</s>) consists of reproach, abuse, and intimidation.

children.text: KAZ03.18.02/ śarīra.prakṛti.śruta.vṛtti.jana.padānāṃ śarīra.upavāde kāṇa.khañja.ādibhiḥ satye tri.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, mithyā.upavāde ṣaṭ.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For reproaching [someone's] body, nature, learning, occupation, or region — with terms like 'one-eyed,' 'lame,' etc. — when true, the fine is three <s>paṇas</s>; for false reproach, six <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.18.03/ "śobhana.akṣimantaḥ" iti kāṇa.khañja.ādīnāṃ stuti.nindāyāṃ dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For addressing the one-eyed, the lame, etc. with [ironic] praise-abuse such as 'O beautiful-eyed one!' — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.18.04/ kuṣṭha.unmāda.klaibya.ādibhiḥ kutsāyāṃ ca satya.mithyā.stuti.nindāsu dvādaśa.paṇa.uttarā daṇḍās tulyeṣu //
children.translated_text: For abusing [someone] with terms like 'leper,' 'madman,' 'eunuch,' etc. — in cases of true, false, praise, and abuse — fines increasing by twelve <s>paṇas</s>, among equals.

children.text: KAZ03.18.05/ viśiṣṭeṣu dvi.guṇāḥ, hīneṣv ardha.daṇḍāḥ, para.strīṣu dvi.guṇāḥ, pramāda.mada.moha.ādibhir ardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: For [offenses against] superiors — double; for inferiors — half the fine; for another's wife — double; for [offenses] due to negligence, intoxication, or confusion — half the fine.

children.text: KAZ03.18.06/ kuṣṭha.unmādayoś cikitsakāḥ saṃnikṛṣṭā pumāṃsaś ca pramāṇaṃ, klība.bhāve striyo mūtra.pheno^apsu viṣṭhā.nimajjanaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: For [allegations of] leprosy and insanity, physicians and those in close proximity and [other] men serve as evidence; for [allegations of] impotence — women, and [also] the froth of urine on water and the sinking of feces.

children.text: KAZ03.18.07/ prakṛty.upavāde brāhmaṇa.kṣatriya.vaiśya.śūdra.anta.avasāyinām apareṇa pūrvasya tri.paṇa.uttarā daṇḍāḥ, pūrveṇa^aparasya dvi.paṇa.adharāḥ, kubrāhmaṇa.ādibhiś ca kutsāyām //
children.translated_text: For reproaching [someone's] class-nature: for a lower [class person reproaching] a higher — among <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, <s>Śūdras</s>, and <s>Antyāvasāyins</s> — fines increasing by three <s>paṇas</s>; for a higher [reproaching] a lower — decreasing by two <s>paṇas</s>; and [similarly] for abusing [someone] with terms like 'bad <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>,' etc.

children.text: KAZ03.18.08/ tena śruta.upavādo vāg.jīvanānāṃ, kāru.kuśīlavānāṃ vṛtty.upavādaḥ, prājjūṇaka.gāndhāra.ādīnāṃ ca jana.pada.upavādā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: By this are explained: reproach of learning for those who live by speech, reproach of livelihood for artisans and performers, and reproach of region for those from <s>Prājjūṇa</s>, <s>Gāndhāra</s>, etc.

children.text: KAZ03.18.09/ yaḥ paraṃ "evaṃ tvāṃ kariṣyāmi" iti karaṇena^abhibhartsayed, akaraṇe yas tasya karaṇe daṇḍas tato^ardha.daṇḍaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: For one who intimidates another [saying] 'I will do this to you' — if the act [threatened] is not carried out, the fine is half of what the penalty would be if the act were carried out.

children.text: KAZ03.18.10/ aśaktaḥ kopaṃ madaṃ mohaṃ vā^apadiśed dvādaśa.paṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: If [the threatened act is] beyond one's capacity and one pleads anger, intoxication, or confusion — [the fine is] twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.18.11/ jāta.vaira.āśayaḥ śaktaś ca^apakartuṃ yāvaj.jīvika.avasthaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: If one harbors enmity and is capable of carrying out the harm, [the fine is] a lifelong surety.

children.text:
KAZ03.18.12ab/ sva.deśa.grāmayoḥ pūrvaṃ madhyamaṃ jāti.saṃghayoḥ /
KAZ03.18.12cd/ ākrośād deva.caityānām uttamaṃ daṇḍam arhati //E
children.translated_text:
For abusing [individuals of] one's own locality or village — the first [level fine]; of one's caste or guild — the middle;
for abusing deities and sacred shrines — the highest fine.

children.text:
(Physical injury)
KAZ03.19.01/ daṇḍa.pāruṣyaṃ sparśanam avagūrṇaṃ prahatam iti //
children.translated_text:
(Physical injury)
Physical assault (<s>daṇḍapāruṣya</s>) [consists of]: touching, striking down, and beating.

children.text: KAZ03.19.02/ nābher adhaḥ.kāyaṃ hasta.paṅka.bhasma.pāṃsubhir iti spṛśatas tri.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, tair eva^amedhyaiḥ pāda.ṣṭhīvikābhyāṃ ca ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ, chardi.mūtra.purīṣa.ādibhir dvādaśa.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For touching [someone] below the navel with the hand, or with mud, ashes, or dust — the fine is three <s>paṇas</s>; with the same [substances] but defiled, or with the foot or spittle — six <s>paṇas</s>; with vomit, urine, feces, etc. — twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.19.03/ nābher upari dvi.guṇāḥ, śirasi catur.guṇāḥ sameṣu //
children.translated_text: Above the navel — double; on the head — fourfold, among equals.

children.text: KAZ03.19.04/ viśiṣṭeṣu dvi.guṇāḥ, hīneṣv ardha.daṇḍāḥ, para.strīṣu dvi.guṇāḥ, pramāda.mada.moha.ādibhir ardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: For [offenses against] superiors — double; for inferiors — half the fine; for another's wife — double; for [offenses] due to negligence, intoxication, or confusion — half the fine.

children.text: KAZ03.19.05/ pāda.vastra.hasta.keśa.avalambaneṣu ṣaṭ.paṇa.uttarā daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: For seizing by the foot, garment, hand, or hair — fines increasing by six <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.19.06/ pīḍana.āveṣṭana.añcana.prakarṣaṇa.adhyāsaneṣu pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For squeezing, twisting, dragging, pulling, and sitting upon [someone] — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.19.07/ pātayitvā^apakrāmato^ardha.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who, having knocked [someone] down, runs away — half the fine.

children.text: KAZ03.19.08/ śūdro yena^aṅgena brāhmaṇam abhihanyāt tad asyac^chedayet //
children.translated_text: A <s>Śūdra</s> who strikes a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> with any limb — that limb of his should be cut off.

children.text: KAZ03.19.09/ avagūrṇe niṣkrayaḥ, sparśe^ardha.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For striking down — the full compensation; for [mere] touching — half the fine.

children.text: KAZ03.19.10/ tena caṇḍāla.aśucayo vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: By this, [the treatment of offenses by] <s>Caṇḍālas</s> and the impure is explained.

children.text: KAZ03.19.11/ hastena^avagūrṇe tri.paṇa.avaro dvādaśa.paṇa.paro daṇḍaḥ, pādena dvi.guṇaḥ, duḥkha.utpādanena dravyeṇa pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, prāṇa.ābādhikena madhyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: For striking down with the hand — the fine ranges from a minimum of three <s>paṇas</s> to a maximum of twelve <s>paṇas</s>; with the foot — double; for causing pain with an object — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine; with [an instrument] endangering life — the middle [level].

children.text: KAZ03.19.12/ kāṣṭha.loṣṭa.pāṣāṇa.loha.daṇḍa.rajju.dravyāṇām anyatamena duḥkham aśoṇitam utpādayataś caturviṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, śoṇita.utpādane dvi.guṇaḥ, anyatra duṣṭa.śoṇitāt //
children.translated_text: For one who causes pain without drawing blood using any one of wood, clod, stone, iron, stick, or rope — a fine of twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; for drawing blood — double, except in cases of impure blood.

children.text: KAZ03.19.13/ mṛta.kalpam aśoṇitaṃ ghnato hasta.pāda.pārañcikaṃ vā kurvataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, pāṇi.pāda.danta.bhaṅge karṇa.nāsa.ācchedane vraṇa.vidāraṇe cca, anyatra duṣṭa.vraṇebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: For beating [someone] nearly to death without [drawing] blood, or for disabling a hand or foot — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine; also for breaking a finger or toe, or cutting an ear or nose, or tearing open a wound — except for impure wounds.

children.text: KAZ03.19.14/ sakthi.grīva.ābhañjane netra.bhedane vā vākya.ceṣṭā.bhojana.uparodheṣu ca madhyamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ samutthāna.vyayaś ca //
children.translated_text: For breaking the thigh or neck, or for piercing the eye, or for obstructing speech, movement, or eating — the middle <s>sāhasa</s> fine, plus the cost of treatment.

children.text: KAZ03.19.15/ vipattau kaṇṭaka.śodhanāya nīyeta //
children.translated_text: In case of [resulting] death — [the offender] should be sent to the department for the removal of thorns [i.e., criminal investigation].

children.text: KAZ03.19.16/ mahā.janasya^ekaṃ ghnataḥ pratyekaṃ dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: When one person of a group strikes [another], each [member] incurs double the fine.

children.text: KAZ03.19.17/ "paryuṣitaḥ kalaho^anupraveśo vā na^abhiyojyaḥ" ity ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: "A stale quarrel or joining an ongoing [quarrel] should not be actionable" — say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.19.18/ na^asty apakāriṇo mokṣa iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: "There is no release for one who has caused harm" — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.19.19/ "kalahe pūrva.āgato jayati, akṣamamāṇo hi pradhāvati" ity ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: "In a quarrel, the one who arrived first prevails, for one who cannot endure [the insult] rushes forward" — say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.19.20/ na^iti kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: "Not so" — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.19.21/ pūrvaṃ paścād vā^abhigatasya sākṣiṇaḥ pramāṇam, asākṣike ghātaḥ kalaha.upaliṅganaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: Whether [the accused] arrived first or later, the testimony of witnesses is authoritative; in the absence of witnesses, [the evidence is] the injuries, or the signs of the quarrel.

children.text: KAZ03.19.22/ ghāta.abhiyogam apratibruvatas tad ahar eva paścāt.kāraḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who does not respond to the charge of assault — that same day, a counter-charge [is filed].

children.text: KAZ03.19.23/ kalahe dravyam apaharato daśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, kṣudraka.dravya.hiṃsāyāṃ tac ca tāvac ca daṇḍaḥ, sthūlaka.dravya.hiṃsāyāṃ tac ca dvi.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ, vastra.ābharaṇa.hiraṇya.suvarṇa.bhāṇḍa.hiṃsāyāṃ tac ca pūrvaś ca sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who seizes property during a quarrel — a fine of ten <s>paṇas</s>; for damage to petty goods — a fine equal to [the value of] the goods plus the same amount; for damage to valuable goods — [the value of] the goods plus double [that amount]; for damage to cloth, ornaments, silver, gold, or vessels — [the value of] the goods plus the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.19.24/ para.kuḍyam abhighātena kṣobhayatas tri.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, chedana.bhedane ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ, pratīkāraś ca //
children.translated_text: For one who shakes another's wall by striking it — a fine of three <s>paṇas</s>; for cutting or breaking [it] — six <s>paṇas</s>, plus restitution.

children.text: KAZ03.19.25/ duḥkha.utpādanaṃ dravyam anya.veśmani prakṣipato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, prāṇa.ābādhikaṃ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who throws a pain-causing object into another's dwelling — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for [throwing] something life-threatening — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.19.26/ kṣudra.paśūnāṃ kāṣṭha.ādibhir duḥkha.utpādane paṇo dvi.guṇo vā daṇḍaḥ, śoṇita.utpādane dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: For causing pain to small animals with wood, etc. — a fine of one or two <s>paṇas</s>; for drawing blood — double.

children.text: KAZ03.19.27/ mahā.paśūnām eteṣv eva sthāneṣv dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ samutthāna.vyayaś ca //
children.translated_text: For large animals, in the same situations — double the fine, plus the cost of treatment.

children.text: KAZ03.19.28/ pura.upavana.vanaspatīnāṃ puṣpa.phalac.chāyāvatāṃ prarohac.chedane ṣaṭ.paṇaḥ, kṣudra.śākhāc.chedane dvādaśa.paṇaḥ, pīna.śākhāc.cchedane catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ, skandha.vadhe pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, samucchittau madhyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: For cutting the shoots of flowering, fruiting, or shade-giving trees in city parks — six <s>paṇas</s>; for cutting small branches — twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for cutting large branches — twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; for killing the trunk — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine; for uprooting — the middle [level].

children.text: KAZ03.19.29/ puṣpa.phalac.chāyāvad.gulma.latāsv ardha.daṇḍāḥ, puṇya.sthāna.tapo.vana.śmaśāna.drumeṣu ca //
children.translated_text: For [damage to] flowering, fruiting, or shade-giving shrubs and creepers — half the fines; also for trees in holy places, ascetic groves, and cremation grounds.

children.text:
KAZ03.19.30ab/ sīma.vṛkṣeṣu caityeṣu drumeṣv ālakṣiteṣu ca /
KAZ03.19.30cd/ ta eva dvi.guṇā daṇḍāḥ kāryā rāja.vaneṣu ca //E
children.translated_text:
For boundary trees, sacred trees, and marked trees,
the same [fines] should be doubled; likewise in the royal forests.

children.text:
(ṅambling and betting)
(ṃiscellaneous)
KAZ03.20.01/ dyūta.adhyakṣo dyūtam eka.mukhaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text:
(Gambling and betting)
(Miscellaneous)
The superintendent of gambling should have gambling conducted in a single [authorized] place.

children.text: KAZ03.20.02/ anyatra dīvyato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍo gūḍha.ājīvi.jñāpana.artham //
children.translated_text: For gambling elsewhere — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>, for the purpose of detecting those of secret livelihood.

children.text: KAZ03.20.03/ "dyūta.abhiyoge jetuḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, parājitasya madhyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: "In a gambling dispute, the winner [should receive] the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine; the loser, the middle [level].

children.text: KAZ03.20.04/ bāliśa.jātīyo hy eṣa jetu.kāmaḥ parājayaṃ na kṣamate" ity ācāryāḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who wishes to win is of a childish nature and cannot endure defeat" — say the teachers.

children.text: KAZ03.20.05/ na^ity kauṭilyaḥ //
children.translated_text: "Not so" — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.20.06/ parājitaś ced dvi.guṇa.daṇḍaḥ kriyeta na kaścana rājānam abhisariṣyati //
children.translated_text: "If the loser were given a double fine, no one would approach the king [for gambling].

children.text: KAZ03.20.07/ prāyaśo hi kitavāḥ kūṭa.devinaḥ //
children.translated_text: For most gamblers are cheats who play with loaded [dice].

children.text: KAZ03.20.08/ teṣām adhyakṣāḥ śuddhāḥ kākaṇīr akṣāṃś ca sthāpayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: The superintendents should provide clean cowrie-shells and dice.

children.text: KAZ03.20.09/ kākaṇy.akṣāṇām anya.upadhāne dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, kūṭa.karmaṇi pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍo jita.pratyādānam, upadhau steya.daṇḍaś ca //
children.translated_text: For substituting [unauthorized] cowrie-shells or dice — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for cheating — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine and restitution of the winnings; for fraud — the penalty for theft.

children.text: KAZ03.20.10/ jita.dravyād adhyakṣaḥ pañcakaṃ śatam ādadīta, kākaṇy.akṣa.arālā.śalākā.avakrayam udaka.bhūmi.karma.krayaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: From the winnings, the superintendent should collect five percent, and [also] the hire of cowrie-shells, dice, <s>arālā</s> (board/mat), and <s>śalākā</s> (counting-sticks), and the charge for water and floor-space.

children.text: KAZ03.20.11/ dravyāṇām ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ ca kuryāt //
children.translated_text: He should arrange the pledging and sale of goods.

children.text: KAZ03.20.12/ akṣa.bhūmi.hasta.doṣāṇāṃ ca^apratiṣedhane dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For failing to prevent defects in the dice, the floor, or the hands — double the fine.

children.text: KAZ03.20.13/ tena samāhvayo vyākhyātaḥ, anyatra vidyā.śilpa.samāhvayāt / iti //
children.translated_text: By this, betting (<s>samāhvaya</s>) is explained, except for wagers on skill and craft. — Thus [ends this section].

children.text: KAZ03.20.14/ prakīrṇakaṃ tu - yācitaka.avakrītaka.āhitaka.nikṣepakāṇāṃ yathā.deśa.kālam adāne, yāmac.chāyā.samupaveśa.saṃsthitīnāṃ vā deśa.kāla.atipātane, gulmatara.deyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sādhayataḥ, prativeśa.anuveśayor upari nimantraṇe ca dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: As for miscellaneous [offenses]: for failure to return, at the designated place and time, a borrowed, purchased, pledged, or deposited [item]; or for overstaying beyond the designated place or time [at a resting place], determined by watch-periods or shadow-lengths; for suing a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> for a toll or ferry payment; and for [unauthorized] invitation to a neighbor's or adjacent [dwelling's celebrations] — a fine of twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.20.15/ saṃdiṣṭam artham aprayacchato, bhrātṛ.bhāryāṃ hastena laṅghayato, rūpa.ājīvām anya.uparuddhāṃ gacchataḥ, para.vaktavyaṃ paṇyaṃ krīṇānasya, samudraṃ gṛham udbhindataḥ, sāmanta.catvāriṃśat.kulya.ābādhām ācarataś ca^aṣṭa.catvāriṃśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who does not hand over a commissioned sum; for one who touches with the hand a brother's wife; for one who visits a woman who lives by her beauty but is kept by another; for one who buys goods that are [reserved for] another's commission; for one who breaks into a house [like] flooding the ocean; for one who causes harm to neighbors or to the forty <s>kulya</s> families — a fine of forty-eight <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ03.20.16/ kula.nīvī.grāhakasya^apavyayane, vidhavāṃ chanda.vāsinīṃ prasahya^adhicarataḥ, caṇḍālasya^āryāṃ spṛśataḥ, pratyāsannam āpady anabhidhāvato, niṣkāraṇam abhidhāvanaṃ kurvataḥ, śākya.ājīvaka.ādīn vṛṣala.pravrajitān deva.pitṛ.kāryeṣu bhojayataḥ śatyo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who wastes a family's capital savings; for one who forcibly mounts a willing widow; for a <s>Caṇḍāla</s> who touches an <s>Ārya</s> woman; for one who does not rush to help a neighbor in distress; for one who raises an alarm without cause; for one who feeds <s>Śākya</s>, <s>Ājīvaka</s>, and other <s>Śūdra</s> ascetics at ceremonies for gods and ancestors — a fine of one hundred [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ03.20.17/ śapatha.vākya.anuyogam aniṣṛṣṭaṃ kurvataḥ, yukta.karma ca^ayuktasya, kṣudra.paśu.vṛṣāṇāṃ puṃstva.upaghātinaḥ, dāsyā garbham auṣadhena pātayataś ca pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For one who administers an unauthorized trial by oath; for one not in office who performs an official act; for one who damages the virility of small animal bulls; and for one who causes the miscarriage of a slave-woman's embryo by means of medicine — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: KAZ03.20.18/ pitā.putrayor dampatyor bhrātṛ.bhaginyor mātula.bhagineyayoḥ śiṣya.ācāryayor vā parasparam apatitaṃ tyajataḥ, sārtha.ābhiprayātaṃ grāma.madhye vā tyajataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, kāntāre madhyamaḥ, tan.nimittaṃ bhreṣayata uttamaḥ, saha.prasthāyiṣv anyeṣv ardha.daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: For abandoning — without outcasting — [the following]: father and son mutually, husband and wife, brother and sister, maternal uncle and nephew, teacher and pupil; for abandoning a fellow-traveler in a caravan or in the middle of a village — the first level of the <s>sāhasa</s> fine; in the wilderness — the middle [level]; for causing death thereby — the highest [level]; for other fellow-travelers — half the fines.

children.text: KAZ03.20.19/ puruṣam abandhanīyaṃ badhnato bandhayato bandhaṃ vā mokṣayato, bālam aprāpta.vyavahāraṃ badhnato bandhayato vā sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: For binding, causing to be bound, or releasing from bondage a person who should not be bound; or for binding or causing to be bound a child who has not attained legal majority — a fine of one thousand [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ03.20.20/ puruṣa.aparādha.viśeṣeṇa daṇḍa.viśeṣaḥ kāryaḥ //
children.translated_text: The fine should be determined according to the specific nature of the person's offense.

children.text: KAZ03.20.21/ tīrtha.karas tapasvī vyādhitaḥ kṣut.pipāsā.adhva.klāntas tiro.jana.pado daṇḍa.khedī niṣkiṃcanaś ca^anugrāhyāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.20.21/ A pilgrim performing religious rites, an ascetic, a sick person, one exhausted by hunger, thirst, or travel, one off the beaten path, one wearied by punishment, and one who is destitute — these should be shown compassion.

children.text: KAZ03.20.22/ deva.brāhmaṇa.tapasvi.strī.bāla.vṛddha.vyādhitānām anāthānām anabhisaratāṃ dharmasthāḥ kāryāṇi kuryuḥ, na ca deśa.kāla.bhogac.chalena^atihareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.20.22/ The judicial officers should handle the cases of deities, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, ascetics, women, children, the aged, and the sick — [all] helpless and unable to appear [in court] — and should not exploit [them] under the pretext of place, time, or enjoyment.

children.text: KAZ03.20.23/ pūjyā vidyā.buddhi.pauruṣa.abhijana.karma.atiśayataś ca puruṣāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ03.20.23/ Men are to be honored for their excellence in learning, intellect, valor, noble birth, and deeds.

children.text:
KAZ03.20.24ab/ evaṃ kāryāṇi dharmasthāḥ kuryur acchala.darśinaḥ /
KAZ03.20.24cd/ samāḥ sarveṣu bhāveṣu viśvāsyā loka.sampriyāḥ //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ03.20.24ab/ Thus the judicial officers should handle cases, being perceptive of fraud,
KAZ03.20.24cd/ impartial in all matters, trustworthy, and dear to all the people.

children.text:
(ṣuppression of criminals)
(Keeping a watch over artisans)
KAZ04.1.01/ pradeṣṭāras trayas trayo^amātyāḥ kaṇṭaka.śodhanaṃ kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Suppression of criminals)
(Keeping a watch over artisans)
KAZ04.1.01/ Three groups of three magistrates each should carry out the removal of thorns (<s>kaṇṭakaśodhana</s>).

children.text: KAZ04.1.02/ arthya.pratīkārāḥ kāru.śāsitāraḥ saṃnikṣeptāraḥ sva.vitta.kāravaḥ śreṇī.pramāṇā nikṣepaṃ gṛhṇīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.02/ Those qualified in financial remedies, supervisors of artisans, assessors, those who know their own craft, and [those vouched for by] guild standards should receive deposits.

children.text: KAZ04.1.03/ vipattau śreṇī nikṣepaṃ bhajeta //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.03/ In case of loss, the guild should bear the deposit.

children.text: KAZ04.1.04/ nirdiṣṭa.deśa.kāla.kāryaṃ ca karma kuryuḥ, anirdiṣṭa.deśa.kālaṃ kārya.apadeśam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.04/ And they should perform work at the designated place, time, and task; [if] undesignated in place and time, [they should have] a pretext of assignment.

children.text: KAZ04.1.05/ kāla.atipātane pāda.hīnaṃ vetanaṃ tad.dvi.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.05/ For delay beyond the time — one-quarter reduction of wages and a fine of double that.

children.text: KAZ04.1.06/ anyatra bhreṣa.upanipātābhyāṃ naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā^abhyāvaheyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.06/ Except through accident or calamity, they should replace what is lost or destroyed.

children.text: KAZ04.1.07/ kāryasya^anyathā.karaṇe vetana.nāśas tad.dvi.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.07/ For performing the work wrongly — loss of wages and a fine of double that.

children.text: KAZ04.1.08/ tantu.vāyā daśa.ekādaśikaṃ sūtraṃ vardhayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.08/ Weavers should increase the thread by ten or eleven [parts per hundred].

children.text: KAZ04.1.09/ vṛddhic.chede cheda.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.09/ For cutting the excess — a fine double the cut.

children.text: KAZ04.1.10/ sūtra.mūlyaṃ vāna.vetanaṃ, kṣauma.kauśeyānām adhyardha.guṇaṃ, pattra.ūrṇā.kambala.dukūlānāṃ dvi.guṇam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.10/ The price of the thread is the weaving wage; for linen and silk, one and a half times; for leaf-fiber, wool, blanket, and <s>dukūla</s> cloth — double.

children.text: KAZ04.1.11/ māna.hīne hīna.avahīnaṃ vetanaṃ tad.dvi.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ, tulā.hīne hīna.catur.guṇo daṇḍaḥ, sūtra.parivartane mūlya.dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.11/ For a shortfall in measurement — a fine [equal to] the deficiency plus the lost wages; for a shortfall in weight — a fine of four times the deficiency; for substituting thread — double the [original] price.

children.text: KAZ04.1.12/ tena dvi.paṭa.vānaṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.12/ By this, the weaving of two-layered cloth is explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.13/ ūrṇā.tulāyāḥ pañca.paliko vihananac.chedo romac.chedaś ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.13/ From a <s>tulā</s> of wool — five <s>palas</s> of waste from beating and shearing.

children.text: KAZ04.1.14/ rajakāḥ kāṣṭha.phalaka.ślakṣṇa.śilāsu vastrāṇi nenijyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.14/ Washermen should wash garments on wooden boards, flat stones, or smooth rocks.

children.text: KAZ04.1.15/ anyatra nenijato vastra.upaghātaṃ ṣaṭ.paṇaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.15/ For one who washes elsewhere — he should pay for the damage to the garment and a fine of six <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.16/ mudgara.aṅkād anyad vāsaḥ paridadhānās tri.paṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.16/ For wearing a garment other than the one marked with a mallet-stamp — the fine is three <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.17/ para.vastra.vikraya.avakraya.ādhāneṣu ca dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, parivartane mūlya.dvi.guṇo vastra.dānaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.17/ For selling, renting out, or pledging another's garment — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; for substituting — double the price plus return of the garment.

children.text: KAZ04.1.18/ mukula.avadātaṃ śilā.paṭṭa.śuddhaṃ dhauta.sūtra.varṇaṃ pramṛṣṭa.śvetaṃ ca^eka.rātra.uttaraṃ dadyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.18/ They should deliver [the garment] one day later for: bud-white, stone-slab cleaned, washed-thread-colored, and wiped-white [treatments].

children.text: KAZ04.1.19/ pañca.rātrikaṃ tanu.rāgaṃ, ṣaḍ.rātrikaṃ nīlaṃ, puṣpa.lākṣā.mañjiṣṭhā.raktaṃ guru.parikarma yatna.upacāryaṃ jātyaṃ vāsaḥ sapta.rātrikam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.19/ Five days for light dyeing; six days for indigo; seven days for a fine garment [dyed with] flower, lac, and <s>mañjiṣṭhā</s> red — [which requires] intensive treatment and careful handling.

children.text: KAZ04.1.20/ tataḥ paraṃ vetana.hāniṃ prāpnuyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.20/ Beyond that, they should incur loss of wages.

children.text: KAZ04.1.21/ śraddheyā rāga.vivādeṣu vetanaṃ kuśalāḥ kalpayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.21/ Trustworthy experts should determine the wages in disputes over dyeing.

children.text: KAZ04.1.22/ parārdhyānāṃ paṇo vetanaṃ, madhyamānām ardha.paṇaḥ, pratyavarāṇāṃ pādaḥ, sthūlakānāṃ māṣaka.dvi.māṣakaṃ, dvi.guṇaṃ raktakānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.22/ For very fine [cloth], the wage is one <s>paṇa</s>; for middling, half a <s>paṇa</s>; for inferior, one-quarter; for coarse, one or two <s>māṣakas</s>; double for colored [cloth].

children.text: KAZ04.1.23/ prathama.nejane catur.bhāgaḥ kṣayaḥ, dvitīye pañca.bhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.23/ At the first washing, the loss [in size] is one-quarter; at the second, one-fifth.

children.text: KAZ04.1.24/ tena^uttaraṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.24/ By this, the subsequent [washings] are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.25/ rajakais tunna.vāyā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.25/ By [the rules for] washermen, tailors are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.26/ suvarṇa.kārāṇām aśuci.hastād rūpyaṃ suvarṇam anākhyāya sarūpaṃ krīṇatāṃ dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ, virūpaṃ catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ, cora.hastād aṣṭa.catvāriṃśat.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.26/ For goldsmiths who purchase silver or gold from an unclean source without declaration: if of proper form — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; if of improper form — twenty-four <s>paṇas</s>; from a thief — forty-eight <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.27/ pracchanna.virūpa.mūlya.hīna.krayeṣu steya.daṇḍaḥ, kṛta.bhāṇḍa.upadhau ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.27/ For secretly buying [goods that are] of improper form, of reduced value, or [at below market] price — the penalty for theft; likewise for fraud involving finished articles.

children.text: KAZ04.1.28/ suvarṇān māṣakam apaharato dvi.śato daṇḍaḥ, rūpya.dharaṇān māṣakam apaharato dvādaśa.paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.28/ For one who steals one <s>māṣaka</s> from [a quantity of] gold — the fine is two hundred [<s>paṇas</s>]; for one who steals one <s>māṣaka</s> from a <s>dharaṇa</s> of silver — twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.29/ tena^uttaraṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.29/ By this, the higher [fines] are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.30/ varṇa.utkarṣam apasāraṇaṃ yogaṃ vā sādhayataḥ pañca.śato daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.30/ For one who achieves an enhancement of color, a reduction [of impurities], or a [special] combination — the fine is five hundred [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ04.1.31/ tayor apacaraṇe rāgasya^apahāraṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.31/ In their malfeasance regarding those two, one should know [it as] theft of the color [quality].

children.text: KAZ04.1.32/ māṣako vetanaṃ rūpya.dharaṇasya, suvarṇasya^aṣṭa.bhāgaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.32/ The wage for [working] one <s>dharaṇa</s> of silver is one <s>māṣaka</s>; for gold, one-eighth.

children.text: KAZ04.1.33/ śikṣā.viśeṣeṇa dvi.guṇo vetana.vṛddhiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.33/ For special skill, the wage increases double.

children.text: KAZ04.1.34/ tena^uttaraṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.34/ By this, the higher [wages] are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.35/ tāmra.vṛtta.kaṃsa.vaikṛntaka.āra.kūṭakānāṃ pañcakaṃ śataṃ vetanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.35/ For [workers in] copper, <s>vṛtta</s> (brass), bell-metal, <s>vaikṛntaka</s>, and alloys — the wage is five percent.

children.text: KAZ04.1.36/ tāmra.piṇḍo daśa.bhāga.kṣayaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.36/ A copper ingot [suffers] a one-tenth loss [in smelting].

children.text: KAZ04.1.37/ pala.hīne hīna.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.37/ For a shortfall of one <s>pala</s> — a fine of double the deficiency.

children.text: KAZ04.1.38/ tena^uttaraṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.38/ By this, the higher [fines] are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.39/ sīsa.trapu.piṇḍo viṃśati.bhāga.kṣayaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.39/ A lead or tin ingot [suffers] a one-twentieth loss.

children.text: KAZ04.1.40/ kākaṇī ca^asya pala.vetanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.40/ And its wage per <s>pala</s> is one <s>kākaṇī</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.41/ kāla.āyasa.piṇḍaḥ pañca.bhāga.kṣayaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.41/ A steel ingot [suffers] a one-fifth loss.

children.text: KAZ04.1.42/ kākaṇī.dvayaṃ ca^asya pala.vetanam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.42/ And its wage per <s>pala</s> is two <s>kākaṇīs</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.43/ tena^uttaraṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.43/ By this, the higher [wages] are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.44/ rūpa.darśakasya sthitāṃ paṇa.yātrām akopyāṃ kopayataḥ kopyām akopayato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.44/ For the coin-inspector who destabilizes a fixed currency standard, or fails to destabilize [a counterfeit] one — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.45/ vyājī.pariśuddhau paṇa.yātrā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.45/ The currency [is authorized] after purification of the fee.

children.text: KAZ04.1.46/ paṇān māṣakam upajīvato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.46/ For one who earns a living by [extracting] one <s>māṣaka</s> per <s>paṇa</s> [in illegal fees] — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.47/ tena^uttaraṃ vyākhyātam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.47/ By this, the higher [fines] are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.48/ kūṭa.rūpaṃ kārayataḥ pratigṛhṇato niryāpayato vā sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ, kośe prakṣipato vadhaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.48/ For one who has counterfeit coins made, receives them, or circulates them — the fine is one thousand [<s>paṇas</s>]; for one who introduces them into the treasury — death.

children.text: KAZ04.1.49/ caraka.pāṃsu.dhāvakāḥ sāra.tri.bhāgaṃ, dvau rājā ratnaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.49/ Itinerant gold-washers and dust-sifters [receive] one-third of the fine metal [recovered]; the king [receives] two-thirds and the gem.

children.text: KAZ04.1.50/ ratna.apahāra uttamo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.50/ For stealing a gem — the highest fine.

children.text: KAZ04.1.51/ khani.ratna.nidhi.nivedaneṣu ṣaṣṭham aṃśaṃ nivettā labheta, dvādaśam aṃśaṃ bhṛtakaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.51/ For reporting a mine, gem, or treasure — the reporter receives one-sixth of the share; a hired [reporter], one-twelfth.

children.text: KAZ04.1.52/ śata.sahasrād ūrdhvaṃ rāja.gāmī nidhiḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.52/ A treasure exceeding one hundred thousand [<s>paṇas</s>] belongs to the king.

children.text: KAZ04.1.53/ ūne ṣaṣṭham aṃśaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.53/ If less, he should give one-sixth.

children.text: KAZ04.1.54/ paurvapauruṣikaṃ nidhiṃ jānapadaḥ śuciḥ sva.karaṇena samagraṃ labheta //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.54/ An ancestral treasure [found by] a trustworthy subject with his own means — he may take it all.

children.text: KAZ04.1.55/ sva.karaṇa.abhāve pañca.śato daṇḍaḥ, pracchanna.ādāne sahasram //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.55/ In the absence of his own means — the fine is five hundred [<s>paṇas</s>]; for taking it secretly — one thousand.

children.text: KAZ04.1.56/ bhiṣajaḥ prāṇa.ābādhikam anākhyāya^upakramamāṇasya vipattau pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, karma.aparādhena vipattau madhyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.56/ For a physician who undertakes treatment without declaring a life-threatening [condition] — if the patient dies, the first level <s>sāhasa</s> fine; if [the patient dies] due to a professional error — the middle [level].

children.text: KAZ04.1.57/ marma.vadha.vaiguṇya.karaṇe daṇḍa.pāruṣyaṃ vidyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.57/ For causing death to a vital organ or creating a disability — the penalties for physical assault should apply.

children.text: KAZ04.1.58/ kuśīlavā varṣā.rātram ekasthā vaseyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.58/ Performers should reside in one place during the rainy season.

children.text: KAZ04.1.59/ kāma.dānam atimātram ekasya^ativādaṃ ca varjayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.59/ They should avoid excessive voluntary gifts [concentrated on] one person, and excessive praise of one person.

children.text: KAZ04.1.60/ tasya^atikrame dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.60/ For transgressing this — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.1.61/ kāmaṃ deśa.jāti.gotra.caraṇa.maithuna.avahāsena narmayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.61/ They may freely make jests concerning country, caste, family, [Vedic] branch, sexual conduct, and [personal] ridicule.

children.text: KAZ04.1.62/ kuśīlavaiś cāraṇā bhikṣukāś ca vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.62/ By [the rules for] performers, wandering bards and mendicants are also explained.

children.text: KAZ04.1.63/ teṣām ayaḥ.śūlena yāvataḥ paṇān abhivadeyus tāvantaḥ śiphā.prahārā daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.63/ For them, the punishment in lieu of iron-stake [execution] — as many <s>paṇas</s> as they claim [in defamation], that many lashes with a cane.

children.text: KAZ04.1.64/ śeṣāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ niṣpatti.vetanaṃ śilpināṃ kalpayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.1.64/ For other trades, he should determine the output-based wages of the artisans.

children.text:
KAZ04.1.65ab/ evaṃ corān acora.ākhyān vaṇik.kāru.kuśīlavān /
KAZ04.1.66cd/ bhikṣukān kuhakāṃś ca^anyān vārayed deśa.pīḍanāt //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ04.1.65ab/ Thus the thieves not called thieves — traders, artisans, performers,
KAZ04.1.66cd/ mendicants, and other charlatans — he should prevent from oppressing the people.

children.text:
(Keeping a watch over traders)
KAZ04.2.01/ saṃsthā.adhyakṣaḥ paṇya.saṃsthāyāṃ purāṇa.bhāṇḍānāṃ sva.karaṇa.viśuddhānām ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā sthāpayet //
children.translated_text:
(Keeping a watch over traders)
KAZ04.2.01/ The superintendent of markets should establish the deposit or sale of old merchandise [that is] authenticated with marks of ownership in the marketplace.

children.text: KAZ04.2.02/ tulā.māna.bhāṇḍāni ca^avekṣeta pautava.apacārāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.02/ And he should inspect the scales, measures, and vessels to prevent fraud in weighing.

children.text: KAZ04.2.03/ parimāṇī.droṇayor ardha.pala.hīna.atiriktam adoṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.03/ In a <s>parimāṇī</s> and <s>droṇa</s> [measure], a deficiency or excess of half a <s>pala</s> is not an offense.

children.text: KAZ04.2.04/ pala.hīna.atirikte dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.04/ For a deficiency or excess of one <s>pala</s> — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.2.05/ tena pala.uttarā daṇḍa.vṛddhir vyākhyātā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.05/ By this, the increasing fines for each [additional] <s>pala</s> are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.2.06/ tulāyāḥ karṣa.hīna.atiriktam adoṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.06/ In a balance, a deficiency or excess of one <s>karṣa</s> is not an offense.

children.text: KAZ04.2.07/ dvi.karṣa.hīna.atirikte ṣaṭ.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.07/ For a deficiency or excess of two <s>karṣas</s> — the fine is six <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.2.08/ tena karṣa.uttarā daṇḍa.vṛddhir vyākhyātā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.08/ By this, the increasing fines for each [additional] <s>karṣa</s> are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.2.09/ āḍhakasya^ardha.karṣa.hīna.atiriktam adoṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.09/ In an <s>āḍhaka</s> [measure], a deficiency or excess of half a <s>karṣa</s> is not an offense.

children.text: KAZ04.2.10/ karṣa.hīna.atirikte tri.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.10/ For a deficiency or excess of one <s>karṣa</s> — the fine is three <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.2.11/ tena karṣa.uttarā daṇḍa.vṛddhir vyākhyātā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.11/ By this, the increasing fines for each [additional] <s>karṣa</s> are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.2.12/ tulā.māna.viśeṣāṇām ato^anyeṣām anumānaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.12/ For other types of scales and measures, one should estimate [the fines] from this.

children.text: KAZ04.2.13/ tulā.mānābhyām atiriktābhyāṃ krītvā hīnābhyāṃ vikrīṇānasya ta eva dvi.guṇā daṇḍāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.13/ For one who buys with oversize scales and measures and sells with undersize ones — the same fines, doubled.

children.text: KAZ04.2.14/ gaṇya.paṇyeṣv aṣṭa.bhāgaṃ paṇya.mūlyeṣv apaharataḥ ṣaṇ.ṇavatir daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.14/ For one who steals one-eighth of the price on goods sold by count — the fine is ninety-six [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ04.2.15/ kāṣṭha.loha.maṇi.mayaṃ rajju.carma.mṛṇ.mayaṃ sūtra.valka.roma.mayaṃ vā jātyam ity ajātyaṃ vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayato mūlya.aṣṭa.guṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.15/ For one who sells or deposits [as genuine] what is not genuine — [saying] "it is made of wood, iron, or gem" when [made of] rope, leather, or clay, or "it is made of thread, bark, or hair" — the fine is eight times the price.

children.text: KAZ04.2.16/ sāra.bhāṇḍam ity asāra.bhāṇḍaṃ taj.jātam ity ataj.jātaṃ rādhā.yuktam ity upadhiyuktaṃ samudga.parivartimaṃ vā vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayato hīna.mūlyaṃ catuṣpañcāśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, paṇa.mūlyaṃ dvi.guṇo, dvi.paṇa.mūlyaṃ dvi.śataḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.16/ For one who sells or deposits as genuine articles — [calling] "fine goods" what is of inferior goods, [calling] "of that type" what is not of that type, [calling] "naturally treated" what is adulterated, or [selling] goods with a swappable inner container — the fine is fifty-four <s>paṇas</s> for goods worth less [than a <s>paṇa</s>]; double for goods worth a <s>paṇa</s>; two hundred for goods worth two <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.2.17/ tena^argha.vṛddhau daṇḍa.vṛddhir vyākhyātā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.17/ By this, the increasing fines for increasing prices are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.2.18/ kāru.śilpināṃ karma.guṇa.apakarṣam ājīvaṃ vikraya.kraya.upaghātaṃ vā sambhūya samutthāpayatāṃ sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.18/ For artisans and craftsmen who, combining together, degrade the quality of work, [reduce] the livelihood, or damage the [processes of] sale and purchase — the fine is one thousand [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ04.2.19/ vaidehakānāṃ vā sambhūya paṇyam avarundhatām anargheṇa vikrīṇatāṃ vā sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.19/ For traders who, combining together, hoard merchandise or sell at unreasonable prices — the fine is one thousand [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ04.2.20/ tulā.māna.antaram argha.varṇa.antaraṃ vā - dharakasya māyakasya vā paṇa.mūlyād aṣṭa.bhāgaṃ hasta.doṣeṇa^ācarato dvi.śato daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.20/ For a difference in weight or measure, or a difference in price or quality — when a carrier or assayer, through deliberate hand-manipulation, [creates a discrepancy of] one-eighth of the <s>paṇa</s>-value — the fine is two hundred [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ04.2.21/ tena dvi.śata.uttarā daṇḍa.vṛddhir vyākhyātā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.21/ By this, the increasing fines above two hundred are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.2.22/ dhānya.sneha.kṣāra.lavaṇa.gandha.bhaiṣajya.dravyāṇāṃ sama.varṇa.upadhāne dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.22/ For adulterating grains, oils, alkalis, salts, perfumes, medicines, or [other] substances with similar-looking [substitutes] — the fine is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.2.23/ yan.niṣṛṣṭam upajīveyus tad eṣāṃ divasa.saṃjātaṃ saṃkhyāya vaṇik sthāpayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.23/ Whatever [profit] is granted for them to earn their living — that daily income should be calculated, and the trader should keep [records].

children.text: KAZ04.2.24/ kretṛ.vikretror antara.patitam ādāyād anyad bhavati //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.24/ What falls between buyer and seller [as wastage or spillage] becomes revenue other than the tax.

children.text: KAZ04.2.25/ tena dhānya.paṇya.nicayāṃś ca^anujñātāḥ kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.25/ By this, they are authorized to maintain grain and merchandise reserves.

children.text: KAZ04.2.26/ anyathā.nicitam eṣāṃ paṇya.adhyakṣo gṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.26/ What is improperly stored, the superintendent of commerce should confiscate.

children.text: KAZ04.2.27/ tena dhānya.paṇya.vikraye vyavahareta^anugraheṇa prajānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.27/ With that, he should conduct trade in grain and merchandise for the benefit of the subjects.

children.text: KAZ04.2.28/ anujñāta.krayād upari ca^eṣāṃ sva.deśīyānāṃ paṇyānāṃ pañcakaṃ śatam ājīvaṃ sthāpayet, para.deśīyānāṃ daśakam //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.28/ And above the authorized purchase [price], he should fix the profit margin for their domestic goods at five percent, and for foreign goods at ten percent.

children.text: KAZ04.2.29/ tataḥ param arghaṃ vardhayatāṃ kraye vikraye vā bhāvayatāṃ paṇa.śate pañca.paṇād dvi.śato daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.29/ For those who increase the price beyond that, or manipulate [prices] in buying or selling — on a hundred <s>paṇas</s>, [for every] five <s>paṇas</s> [of excess], the fine is two hundred [<s>paṇas</s>].

children.text: KAZ04.2.30/ tena^argha.vṛddhau daṇḍa.vṛddhir vyākhyātā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.30/ By this, the increasing fines for increasing prices are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.2.31/ sambhūya.kraye ca^eṣām avikrīte na^anyaṃ sambhūya.krayaṃ dadyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.31/ And when goods are purchased jointly by them — until unsold, no one should enter into another joint purchase.

children.text: KAZ04.2.32/ paṇya.upaghāte ca^eṣām anugrahaṃ kuryāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.32/ And he should grant relief in the event of loss of merchandise.

children.text: KAZ04.2.33/ paṇya.bāhulyāt paṇya.adhyakṣaḥ sarva.paṇyāny eka.mukhāni vikrīṇīta //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.33/ When there is an abundance of goods, the superintendent of trade should sell all goods through a single outlet.

children.text: KAZ04.2.34/ teṣv avikrīteṣu na^anye vikrīṇīran //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.34/ Until those [monopoly goods] are sold, others should not sell.

children.text: KAZ04.2.35/ tāni divasa.vetanena vikrīṇīrann anugraheṇa prajānām //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.2.35/ They should sell those [goods] at daily wages for the benefit of the people.

children.text:
KAZ04.2.36ab/ deśa.kāla.antaritānāṃ tu paṇyānāṃ - prakṣepaṃ paṇya.niṣpattiṃ śulkaṃ vṛddhim avakrayam /
KAZ04.2.36cd/ vyayān anyāṃś ca saṃkhyāya sthāpayed argham arghavit //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ04.2.36ab/ But for goods separated by place and time — having calculated the cost, production, customs duty, interest, storage,
KAZ04.2.36cd/ and other expenses, the price-expert should fix the price.

children.text:
(ṛemedial measures during calamities)
KAZ04.3.01/ daivāny aṣṭau mahā.bhayāni - agnir udakaṃ vyādhir durbhikṣaṃ mūṣikā vyālāḥ sarpā rakṣāṃsi^iti //
children.translated_text:
(Remedial measures during calamities)
KAZ04.3.01/ There are eight great divine calamities: fire, flood, disease, famine, rats, wild animals, serpents, and evil spirits.

children.text: KAZ04.3.02/ tebhyo jana.padaṃ rakṣet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.02/ He should protect the countryside from these.

children.text: KAZ04.3.03/ grīṣme bahir.adhiśrayaṇaṃ grāmāḥ kuryuḥ, daśa.mūlī.saṃgraheṇa^adhiṣṭhitā vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.03/ In summer, villages should cook outside, or [be] supervised with an organized ten-household fire-watch.

children.text: KAZ04.3.04/ nāgarika.praṇidhāv agni.pratiṣedho vyākhyātaḥ, niśānta.praṇidhau rāja.parigrahe ca //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.04/ Fire prevention is explained under the rules of the city superintendent, under the palace watch, and in [the section on] the royal household.

children.text: KAZ04.3.05/ bali.homa.svasti.vācanaiḥ parvasu ca^agni.pūjāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.05/ He should have fire-worship performed at festivals with offerings, oblations, and blessings.

children.text: KAZ04.3.06/ varṣā.rātram ānūpa.grāmāḥ pūra.velām utsṛjya vaseyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.06/ Riverside villages should, during the rainy season at night, vacate [their homes] during the flood season.

children.text: KAZ04.3.07/ kāṣṭha.veṇu.nāvaś ca^upagṛhṇīyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.07/ They should keep ready boats [made of] wood and bamboo.

children.text: KAZ04.3.08/ uhyamānam alābu.dṛti.plava.gaṇḍikā.veṇikābhis tārayeyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.08/ Those being swept away should be rescued with gourds, leather floats, rafts, logs, and bamboo bundles.

children.text: KAZ04.3.09/ anabhisaratāṃ dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra plava.hīnebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.09/ The fine for not coming to the rescue is twelve <s>paṇas</s>, except for those without a float.

children.text: KAZ04.3.10/ parvasu ca nadī.pūjāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.10/ He should have river-worship performed at festivals.

children.text: KAZ04.3.11/ māyā.yogavido vedavido vā varṣam abhicareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.11/ Those skilled in magical arts or knowers of the <s>Vedas</s> should perform rain-making rites.

children.text: KAZ04.3.12/ varṣa.avagrahe śacī.nātha.gaṅgā.parvata.mahā.kaccha.pūjāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.12/ In drought, he should have worship performed for <s>Śacī's</s> lord [<s>Indra</s>], the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, mountains, and great marshes.

children.text: KAZ04.3.13/ vyādhi.bhayam aupaniṣadikaiḥ pratīkāraiḥ pratikuryuḥ, auṣadhaiś cikitsakāḥ śānti.prāyaścittair vā siddha.tāpasāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.13/ The danger of disease should be countered with esoteric remedies, with medicines by physicians, or with pacificatory rites and penances by accomplished ascetics.

children.text: KAZ04.3.14/ tena marako vyākhyātaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.14/ By this, [the remedy for] plague is explained.

children.text: KAZ04.3.15/ tīrtha.abhiṣecanaṃ mahā.kaccha.vardhanaṃ gavāṃ śmaśāna.avadohanaṃ kabandha.dahanaṃ deva.rātriṃ ca kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.15/ He should have performed: sprinkling with water from sacred fords, extension of great marshes, milking of cows at cremation grounds, burning of headless trunks, and an all-night vigil for the gods.

children.text: KAZ04.3.16/ paśu.vyādhi.marake sthāna.artha.nīrājanaṃ sva.daivata.pūjanaṃ ca kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.16/ In an animal epidemic, he should have performed: lustration with reference to the stable and the goods, and worship of the patron deity.

children.text: KAZ04.3.17/ durbhikṣe rājā bīja.bhakta.upagrahaṃ kṛtvā^anugrahaṃ kuryāt, durga.setu.karma vā bhakta.anugraheṇa, bhakta.saṃvibhāgaṃ vā, deśa.nikṣepaṃ vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.17/ In famine, the king, having collected seed-grain and provisions, should grant relief — or [he should undertake] fort and embankment construction providing food as wages, or distribute food, or relocate [the population].

children.text: KAZ04.3.18/ mitrāṇi vā vyapāśrayeta, karśanaṃ vamanaṃ vā kuryāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.18/ Or he should seek the support of allies, or thin out [non-essential dependents] or expel [them].

children.text: KAZ04.3.19/ niṣpanna.sasyam anya.viṣayaṃ vā sajana.pado yāyāt, samudra.saras.taṭākāni vā saṃśrayeta //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.19/ Or he should move, together with the people, to another territory with ripe crops, or take refuge at the ocean, a lake, or a reservoir.

children.text: KAZ04.3.20/ dhānya.śāka.mūla.phala.āvāpān vā setuṣu kurvīta, mṛga.paśu.pakṣi.vyāla.matsya.ārambhān vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.20/ Or he should have planted at the embankments: grain, vegetables, roots, and fruits; or initiate operations for [obtaining] game, cattle, birds, wild animals, and fish.

children.text: KAZ04.3.21/ mūṣika.bhaye mārjāra.nakula.utsargaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.21/ Against the danger of rats: release of cats and mongooses.

children.text: KAZ04.3.22/ teṣāṃ grahaṇa.hiṃsāyāṃ dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, śunām anigrahe ca^anyatra^araṇya.carebhyaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.22/ The fine for capturing or harming them is twelve <s>paṇas</s>; and [the same] for not restraining dogs, except those ranging in the forest.

children.text: KAZ04.3.23/ snuhi.kṣīra.liptāni dhānyāni visṛjed, upaniṣad.yoga.yuktāni vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.23/ Grain smeared with the milk of <s>snuhi</s> (Euphorbia) should be scattered, or [grain] treated with esoteric preparations.

children.text: KAZ04.3.24/ mūṣika.karaṃ vā prayuñjīta //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.24/ Or a rat-tax should be imposed.

children.text: KAZ04.3.25/ śāntiṃ vā siddha.tāpasāḥ kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.25/ Or accomplished ascetics should perform pacificatory rites.

children.text: KAZ04.3.26/ parvasu ca mūṣika.pūjāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.26/ He should have rat-worship performed at festivals.

children.text: KAZ04.3.27/ tena śalabha.pakṣi.krimi.bhaya.pratīkārā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.27/ By this, the remedies against locusts, birds, and vermin are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.3.28/ vyāla.bhaye madana.rasa.yuktāni paśu.śavāni prasṛjet, madana.kodrava.pūrṇāny audaryāṇi vā //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.28/ Against the danger of wild animals: carcasses of cattle laced with <s>madana</s> (intoxicant) should be scattered, or bellies [of animals] stuffed with <s>madana</s> and <s>kodrava</s> [grain].

children.text: KAZ04.3.29/ lubdhakāḥ śva.gaṇino vā kūṭa.pañjara.avapātaiś careyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.29/ Hunters with their dogs should patrol with traps, cages, and pitfalls.

children.text: KAZ04.3.30/ āvaraṇinaḥ śastra.pāṇayo vyālān abhihanyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.30/ Armored men with weapons should strike down the wild animals.

children.text: KAZ04.3.31/ anabhisartur dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.31/ The fine for not coming to the rescue is twelve <s>paṇas</s>.

children.text: KAZ04.3.32/ sa eva lābho vyāla.ghātinaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.32/ The same [amount] is the reward for the slayer of a wild animal.

children.text: KAZ04.3.33/ parvasu ca parvata.pūjāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.33/ He should have mountain-worship performed at festivals.

children.text: KAZ04.3.34/ tena mṛga.paśu.pakṣi.saṃgha.grāha.pratīkārā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.34/ By this, the remedies against herds of wild animals, cattle, birds, and crocodiles are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.3.35/ sarpa.bhaye mantrair oṣadhibhiś ca jāṅgulīvidaś careyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.35/ Against the danger of serpents: those skilled in antidotes (<s>jāṅgulīvidas</s>) should patrol with incantations and herbs.

children.text: KAZ04.3.36/ sambhūya vā^api sarpān hanyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.36/ Or they should collectively kill the serpents.

children.text: KAZ04.3.37/ atharva.vedavido vā^abhicareyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.37/ Or those learned in the <s>Atharva Veda</s> should perform [counter-] rites.

children.text: KAZ04.3.38/ parvasu ca nāga.pūjāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.38/ He should have serpent-worship (<s>nāga-pūjā</s>) performed at festivals.

children.text: KAZ04.3.39/ tena^udaka.prāṇi.bhaya.pratīkārā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.39/ By this, the remedies against dangers from aquatic creatures are explained.

children.text: KAZ04.3.40/ rakṣo.bhaye rakṣo.ghnāny atharva.vedavido māyā.yogavido vā karmāṇi kuryuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.40/ Against the danger of evil spirits: those learned in the <s>Atharva Veda</s> or those skilled in magical arts should perform spirit-destroying rites.

children.text: KAZ04.3.41/ parvasu ca vitardic.chatra.ullopikā.hasta.patākāc.chāga.upahāraiś caitya.pūjāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.41/ He should have worship of sacred sites performed at festivals, with offerings of raised platforms, parasols, streamers, hand-flags, and goats.

children.text: KAZ04.3.42/ "caruṃ vaś carāmaḥ" ity evaṃ sarva.bhayeṣv aho.rātraṃ careyuḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.42/ 'We are performing an offering for you' — with such [proclamations], they should patrol day and night during all calamities.

children.text: KAZ04.3.43/ sarvatra ca^upahatān pitā^iva^anugṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.3.43/ And everywhere he should protect the afflicted like a father.

children.text:
KAZ04.3.44ab/ māyā.yogavidas tasmād viṣaye siddha.tāpasāḥ /
KAZ04.3.44cd/ vaseyuḥ pūjitā rājñā daiva.āpat.pratikāriṇaḥ //E
children.translated_text:
KAZ04.3.44ab/ Therefore, those skilled in magical arts, accomplished ascetics,
KAZ04.3.44cd/ should reside in the realm, honored by the king, as counteractors of divine calamities.

children.text:
(ṅuarding against persons with secret means of income)
KAZ04.4.01/ samāhartṛ.praṇidhau jana.pada.rakṣaṇam uktam //
children.translated_text:
(Guarding against persons with secret means of income)
KAZ04.4.01/ The protection of the countryside under the collector's supervision has been stated.

children.text: KAZ04.4.02/ tasya kaṇṭaka.śodhanaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.4.02/ We shall now describe the removal of thorns [from it].

children.text: KAZ04.4.03/ samāhartā jana.pade siddha.tāpasa.pravrajita.cakra.cara.cāraṇa.kuhaka.pracchandaka.kārtāntika.naimittika.mauhūrtika.cikitsaka.unmatta.mūka.badhira.jaḍa.andha.vaidehaka.kāru.śilpi.kuśīlava.veśa.śauṇḍika.āpūpika.pākva.māṃsika.audanika.vyañjanān praṇidadhyāt //
children.translated_text: KAZ04.4.03/ The collector should deploy [agents] in the countryside in the guise of accomplished ascetics, wandering monks, itinerant fortune-tellers, conjurers, charlatans, fortune-tellers, diviners, astrologers, physicians, madmen, mutes, the deaf, dull, blind, traders, artisans, craftsmen, entertainers, distillers, liquor-sellers, cake-sellers, cooked-meat vendors, and rice-cake vendors.

children.text: KAZ04.4.04/ te grāmāṇām adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca śauca.āśaucaṃ vidyuḥ //
