children.translated_text: all [fires] together, with goat-fat and human [fat] that is permanent.

children.text:
KAZ14.1.38ab/ juhuyād agni.mantreṇa rāja.vṛkṣasya dārubhiḥ /
KAZ14.1.38cd/ eṣa niṣpratikāro^agnir dviṣatāṃ netra.mohanaḥ //
children.translated_text: One should offer with the fire-<s>mantra</s>, using wood of the <s>rāja-vṛkṣa</s> (royal tree). This is an irremediable fire that bewilders the eyes of enemies.

children.text: KAZ14.1.39/ adite namaste, anumate namaste, sarasvati namaste, deva savitar namāste //
children.translated_text: Homage to <s>Aditi</s>, homage to <s>Anumati</s>, homage to <s>Sarasvatī</s>, homage to the divine <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: KAZ14.1.40/ agnaye svāhā, somāya svāhā, bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā //E
children.translated_text: <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s> to <s>Soma</s>, <s>svāhā</s> to <s>Bhūḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s> to <s>Bhuvaḥ</s>.

children.text:
(pralambhanam, tatra adbhuta.utpādanam)
KAZ14.2.01/ śirīṣa.udumbara.śamī.cūrṇaṃ sarpiṣā saṃhṛtya^ardha.māsikaḥ kṣud.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Deception — therein, the production of marvels)
Powder of <s>śirīṣa</s>, <s>udumbara</s> (fig tree), and <s>śamī</s>, mixed with ghee — [enables] fasting for a half-month.

children.text: KAZ14.2.02/ kaśeruka.utpala.kandekṣu.mūla.bisa.dūrvā.kṣīra.ghṛta.maṇḍa.siddho māsikaḥ //
children.translated_text: A preparation cooked with <s>kaśeruka</s>, lotus bulb, sugarcane root, lotus root, <s>dūrvā</s> grass, milk, and ghee-cream — [enables fasting] for a month.

children.text: KAZ14.2.03/ māṣa.yava.kulattha.darbha.mūla.cūrṇaṃ vā kṣīra.ghṛtābhyām, vallī.kṣīra.ghṛtaṃ vā sama.siddham, sāla.pṛśni.parṇī.mūla.kalkaṃ payasā pītvā, payo vā tat.siddhaṃ madhu.ghṛtābhyām aśitvā māsam upavasati //
children.translated_text: Or, powder of black gram, barley, horse-gram, and <s>darbha</s>-grass root with milk and ghee; or a balanced preparation of creeper-milk and ghee; or a paste of <s>sāla-pṛśni-parṇī</s> root drunk with milk, or milk cooked with it and consumed with honey and ghee — [enables] fasting for a month.

children.text: KAZ14.2.04/ śveta.basta.mūtre sapta.rātra.uṣitaiḥ siddha.arthakaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ kaṭuka.ālābau māsa.ardha.māsa.sthitaṃ catuṣ.pada.dvi.padānāṃ virūpa.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: Oil prepared with white mustard seeds kept for seven nights in white goat's urine, stored in a bitter gourd for a half-month to a month — is a disfiguring agent for quadrupeds and bipeds.

children.text: KAZ14.2.05/ takra.yava.bhakṣasya sapta.rātrād ūrdhvaṃ śveta.gardabhasya leṇḍa.yavaiḥ siddhaṃ gaura.sarṣapa.tailaṃ virūpa.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: After seven days of feeding [an animal] on buttermilk and barley, oil of white mustard seeds prepared with the dung-grains of a white donkey — is a disfiguring agent.

children.text: KAZ14.2.06/ etayor anyatarasya mūtra.leṇda.rasa.siddhaṃ siddha.arthaka.tailam arka.tūla.pataṅga.cūrṇa.pratīvāpaṃ śvetī.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: Oil of white mustard seeds prepared with the urine, dung-juice of either of these, with a final admixture of <s>arka</s> cotton and lac powder — is a whitening agent.

children.text: KAZ14.2.07/ śveta.kukkuṭa.ajagara.leṇḍa.yogaḥ śvetī.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: A compound of droppings of white rooster and python is a whitening agent.

children.text: KAZ14.2.08/ śveta.basta.mūtre śveta.sarṣapāḥ sapta.rātra.uṣita.astakra(?).marka..kṣīra.lavaṇaṃ dhānyaṃ ca pakṣa.sthito yogaḥ śvetī.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: White mustard seeds kept for seven nights in white goat's urine, with buttermilk, <s>marka</s>-milk, salt, and grain — this compound, stored for a fortnight, is a whitening agent.

children.text: KAZ14.2.09/ kaṭuka.alābau valī.gate gataṃ.ardha.māsa.sthitaṃ gaura.sarṣapa.piṣṭaṃ romṇāṃ śvetī.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: White mustard paste stored in a wrinkled bitter gourd for a half-month — is a whitening agent for hair.

children.text:
KAZ14.2.10ab/ alojuneti yaḥ kīṭaḥ śvetā ca gṛha.golikā /
KAZ14.2.10cd/ etena piṣtena^abhyaktāḥ keśāḥ syuḥ śaṅkha.pāṇḍarāḥ //
children.translated_text: The insect called <s>alojuneti</s> and the white house-lizard — with a paste of these applied, the hair becomes conch-shell white.

children.text: KAZ14.2.11/ gomayena tinduka.ariṣṭa.kalkena vā mardita.aṅgasya bhallātaka.rasa.anuliptasya māsikaḥ kuṣṭha.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: One whose body is rubbed with cow-dung or a paste of <s>tinduka</s> and <s>ariṣṭa</s>, and anointed with <s>bhallātaka</s> (marking-nut) juice — the leprosy-producing compound [takes effect] in a month.

children.text: KAZ14.2.12/ kṛṣṇa.sarpa.mukhe gṛha.golikā.mukhe vā sapta.rātra.uṣitā gujjāḥ kuṣṭha.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Guñjā</s> (rosary pea) seeds kept for seven nights in the mouth of a black snake or house-lizard — is a leprosy-producing compound.

children.text: KAZ14.2.13/ śuka.pitta.aṇḍa.rasa.abhyaṅgaḥ kuṣṭha.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: An ointment of parrot bile and egg-juice is a leprosy-producing compound.

children.text: KAZ14.2.14/ kuṣṭhasya.priyāla.kalka.kaṣāyaḥ pratīkāraḥ //
children.translated_text: The remedy for leprosy is a decoction-paste of <s>priyāla</s>.

children.text: KAZ14.2.15/ kukkuṭa.kośa.atakī(?).śatāvarī.mūla.yuktam āhārayamāṇo māsena gauro bhavati //
children.translated_text: One who eats food combined with the roots of <s>kukkuṭa</s>, <s>kośa-atakī</s>, and <s>śatāvarī</s> becomes fair-complexioned within a month.

children.text: KAZ14.2.16/ vaṭa.kaṣāya.snātaḥ saha.cara.kalka.digdhaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavati //
children.translated_text: One bathed in a decoction of banyan and anointed with a paste of <s>saha-cara</s> becomes dark.

children.text: KAZ14.2.17/ śakuna.kaṇgu.taila.yuktā hari.tāla.manaḥ.śilāḥ śyāmī.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: <s>Hari-tāla</s> (orpiment) and realgar mixed with <s>śakuna-kaṅgu</s> oil is a darkening agent.

children.text: KAZ14.2.18/ kha.dyota.cūrṇaṃ sarṣapa.taila.yuktaṃ rātrau jvalati //
children.translated_text: Firefly powder mixed with mustard oil glows at night.

children.text: KAZ14.2.19/ kha.dyota.gaṇḍū.pada.cūrṇaṃ samudra.jantūnāṃ bhṛṅga.kapālānāṃ khadira.karṇikārāṇāṃ puṣpa.cūrṇaṃ vā śakuna.kaṅgu.taila.yuktaṃ tejana.cūrṇam //
children.translated_text: Powder of fireflies and earthworms — or flower-powder of marine creatures, <s>bhṛṅga</s> shells, <s>khadira</s>, and <s>karṇikāra</s> — mixed with <s>śakuna-kaṅgu</s> oil, is a luminous powder.

children.text: KAZ14.2.20/ pāribhadraka.tvan.maṣī maṇḍūka.vasayā yuktā gātra.prajvālanam agninā //
children.translated_text: Ink from <s>pāribhadraka</s> bark mixed with frog-fat is a body-igniting agent [that appears to burn but does not harm].

children.text: KAZ14.2.21/ paribhadraka.tvak.tila.kalka.pradigdhaṃ śarīram agninā jvalati //
children.translated_text: A body anointed with a paste of <s>pāribhadraka</s> bark and sesame appears to burn in fire.

children.text: KAZ14.2.22/ pīlu.tvan.maṣīmayaḥ piṇḍo haste jvalati //
children.translated_text: A ball made of <s>pīlu</s>-bark ink blazes in the hand.

children.text: KAZ14.2.23/ maṇḍūka.vasā.digdho^agninā jvalati //
children.translated_text: One anointed with frog-fat appears to blaze in fire.

children.text: KAZ14.2.24/ tena pradigdham aṅgaṃ kuśa.āmra.phala.taila.siktaṃ samudra.maṇḍūkī.phenaka.sarja.rasa.cūrṇa.yuktaṃ vā jvalati //
children.translated_text: A limb anointed with this, sprinkled with <s>kuśa</s>-mango-fruit oil, or mixed with the powder of sea-foam, <s>maṇḍūkī</s> froth, and <s>sarja</s> resin, blazes [without harm].

children.text: KAZ14.2.25/ maṇḍūka.kulīra.ādīnāṃ vasayā sama.bhāgaṃ tailaṃ siddham abhyaṅgaṃ gātrāṇām agni.prajvālanam //
children.translated_text: Oil prepared with equal parts of the fat of frogs, crabs, and others — used as a body ointment, [enables apparent] blazing in fire.

children.text: KAZ14.2.26/ veṇu.mūla.śaivala.liptam aṅgaṃ maṇḍūka.vasā.digdham agninā jvalati //
children.translated_text: A limb coated with bamboo-root and <s>śaivala</s> (moss), anointed with frog-fat, appears to blaze in fire.

children.text: KAZ14.2.27/ pāribhadraka.ppatibalā.vañjula.vajra.kadalī.mūla.kalkena maṇḍūka.vasā.siddhena tailena^abhyakta.pādo^aṅgāreṣu gacchati //
children.translated_text: One whose feet are anointed with an oil prepared with frog-fat and a paste of the roots of <s>pāribhadraka</s>, <s>pratibalā</s>, <s>vañjula</s>, <s>vajra-kadalī</s> — walks on hot coals.

children.text:
KAZ14.2.28ab/ upa.udakā pratibalā vañjulaḥ pāribhadrakaḥ /
KAZ14.2.28cd/ eteṣāṃ mūla.kalkena maṇḍūka.vasayā saha //
children.translated_text: <s>Upa-udakā</s>, <s>pratibalā</s>, <s>vañjula</s>, and <s>pāribhadraka</s> — with the root-paste of these, together with frog-fat,

children.text:
KAZ14.2.29ab/ sādhayet tailam etena pādāv abhyajya nirmalau /
KAZ14.2.29cd/ aṅgāra.rāśau vicared yathā kusuma.saṃcaye //
children.translated_text: one should prepare oil; anointing the spotless feet with this, one may walk on a heap of coals as if on a bed of flowers.

children.text: KAZ14.2.30/ haṃsa.krauñca.mayūrāṇām anyeṣāṃ vā mahā.śakunīnām udaka.plavānāṃ puccheṣu baddhā nala.dīpikā rātrāv ulkā.darśanam //
children.translated_text: Reed-lamps tied to the tails of swans, herons, peacocks, or other large water-birds — at night, [create] the appearance of meteors.

children.text: KAZ14.2.31/ vaidyutaṃ bhasma.aṅgi.śamanam //
children.translated_text: Lightning-ash [a chemical compound] extinguishes fire.

children.text: KAZ14.2.32/ strī.puṣpa.pāyitā māṣā vrajakulī.mūlaṃ maṇḍūka.vasā.miśraṃ culluyāṃ dīptāyām apācanam //
children.translated_text: Black gram fed with menstrual blood, and <s>vrajakulī</s> root mixed with frog-fat — [placed in] a blazing stove, [produce] non-cooking [of food].

children.text: KAZ14.2.33/ cullī.śodhanaṃ pratīkāraḥ //
children.translated_text: Cleaning the stove is the remedy.

children.text:
KAZ14.2.34/ pīlumayo maṇir agni.garbhaḥ suvarcalā.mūla.granthiḥ sūtra.granthir vā picu.pariveṣṭito mukhyād agni.dhūma.utsargaḥ //E
KAZ14.2.35/ kuśa.āmra.phala.taila.sikto^agnir varṣa.pravāteṣu jvalati //
children.translated_text:
A <s>pīlu</s>-wood jewel containing fire inside; a knot of <s>suvarcalā</s> root; or a knot of thread wrapped in cotton — [enables] the release of fire and smoke from the mouth.
Oil of <s>kuśa</s>-mango fruit — fire [fed with it] blazes in rain and wind.

children.text: KAZ14.2.36/ samudra.phenakas taila.yukto^ambhasi plavamāno jvalati //
children.translated_text: Sea-foam mixed with oil, floating on water, blazes.

children.text: KAZ14.2.37/ plavamānānām asthiṣu kalmāṣa.veṇunā nirmathito^agnir na^udakena śāmyati, udakena jvalati //
children.translated_text: Fire produced by friction on the bones of floating [creatures] with variegated bamboo is not extinguished by water — it blazes with water.

children.text: KAZ14.2.38/ śastra.hatasya śūla.protasya vā puruṣasya vāma.pārśva.parśuka.asthiṣu kalmāṣa.veṇunā nirmathito^agniḥ striyāḥ puruṣasya vā^asthiṣu manuṣya.parśukayā nirmathito^agnir yatra trir apasavyaṃ gacchati na ca^atra^anyo^agnir jvalati //
children.translated_text: Fire kindled with a spotted bamboo on the left-side rib-bones of a man slain by a weapon or impaled on a stake, or fire kindled with a human rib-bone on the bones of a woman or a man — wherever it goes counter-clockwise three times, no other fire burns there.

children.text:
KAZ14.2.39ab/ cuccundarī khañjarīṭaḥ khāra.kīṭaś ca piṣyate /
KAZ14.2.39cd/ aśva.mūtreṇa saṃsṛṣṭā nigalānāṃ tu bhañjanam //
children.translated_text: A musk-shrew, a wagtail, and a <s>khāra</s>-beetle are ground together; mixed with horse urine, [the paste] causes the breaking of fetters.

children.text: KAZ14.2.40/ ayas.kānto vā pāṣāṇaḥ kulīra.dardura.khāra.kīṭa.vasā.pradehena dvi.guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: Or, a lodestone [smeared] with the fat of crabs, frogs, and <s>khāra</s>-beetles doubles [its attracting power].

children.text: KAZ14.2.41/ nāraka.garbhaḥ kaṅka.bhāsa.pārśva.utpala.udaka.piṣṭaś catuṣ.pada.dvi.padānāṃ pāda.lepaḥ //
children.translated_text: A <s>nāraka</s>-compound — ground with the feathers of a heron, a <s>bhāsa</s> bird, and the blue lotus water — [applied as] a foot-ointment for quadrupeds and bipeds.

children.text: KAZ14.2.42/ ulūka.gṛdhra.vasābhyām uṣṭra.carma.upānahāv abhyajya vaṭapattraiḥ praticchādya pañcāśad.yojanāny aśrānto gacchati //
children.translated_text: Having anointed camel-hide sandals with the fat of owls and vultures and covering [the feet] with banyan leaves, one walks fifty <s>yojanas</s> without fatigue.

children.text: KAZ14.2.43/ śyena.kaṅka.kāka.gṛdhra.haṃsa.krauñca.vīcī.rallānāṃ majjāno retāṃsi vā yojana.śatāya, siṃha.vyāghra.dvīpa.kāka.ulūkānāṃ majjāno retāṃsi vā //
children.translated_text: The marrows or semen of hawks, herons, crows, vultures, geese, cranes, <s>vīcī</s> birds, and <s>ralla</s> birds [enable travel of] a hundred <s>yojanas</s>; [likewise] the marrows or semen of lions, tigers, leopards, crows, and owls.

children.text: KAZ14.2.44/ sārvavarṇikāni garbha.patanāny uṣṭrikāyām abhiṣūya śmaśāne preta.śiśūn vā tat.samutthitaṃ medo yojana.śatāya //
children.translated_text: All-caste embryos sewn into a she-camel, or the fat arising from stillborn children at a cremation ground — [enables travel of] a hundred <s>yojanas</s>.

children.text:
KAZ14.2.45a/ aniṣṭair adbhuta.utpātaiḥ parasya^udvegam ācaret /
KAZ14.2.45b/ ārājyāya^iti nirvādaḥ samānaḥ kopa ucyate //E
children.translated_text: Through inauspicious and portentous prodigies, one should cause alarm in the enemy. 'Until [the loss of] the kingdom' — this proclamation is called the same as sedition.

children.text:
(pralambhanam, tatra bhaiṣajya.mantra.yogah)
KAZ14.3.01/ mārjāra.uṣṭra.vṛka.varāha.śva.avi.dvāgulī.naptṛ.kāka.ulūkānām anyeṣāṃ vā niśā.carāṇāṃ sattvānām ekasya dvayor bahūnāṃ vā dakṣiṇāni vāmāni ca^akṣīṇi gṛhītvā dvidhā cūrṇaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text:
(Deception — therein, the application of medicines, spells, and magical formulas)
Taking the right and left eyes of one, two, or many nocturnal creatures — cats, camels, wolves, boars, dogs, sheep, <s>dvāgulī</s> birds, <s>naptṛ</s> birds, crows, and owls — or other such beings, one should make two [sets of] powder.

children.text: KAZ14.3.02/ tato dakṣiṇaṃ vāmena vāmaṃ dakṣiṇena samabhyajya rātrau tamasi ca paśyati //
children.translated_text: Then, anointing [the right eye] with the left [powder] and the left [eye] with the right [powder], one sees in the dark of night.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.03ab/ eka.āmlakaṃ varāha.akṣi kha.dyotaḥ kāla.śārivā /
KAZ14.3.03cd/ etena^abhyakta.nayano rātrau rūpāṇi paśyati //
children.translated_text: A single <s>āmalaka</s> (emblic myrrh), a boar's eye, a firefly, and <s>kāla-śārivā</s> (a medicinal plant) — with this applied to the eyes, one sees forms at night.

children.text: KAZ14.3.04/tri.rātra.upoṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa śastra.hatasya śūla.protasya vā puṃsaḥ śiraḥ.kapāle mṛttikāyāṃ yavān āvāsya^avikṣīreṇa secayet //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, in the skull of a man slain by a weapon or impaled on a stake, having sown barley in earth, one should water it with ewe's milk.

children.text: KAZ14.3.05/ tato yava.virūḍha.mālām ābadhya naṣṭac.chāyā.rūpaś carati //
children.translated_text: Then, wearing a garland of the sprouted barley, one moves about with shadow and form concealed.

children.text: KAZ14.3.06/ tri.ratra.upoṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa śva.mārjāra.ulūka.vāgulīnāṃ dakṣiṇāni vāmāni ca^akṣīṇi dvidhā cūrṇaṃ kārayet //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, one should make two [sets of] powder from the right and left eyes of dogs, cats, owls, and bats.

children.text: KAZ14.3.07/ tato yathā.svam abhyakta.akṣo naṣṭac.chāyā.rūpaś carati //
children.translated_text: Then, anointing each eye with the corresponding [powder], one moves about with shadow and form concealed.

children.text: KAZ14.3.08/ tri.rātra.upoṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa puruṣa.ghātinaḥ kāṇḍakasya śalākām añjanīṃ ca kārayet //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, one should make a collyrium stick and applicator from the arrow of one who has slain a man.

children.text: KAZ14.3.09/ tato anyatamena^akṣi.cūrṇena^abhyakta.akṣo naṣṭac.chāyā.rūpaś carati //
children.translated_text: Then, anointing the eye with either [set of] eye-powder, one moves about with shadow and form concealed.

children.text: KAZ14.3.10/ tri.rātra.upoṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa kālāyasīm añjanīṃ śalākāṃ ca kārayet //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, one should make an applicator and stick of dark iron.

children.text: KAZ14.3.11/ tato niśā.carāṇāṃ sattvānām anyatamasya śiraḥ.kapālam añjanena pūrayitvā mṛtāyāḥ striyā yonau praveśya dāhayet //
children.translated_text: Then, filling the skull of any one of the nocturnal creatures with collyrium, inserting it into the womb of a dead woman, one should burn it.

children.text: KAZ14.3.12/ tad añjanaṃ puṣyeṇa^uddhṛtya tasyām añjanyāṃ nidadhyāt //
children.translated_text: That collyrium, extracted on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, should be placed in that applicator.

children.text: KAZ14.3.13/ tena^abhyakta.akṣo naṣṭa.chāyā.rūpaś carati //
children.translated_text: One anointed in the eyes with that moves about with shadow and form concealed.

children.text: KAZ14.3.14/ yatra brāhmaṇam āhita.agniṃ dagdhaṃ dahyamānaṃ vā paśyet tatra tri.rātra.upoṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa svayaṃ.mṛtasya vāsasā prasevaṃ kṛtvā citā.bhasmanā pūrayitvā tam ābadhya naṣṭac.chāyā.rūpaś carati //
children.translated_text: Wherever one sees a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who maintains the sacred fire being cremated or being burnt, there, having fasted for three nights, on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, making a pouch from the garment of one who died naturally, filling it with pyre-ash, and wearing it, one moves about with shadow and form concealed.

children.text: KAZ14.3.15/ brāhmaṇasya preta.kārye yo gaur māryate tasya^asthi.majja.cūrṇa.pūrṇā^ahi.bhastrā paśūnām antar.dhānam //
children.translated_text: Powder from the bones and marrow of a cow slaughtered at the funeral rites of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, placed in a serpent-skin bellows — this causes the disappearance of cattle.

children.text: KAZ14.3.16/ sarpa.daṣṭasya bhasmanā pūrṇā pracalāka.bhastrā mṛgāṇām antar.dhānam //
children.translated_text: A <s>pracalāka</s>-skin bellows filled with the ashes of one bitten by a serpent — this causes the disappearance of deer.

children.text: KAZ14.3.17/ ulūka.vāgulī.puccha.purīṣa.jānv.asthi.cūrṇa.pūrṇā^ahi.bhastrā pakṣiṇām antar.dhānam //
children.translated_text: A serpent-skin bellows filled with powder from the tails, excrement, knee-bones of owls and bats — this causes the disappearance of birds.

children.text: KAZ14.3.18/ ity aṣṭāv antar.dhāna.yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: Thus [there are] eight formulas for causing disappearance.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.19ab/ "baliṃ vairocanaṃ vande śata.māyaṃ ca śambaram /
KAZ14.3.19cd/ bhaṇḍīra.pākaṃ narakaṃ nikumbhaṃ kumbham eva ca //
children.translated_text: 'I salute <s>Bali Vairocana</s>, and <s>Śambara</s> of a hundred illusions, <s>Bhaṇḍīra-pāka</s>, <s>Naraka</s>, <s>Nikumbha</s>, and <s>Kumbha</s> as well,

children.text:
KAZ14.3.20ab/ devalaṃ nāradaṃ vande vande sāvarṇi.gālavam /
KAZ14.3.20cd/ eteṣām anuyogena kṛtaṃ te svāpanaṃ mahat //
children.translated_text: I salute <s>Devala</s> and <s>Nārada</s>, I salute <s>Sāvarṇi</s> and <s>Gālava</s>. By the practice of these, a great slumber has been created for you.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.21ab/ yathā svapanty ajagarāḥ svapanty api camū.khalāḥ /
KAZ14.3.21cd/ tathā svapantu puruṣā ye ca grāme kutūhalāḥ //
children.translated_text: Just as pythons sleep, and just as chameleons sleep, so may all persons sleep, and those in the village who are curious.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.22ab/ bhaṇḍakānāṃ sahasreṇa ratha.nemi.śatena ca /
KAZ14.3.22cd/ imaṃ gṛhaṃ pravekṣyāmi tūṣṇīm āsantu bhāṇḍakāḥ //
children.translated_text: With a thousand <s>bhaṇḍakas</s> (bundles) and a hundred chariot-rims, I shall enter this house — let the bundles be silent.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.23ab/ namas.kṛtvā ca manave baddhvā śunaka.phelakāḥ /
KAZ14.3.23cd/ ye devā deva.lokeṣu mānuṣeṣu ca brāhmaṇāḥ //
children.translated_text: Having saluted <s>Manu</s> and bound the dog-pegs — the gods who [dwell] in the divine worlds and the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> among men,

children.text:
KAZ14.3.24ab/ adhyayana.pāragāḥ siddhā ye ca kaulāsa tāpasāḥ /
KAZ14.3.24cd/ etebhyaḥ sarva.siddhebhyaḥ kṛtaṃ te svāpanaṃ mahat //
children.translated_text: The accomplished ones who have mastered learning, and the ascetics on <s>Kailāsa</s> — to all these accomplished ones, a great slumber has been created for you.

children.text: KAZ14.3.25/ atigacchanti ca mayy apagacchantu saṃhatāḥ //
children.translated_text: And [all obstacles] pass away from me — let them depart together.'

children.text: KAZ14.3.26/ alite, valite, manave svāhā //
children.translated_text: '<s>Alite</s>, <s>valite</s>, to <s>Manu</s> — <s>svāhā</s>.'

children.text: KAZ14.3.27/ etasya prayogaḥ //
children.translated_text: This is its application:

children.text: KAZ14.3.28/ tri.rātra.upoṣitaḥ kṛṣṇa.catur.daśyāṃ puṣya.yoginyāṃ śva.pākī.hastād vilakha.avalekhanaṃ krīṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight when <s>Puṣya</s> is in conjunction, one should purchase a scraping-instrument from the hand of a <s>Śvapākī</s> (outcaste woman).

children.text: KAZ14.3.29/ tan.māṣaiḥ saha kaṇḍolikāyāṃ kṛtvā^asaṃkīrṇa ādahane nikhānayet //
children.translated_text: Placing that together with black beans in a small basket, [keeping oneself] unpolluted, one should bury it in a cremation ground.

children.text: KAZ14.3.30/ dvitīyasyāṃ caturdaśyām uddhṛtya kumāryā peṣayitvā gulikāḥ kārayet //
children.translated_text: On the next fourteenth [of the dark fortnight], having dug it up and ground it with a virgin [girl's help], one should make pills.

children.text: KAZ14.3.31/ tata ekāṃ gulikām abhimantrayitvā yatra^etana mantreṇa kṣipati tat sarvaṃ prasvāpayati //
children.translated_text: Then, having consecrated one pill with this <s>mantra</s>, wherever one throws it, it puts everything to sleep.

children.text: KAZ14.3.32/ etena^eva kalpena śvā.vidhaḥ śalyakaṃ tri.kālaṃ triśvetam asaṃkīrṇa ādahane nikhānayet //
children.translated_text: By this same procedure, a porcupine's quill — [taken] three times at dawn — [should be buried] unpolluted in a cremation ground.

children.text: KAZ14.3.33/ dvitīyasyāṃ caturdaśyām uddhṛtya^ādahana.bhasmanā saha yatra.etena mantreṇa kṣipati tat sarvaṃ prasvāpayati //
children.translated_text: On the next fourteenth of the dark fortnight, having dug it up together with the cremation-ground ashes, wherever one throws [it] with this <s>mantra</s>, it puts everything to sleep.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.34ab/ "suvarṇa.puṣpīṃ brahmāṇīṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca kuśa.dhvajam /
KAZ14.3.34cd/ sarvāś ca devatā vande vande sarvāṃś ca tāpasān //
children.translated_text: 'I salute <s>Suvarṇa-puṣpī</s> and <s>Brahmāṇī</s>, and <s>Brahmā</s> with the <s>kuśa</s>-banner. I salute all deities and all ascetics.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.35ab/ vaśaṃ me brāhmaṇā yāntu bhūmi.pālāś ca kṣatriyāḥ /
KAZ14.3.35cd/ vaśaṃ vaiśyāś ca śūdrāś ca vaśatāṃ yāntu me sadā //
children.translated_text: May <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> come under my control, and <s>Kṣatriya</s> rulers of the earth; may <s>Vaiśyas</s> and <s>Śūdras</s> always come under my control.

children.text: KAZ14.3.36/ svāhā - amile kimile vayu.cāre prayoge phakke vayuhve vihāle danta.kaṭake svāhā //
children.translated_text: <s>Svāhā</s> — <s>amile</s> <s>kimile</s> <s>vayu-cāre</s> <s>prayoge</s> <s>phakke</s> <s>vayuhve</s> <s>vihāle</s> <s>danta-kaṭake</s> — <s>svāhā</s>.'

children.text:
KAZ14.3.37ab/ sukhaṃ svapantu śunakā ye ca grāme kutūhalāḥ /
KAZ14.3.37cd/ śvā.vidhaḥ śalyakaṃ ca^etat tri.śvetaṃ brahma.nirmitam //
children.translated_text: 'May the dogs sleep soundly, and those in the village who are curious. The porcupine's quill — this triple-white [substance] was fashioned by <s>Brahmā</s>.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.38ab/ prasuptāḥ sarva.siddhā hi etat te svāpanaṃ kṛtam /
KAZ14.3.38cd/ yāvad grāmasya sīmāntaḥ sūryasya^udgamanād iti //
children.translated_text: All the accomplished ones are fast asleep — this slumber has been created for you, up to the boundary of the village, until sunrise.'

children.text: KAZ14.3.39/ svāhā" //
children.translated_text: '<s>Svāhā</s>.'

children.text: KAZ14.3.40/ etasya prayogaḥ //
children.translated_text: This is its application:

children.text: KAZ14.3.41/ śvā.vidhaḥ śalyakāni tri.śvetāni, sapta.rātra.upoṣitaḥ kṛṣṇa.caturdaśyāṃ khādirābhiḥ samidhāmir(?) agnim etena mantreṇa^aṣṭa.śata.sampātaṃ kṛtvā madhu.ghṛtābhyām abhijuhuyāt //
children.translated_text: Porcupine quills, triple-white — having fasted for seven nights, on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, having performed eight hundred oblations into the fire with <s>khadira</s>-wood kindling using this <s>mantra</s>, one should offer [a final oblation] with honey and ghee.

children.text: KAZ14.3.42/ tata ekam etena mantreṇa grāma.dvāri gṛha.dvāri vā yatra nikhanyate tat sarvaṃ prasvāpayati //
children.translated_text: Then, burying one [quill] with this <s>mantra</s> at the village gate or the house gate, it puts everything there to sleep.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.43ab/ "baliṃ vairocanaṃ vande śatamāyaṃ ca śambaram /
KAZ14.3.43cd/ nikumbhaṃ narakaṃ kumbhaṃ tantu.kacchaṃ mahā.asuram //
children.translated_text: 'I salute <s>Bali Vairocana</s>, and <s>Śambara</s> of a hundred illusions, <s>Nikumbha</s>, <s>Naraka</s>, <s>Kumbha</s>, <s>Tantu-kaccha</s> the great <s>Asura</s>,

children.text:
KAZ14.3.44ab/ armālavaṃ pramīlaṃ ca maṇḍa.ulūkaṃ ghaṭa.ubalam /
KAZ14.3.44cd/ kṛṣṇa.kaṃsa.upacāraṃ ca paulomīṃ ca yaśasvinīm //
children.translated_text: <s>Armālava</s> and <s>Pramīla</s>, <s>Maṇḍa-ulūka</s> and <s>Ghaṭa-ubala</s>, and the worship of <s>Kṛṣṇa-kaṃsa</s>, and the illustrious <s>Paulomī</s>.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.45ab/ abhimantrayitvā gṛhṇāmi siddhy.arthaṃ śava.śārikām /
KAZ14.3.45cd/ jayatu jayati ca namaḥ śalaka.bhūtebhyaḥ svāhā //
children.translated_text: Having consecrated, I take the corpse-<s>śārikā</s> for the sake of success. Victory, victory — homage to the <s>śalaka</s>-spirits — <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.46ab/ sukhaṃ svapantu śunakā ye ca grāme kutūhalāḥ /
KAZ14.3.46cd/ sukhaṃ svapantu siddha.arthā yam arthaṃ mārgayāmahe /
KAZ14.3.46ec/ yāvad astam ayād udayo yāvad arthaṃ phalaṃ mama //
children.translated_text: May the dogs sleep soundly, and those in the village who are curious. May those whose purpose is accomplished sleep soundly — for the goal we seek, until sunset comes and my purpose bears fruit.'

children.text: KAZ14.3.47/ iti svāhā //
children.translated_text: Thus, <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: KAZ14.3.48/ etasya prayogaḥ //
children.translated_text: This is its application:

children.text: KAZ14.3.49/ catur.bhakta.upavāsī kṛṣṇa.caturdaśyām asaṃkīrṇa ādahane baliṃ kṛtvā^etena mantreṇa śava.śārikāṃ gṛhītvā pautrī.poṭṭalikaṃ badhnīyāt //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for four meals, on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, making an offering at the cremation ground [while] unpolluted, having taken a corpse-<s>śārikā</s> with this <s>mantra</s>, one should tie it in a <s>pautrī</s>-leaf packet.

children.text: KAZ14.3.50/ tan.madhye śvā.vidhaḥ śalyakena viddhvā yatra^etena mantreṇa nikhanyate tat sarvaṃ prasvāpayati //
children.translated_text: Piercing the middle of that with a porcupine's quill, wherever one buries it with this <s>mantra</s>, it puts everything to sleep.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.51ab/ "upaimi śaraṇaṃ ca^agniṃ daivatāni diśo daśa /
KAZ14.3.51cd/ apayāntu ca sarvāṇi vaśatāṃ yāntu me sadā //
children.translated_text: 'I take refuge in fire, in the deities, and in the ten directions. May all [obstacles] depart and always come under my control.

children.text: KAZ14.3.52/ svāhā" //
children.translated_text: <s>Svāhā</s>.'

children.text: KAZ14.3.53/ etasya prayogaḥ //
children.translated_text: This is its application:

children.text: KAZ14.3.54/ tri.rātra.uposṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa śarkarā eka.viṃśati.sampātaṃ kṛtvā madhu.ghṛtābhyām abhijuhuyāt //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, having performed twenty-one oblations with sugar, one should offer [the final oblation] with honey and ghee.

children.text: KAZ14.3.55/ tato gandha.mālyena pūjayitvā nikhānayet //
children.translated_text: Then, having worshipped [the sugar pieces] with incense and garlands, one should bury them.

children.text: KAZ14.3.56/ dvitīyena puṣyeṇa^uddhṛtya^ekāṃ śarkarām abhimantrayitvā kapāṭam āhanyāt //
children.translated_text: On the next <s>Puṣya</s>, having dug them up and consecrated one sugar-piece with the <s>mantra</s>, one should strike the door-bolt.

children.text: KAZ14.3.57/ abhyantarm catasṛṇāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ dvāram apāvriyate //
children.translated_text: With four sugar-pieces from within, the door is opened.

children.text: KAZ14.3.58/ catur.bhakta.upavāsī kṛṣṇa.caturdaśyāṃ bhagnasya puruṣasya^asthnā ṛṣabhaṃ kārayet, abhimantrayec ca^etena //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for four meals, on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, one should make a small bull-figure from the bone of a broken man, and consecrate it with this [<s>mantra</s>].

children.text: KAZ14.3.59/ dvi.go.yuktaṃ go.yānam āhṛtaṃ bhavati //
children.translated_text: A cart yoked with two oxen is obtained.

children.text: KAZ14.3.60/ tataḥ parama.ākāśe virāmati //
children.translated_text: Then it stops at the highest point of the sky.

children.text: KAZ14.3.61/ ravi.sagandhaḥ parighamati sarvaṃ pṛṇāti //
children.translated_text: [One anointed with] <s>ravi-sagandha</s> (a sun-scented substance) moves everywhere and satisfies all.

children.text: KAZ14.3.62/ "caṇḍālī.kumbhī.tumba.kaṭuka.sāra.oghaḥ sanārī.bhago^asi - svāhā //
children.translated_text: '<s>Caṇḍālī</s>-pot, <s>tumba</s>, sharp essence, flood — you possess the sacred share — <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: KAZ14.3.63/ tāla.udghāṭanaṃ prasvāpanaṃ ca //
children.translated_text: Lock-opening and sleep-inducing [formula].'

children.text:
KAZ14.3.64/ tri.rātra.upoṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa śastra.hatasya śūla.protasya vā puṃsaḥ śiraḥ.kapāle mṛttikāyāṃ tuvarī.rāvāsya^udakena secayet //(?)
KAZ14.3.65/ jātānāṃ puṣyeṇa^eva gṛhītvā rajjukāṃ vartayet //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, on the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation, in the skull of a man slain by a weapon or impaled on a stake, having sown <s>tuvarī</s> (pigeon pea) seeds in earth, one should water them. Having taken the grown [plants] on the <s>Puṣya</s> [constellation] itself, one should twist a cord.

children.text: KAZ14.3.66/ tataḥ sajyānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ yantrāṇāṃ ca purastāc chedanaṃ jyāc.chedanaṃ karoti //
children.translated_text: Then, it cuts the strings of strung bows and the strings of mechanical devices placed before [it].

children.text: KAZ14.3.67/ udaka.ahi.bhastrām ucchvāsa.mṛttikayā striyāḥ puruṣasya vā pūrayet, nāsikā.bandhanaṃ mukha.grahaś ca //
children.translated_text: One should fill a water-serpent-skin bellows with the exhalation-earth of a woman or a man — [it causes] nasal blockage and mouth-seizing.

children.text: KAZ14.3.68/ varāha.bhastrām ucchvāsamṛttikayā pūrayitvā markaṭa.snāyunā^avabadhnīyāt, ānāha.kāraṇam //
children.translated_text: Having filled a boar-skin bellows with exhalation-earth and tied it with a monkey's sinew — [it serves as] a cause of constipation.

children.text: KAZ14.3.69/ kṛṣṇa.caturdaśyāṃ śastra.hatāyā goḥ kapilāyāḥ pittena rāja.vṛkṣamayīm amitra.pratimām añjyāt, andhī.karaṇam //
children.translated_text: On the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, with the bile of a tawny cow slain by a weapon, one should anoint an image of the enemy made of <s>rāja-vṛkṣa</s> (castor) wood — [this causes] blinding.

children.text: KAZ14.3.70/ catur.bhakta.upavāsī kṛṣṇa.caturdaśyāṃ baliṃ kṛtvā śūla.protasya puruṣasya^asthnā kīlakān kārayet //
children.translated_text: Having fasted for four meals, on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, having made an offering, one should fashion pegs from the bone of a man impaled on a stake.

children.text: KAZ14.3.71/ eteṣām ekaḥ purīṣe mūtre vā nikhāta ānāhaṃ karoti, pade^asya^āsane vā nikhātaḥ śoṣeṇa mārayati, āpaṇe kṣetre gṛhe vā vṛttic.chedaṃ karoti //
children.translated_text: Of these, one [such peg], buried in feces or urine, causes constipation; buried in [someone's] footprint or seat, it kills by wasting; [buried] in a shop, field, or house, it destroys livelihood.

children.text: KAZ14.3.72/ etena^eva kalpena vidyud.dagdhasya vṛkṣasya kīlakā vyākhyātāḥ //
children.translated_text: By the same procedure, the pegs [made from] a tree struck by lightning are explained.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.73ab/ punar navam avācīnaṃ nimbaḥ kāma.madhuś ca yaḥ /
KAZ14.3.73cd/ kapi.roma manuṣya.asthi baddhvā mṛtaka.vāsasā //
children.translated_text: Fresh and [planted] face-down <s>nimba</s> (neem), <s>kāmamadhu</s>, monkey hair, and human bone, bound with a corpse's garment —

children.text:
KAZ14.3.74ab/ nikhanyate gṛhe yasya dṛṣṭvā vā yat padaṃ nayet /
KAZ14.3.74cd/ saputra.dāraḥ sadhana.strīn pakṣān na^ativartate //
children.translated_text: when buried in [someone's] house, or when one sees it and steps [on it], [that person], together with wife, children, and wealth, does not survive beyond three fortnights.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.75ab/ punar navam avācīnaṃ nimbaḥ kāma.madhuś ca yaḥ /
KAZ14.3.75cd/ svayaṃ.guptā manuṣya.asthi pade yasya nikhanyate //
children.translated_text: Fresh and [planted] face-down <s>nimba</s>, <s>kāmamadhu</s>, <s>svayaṃguptā</s> (Mucuna pruriens), and human bone — when buried in [someone's] footprint,

children.text:
KAZ14.3.76ab/ dvāre gṛhasya senāyā grāmasya nagarasya vā /
KAZ14.3.76cd/saputra.dāraḥ sadhana.strīn pakṣān na^ativartate //
children.translated_text: or at the gate of a house, army, village, or city — [that person], together with wife, children, and wealth, does not survive beyond three fortnights.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.77ab/ aja.markaṭa.romāṇi mārjāra.nakulasya ca /
KAZ14.3.77cd/ brāhmaṇānāṃ śva.pākānāṃ kāka.ulūkasya ca^āharet /
KAZ14.3.77cd/ etena viṣṭhā^avakṣuṇṇā sadya utsāda.kārikā //
children.translated_text: One should collect the hairs of a goat, monkey, cat, and mongoose, [and those of] <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> and outcasts, and [feathers of] crows and owls. Feces mixed with these immediately cause destruction.

children.text:
KAZ14.3.78ab/ preta.nirmālikā kiṇvaṃ romāṇi nakulasya ca /
KAZ14.3.78cd/ vṛścika.āly(?).ahi.kṛttiś ca pade yasya nikhanyate /
KAZ14.3.78ef/ bhavaty apuruṣaḥ sadyo yāvat tan na^apanīyate //
children.translated_text: Funeral-garland [remnants], yeast, mongoose hairs, and the skins of scorpions, lizards(?), and snakes — when buried in [someone's] footprint, he becomes impotent immediately, as long as it is not removed.

children.text: KAZ14.3.79/ tri.rātra.upoṣitaḥ puṣyeṇa śastra.hatasya śūla.protasya vā puṃsaḥ śiraḥ.kapāle mṛttikāyāṃ guñjā āvāsya^udakena secayet //
children.translated_text: After fasting for three nights, on [the day of the constellation] <s>Puṣya</s>, one should plant <s>guñjā</s> (rosary pea) seeds in clay inside the skull of a man killed by a weapon or impaled on a stake, and water [them].

children.text: KAZ14.3.80/ jātānām amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā puṣya.yoginyāṃ guñja.vallīr grāhayitvā maṇḍalikāni kārayet //
children.translated_text: When they have sprouted, on a new-moon or full-moon day coinciding with <s>Puṣya</s>, one should have the <s>guñjā</s> vines gathered and make [them into] bracelets.

children.text: KAZ14.3.81/ teṣv anna.pāna.bhājanāni nyastāni na kṣīyante //
children.translated_text: Food and drink vessels placed in these [bracelets] are never depleted.

children.text: KAZ14.3.82/ rātri.prekṣāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ pradīpa.agniṣu mṛta.dhenoḥ stanān utkṛtya dāhayet //
children.translated_text: When a night-entertainment has commenced, among the lamps and fires, one should cut off and burn the udders of a dead cow.

children.text: KAZ14.3.83/ dagdhān vṛṣa.mūtreṇa peṣayitvā nava.kumbham antar.lepayet //
children.translated_text: Having ground the burnt [remains] with bull's urine, one should coat the inside of a new pot [with the paste].

children.text: KAZ14.3.84/ taṃ grāmam apasavyaṃ pariṇīya yat tatra nyastaṃ nava.nītam eṣāṃ tat sarvam āgacchati //
children.translated_text: Having carried that pot counter-clockwise around the village, whatever fresh butter is stored there — all of it comes [to the bearer].

children.text: KAZ14.3.85/ kṛṣṇa.caturdaśyāṃ puṣya.yoginyāṃ śuno lagnakasya yonau kālāyasīṃ mudrikāṃ preṣayet //
children.translated_text: On the dark fourteenth [day of the month], coinciding with <s>Puṣya</s>, one should send an iron ring through the vagina of a bitch in heat.

children.text: KAZ14.3.85/ tāṃ svayaṃ patitāṃ gṛhṇīyāt //
children.translated_text: One should pick it up when it falls out on its own.

children.text: KAZ14.3.87/ tayā vṛkṣa.phalāny ākāritāny āgacchanti //
children.translated_text: With that [ring], fruits from trees, when summoned, come [of their own accord].

children.text:
KAZ14.3.88ab/ mantra.bhaiṣajya.samyuktā yogā māyā.kṛtāś ca ye /
KAZ14.3.88cd/ upahanyād amitrāṃs taiḥ sva.janaṃ ca^abhipālayet //E
children.translated_text: These practices, combined with spells and medicines, and those fashioned through illusion — with these one should strike enemies and protect one's own people.

children.text:
(sva.bala.upaghāta.pratīkārah)
KAZ14.4.01/ sva.pakṣe para.prayuktānāṃ dūṣī.viṣa.garāṇāṃ pratīkāraḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Countermeasures against harm to one's own forces)
Countermeasures against poisonous substances and toxic mixtures deployed by the enemy against one's own side:

children.text: KAZ14.4.02/ śleṣmātaka.kapittha.danti.danta.śaṭha.goji.śirīṣa.pāṭalī.balāsyonāga.punar.navā.śveta.vāraṇa.kvātha.yuktam(?) candana.sālā.vṛkī.lohita.yuktaṃ nejana.udakaṃ rāja.upabhogyānāṃ guhya.prakṣālanaṃ strīṇām, senāyāś ca viṣa.pratīkāraḥ //
children.translated_text: Washing-water [made from] a decoction of <s>śleṣmātaka</s>, <s>kapittha</s> (wood apple), <s>danti</s>, <s>dantaśaṭha</s>, <s>goji</s>, <s>śirīṣa</s>, <s>pāṭalī</s>, <s>balā</s>, <s>syonāga</s>, <s>punarnava</s>, and <s>śvetavāraṇa</s>, combined with <s>candana</s> (sandalwood), <s>sālā</s>, <s>vṛkī</s>, and <s>lohita</s> — [this serves as] the intimate wash for the king's women, and as a poison-antidote for the army.

children.text: KAZ14.4.03/ pṛṣata.nakula.nīla.kaṇṭha.godhā.pitta.yuktaṃ mahī.rājī.cūrṇaṃ sindu.vārita.varaṇa.vāruṇī.taṇḍulīyaka.śata.parva.agra.piṇḍītaka.yogo madana.doṣa.haraḥ //
children.translated_text: A powder of <s>mahīrājī</s> combined with the bile of a spotted deer, mongoose, peacock, and <s>godhā</s> (iguana), [mixed with] a compound of <s>sinduvārita</s>, <s>varaṇa</s>, <s>vāruṇī</s>, <s>taṇḍulīyaka</s>, <s>śataparva</s>, and the tip of <s>piṇḍītaka</s> — [this is] a remedy for intoxicant-poisoning.

children.text: KAZ14.4.04/ sṛgāla.vinnā.madana.sindu.vārita.varaṇa.vāraṇa.valī.mūla.kaṣāyāṇām anyatamasya samastānāṃ vā kṣīra.yuktaṃ pānaṃ madana.doṣa.haram //
children.translated_text: A drink mixed with milk, [made from] a decoction of any one or all of <s>sṛgālavinnā</s>, <s>madana</s>, <s>sinduvārita</s>, <s>varaṇa</s>, and <s>vāraṇavalī</s> root — [this is] a remedy for intoxicant-poisoning.

children.text: KAZ14.4.05/ kaiḍarya.pūti.tila.tailam unmāda.haraṃ nastaḥ.karma //
children.translated_text: Oil of <s>kaiḍarya</s> and rancid sesame, [applied as] a nasal treatment — [this is] a remedy for madness.

children.text: KAZ14.4.06/ priyaṅgu.nakta.māla.yogaḥ kuṣṭha.haraḥ //
children.translated_text: A compound of <s>priyaṅgu</s> and <s>naktamāla</s> — [this is] a remedy for skin disease.

children.text: KAZ14.4.07/ kuṣṭha.lodhra.yogaḥ pāka.śoṣaghnaḥ //
children.translated_text: A compound of <s>kuṣṭha</s> and <s>lodhra</s> — [this] cures inflammation and wasting.

children.text: KAZ14.4.08/ kaṭa.phala.dravantī.vilaṅga.cūrṇaṃ nastaḥ.karma śiro.roga.haram //
children.translated_text: A powder of <s>kaṭaphala</s>, <s>dravantī</s>, and <s>vilaṅga</s>, [applied as] a nasal treatment — [this] cures head ailments.

children.text: KAZ14.4.09/ priyaṅgu.mañjiṣṭhāta.garalā.kṣāra.samadhuka.haridrā.kṣaudra.yogo rajju.udaka.viṣa.prahāra.patana.nihsaṃjñānāṃ punaḥ.pratyānayanāya //
children.translated_text: A compound of <s>priyaṅgu</s>, <s>mañjiṣṭhā</s>, <s>atagaralā</s>, alkali, <s>samadhuka</s>, <s>haridrā</s> (turmeric), and honey — [this is] for reviving those who have lost consciousness from hanging, drowning, poison, assault, or falling.

children.text: KAZ14.4.10/ manuṣyāṇām akṣa.mātram, gava.aśvānāṃ dvi.guṇam, catur.guṇaṃ hasty.uṣṭrāṇām //
children.translated_text: For humans, a dose the size of an <s>akṣa</s>-fruit; for cattle and horses, double; for elephants and camels, quadruple.

children.text: KAZ14.4.11/ rukma.garbhaś ca^eṣāṃ maṇiḥ sarva.viṣa.haraḥ //
children.translated_text: And a gold-centered gem among these is an antidote for all poisons.

children.text: KAZ14.4.12/ jīvantī.śvetā.muṣkaka.puṣpa.vandākānām akṣīve jātasya^aśvatthasya maṇiḥ sarva.viṣa.haraḥ //
children.translated_text: A gem [made from] the <s>aśvattha</s> (sacred fig) tree born on a day of non-intoxication [under the constellation] of <s>jīvantī</s>, <s>śvetā</s>, <s>muṣkaka</s>, <s>puṣpa</s>, and <s>vandāka</s> — [this is] an antidote for all poisons.

children.text:
KAZ14.4.13ab/ tūryāṇāṃ taiḥ praliptānāṃ śabdo viṣa.vināśanaḥ /
KAZ14.4.13cd/ lipta.dhvajaṃ patākāṃ vā dṛṣṭvā bhavati nirviṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: The sound of instruments smeared with these destroys poison; and one who sees a banner or flag smeared [with them] becomes free from poison.

children.text:
KAZ14.4.14ab/ etaiḥ kṛtvā pratīkāraṃ sva.sainyānām atha^ātmanaḥ /
KAZ14.4.14cd/ amitreṣu prayuñjīta viṣa.dhūma.ambu.dūṣaṇān //E
children.translated_text: Having thus prepared countermeasures for one's own forces and for oneself, one should deploy poison, smoke, and water-contaminants against enemies.

children.text:
(tantra.yuktayah)
KAZ15.1.01/ manuṣyāṇāṃ vṛttir arthaḥ, manuṣyavatī bhūmir ity arthaḥ //
children.translated_text:
(Elements of composition)
The livelihood of people is <s>artha</s> (wealth); the meaning [of 'earth'] is land inhabited by people.

children.text: KAZ15.1.02/ tasyāḥ pṛthivyā lābha.pālana.upāyaḥ śāstram artha.śāstram iti //
children.translated_text: The science that is the means of acquiring and protecting that earth is the <s>śāstra</s> [called] <s>Arthaśāstra</s>.

children.text:
KAZ15.1.03/ tad.dvātriṃśad yukti.yuktaṃ - adhikaraṇam, vidhānam, yogaḥ, pada.arthaḥ, hetv.arthaḥ, uddeśaḥ, nirdeśaḥ, upadeśaḥ, apadeśaḥ, atideśaḥ, pradeśaḥ, upamānam, artha.āpattiḥ, saṃśayaḥ, prasaṅgaḥ, viparyayaḥ, vākya.śeṣaḥ, anumatam, vyākhyānam, nirvacanam, nidarśanam, apavargaḥ, sva.saṃjñā, pūrva.pakṣaḥ, uttara.pakṣaḥ, eka.antaḥ, anāgata.avekṣaṇam,
atikrānta.avekṣaṇam, niyogaḥ, vikalpaḥ, samuccayaḥ ūhyam iti //
children.translated_text: It is endowed with thirty-two compositional elements: subject-matter (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>), arrangement (<s>vidhāna</s>), connection (<s>yoga</s>), word-meaning (<s>padārtha</s>), reason-meaning (<s>hetvārtha</s>), summary statement (<s>uddeśa</s>), detailed statement (<s>nirdeśa</s>), instruction (<s>upadeśa</s>), citation of authority (<s>apadeśa</s>), extension (<s>atideśa</s>), illustration (<s>pradeśa</s>), analogy (<s>upamāna</s>), implication (<s>arthāpatti</s>), doubt (<s>saṃśaya</s>), incidental reference (<s>prasaṅga</s>), inversion (<s>viparyaya</s>), sentence-completion (<s>vākyaśeṣa</s>), approval (<s>anumata</s>), explanation (<s>vyākhyāna</s>), etymological derivation (<s>nirvacana</s>), exemplification (<s>nidarśana</s>), exception (<s>apavarga</s>), technical term (<s>svasaṃjñā</s>), prior position (<s>pūrvapakṣa</s>), counter-position (<s>uttarapakṣa</s>), definitive conclusion (<s>ekānta</s>), forward-reference (<s>anāgatāvekṣaṇa</s>), backward-reference (<s>atikrāntāvekṣaṇa</s>), injunction (<s>niyoga</s>), alternative (<s>vikalpa</s>), combination (<s>samuccaya</s>), and that which is to be inferred (<s>ūhya</s>).

children.text: KAZ15.1.04/ yam artham adhikṛtya^ucyate tad adhikaraṇam //
children.translated_text: The subject in respect of which [something] is stated — that is <s>adhikaraṇa</s> (subject-matter).

children.text: KAZ15.1.05/ "pṛthivyā lābhe pālane ca yāvanty artha.śāstrāṇi pūrva.ācāryaiḥ prasthāpitāni prāyaśas tāni saṃhṛtya^ekam idam artha.śāstraṃ kṛtam" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Having compiled most of the treatises on the acquisition and protection of the earth promulgated by earlier teachers, this single <s>Arthaśāstra</s> has been composed.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.06/ śāstrasya prakaraṇa.anupūrvī vidhānam //
children.translated_text: The sequential order of the topics of the treatise is <s>vidhāna</s> (arrangement).

children.text: KAZ15.1.07/ "vidyā.samuddeśaḥ, vṛddha.samyogaḥ, indriya.jayaḥ, amātya.utpattiḥ" ity evaṃ.ādikam iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Enumeration of sciences, association with elders, conquest of the senses, appointment of ministers' — and so forth.

children.text: KAZ15.1.08/ vākya.yojanā yogaḥ //
children.translated_text: The construction of a sentence is <s>yoga</s> (connection).

children.text: KAZ15.1.09/ "catur.varṇa.āśramo lokaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'The world consists of the four <s>varṇas</s> and <s>āśramas</s>.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.10/ pada.avadhikaḥ pada.arthaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Padārtha</s> (word-meaning) is that which defines the scope of a word.

children.text: KAZ15.1.11/ mūla.hara iti padam //
children.translated_text: The word is <s>mūlahara</s> (root-destroyer).

children.text: KAZ15.1.12/ "yaḥ pitṛ.paitāmaham artham anyāyena bhakṣayati sa mūla.haraḥ" ity arthaḥ //
children.translated_text: The meaning is: 'He who consumes the ancestral and paternal property unjustly is a root-destroyer.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.13/ hetur artha.sādhako hetv.arthaḥ //
children.translated_text: A reason that establishes the meaning is <s>hetvārtha</s> (reason-meaning).

children.text: KAZ15.1.14/ "artha.mūlau hi dharma.kāmau" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: '<s>Dharma</s> and <s>kāma</s> are indeed rooted in <s>artha</s>.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.15/ samāsa.vākyam uddeśaḥ //
children.translated_text: A statement in summary form is <s>uddeśa</s> (summary statement).

children.text: KAZ15.1.16/ "vidyā.vinaya.hetur indriya.jayaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Conquest of the senses is caused by training in learning.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.17/ vyāsa.vākyaṃ nirdeśaḥ //
children.translated_text: A statement in detailed form is <s>nirdeśa</s> (detailed statement).

children.text: KAZ15.1.18/ "karṇa.tvag.akṣi.jihvā.ghrāṇa.indriyāṇāṃ śabda.sparśa.rūpa.rasa.gandheṣv avipratipattir indriya.jayaḥ"iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'The non-confusion of the faculties of ear, skin, eye, tongue, and nose with respect to sound, touch, form, taste, and smell — that is conquest of the senses.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.19/ evaṃ vartitavyam ity upadeśaḥ //
children.translated_text: 'One should conduct oneself thus' — this is <s>upadeśa</s> (instruction).

children.text: KAZ15.1.20/ "dharma.artha.virodhena kāmaṃ seveta, na nihsukhaḥ syāt" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'One should enjoy <s>kāma</s> without conflict with <s>dharma</s> and <s>artha</s>; one should not be devoid of happiness.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.21/ evam asāv āha^ity apadeśaḥ //
children.translated_text: 'Such-and-such a one says thus' — this is <s>apadeśa</s> (citation of authority).

children.text: KAZ15.1.22/ "mantri.pariṣadaṃ dvādaśa.amātyān kurvīta^iti mānavāḥ - ṣoḍaśa^iti bārhaspatyāḥ - viṃśatim ity auśanasāḥ - yathā.sāmarthyam iti kauṭilyaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'One should appoint twelve ministers as the advisory council — say the followers of <s>Manu</s>; sixteen — say the followers of <s>Bṛhaspati</s>; twenty — say the followers of <s>Uśanas</s>; as many as are competent — says <s>Kauṭilya</s>.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.23/ uktena sādhanam atideśaḥ //
children.translated_text: Establishing [something new] by means of what has been stated — [this is] <s>atideśa</s> (extension).

children.text: KAZ15.1.24/ "dattasya^apradānam ṛṇa.ādānena vyākhyātam" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Non-return of what has been given is explained by [the rules on] debt-recovery.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.25/ vaktavyena sādhanaṃ pradeśaḥ //
children.translated_text: Establishing [something] by means of what is to be stated — [this is] <s>pradeśa</s> (illustration from what follows).

children.text: KAZ15.1.26/ "sāma.dāna.bheda.daṇḍair vā, yathā^āpatsu vyākhyāsyāmaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Through conciliation, gifts, dissension, and force — as we shall explain in [the section on] calamities.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.27/ dṛṣṭena^adṛṣṭasya sādhanam upamānam //
children.translated_text: Establishing the unseen by means of the seen — [this is] <s>upamāna</s> (analogy).

children.text: KAZ15.1.28/ "nivṛtta.parihārān pitā^iva^anugṛhṇīyāt" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'He should be gracious to those whose exemptions have lapsed, like a father.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.29/ yad anuktam arthād āpadyate sā^artha.āpattiḥ //
children.translated_text: That which, though unstated, follows from the meaning — that is <s>arthāpatti</s> (implication).

children.text:
KAZ15.1.30/ "loka.yātrāvid rājānam ātma.dravya.prakṛti.sampannaṃ priya.hita.dvāreṇa^āśrayeta"
KAZ15.1.31/ "na^apriya.hita.dvāreṇa^āśrayeta" ity arthād āpannaṃ bhavati^iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'One who knows the ways of the world should resort to a king endowed with personal qualities, resources, and subjects, through the path of the agreeable and beneficial' — that 'one should not resort through the path of the disagreeable and harmful' is implied by the meaning.

children.text: KAZ15.1.32/ ubhayato.hetumān arthaḥ saṃśayaḥ //
children.translated_text: A matter that has reasons on both sides — [this is] <s>saṃśaya</s> (doubt).

children.text: KAZ15.1.33/ "kṣīṇa.lubdha.prakṛtim apacarita.prakṛtiṃ vā" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: '[Whether to march against] one whose subjects are impoverished and greedy, or one whose subjects have been mistreated.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.34/ prakaraṇa.antareṇa samāno^arthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ //
children.translated_text: A matter that is related [to another] through a different topic — [this is] <s>prasaṅga</s> (incidental reference).

children.text: KAZ15.1.35/ "kṛṣi.karma.pradiṣṭāyāṃ bhūmau - iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'On land designated for agriculture — the same [applies] as before.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.36/ pratilomena sādhanaṃ viparyayaḥ //
children.translated_text: Establishing [something] by means of the reverse — [this is] <s>viparyaya</s> (inversion).

children.text: KAZ15.1.37/ "viparītam atuṣṭasya" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'The opposite for one who is discontented.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.38/ yena vākyaṃ samāpyate sa vākya.śeṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: That by which a sentence is completed — that is <s>vākyaśeṣa</s> (sentence-completion).

children.text: KAZ15.1.39/ "chinna.pakṣasya^iva rājñaś ceṣṭā.nāśaś ca" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Like a king whose wings have been clipped, the cessation of activity [follows].'

children.text: KAZ15.1.40/ tatra "śakuneḥ" iti vākya.śeṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: There, 'of a bird' is the sentence-completion.

children.text: KAZ15.1.41/ para.vākyam apratiṣiddham anumatam //
children.translated_text: Another's statement that is not refuted — [this is] <s>anumata</s> (approval).

children.text: KAZ15.1.42/ "pakṣāv urasyaṃ pratigraha ity auśanaso vyūha.vibhāgaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Wings, breast, and flank — [this is] the division of formations according to the followers of <s>Uśanas</s>.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.43/ atiśaya.varṇanā vyākhyānam //
children.translated_text: Extraordinary description — [this is] <s>vyākhyāna</s> (explanation).

children.text: KAZ15.1.44/ "viśeṣataś ca saṃghānāṃ saṃgha.dharmiṇāṃ ca rāja.kulānāṃ dyūta.nimitto bhedas tan.nimitto vināśa ity asat.pragrahaḥ pāpiṣṭhatamo vyasanānāṃ tantra.daurbalyāt" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'And especially for republics and for royal families following republican principles, the factional split caused by gambling and the destruction caused by it — [this is] the most wicked indulgence of vices, because of the weakness of the state [it causes].'

children.text: KAZ15.1.45/ guṇataḥ śabda.niṣpattir nirvacanam //
children.translated_text: Derivation of a word from its qualities — [this is] <s>nirvacana</s> (etymological derivation).

children.text: KAZ15.1.46/ "vyasyaty enaṃ śreyasa iti vyasanam" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'That which casts one away from prosperity is <s>vyasana</s> (vice).'

children.text: KAZ15.1.47/ dṛṣṭa.anto dṛṣṭa.anta.yukto nidarśanam //
children.translated_text: An illustration that has an observed conclusion — [this is] <s>nidarśana</s> (exemplification).

children.text: KAZ15.1.48/ "vigṛhīto hi jyāyasā hastinā pāda.yuddham iva.abhyupaiti" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'For one who has quarreled with a superior enters [the conflict] as if in foot-combat with an elephant.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.49/ abhipluta.vyapakarṣaṇam apavargaḥ //
children.translated_text: The disengagement from an overflow [of implications] — [this is] <s>apavarga</s> (exception).

children.text: KAZ15.1.50/ "nityam āsannam ari.balaṃ vāsayed anyatra^abhyantara.kopa.śaṅkāyāḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'One should always station the enemy's forces nearby — except when there is suspicion of internal sedition.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.51/ parair asamitaḥ śabdaḥ sva.saṃjñā //
children.translated_text: A word not shared with others — [this is] <s>svasaṃjñā</s> (technical term).

children.text: KAZ15.1.52/ "prathamā prakṛtiḥ, tasya bhūmy.anantarā dvitīyā, bhūmy.eka.antarā tṛtīyā" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'The first constituent element [is the immediate neighbor]; the one next to him in territory is the second; the one with one territory intervening is the third.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.53/ pratiṣeddhavyaṃ vākyaṃ pūrva.pakṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: A statement to be refuted — [this is] <s>pūrvapakṣa</s> (prior position).

children.text: KAZ15.1.54/ "svāmy.amātya.vyasanayor amātya.vyasanaṃ garīyaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Between calamities of the king and of the ministers, the calamity of the ministers is more serious.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.55/ tasya nirṇayana.vākyam uttara.pakṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: The statement that resolves it — [this is] <s>uttarapakṣa</s> (counter-position).

children.text: KAZ15.1.56/ "tad.āyattatvāt, tat.kūṭa.sthānīyo hi svāmī" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Because [everything] depends on him; for the king is the keystone.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.57/ sarvatra.āyattam eka.antaḥ //
children.translated_text: That which is applicable everywhere — [this is] <s>ekānta</s> (definitive conclusion).

children.text: KAZ15.1.58/ "tasmād utthānam ātmanaḥ kurvīta" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Therefore one should exert oneself.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.59/ paścād evaṃ vihitam ity anāgata.avekṣaṇam //
children.translated_text: 'This will be dealt with later in the following manner' — [this is] <s>anāgatāvekṣaṇa</s> (forward-reference).

children.text: KAZ15.1.60/ "tulā.pratimānaṃ pautava.adhyakṣe vakṣyāmaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'We shall discuss the balance and standard weights under the Superintendent of Weights.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.61/ purastād evaṃ vihitam ity atikrānta.aveṣkaṇam //
children.translated_text: 'This was dealt with earlier in the following manner' — [this is] <s>atikrāntāvekṣaṇa</s> (backward-reference).

children.text: KAZ15.1.62/ "amātya.sampad uktā purastāt" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'The qualifications of ministers have been stated earlier.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.63/ evaṃ na^anyathā^iti niyogaḥ //
children.translated_text: 'Thus and not otherwise' — [this is] <s>niyoga</s> (injunction).

children.text: KAZ15.1.64/ "tasmād dharmyam arthyaṃ ca^asya^upadiśet, na^adharmyam anarthaym ca" iti //
children.translated_text: As in: 'Therefore, one should instruct him in what is righteous and profitable, not in what is unrighteous and unprofitable.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.65/ anena vā^anena vā^iti vikalpaḥ //
children.translated_text: 'By this or by that' — [this is] <s>vikalpa</s> (alternative).

children.text: KAZ15.1.66/ "duhitaro vā dharmiṣṭheṣu vivāheṣu jātāḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: 'Or daughters born in the most righteous marriages.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.67/ anena ca^anena ca^iti samuccayaḥ //
children.translated_text: And this and that — [taken] in combination.

children.text: KAZ15.1.68/ "svayaṃjātaḥ pitur bandhūnāṃ ca dāyādaḥ" iti //
children.translated_text: 'A self-born [son] is the heir of his father and [his father's] kinsmen.'

children.text: KAZ15.1.69/ anukta.karaṇam ūhyam //
children.translated_text: What is unstated in the procedure should be inferred.

children.text:
KAZ15.1.70/ "yathā ca dātā pratigrahītā ca na^upahatau syātāṃ tathā^anuśayaṃ kuśalāḥ kalpayeyuḥ" iti
KAZ15.1.71ab/ evaṃ śāstram idaṃ yuktam etābhis tantra.yuktibhiḥ /
KAZ15.1.71cd/ avāptau pālane ca^uktaṃ lokasya^asya parasya ca //
children.translated_text:
'And the wise should arrange the settlement so that neither the giver nor the receiver is harmed.'
Thus this treatise, properly composed with these principles of systematic exposition, has been stated for the acquisition and protection of this world and the next.

children.text:
KAZ15.1.72ab/ dharmam arthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca pravartayati pāti ca /
KAZ15.1.72cd/ adharma.anartha.vidveṣān idaṃ śāstraṃ nihanti ca //
children.translated_text: This treatise promotes and protects <s>dharma</s> (righteousness), <s>artha</s> (wealth), and <s>kāma</s> (pleasure), and it destroys <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness), <s>anartha</s> (poverty), and <s>dveṣa</s> (hatred).

children.text:
KAZ15.1.73ab/ yena śāstraṃ ca śastraṃ ca nanda.rāja.gatā ca bhūḥ /
KAZ15.1.73cd/ amarṣeṇa^uddhṛtāny āśu tena śāstram idaṃ kṛtam //
children.translated_text: He by whom this science and the sword were swiftly wrested from the <s>Nanda</s> king along with the earth, out of indignation — by that [<s>Kauṭilya</s>] was this treatise composed.

children.text: EEE =End of the Arthaśāstra=
children.translated_text: =End of the <s>Arthaśāstra</s>=
